description: Audit Engagement Support Professional – Consultant- Deloitte Support Services India Private Limited Description of the role The primary role of Audit Engagement Support Professional will be to provide compliance support to Audit Practitioners in completing the documentation of various tasks and activities involved in an Audit engagement life cycle of Deloitte’s client. Work you’ll do • Create, draft, format, edit and finalize on complex business documents such as financial statements, Audit reports, proposals, engagement letters, and other client deliverables for Audit practitioners • Produce quality work in a fast-paced environment, meeting deadlines as well as client expectations for quality and timeliness • Maintain consistency of format and grammar with attention to detail • Assess work to determine best practice for efficient and accurate completion of documents • Interact with stakeholders to seek resolution before proceeding with documents if required • Collaborate with peers, SMEs, and Audit practitioners to ensure adherence of process and quality standards as defined • Flexible to switch between responsibilities and agile to business needs and expectations as it evolves and defined by the leadership Work location & shift timings • Hyderabad office • Hybrid model (work from Deloitte office min of two days in a week) • Rotational 9 hours shifts between 5.30 AM and 11 PM (IST), roster changes every quarter • Flexible to support overtime when there is a business requirement or during night shifts to support clients in Canada during busy season only The team Audit Engagement Support Centre is a team of dedicated professionals who collaborate as one-team with stakeholders to provide high-quality services and assistance to Audit Practitioners. The support and service offerings intermingle at various stages of an engagement life cycle throughout the year, with busy and non-busy seasons based on clients’ filing deadlines. The skills of this team are limited to support activities that are expected of a non-CPA or non-accountant. Subsequently, knowledge and experience acquired in this team with relevant certifications provides platform to transition to an Auditor practitioner role. Qualifications Required • MBA or Master’s Degree in Commerce/Finance • 3 to 6 years work experience in similar field or role • Having knowledge and familiar with the terminologies used in financial and accounting sectors • Should be knowledgeable of life cycle of an engagement and processes involved at various stages • Advanced working knowledge in Outlook, MS-Word, MS-Excel, basic PowerPoint and other collaborative tools Preferred • Good verbal and written communication skills • Strong attention to details • Exceptional interpersonal skills with demonstrated ability to build relationships with clients and colleagues at all levels • Proactive and highly organized with an exceptional ability to multi-task • Ability to respond to requests in a timely manner • Demonstrate enthusiasm for continuous learning relevant to the role • Experience working with Audit professionals, supporting a variety of client documents such as financial statements, audit reports and engagement letters is an asset How you’ll grow At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in exactly the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team-based learning, and eLearning. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state-of-the-art, world-class learning Center in the Hyderabad offices is an extension of the Deloitte University (DU) in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. title: USI-EH27-Consulting-AI&E-IS-Consultant , Technical Transformation-IFS EAM Technical SCM
description: Artificial Intelligence & EngineeringAI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.  Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.Level: Consultant, Technical TransformationAs a Consultant, Technical Transformation, you will be responsible for the design, technical development, customization, integration, and data migration of IFS Cloud SCM solutions for Power & Utilities. You will work closely with clients to understand their business needs, translate them into system requirements, and ensure successful deployment and adoption of IFS functionalities.Work you'll doAs a Consultant, Technical Transformation on the Core Business Operations team, you will be responsible for: Developing and customizing IFS Cloud supply chain management solutions using Structured Query Language (SQL), Procedural Language/Structured Query Language (PL/SQL), Custom Objects, and IFS development tools Designing and implementing integrations between IFS enterprise resource planning (ERP) and third-party applications Performing testing, validation, deployment, and technical troubleshooting for custom functionalities and system performance issues Creating and maintaining technical documentation, including workflows, configurations, and technical design artifacts Collaborating with client stakeholders and functional consultants to gather requirements, map business needs to IFS capabilities, and support user adoption The teamThe Core Business Operations (CBO) portfolio is an integrated set of offerings that addresses our clients’ heart-of-the-business issues. This portfolio combines our functional and technical capabilities to help clients transform, modernize, and run their existing technology platforms across industries. As our clients navigate dynamic and disruptive markets, these solutions are designed to help them drive product and service innovation, improve financial performance, accelerate speed to market, and operate their platforms to innovate continuously.Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/ChennaiQualificationsRequired: Strong Programming Skills: Expertise in SQL, PL/SQL, and IFS-specific development tools. Hands-on Experience in System Integrations: Knowledge of API-based integrations, middleware solutions, IFS Connect and third-party system connectors. Customization & Extensions: Experience in developing custom reports, modifying workflows, and enhancing system functionalities. Performance Optimization: Ability to troubleshoot system issues, enhance database performance, and optimize application behavior. IFS Application & Technical Framework: Solid grasp of IFS Data Model, IFS Aurena, and IFS Application Server or IFS Cloud. Security & Compliance Awareness: Data security best practices, system access controls, and regulatory compliance. Technical Documentation Proficiency: Ability to create technical design documents (TDDs), coding guidelines, and system architecture diagrams. Strong understanding of SCM modules: Procurement, Inventory Management, Supply Chain Planning, Demand Forecasting, Sales & Order Management. Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.), Bachelor of Technology (B. Tech), Master of Computer Applications (M.C.A.), or Master of Science in Computer Science (M.Sc. CS) from an accredited university Preferred: Experience delivering IFS Cloud solutions for Power & Utilities clients Experience with data migration activities for enterprise resource planning implementations Experience conducting system testing, validation, and deployment activities Experience supporting security, access controls, and data integrity requirements within enterprise systems Experience conducting user workshops, training sessions, and solution demonstrations

title: USI-EH27-Product Engineering DnA-Engineering Manager-Manager
description: Engineering Manager (Data & Analytics) – Lead Software Engineer IRole Overview: As an Engineering Manager, you will actively engage in your data engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to multiple high-visibility projects. Your expertise will be pivotal in managing data engineering teams to deliver solutions that delight customers and users, while also driving tangible value for Deloitte's business investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship and advanced proficiency across multiple programming languages and modern frameworks, consistently demonstrating your exemplary track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a role model and engineering mentor, advocating engineering excellence, and leading cross-functional teams to design, develop, test, deploy, and operate advanced software solutions.Key Responsibilities:Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes. Lead data engineering teams to deliver solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations. Serve as the technical advocate for data products and data engineering teams, promoting and supporting evolutionary releases (e.g., alpha, beta, MVP).  Ensure proper planning, code integrity, quality, alignment with customer goals, architecture designs, and NFRs. Possess passion and experience as an individual contributor, responsible for fostering a culture of engineering excellence within the team, being hands-on with design, configuration and/or code part of the time, contributing to team velocity. Work daily with the data engineering teams to resolve any issues, blockers, or impediments, perform code reviews and optimizations, maintain coding standards compliance, and ensure that technical debt is addressed continuously within sprints to achieve comprehensive quality. Be self-driven to learn new technologies, experiment with engineers, and inspire the teams to learn and drive application of those new technologies. Mentor and coach product engineering team to cultivate and nurture strong masters of crafts with passion towards product outcomes.Lead data engineering teams to develop lean solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams to deliver the right solution for the product in the right way at the right time.Exhibit a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions. Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, delivery, infrastructure, and security. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.Possess deep expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, Agile methodologies, DevSecOps, Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment, deployment techniques like Blue-Green, Canary to minimize down-time and enable A/B testing approaches. Act as a Role-Model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery, ensuring high-quality outcomes with minimal waste. Demonstrate proficiency in product development, from conceptualization and design to implementation and scaling, with a focus on continuous improvement and learning. Quickly acquire domain-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business and user needs into engineering plans (e.g., sprint plans, enables, tasks, priorities). Navigate various enterprise functions such as business and enabling areas as well as product, experience, delivery, infrastructure, and security to drive product value and feasibility as well as alignment with organizational goals.Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence stakeholders at all levels through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence, evaluations, and research. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.Engage and collaborate with stakeholders at all organizational levels, from team members to senior executives. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.The TeamUS Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.Qualifications·        A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline. An advanced degree (e.g., MS) is preferred but not required. Experience is the most relevant factor.·        Excellent software engineering and product architecture/design foundation with deep understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/ER/DFD diagrams, OOP/OOD, data-structures, algorithms, code instrumentations, etc.10+ years proven experience with industry-leading business intelligence tools like Tableau, SAP BOE, Power BI and Qlik (including add-on products for data and server management).5+ years of experience with cloud-native data and analytics platforms on Azure, AWS or GCP.·        3+ years of experience with AI/ML and GenAI is preferred.·        Deep understanding of methodologies & tools like XP, Lean, SAFe, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, etc. to deliver high quality products rapidly.Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.Strong SQL skills with experience in stored procedures, triggers, functions, and designing tables/views; proficiency with advanced MS Excel (including PivotTables), Word, and PowerPoint.Experience with ETL tools (e.g., Alteryx, Informatica, SAP SLT, SAP BODS) and working with both structured and unstructured data; familiarity with R/Python for data preparation and integration is a plus.Ability to align technology solutions with business objectives, maintaining a constant awareness of project milestones, client needs, and long-term strategic goals.How You will Grow: At Deloitte, our professional development plans focus on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day and excel in everything they do.Location: BengaluruShift timing – 11AM to 8PM#CAL-BMT#CA-SK#CAP-PD#CA-SG1

description: Finance Transformation Join our Finance Transformation practice to help Deloitte client service teams define and execute Finance and Global Business Services agendas and strategies. You will work with world-class teams and insights, helping support delivery in challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to help unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we collaborate with teams to enable transforming finance. Position SummaryLevel: Analyst or equivalent As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements. Work you’ll do: You’ll plan and deliver Oracle FCCS applications by assessing risks, gathering requirements, designing, developing, and ensuring high-quality delivery. You’ll focus on technical execution, work independently with guidance from leads, and provide functional expertise in EPM processes like Consolidation, Reporting, and Reconciliations. You’ll translate business needs into system solutions, contribute as an individual or team lead, oversee daily reporting and delivery, and play a key role in all project phases from requirements through Hypercare. The team: Controllership & Treasury Transformation (C&TT) is one of the offerings within the Finance Transformation portfolio of Deloitte US India Consulting. This Offering advises, implements, and delivers solution as-a-service relating to digital finance strategies, financial planning and analysis, enterprise performance strategies and technologies solutions. By taking a holistic view of these key business areas from strategy development through process design and technology enablement, we help our clients navigate their challenges while continuing to succeed in their business. Qualifications Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 3-6 years of project experience in implementation of Oracle FCCS Project experience in EPM Suite of Products 11.x and/or Oracle FCCS Hands-on experience in building metadata, designing webforms, data reconciliation, building dashboards and creating complex business rules to cater custom consolidations Proficient in creation of Business Rules – Custom consolidations, Intercompany eliminations, automating Cash Flow, Custom Translations and Currency Overrides, Dynamic calculations Must have a good knowledge of intercompany eliminations, currency translations & financial statement presentations Should have excellent Excel, VB and Python scripting skills Knowledge of upgrade & migration from On-Premises to CloudGood to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: Should be involved in the Design, Implementation, Prototyping, Enhancements and Performance tuning of FCCS applications Industry expertise in domains like Media and Entertainment, Consumer and Industrial Products, Banking, etc. Should have experience of conducting User Acceptance Test, and preparing deliverables such as design documents, test documentation, training materials and administration/procedural guides Should have understanding and experience of software development best practices Good to have knowledge of any RDBMS like Oracle, SQL Server Exposure to traditional and Agile project deliveryEducation: Bachelor’s/Master's degree in Business, Technology or Math/Engineering (B.E./B.Tech (Computer Science) or CAs/CPAs, MBAs) from accredited universityLocation: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai/KolkataShift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST as per business requirements#FT_FCCS#CSReferral-FY26

title: USI-EH27-Consulting-Customer-DFO&I -Five9- Consultant, Managed Services
description: #S&S2027CustomerThe Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.  Position SummaryLevel: Consultant, Technical Transformation or equivalentAs an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.  Work you’ll do:Configure and enhance Five9 ACD capabilities: skills, queues, IVR/IVA, call flows, routing strategies, agent profiles, and campaigns. Build and maintain integrations between Five9 and external systems (e.g., CRM such as Salesforce/Dynamics, ticketing, identity/SSO, data/warehouse). Develop using Five9 APIs (REST) and platform features (CTI/CRM adapters where applicable), including event handling, screen pops, click-to-dial, and dispositioning. Implement automation and data workflows: call logging, activity creation, customer lookup, case creation, callbacks, and post-call processing. Support reporting/analytics needs: business dashboards, operational KPIs, data extracts, and reconciliation between Five9 and source systems. Troubleshoot production issues (routing, audio, agent login, integration failures), perform root-cause analysis, and implement fixes with proper change control. Ensure solutions meet security, privacy, and compliance requirements (PII handling, access control, retention). Create technical documentation: configuration specs, runbooks, test plans, deployment steps, and operational handover. Participate in Agile delivery: estimation, sprint execution, code reviews, CI/CD practices where applicable. The team:Step into our Sales & Service team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end-to-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service!    QualificationsMust Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:3 - 6 years of hands-on experience in contact center engineering/development with at least 1–2 years hands-on with Five9.Strong experience with Five9 Studio/IVR and routing/ACD configuration (skills, queues, priority, agent states, campaigns).Hands-on experience building API-based integrations (REST, OAuth/token auth patterns), plus solid JSON/data mapping.Proficiency in at least one general-purpose language commonly used for integrations (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, C#) and writing maintainable, testable code.Experience with CRM integrations (Salesforce/Dynamics or similar) and common contact center patterns (screen pop, call logging, CTI).Working knowledge of telephony fundamentals (SIP, PSTN basics, call flows, DTMF, codecs concepts) sufficient to troubleshoot with telecom partners.Strong debugging skills across logs, API traces, and platform configuration; ability to translate business requirements into technical designs.Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: Five9 certifications (if available/active) or comparable CCaaS certs. Experience with WFO/WFM/QM integrations, speech analytics, or AI/IVA platforms. Data/BI skills: SQL, Power BI/Tableau, building KPI layers for contact center reporting. Experience with SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, and enterprise identity patterns. Prior work in regulated environments (HIPAA, PCI, SOX, CJIS) and secure SDLC. Education:BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited universityLocation:Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai#FY27ReferralCampaign

title: USI FY27 | Cyber Operate-Digital Identity - PAM Valkyrie - Senior Consultant
description: Senior ConsultantWe are seeking a Privileged Access Management (PAM) professional to support the design, implementation, administration, and advanced operations of enterprise PAM solutions using Valkyrie. The role requires strong hands-on experience across privileged credential management, access governance, platform integrations, automation, troubleshooting, and operational support.This individual will play a key role in delivering secure and resilient privileged access services across enterprise environments, while partnering with security, infrastructure, IAM, application, and audit stakeholders. The position is well suited for a technical leader who can operate independently in an L3/L4 support model and drive both platform stability and continuous control improvement.Work you'll doAs a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for: Architecting and designing Valkyrie PAM solutions, including credential vaulting, secret rotation, session control, access workflows, and enterprise security platform integrations. Leading onboarding and management of privileged, service, and application accounts across Windows, Linux/Unix, cloud, database, and application environments, including bulk onboarding and migration activities. Configuring privileged access policies, least privilege controls, emergency access processes, secrets lifecycle management, and integrations with enterprise platforms. Troubleshooting complex production issues, supporting L3/L4 escalations, and maintaining platform health through patching, upgrades, high availability, disaster recovery readiness, and environment hardening. Developing automation, reporting, runbooks, and operational documentation to support compliance, audit readiness, and advanced PAM use cases. The teamDeloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes: Managing Identity Lifecycle Security Operations Threat Intelligence Application Security Business Transformation Continuous Compliance Cyber Operate team focuses on efficiently running operations by enabling automation, reducing manual effort and adhering to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) based on the standards set by clients.Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/KolkataShift Timings: Flexibility for night, weekend, and holiday coverage is essential. Must be willing to work 24*7 rotational shifts. On call support required based on project assignments.QualificationsRequired: Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, or Master of Science in Computer Science from an accredited university 6-10 years of experience in privileged access management, identity security, or cybersecurity implementation and support roles Hands-on experience with Valkyrie PAM or a comparable enterprise PAM platform Experience onboarding and managing privileged, service, and application accounts across Windows, Linux/Unix, cloud, database, and application environments Experience configuring privileged credential vaulting, secret rotation, session controls, access workflows, and privileged access policies Experience developing application programming interface-based automation and supporting integrations with Active Directory, security information and event management, simple mail transfer protocol, multi-factor authentication, identity governance and administration, or ticketing platforms Experience maintaining PAM infrastructure, including high availability, disaster recovery, patching, upgrades, performance monitoring, and L3/L4 production support Preferred: Experience with privileged analytics, user behavior analytics, or anomaly detection Experience migrating privileged accounts from legacy PAM tools or manual repositories Experience supporting secrets management for applications, DevOps tooling, and continuous integration/continuous delivery pipelines Experience with cloud and hybrid privileged access use cases Experience supporting privileged access in regulated environments with audit and control requirements Privileged access management, identity and access management, or cybersecurity certification#Cyber_Cyber Operate

title: USI - EH27 -OCIO – PROJECT AND PROGRAM MANAGEMENT L55
description: L55 - Specialist Executive Manager, Technical Project and Program ManagementAs a Manager in the Deloitte Technology-US (DT-US) Office of the CIO (OCIO) PMO team, you will play a key role in leveraging leading program and project management practices and methodologies to enable world-class delivery of our major internal technology programs.The DT-US PMO team is part of the Office of CIO (OCIO) and reports to the US OCIO Leader. The OCIO leads the development and implementation for technology strategy at Deloitte and drives the strategic initiatives to build market leading technology capabilities. DT-US powers IT for Deloitte’s 175K+ professionals while supporting business priorities and transformational initiatives in areas such as AI, Cloud, and Cyber.Work you’ll doAs a DT-US Manager, you will work directly with the DT-US PMO FSS or Enabling Area Leads to leverage leading practices used within the Deloitte Businesses and/or industry to drive successful technology implementations. Specifically, you will proactively incorporate those leading practices into our evolving methodologies, tools, templates, processes, and organizational thinking for how we should manage and lead strategic technology implementations for continuous improvements. Additionally, you will support efforts to drive consistency throughout our DT-US organization in how we implement and deliver our technology programs and projects.You will also manage the end-to-end project lifecycle for large and complex projects/programs in one or more of the DT-US project portfolios. You will lead and coordinate project/program team resources to ensure project/program milestones are met and the project/program is delivered on schedule and on budget with the highest standard of quality. You will also manage project/program risk identification and resolution to keep projects/programs on track and able to deliver planned outcomes. As the DT-US PMO Manager, you will be expected to build and demonstrate a strong competency and business knowledge on assigned initiatives. You may have responsibility for managing day-to-day activities of other PMO team members as well as providing coaching and performance feedback.Responsibilities include: Drives cross-functional teams in the delivery of high-risk, complex programs/projects Leads program/project issue/risk management, remediation plans, and escalations across channels, studios/service areas for projects within assigned programs - responsible for providing management direction in these areas and ensuring clear communication, consideration of all factors, generation of solution alternatives, and defined actionable plans. Lead and manage a diverse range of IT projects including software development, infrastructure upgrades, cloud migrations, system integrations, and data migrations while ensuring timely delivery, budget adherence, and high-quality outcomes. Develops and demonstrates strong business knowledge of the assigned business units/portfolios/products Works with all stakeholders to identify and confirm necessary project and program resources throughout the project lifecycle and resolves resource availability conflicts across the program Builds detailed program/project master schedules and promotes collaboration through identified team sites Oversees the activities of other PMO junior resources and offshore teams to ensure delivery of timely solutions. Conducts ongoing examination of projects within the program for compliance with established processes, project plans/schedules and budgets, influencing decisions on resource utilization and allocation at key project lifecycle decision points. Maintains oversight and accountability for program performance including creation/review of key project delivery metrics across projects within the program. Prepares and delivers regular, audience-specific communications/reports/dashboards to ensure that program sponsors, key stakeholders, CIO advisors and leadership are adequately apprised of program and project statuses, successes, risks and issues. Manages and tracks project/program budget/variance and takes corrective actions. Proposes changes to project methodologies, frameworks, and promotes best practices for continuous process improvement. Motivates and leads teams and fosters a mindset of collaboration and continuous process improvement. Accountable for all applicable PMO related processes and methodologies and their proper and consistent execution on all projects Required Qualifications: 10+ years of relevant experience in Project/Program Management working on large, complex, cross-functional IT initiatives utilizing a structured project management methodology and formal tools/approaches (PMBOK, Prince2, etc) 3+ years of experience managing full lifecycle Agile projects including overseeing the strategy / business case development, developing the implementation plan to support the business case, and driving the implementation of the plan to deliver the final program objectives 1+ year of people management experience overseeing and mentoring numerous other PMs, Project Coordinators, etc. 3+ years of project / program financial management (e.g., Planning, Forecasting, Budgeting, Business Case Development, etc.) in addition to experience in planning, estimation, resource management, project tracking, scope control, risk and issues management as well as stakeholder relationship management. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Business Administration or equivalent educational This role would require professional to work from Deloitte Office – Hyderabad office as per business policy. Preferred Qualifications: MBA or equivalent graduate degree preferred Hands on experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) Minimum 2 years of experience managing projects/programs in ServiceNow Minimum of 1 year of experience in a matrixed professional services firm OR consulting Strategic and critical thinker with the ability to make connections across workstreams and Deloitte’s matrixed organizations Excellent written and verbal communications skills and strong executive presence. Must be able to analyze, understand, and communicate complex ideas across varied audiences, including senior Deloitte Partners, Principals, and Managing Director leaders Experience with strategy / business case development, then developing the implementation plan to support the business case, and driving the implementation of the plan to deliver the final program objectives Strong commitment to professional client service excellence Empowered self-starter comfortable to take the lead and managing multiple initiatives with an ability to effectively collaborate across teams Proven success at mentoring and leading teams that are focused on exceptional client service and can manage risk remotely/virtually Excellent interpersonal relations and demonstrated ability to work with others effectively in teams Prior experience in or working for Executive Leaders and their respective offices/leadership teams Prior experience with IT Financial management methodologies and disciplines  Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to logically structure issues and determine recommended resolutions Detail-oriented with ability to plan, prioritize, and make decisions on multiple time-sensitive projects Strong commitment to integrity Strong knowledge of leading-edge project management methodologies Understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) Strong MS PowerPoint skills with proven record to create high impact audience-specific presentations. Proficient in MS Project / MS Project Server (or similar applications)

description: Associate, Procurement and Category Management Deloitte is seeking a motivated and high-performing Procurement Analyst to join the Talent Procurement team in India. This role will serve as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders, supporting procurement needs across Talent, with exposure to broader CoRe Procurement categories as needed. The Analyst will help drive efficient, insight-led procurement by supporting sourcing activities, supplier and contract management, reporting, and market research. description: Delphix Data Analytics Engineer – Software Specialist Engineer IIRole Overview: As a Data Analytics Engineer, you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to multiple high-visibility projects. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering solutions that delight customers and users, while also driving tangible value for Deloitte's business investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftmanship across multiple programming languages and modern frameworks, consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy advanced software solutions.Work you will do·       Responsible for implementation/delivering/Administering Delphix Platform to support the Deloitte US Member Firm. ·       Development, maintenance and testing of Delphix Engine, Delphix Masking Engine. ·       Participation in meetings about changes in the system itself or source systems, input/impact assessment ·       Knowledge of Build/Release management in Delphix Platform. ·       Expertise in monitoring the Delphix Engines. ·       Ability to proactively identify, troubleshoot and resolve live Engine issues ·       Deep expertise around best practices in the various aspects of IT, technology trends, application capabilities and ability to develop solutions to implement key business strategies. ·       Be able to work with the business to understand their needs. ·       Knowledge in SQL Server Database. ·       Excellent communication and presentation skills. Key Responsibilities:Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations. Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring code integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals. Lead requirement analysis, component design, development, unit testing, integrations, and support. Engineering Craftsmanship: Maintain accountability for the integrity of code design, implementation, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code ensuring all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.Customer-Centric Engineering: Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time.Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a learning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions. Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.Advanced Technical Proficiency: Possess deep expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including Agile methodologies and DevSecOps to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from code check-in to production with all quality checks through SDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Demonstrate understanding of the full lifecycle product development, focusing on continuous improvement, and learning.Domain Expertise: Quickly acquire domain-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs, architectures, and data designs into technical specifications and code. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.Effective Communication and Influence: Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.Key Qualifications:§  A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline. An advanced degree (e.g., MS) is preferred but not required. Experience is the most relevant factor.§  Strong data engineering foundation with deep understanding of data-structure, algorithms, code instrumentations, etc.§  3-5 years of experience with Data Anonymization tool – Delphix. §  Able to work on the Masking algorithms. §  Able to work on the Delphix Virtualization Engine, creating Gold and Child VDBs, troubleshooting issues in Virtualization Engine and Masking Engine.§  Able to work on the Delphix Control Tower.  §  6+ years in-depth experience in RDBMS, SQL §  Hands-on experience in unstructured file data masking. §  Exposure in Azure/AWS/GCP. §  Experience in anonymizing the structured data (SQL, Azure SQL) as well unstructured((JSON/XML/BLOB/CSV) data. §  Experience in corporate standards and guidelines for dealing with client data, including sensitive data. §  Experience in dynamic and persistent data masking techniques, including encryption, tokenization, randomization, substitution, customized masking techniques, and seed value masking. §  Ability to understand the business and data domain of the customer or partner and the business problems the customer or partner is facing, with the intent to solve the business problems. §  Privacy architect - capable of computing statistical validation of many different types of anonymizations §  Strong oral and written communication skills. §  Very familiar with Data Security principles.§  Experience in Delphix engine upgrade.Good to have skills: 1. Knowledge of SQL Database 2. Knowledge of Delphix API’s 3. Knowledge in PaaS/SaaS/IaaS technologies 4. Experience with products hosted on cloud would be a big plus. 5. Experience in Salesforce, Snowflake and SAP HANA data virtualization and masking setup.How You will Grow: At Deloitte, our professional development plans focus on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day and excel in everything they do.

description: GenAI – Consultant, Software Engineer IIEnterprise PerformanceOur Enterprise Performance team helps organizations transform core business operations through technology, data, and innovation across finance, supply chain, and IT. Configuring and extending product lifecycle management (PLM) platforms such as Teamcenter, Windchill, 3DEXPERIENCE, or SAP PLM to support workflows, data models, and integrations. Building large language model (LLM) agents, multi-agent workflows, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions using structured and unstructured supply chain and engineering data. Integrating solutions with enterprise platforms and cloud environments, including Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure. Working with functional and technical teams to translate business requirements into scalable solution designs, validate outputs, and measure performance through defined operational metrics. Our professionals as part of the Supply Chain Network Operations (SCNO) service line within Enterprise Performance focus on helping organizations achieve sustainable competitive advantage throughout their operations, spanning product development, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution. We excel at translating strategic objectives into tangible, measurable outcomes at the operational level. By aligning high-level goals with frontline execution, we ensure our clients realize real value and improved performance across every stage of their supply chain and operations.Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / ChennaiShift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST as per business requirementsQualificationsRequired: 3-6 years of experience in software engineering, enterprise application development, artificial intelligence, machine learning, or product lifecycle management. 3+ years of experience in PLM design and development using Teamcenter, Windchill, 3DEXPERIENCE, SAP PLM, or a comparable platform. 2+ years of experience building LLM-driven agents and multi-agent workflows using LangChain, LangGraph, or comparable frameworks. Experience building RAG solutions using structured and unstructured supply chain, engineering, or product data. Experience with Python in production-grade application development. Experience with vector databases, graph databases, and cloud deployment on AWS and/or Azure, including artificial intelligence and machine learning services. Experience integrating OpenAI, Anthropic, or Cohere models with cloud services. title: USI | EH27 | Talent Business Analyst - Specialist Assistant Manager
description: At Deloitte, the Business Advisor team partners the business leaders of a function or service to craft, execute and drive the delivery of the firm’s Talent strategy. You will play a key role in helping business drive performance, develop talent and retain key talent. You would work on initiatives like succession planning, performance management, compensation planning etc. among the many activities you will be a part of. You are expected to work with the business to drive solutions to core business problems from a Talent standpoint. Work you'll do As a Specialist Assistant Manager, Analytics and Insights on the Business Advisory team, you will be responsible for supporting business leaders with talent insights, workforce planning, and talent strategy execution. Analyze attrition, engagement, survey, and workforce data to identify trends, root causes, and actions that support business priorities. Develop reports, metrics, and insights to support headcount forecasting, skill planning, and talent decisions across assigned FSS groups. Evaluate talent programs and processes, identify improvement opportunities, and support implementation of new initiatives and cross-functional projects. Partner with business leaders, Deployment, Development, Acquisition, Total Rewards, and other Talent stakeholders to align talent services with business needs. Support performance management, workforce development, talent communications, and governance activities to help drive consistent talent outcomes. The team Our Talent team offers HR solutions by tapping into the different aspects of HR policies, to ensure every professional’s engagement with the organization is meaningful. It is structured into five major organizations: Talent Acquisition, Talent Delivery, Talent Development, Talent Specialties and Talent Operations. As part of the Business Advisory team, you will work with our business leaders, foster change throughout the organization and ensure that Talent strategies are aligned with the firm’s culture. Location: Hyderabad Shift Timings: 2 PM to 11 PM Qualifications Required: MBA or equivalent degree 6-9 years of experience in human resources, talent advisory, workforce planning, talent analytics, or HR business partnering Experience analyzing workforce, attrition, engagement, or survey data using reporting or analytics tools Experience supporting business leaders in a matrixed organization Experience partnering with talent stakeholders such as Talent Acquisition, Development, Total Rewards, or Deployment Preferred: SHRM, PHR, or SPHR certification Experience supporting performance management, succession planning, compensation planning, or workforce planning activities Experience creating executive-ready dashboards, reports, or presentations Experience leading process improvement or cross-functional initiatives Experience supporting US stakeholders or global teams

description: Deloitte Global Consulting Services – Sales Specialist Assistant ManagerAbout the teamGlobal Consulting Services (GCS) works globally across practices and borders to support Deloitte’s Strategy, Risk & Transactions (SR&T) and Technology & Transformation (T&T) businesses. The team is focused on offering our clients and people the global experience that’s essential in today’s world. Through GCS, we provide innovative solutions for cross-cultural, cross-border challenges our teams may encounter around the world. Leveraging leading-edge tools, methods, and resources, we deliver top-notch service that is applied locally while staying true to our global brand and core values.Within the GCS, the Global Sales team is tasked with ensuring consistency in sales practices, sharing best practices, and enhancing win rates on a global scale. Collaborating closely with designated Global Sales Leaders from various geographies and business units, the team is committed to executing strategic priorities that are typically high-impact and high-visibility, aligning with the overarching strategic objectives of the firm.We are looking for a dynamic and motivated individual who thrives in both individual contributor as well as collaborative environments across different project magnitudes.Overview of the roleThe Global Sales Excellence Council Support role is responsible for coordinating and supporting the day-to-day operations of the Council composed of senior global leaders. The role ensures the council operates efficiently, with strong governance, clear communication, and effective coordination across regions, functions, and stakeholder groups.Work you’ll do The professional will help to accelerate execution of our Global Sales Excellence Council strategic agenda by simplifying, and streamlining operations (reporting, PMO activities etc.), creating compelling and transparent leadership communications. The professional will synthesize outcomes, demonstrate strong analytical and business writing skills, and develop impactful narratives with recommendations based on research and analysis. Projects often involve collaboration across workstreams to ensure coordination and alignment.Key responsibilities·       Support the end-to-end operations of the Global Council, including planning, scheduling, logistics, and coordination of meetings and related activities·       Partner with global stakeholders to ensure timely preparation of materials, agendas, briefing packs, and follow-up actions·       Coordinate across time zones and geographies to support participation and engagement from council members and their teams·       Track action items, decisions, and deliverables to ensure accountability and follow-through·       Help manage governance processes, including meeting cadence, documentation, and reporting·       Draft, edit, and distribute communications, summaries, and meeting outputs in a clear and professional manner·       Maintain organized records of council materials, decisions, and key updates·       Support stakeholder engagement by ensuring communications are well timed, concise, and aligned to leadership priorities·       Identify opportunities to improve operating processes, meeting effectiveness, and coordination efficiency·       Manage sensitive information with a high level of confidentiality and professionalism·       Provide additional administrative and operational support as needed to enable effective council performance·       Demonstrate solid project management skills, and seamlessly support and switch to different workstreams as required·       Thrive in a fast-paced global team environment, leveraging strong written and verbal communication skills to collaborate effectively in a remote setting·       Operate in cross-functional and geographically diverse team and effectively deliver on strategic priorities, including reporting, analytics, and operational priorities with evolving business needs·       Demonstrate strong stakeholder management by communicating status, risks, issues, and recommendations proactively, while managing expectations across a global, matrixed organizationRequisite core skills·       Strong coordination and project management skills·       Excellent written and verbal communication skills·       Ability to work effectively across global teams and diverse stakeholders·       Strong attention to detail and follow-through·       High level of discretion and professionalism·       Comfortable working in a dynamic, matrixed environment·       Strong logical structuring and storyboarding skills, superior knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint·       Strong business writing skills (i.e., clear, concise, and compelling writing capabilities)·       Experience supporting a global leadership forum, steering committee, board, or council·       Background in operations, program coordination, executive support, or governance·       Exposure to multinational or cross-functional business environments·       Accustomed to working in co-located and virtual teamsQualifications, experience, work location, and timingWe are looking for a passionate, high energy, and self-motivated individual who is accustomed to working independently and collaboratively on small and large projects in a close-knit team.·       Education: Master’s Degree, MBA is preferred·       Work experience: 6+ years of relevant experience in Project Management or supporting a global leadership forum·       Strong track record with previous employment, preferably with consulting firms·       Location: Hyderabad·       Work hours: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM OR 02:00 PM – 11:00 PM (expected to be flexible with time zones)·       Working from office: The individual is expected to come to office at least 2 days a week as per the ‘work from office’ scheduleAbout Deloitte“Deloitte” is the brand under which independent firms throughout the world collaborate to provide services in a geographic area. These firms are members of Deloitte Touché Tohmatsu Limited DTTL, a UK private company limited by guarantee. With 260,000+ people in over 150 countries, Deloitte member firms serve more than 80 percent of the world's largest companies as well as large national enterprises, public institutions, and successful fast-growing companiesDeloitte Support Services India Pvt LtdEnabling Areas (EA) at the U.S. India offices are the support arm of the organization and comprise several groups including Talent, Technology, Finance, Communications, Field Operations, etc. EA gives every client-service business unit access to the best and brightest resources when it comes to support services. More specifically, EA enables the business units to solely focus on satisfying clients and developing new products and services to sustain competitive advantage, while they consolidate and standardize a diverse collection of systems, processes, and functions. The team provides a wide array of services to the U.S and India professionals, and is continually evaluating and expanding its portfolio How you’ll growAt Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team-based learning, and eLearning. Deloitte University (DU): The Leadership Center in India, our state-of-the- art, world-class learning Center in the Hyderabad offices is an extension of the DU in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. Learn more about Life at DeloitteCorporate CitizenshipDeloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. title: USI-EH27-GAA-OCEO Digital Communications Coordinator-L40-HYD
description: Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.This role with Deloitte Global (DTTL) ideal for individuals who would like to gain global experience. Due to the global nature of this role, relocation is not required, nor supported. Candidates would be expected to work from their current location.The A&A OCEO team is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented professional to support digital communications priorities. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional project coordination capabilities, and the ability to manage multiple priorities with accuracy and efficiency. The ideal candidate is a forward-thinking team player who can maintain structure across recurring processes, synthesize performance metrics into clear stakeholder insights, and help drive execution across key office initiatives.Work you'll doAs a Specialist Assistant Manager, Communications on the A&A OCEO team, you will be responsible for:Support day-to-day digital channel priorities by managing multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining strong organization and follow-through.Maintain action trackers (through Workfront and Teams), workplans, deadlines, and status reporting to ensure visibility across office priorities.Own and manage recurring communications efforts including distribution lists maintenance, ensuring consistency, timeliness, and quality.Assist with A&A digital communications priorities, including support for platforms such as D.com and Deloitte Resources.Coordinate with support teams, including CoRe CS and CoRe KS, to help enable smooth execution of projects.Pull and review metrics from platforms such as Power BI and Adobe Analytics/metrics tools for DR and D.comTranslate quantitative metrics from reports related to DR, D.com, and other channels into concise qualitative insights and highlights for stakeholders.Prepare clear written communications, summaries, and updates for leadership and cross-functional teams post calls/meetingsAnticipate needs, identify potential issues early, and engage proactively with the team to keep priorities moving forward.Support continuous improvement of team processes, reporting approaches, and communication workflows.The teamDeloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.This role supports Deloitte’s global Audit and Assurance agenda by helping strengthen the consistency, quality, and scalability of the digital communications priorities across the Deloitte network.Location: HyderabadShift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PMQualificationsRequired:5+ years of experience in Business communications and reporting within consulting or professional services businessProficiency in English, with strong writing, editing, and verbal communication skills. Especially with corporate/executive communications.Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects with ease while staying highly organized.Experience maintaining action trackers, workplans, timelines, and status visibility across competing priorities.Strong ability to own recurring processes and communications with minimal oversight.Experience supporting digital communications initiatives and content coordination.Ability to work effectively with cross-functional support teams and stakeholders.Experience interpreting metrics from reporting platforms such as Power BI and Adobe metrics tools.Ability to synthesize quantitative data into clear, actionable qualitative insights for stakeholder audiences.Proactive, forward-thinking mindset with strong team engagement and problem-solving skills.Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.Preferred:BA/MA Mass Communication or communications Degree, MBA in MarketingExperience supporting communications, operations, or program coordination functions in a professional services environment.Familiarity with web, digital content, or stakeholder reporting processes.Strong attention to detail and ability to manage deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

title: USI-EH27-Tax-BTS-Tax Operate-GCC-L55-Tax Manager
description: BTS Tax Operate - Tax ManagerRole SummaryThe Manager will serve as a key engagement management lead across a portfolio of complex U.S. domestic and global tax engagements, with accountability for day-to-day delivery management, governance, execution, and stakeholder communication.This role will drive engagement planning, operational visibility, issue resolution, and cross-functional coordination across U.S. and global tax compliance and related tax accounting activities to help deliver a consistent, scalable, and high-quality client and internal experience.Engagement Management and Delivery Governance Serve as a key engagement management lead across U.S. and global tax engagements, bridging tax client service teams, client stakeholders, and local/regional Deloitte teams to support predictable, high-quality delivery. Manage day-to-day engagement governance and project management across the portfolio. Manage contracting and SOW development, including scope and fee management. Build and maintain engagement workplans, service delivery milestones, and governance routines to support disciplined execution. Monitor execution against agreed client service plans and follow through on open items, milestones, and deliverables. Maintain transparency into engagement status through dashboards, reporting packs, and web-based tracking tools or portals. Lead recurring status calls, working sessions, and client readouts, ensuring updates are clear, action-oriented, and decision-useful. Drive issue resolution and risk management by identifying, tracking, and escalating technical, process, data, timing, and scope risks early. Manage engagement economics by organizing staffing plans, tracking budget-to-actuals, forecasting fees, monitoring realization, and communicating variances to engagement leadership. Support invoicing and central billing, including tracking, coordination, and follow-up with project leaders and internal teams as needed. Promote quality and standardization by reinforcing templates, review protocols, documentation requirements, playbooks, and engagement quality controls. U.S. Tax Compliance specific responsibilities: Manage governance and project management for U.S. corporate income tax and investment management tax engagements, including federal and multistate compliance, tax provisions, extensions, quarterly estimates, partnership returns, K-1 preparation and distribution, fund and entity-level reporting, and related supporting activities. Coordinate the end-to-end U.S. compliance process, including document and data requests, workpaper tracking, review readiness, and timely filing deliverables through Deloitte platforms. Support U.S. tax accounting and tax provision deliverables where in scope, coordinating calendars, data flows, and review cycles. Coordinate with service line teams as needed, including SALT, international tax, credits and incentives, and tax controversy. Global Tax Compliance specific responsibilities: Lead governance and project management for global tax compliance engagements and support transparency into the client’s compliance and reporting process through the Deloitte platform. Monitor execution against global client service plans and support consistent delivery across jurisdictions. Manage local country issues promptly and in accordance with engagement communication protocols. Work with local and regional member firms to identify and resolve issues and share insights to improve delivery efficiency. Review engagement status reports delivered to clients on a monthly basis. Lead client conference calls to discuss global compliance and obligation status and maintain strong working relationships with client stakeholders. Coordinate transition activities for global engagements, including web-based platform setup, scope discussions, and delivery tracking. Transitions, Scope Changes, and Pursuits Lead/Manage onboarding and transition planning for new engagements and major scope changes, including kickoff coordination, scope confirmation, stakeholder mapping, timelines, and roles. Stand up engagement operations, including workflow tracking, deliverable calendars, secure collaboration methods, and intake/checklist processes. Coordinate with Deloitte teams to confirm responsibilities, handoffs, and interfaces across workstreams. Draft or support drafting the Statement of Work, including scope boundaries, assumptions, deliverables, and change control triggers. Review RFPs and support setup of new opportunities in Pursuit Manager for new clients. Review fee inputs provided by local member firms against indicative fees and follow up on questions or assumptions. Prepare the client copy of fee files and assumptions for Senior Manager review. Client Communication and Stakeholder Management Develop strong working relationships with client tax and finance stakeholders, engagement leaders, and internal teams. Translate complex engagement activity into clear status updates, decisions needed, and actions required for both client and internal audiences. Support effective communication across workstreams to ensure the right information reaches the right stakeholders at the right time. Maintain disciplined follow-up on actions, deliverables, and issue resolution to strengthen trust and visibility. Team Leadership and Development Coach and develop junior team members through on-the-job guidance, timely feedback, and strong day-to-day support. Create a positive learning culture that encourages accountability, collaboration, professional growth, and operational excellence. Help reinforce consistency, discipline, and strong team practices across the engagement management environment. Influence and collaborate across levels and teams while fostering trust and accountability. Qualifications / Experience Post-graduation/master’s in business administration preferred. 8+ years of relevant experience in engagement management, project management office leadership, tax operations, or related service delivery roles. Experience supporting U.S. corporate income tax compliance, investment management tax compliance, tax accounting/provision, and/or global tax compliance and reporting environments. Demonstrated experience managing complex engagements involving planning, staffing, budgeting, status reporting, risk management, technical delivery coordination, and client communications. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex topics into clear actions and status updates. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams simultaneously. Proven problem-solving mindset, sound judgment, and ability to adapt quickly to changing timelines and scope. Strong technology and reporting skills, including Excel, PowerPoint, and data/reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Alteryx. Familiarity with tax compliance, tax accounting, workflow, and AI-enabled productivity tools is an important capability for this role.

description: Customer The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence. Position Summary Level: Consultant, Technical Transformation or equivalentAs an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Learn/adopt firm tools; build rapport with onshore teams. Understand pipeline setup and DevOps procedures. Manage time for meetings and prep work. Learn/adopt new tech stack features; understand limitations. Learn basics of Agentforce/GenAI modules and their configuration within Salesforce. The team:  Step into our Sales & Service team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. title: USI - EH27- CoRe DDAI - Assistant Manager – Creative - UI/UX Generalist Lead - Hyderabad
description: Software Specialist Engineer II We are seeking a UI/UX Generalist Lead who can contribute across the end-to-end design lifecycle, including research, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, validation, handoff, and design QA. This role is suited for someone who can work hands-on on complex business and enterprise workflows, partner closely with cross-functional teams, and mentor junior designers while maintaining a high standard of design quality and accessibility. A portfolio is good to have and, if shared, should demonstrate relevant case studies, problem-solving approach, end-to-end UX process, and shipped outcomes. Work you'll do As a Software Specialist Engineer II on the CoRe Business Solutions team, you will be responsible for: Lead end-to-end UX work across discovery, research synthesis, information architecture, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, visual design, validation, handoff, and design QA Design intuitive, responsive, and scalable experiences for web and enterprise applications, including complex workflows, edge cases, and multi-step user interactions Translate business and user needs into practical design solutions aligned with business goals, technical feasibility, and user needs Partner with project managers, developers, and business stakeholders to shape experiences, communicate design rationale, and support implementation Mentor junior designers, contribute to design consistency, and improve workflows, documentation, and design-to-development handoff practices The team CoRe Business Solutions team offers you an opportunity to be an integral part of the Digital Customer Solutions Group. The principal focus of this group is to customize technical solutions for global Deloitte Member Firms to address a variety of business needs including marketing and communication, knowledge management, learning and development, and overall process automation. The team uses primarily Microsoft SharePoint (on-prem and cloud) as a platform. We use various web development and automation tools/technologies (i.e. HTML, jQuery, Java Script, REST/SOAP API, JSON, Nintex, Kendo, Azure, Power Apps/Flows, and many more) within a structured delivery process to develop products that deliver significant value to our internal customers across Deloitte’s global network. Location: Hyderabad Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM Qualifications Required: 8+ years of experience in UI/UX design 2+ years of experience in a lead, mentoring, or team-support capacity Experience owning end-to-end UX initiatives from discovery through design QA Proficiency in Figma for design, prototyping, and collaboration Experience designing enterprise, business, or workflow-heavy digital products Working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 AA and experience incorporating accessibility into discovery, design, testing, and pre-release review Bachelor of Engineering (B.E./B.Tech.) or Master of Technology (M.Tech.) with 60% or 6.5 GPA and above throughout, without active backlogs Preferred: Portfolio demonstrating case studies, problem-solving approach, end-to-end UX process, and shipped outcomes Experience with FigJam for workshops, ideation, and journey mapping Experience with Adobe Creative Suite for visual design support Experience applying design systems, reusable components, and consistent interaction patterns Experience working in enterprise, platform, or product environments with complex workflows Certifications in Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or similar disciplines
