title: USI-EH27-Tax-BTS-Tax Operate-GCC-L65-Tax Senior Manager
description: BTS Tax Operate - Tax Senior ManagerRole summaryThe Senior Manager will serve as a senior engagement management lead across a portfolio of complex U.S. domestic and global tax compliance engagements, with accountability for day-to-day client engagement delivery, governance, and execution.This role is accountable for delivery governance, engagement economics, executive communication, transitions, issue resolution, and team leadership across a portfolio of tax compliance and reporting engagements. The Senior Manager will help ensure a consistent, scalable, and high-quality client and internal experience by aligning delivery discipline, stakeholder management, operational visibility, and coordination across the engagement lifecycle.Strategic Engagement Leadership Serve as the senior engagement management lead across a portfolio of complex U.S. corporate and investment management tax engagements, providing strategic oversight, leadership presence, and accountability for delivery quality and client outcomes. Lead large-scale engagement governance and project management, ensuring strategic alignment, risk management, and clear visibility to senior leadership and clients. Provide direction across workstreams, teams, and leadership groups to drive transparency, delivery discipline, and accountability. Support coordination across U.S. and global engagement teams to ensure consistent execution and alignment to client service expectations Delivery Governance and Operational Excellence Oversee engagement plans, service delivery milestones, compliance calendars, and governance routines to ensure work is executed in line with client expectations and internal quality standards. Drive visibility into engagement status through dashboards, reporting packs, and web-based tracking tools. Monitor execution against client service plans and ensure timely follow-through on obligations, milestones, and deliverables. Lead issue resolution and risk management across the engagement portfolio, escalating material risks and coordinating with internal teams, service lines, and regional or member-firm counterparts as needed. Promote continuous improvement, standardized ways of working, and operational excellence across the broader playbook. Client Relationship Management and Executive Communication Develop trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, engagement leaders, and PPMDs/LTPs, serving as a strategic advisor on engagement operations and delivery priorities. Lead executive communications, including governance calls, high-stakes presentations, monthly status reviews, and leadership updates tailored to audience and business need. Manage strategic messaging to ensure the right information reaches the right audience at the right time. Lead conference calls with clients to discuss compliance and obligation status and strengthen working relationships with key stakeholders. Support market visibility and eminence-building through internal and external relationship-building opportunities Engagement Economics and Resource Strategy Oversee engagement economics, including staffing strategy, budget-to-actual performance, fee forecasting, and realization across the portfolio. Maintain resource visibility and staffing rosters across large or multi-workstream engagements, aligning talent to evolving client needs. Organize staffing and monitor budgets, communicating issues and performance trends to project leaders in a timely manner. Translate financial and operational data into actionable insights for engagement leadership. Coordinate with local and regional member-firm teams to align staffing, fee assumptions, and delivery expectations across global engagements Transitions, Scope Changes, and Pursuits Lead transition planning for new engagements and major scope changes, including onboarding, scope confirmation, stakeholder alignment, and resource strategy. Lead the transition process end to end, including setup of delivery tracking tools, status reporting, and readiness oversight. Work with local and regional Deloitte teams to track transition status and manage scope discussions. Support development of engagement documentation, including assumptions, deliverables, and change control triggers. Review proposals, support opportunity setup, finalize fees and assumptions, and help shape commercially viable delivery approaches. Talent Leadership and Team Development Build, lead, and develop high-performing teams, fostering inclusion, accountability, trust, and strong team culture. Coach and mentor team members, helping them grow professionally while reinforcing high standards of delivery and collaboration. Drive organizational development initiatives that strengthen capability, scalability, and consistency across teams. Create a positive learning culture that supports professional growth, performance, and well-being. Support an environment of transparency, respect, and continuous development across the team Qualifications / Experience Post-graduation/master’s in business administration preferred. 12+ years of relevant experience in engagement management, project management office leadership, tax operations, or related service delivery roles. Experience supporting U.S. corporate income tax compliance, investment management tax compliance, and/or global tax compliance and reporting environments. Demonstrated experience leading large, complex engagements involving portfolio oversight, stakeholder management, staffing strategy, budgeting, and risk management. Strong executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders. Strong technology and reporting skills, including Excel, PowerPoint, and data/reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Alteryx. Ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt quickly to change, and lead teams through complexity. Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity and workflow tools is required.

The teamCyber Strategy & Transformation teams develop and transform cyber programs in line with a client's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite. description: SAP PaPM Consultant: Job DescriptionOverviewAs a PaPM Consultant you will help businesses leverage SAP Profitability and Performance Management (PaPM) to improve profitability analysis, optimize performance, and enable granular financial modeling and reporting. You will perform technical configuration, business process mapping, and also responsible for client stakeholder management.Key Responsibilities Business Requirement Analysis Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs related to profitability, cost management, and performance KPIs. Translate client requirements into functional specifications in SAP PaPM. Solution Design & Implementation Design PaPM models, allocation logic, driver-based costing, and other performance analytics scenarios. Configure SAP PaPM environments, including data sources, rules, allocations, and integrations. Able to work on PaPM solutions on Cost Allocations, Transfer Pricing, Pillar 2 and other use cases. Technical Configuration Build calculation logic, perform data modeling, and set up performance measures within PaPM. Ensure correct integration with SAP and non-SAP source systems. Testing & Validation Develop and execute test cases to validate solution configurations. Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and resolve defects or configuration gaps. Training & Documentation Develop training materials and deliver sessions for end-users and client teams. Document solution designs, technical configuration, and project status updates. Client Interaction Act as the point of contact for client stakeholders during implementation phases. Provide ongoing support, enhancements, and best practice recommendations. Required Skills and Experience Technical Skills 3+ years in SAP consulting, with at least 1+ year hands-on experience with SAP PaPM (or SAP FS-PER, the predecessor). Understanding of SAP HANA data modeling, views, and integration. Familiarity with SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, or other ERP solutions is advantageous. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Consulting Skills Ability to communicate complex concepts in understandable terms. Experience managing client expectations and facilitating workshops. Education & Certification Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, IT, or related field. SAP certification in PaPM or related modules (preferred). #FY27SAPOPENROLES

description: Human Capital The Human Capital Offering Portfolio focuses on helping organizations manage and sustain their performance through their most important asset: their people. title: USI-EH27- G&P-Sales Excellence-L55-Specialist Executive Manager, Pursuit Strategy (Tax)-Hyderabad
description: Specialist Executive Manager, Pursuit Strategy (Pursuit Manager-Tax)Do you love writing in a compelling and creative way? Does it excite you to be able to run an end-to-end sales cycle leading and coaching a pursuit team to success? If so, you may be a good fit for our USI Pursuits CoE team. The pursuit manager works closely with senior partners and other pursuit/sales professionals in support of priority competitive opportunities with US-based clients. The role focuses on writing compelling proposals with an original, persuasive voice, synthesizing and articulating strategic messaging, and editing proposal content from multiple sources. Depending upon the pursuit, the role may also involve coordination aspects of proposal and presentation development. Join us to collaborate with senior leaders, leverage innovative tools, and make a measurable impact on Deloitte’s success.Work you’ll doAs a Pursuit Specialist Executive Manager, you will lead the proposal process from pre-RFP discussions through orals coaching and post-presentation follow-up. Key responsibilities include:Strategic management:Oversee end-to-end RFP and proposal processes, including planning, win theme strategy, proposal writing, and oral presentation coaching.Advise and collaborate with client service professionals, providing strategic communication insights and leadership.Leverage proprietary GenAI tools to bring efficiency to the pursuit process, share meaningful insights with client service teams, and guide the strategy.Exhibit outstanding verbal skills in facilitating and distilling complex discussions; demonstrate a finely tuned ability to sift through a discussion, extracting the most significant information and action items.Develop and implement effective pursuit and messaging strategies, lead meetings, and present in various forums.Negotiate and mediate to resolve conflicts and reach consensus quickly.Direct competitive intelligence and knowledge management efforts to inform pursuit messaging.Influence and persuade stakeholders to adopt best practices and innovative approaches.Teaming, collaboration, and leading:Demonstrate exceptional business insight, judgment, and executive presence.Build trusted advisor relationships with senior clients (VP and C-level), understanding their objectives and success factors.Collaborate with partner advisors, and graphic design professionals to deliver high-quality, brand-compliant proposals and presentations.Mentor and develop junior team members, fostering growth and collaboration.Navigate large, complex pursuits to positively influence team dynamics and manage expectations.Operational:Develop, organize, and manage proposal content and collateral, ensuring version control and quality across all components.Engage with the pursuit team strategically; pose questions that encourage a team to consider all aspects of the client’s position, and draw out essential messaging.Taking ownership of quality, maintain a quality checklist to ensure 100% quality on all documentsContribute to the development of pursuit best practices, proposal databases, marketing materials, and prospect presentations.Develop and coordinate effective pursuit communications strategies; advise the pursuit team on communication objectives, messages, and tone; and manage the overall process to develop value-focused deliverables.Other activities include the development and implementation of leading pursuit practices, the development of content for the proposal database, internal and external marketing brochures, and presentations for prospect meetings.The teamOur team culture is collaborative and encourages team members to take initiative and seek on-the-job learning opportunities. Our pursuit management professionals work with a strong sense of camaraderie towards collective success, creative brainstorming to deliver value, and commitment to excellence.QualificationsRequired:14+ years of post-Master’s degree experience in pursuit writing/management or content development.Master’s degree in Business, Management, or a related field.Experience using GenAI tools and demonstrated ability to leverage technology for effective proposal development.Exceptional written and oral communication skills.Intellectual curiosity and ability to quickly learn about a wide variety of topics.Ability to prioritize and multitask in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.Initiative and ability to interact effectively with all levels of management.Strong project management skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office.High level of flexibility and adaptability.Location: HyderabadWork hours: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST

title: USI-EH27- G&P-R&I-L40-Specialist Assistant Manager, Strategic Market Insights and Thought Leadership (TMT-TMT- AI Data Centers, Semiconductors, and Tech Hardware Research)-Hyderabad
description: Specialist Assistant Manager, Strategic Market Insights and Thought Leadership (TMT- AI Data Centers, Semiconductors, and Tech Hardware Research)  Deloitte’s Center for TMT is one of the industry teams within the Research & Insights (R&I) group, focusing primarily on the TMT industry. The Center's goals are to:Assess opportunities and challenges facing companies in the TMT industryProvide practical and actionable insights - whether they are strategic, technical, operational.Bring together a range of stakeholders to address issues impacting the health and evolution of the TMT industry.Make extensive use of leading practices from TMT professionals across diverse disciplines, including content strategy, digital distribution, advertising and monetization, consumer analytics, rights management, finance, risk management, regulation, and human capital, to identify innovative steps they have taken to address critical challenges.Learn more about the TMT Center and have a peek into our work here.This role involves contributing to thought leadership and research projects across the full lifecycle—from design to delivery—examining critical challenges and opportunities in the Technology sector with particular focus primarily on semiconductor and enterprise hardware sub-sectors (including AI data center infrastructure), as well as consumer tech (secondary focus). The candidate will contribute to advancing the quality of the Center's research and thought-leadership work in Technology sector, with a focus on AI tech infrastructure (e.g., data centers, memory, GPUs, networking, edge, etc.), hybrid computing architectures, advanced packaging of hardware and chips, AI in chip design and manufacturing, strategic supply chain chokepoints, and adoption of AI/agent powered consumer devices and edge applications. These include whitepapers, in-depth research reports, case studies, articles, data-based research tools, client presentations, and collaterals for specific client accounts. These deliverables would integrate information from a range of primary and secondary sources, including Deloitte subject-matter experts, primary research (surveys), publicly available data, third-party research, analyst reports, presentations, industry commentaries, and news articles.  Responsibilities:As a Specialist Assistant Manager, focused on developing thought leadership, you will be required to –Work across diverse Tech sector (with a focus on semiconductor and enterprise hardware) topics, quickly build subject-matter familiarity, synthesize complex information, and deliver high-quality research insights.Develop and maintain subsector-level expertise across tech (and specifically hardware, semiconductor and consumer tech) landscape, including emerging technologies, business models, and financial drivers. This includes proactively researching companies, trends, themes, underlying technologies, and potential disruptions through direct study of industry reports, company disclosures and other credible sources.Identify novel topics, areas and trends to focus on, based on extensive analysis of competition thoughtware/articles and importance of issues based on market studies, industry reports and tracking.Design research proposals, build consensus, and formulate a research plan. Execute structured research plans by translating business objectives into clear research questions, identifying areas of investigation, and conducting thorough secondary research using relevant and trustworthy industry, company, and news sources.Interact with internal and external subject matter experts on industry topics and synthesize takeaways and findings into concise and well-structured narratives, assisting senior research leads to shape internal/external thought-leadership content and collaterals – through a combination of expertise and direct study, complemented by AI tools.Liaison with U.S. colleagues and senior researchers to understand, refine, and manage internal client expectations and priorities. Apply established research tools and methodologies to support business decision-making. Work on varied data sets (e.g., survey data, publicly available data sets) to derive data-driven insights.Identify and use the relevant data analysis methods and work with the relevant data science and analytics professionals to analyze voluminous and complex datasets. Demonstrate strong writing skills as required for thought leadership reports. Display strong consultative and engaging presentation skills.Being largely autonomous (with minimal supervision) and managing the projects to ensure outcomes and meet deadlines, demonstrating a high level of ownership and accountability.Assist senior researchers and practice leaders with internal briefings and external client meetings/webinars – by performing customized data analysis and presenting results and insights into client-ready briefing decks.Ability to apply sound research judgment by grounding outputs in direct study and critical thinking, while using generative AI tools to enhance efficiency (and not as a substitute for independent synthesis.)Develop an understanding of Deloitte’s solutions, services, and offerings Requisite experience and skillsExperience6-9 years of experience in supporting/managing research projects, preferably in Technology industry related topics and areas as noted earlier in this document.Experience working with US/global clients and teams is preferred. Since the job requires working closely with US-based colleagues, the ability to work across cultures is important. Industry/sector/subsector skillsBusiness research/thought-leadership development in Technology sector is preferred. description: Deputy Manager, Risk and Regulatory ServicesWe are seeking an Assistant Manager to support the Assurance Nonattest Quality & Risk Management team within the Audit & Assurance business. This role supports quality monitoring, and risk-sensing activities across Assurance nonattest engagements and helps teams adhere to internal policies, quality standards, and established processes.The professionals in this role will review monitoring results, identify trends and risk indicators, oversee reporting and issue tracking, and provide actionable insights to leadership and key stakeholders. The role also includes responsibility for reviewing team output, coaching junior professionals, strengthening execution quality, and contributing to continuous improvement of monitoring processes, and reporting capabilities.The ideal candidate will be a critical thinker with relevant experience in compliance, quality monitoring, reporting, analytics, engagement operations, or related business support environments.Work you'll do:As a Deputy Manager, Risk and Regulatory Services in the Assurance Nonattest Quality & Risk Management team, you will be responsible for supporting quality monitoring, reporting, and issue management activities across Assurance nonattest engagements.Key Responsibilities• Support execution of quality monitoring, and compliance tracking across Assurance nonattest engagements• Review monitoring results, exception outputs, and engagement-level information to identify policy/process non-adherence, quality risks, and negative trends• Perform and oversee data validation, data cleansing, and trend analysis to improve the reliability and usability of reporting outputs• Translate business, risk, process, and policy requirements into meaningful metrics, reporting views, and actionable insights• Track findings, remediation actions, aging items, and closure status to support timely follow-up and effective issue management• Prepare concise summaries, presentations, dashboards, and reports for leadership and key stakeholders• Review work performed by analysts and senior analysts to ensure accuracy, consistency, and adherence to team standards• Coach and guide junior team members on quality of work, analytical approach, judgment, and documentation standards• Help allocate work, monitor progress against deadlines, and support prioritization across multiple assignments• Collaborate with Quality & Risk Management (QRM) and engagement teams to strengthen processes and improve reporting effectiveness• Identify opportunities for process improvement and efficiency through analysis of operational and performance data• Contribute to continuous improvement of methodologies, templates, governance routines, and analytics capabilitiesThe teamThe Assurance Nonattest Quality & Risk Management team supports the Audit & Assurance business by monitoring quality, identifying risk indicators, and helping teams operate within established policies and processes. The team works closely with Quality & Risk Management and engagement stakeholders to provide reporting, issue tracking, and insights that strengthen execution quality and support continuous improvement across nonattest engagements.Location : HyderabadQualifications & Expectations• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field• 6+ years of experience in engagement operations, project management, quality monitoring, compliance, reporting, or data analytics• Experience reviewing work, coaching junior team members, and supporting team delivery quality• Experience creating leadership-level reporting, analyses, and presentations using Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint• Experience with dashboard development, data modeling/analytics, and report creation. Familiarity with Tableau/Power BI is preferred• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and translate findings into practical recommendations• Experience in Assurance-related services, compliance, risk, quality tracking, reporting, data analytics, or related business operations• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to navigate within and across cross-functional teams• High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment with minimalsupervision • Awareness of product development concepts, including ideation, testing, and release cycles. Familiarity with Agile methodology is preferred• You should expect to co-locate with team members or other colleagues in a Deloitte office, and/or virtually, based on specific team and business expectationsSuccess in This Role Will Be Measured By• Timely completion of monitoring and reporting activities• Accuracy, quality, and usability of dashboards, reports, and outputs• Value of insights and trend analysis provided to stakeholders• Effective tracking, escalation, and closure of findings and remediation actions• Quality, consistency, and timeliness of team deliverables• Effectiveness in coaching junior team members and improving overall team execution quality• Ability to work independently, demonstrate ownership, and uphold high ethical standards

Works with the team to identify bottlenecks and optimizations, adhering to defined standards/SLAs. Develops and iterates operational solutions with customers and product teams; responds to incidents rapidly to minimize downtime and user impact. Delivers lean, supportable solutions in small increments; validates with evidence, learns fast, and adapts execution to navigate ambiguity and complexity.·       Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Collaborates with product, delivery, infrastructure, and security teams; partners with COTS vendors to validate operational capabilities; integrates diverse perspectives to drive decisions, synergy, and innovation.·       Advanced Technical Proficiency: Applies intermediate SRE practices (Agile, DevSecOps, CI/CD) to improve automation and quality; supports the product lifecycle from design through scaling with continuous improvement and learning.·       Domain Knowledge: Learns domain/product/COTS context quickly; translates business and user needs into operational plans and automations; navigates product, UX, engineering, compliance, and security to drive feasible product value.·       Effective Communication and Influence: Communicates SRE concepts clearly; influences with evidence-based trade-offs, evaluations, and research; connects technical decisions to business objectives through coherent narratives.·       Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engages product engineering teams and customers as needed; builds trusted relationships and a co-creation culture; drives consensus across diverse viewpoints to deliver feasible solutions.The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes by leveraging a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.The successful candidate will possess:§  Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.Required Qualifications:§  A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline. description: Tax Senior - UK Corporate TaxDo you have a passion to work for U.K.-based clients of Deloitte Tax to provide tax compliance services? Are you ready to take the next step in your career by focusing on providing business and individual tax return compliance? Are you ready to fulfill your potential and want to have a significant impact to global initiatives? If the answer to all of the above is "Yes," come join us!Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP ("Deloitte Tax") U.S. service lines and regions have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn and support practice U.S. taxation, a much sought-after career option. In recent years, member firms, such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, etc. have obtained support in their tax related practice through the Deloitte Tax in India.At Deloitte, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.Work you’ll doIncreasingly complex tax decisions can have a significant effect—positive or negative—on the future of clients’ business. Our approach combines insight and innovation from multiple disciplines with business and industry knowledge to help clients excel globally.To list some of key responsibilities: -• Accurate preparation of low complexity UK Corporation Tax returns and computations across a range of industries using the standard procedures.• Identification and documentation of issues and preparation of client queries ✓ Working as part of a wider team to complete required volumes of work• Other UK Corporation Tax compliance-related processing activities as requiredThe TeamThe Deloitte UK team based in Hyderabad specializes in three core areas: UK corporation tax return preparation, electronic tagging and review of UK statutory financial statements, and governance and other support work for global tax outsourcing projects. On taking up a position with the UK team you will have the opportunity to focus on at least two of these core specialisms.Qualifications Required:• Full time master's in business administration (MBA) in Finance or equivalent from reputed University• At least 5-8 years of experience in experience in UK Corporate Tax returns• Excellent written and verbal communication skills• Strong accounting knowledge• Knowledge of Microsoft Office products — In particular, Excel and WordWork Location: HyderabadShift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM IST | 2 PM to 11 PM IST

description: Assistant Manager, Direct Tax – Firm Tax (Transfer Pricing)We are looking for professionals with sound working knowledge in Indian transfer pricing regulations and international tax law matters.Work you’ll do  The primary area of focus for this position is ensuring transfer pricing compliances (amongst other corporate tax compliances as well), compiling information and drafting submissions for defending tax litigation for the group of entities, visiting income-tax department to represent before the transfer pricing officer in relation to any transfer pricing litigation matters, working on APA and other advisory related work. The team consists of tax professionals with adequate expertise in handling tax matters. This team works in close coordination with the USI finance, legal and enabling besides business teams to ensure optimum tax health of the USI companies named above. QualificationsRequired:M.Com/MBA with 6- 8 years of experienceCA with 2 to 4 years’ experience with a large MNC or Big 4/consulting firm (preference would be a Big 4 or consulting firm)Detailed understanding of transfer pricing provisions and regulationsKnowledge and working experience of transfer pricing compliances such as preparation of TP documentation, Form 3CEB and other compliance formsKnowledge and working experience about transfer pricing litigation matters such as preparation of submission, research on technical issues, representation before the transfer pricing authorities, etc.Ability to work independently and work together with a team in an energetic and dynamic work environmentProficiency in MS Office (including advanced Excel, Word and PowerPoint skills).A self-motivator, a team player cum individual contributor with knowledge of an ERP environmentGood Communication, analytical skills, multi-tasking, and ability to work under pressure.Must be detail-oriented with a commitment to accuracy and quality work.Possess strong problem-solving skills with the ability to follow a transaction from beginning to end through various systems and reports.Strong written and verbal communication skills Location: HyderabadShift Timings: 9 AM to 6 PMHow you’ll grow At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. description: The Workplace Experience & Design (WED) Operations role supports Deloitte workplaces by enabling the systems, tools, and processes that drive workplace measurement, planning, and execution.Working in close partnership with the U.S. Real Estate Workplace Experience & Design teams, this role translates strategy, measurement insights, and operational needs into structured workflows, tools, and actionable plans that support workplace strategy and delivery.Sitting at the intersection of analytics, operations, workplace strategy, and technology, this role partners across functions to ensure WED initiatives are data-driven, well-governed, and effectively executed—not just well-designed.Work you'll doAs a Specialist, Analytics and Insights on the Workplace Experience & Design team, you will be responsible for:• Translate WED and Real Estate strategy into structured workstreams, execution plans, and roadmap delivery activities.• Lead measurement and analytics enablement through dashboards, tools, key performance indicators, and reporting that support data-driven decisions.• Support strategic planning, governance, and standards tracking across workplace initiatives, including forecasting, risk identification, and compliance reporting.• Improve workflows, tools, and operating processes to increase efficiency, transparency, scalability, and adoption across teams.• Coordinate execution across Workplace Experience & Design, Real Estate, WIQ, and Technology stakeholders to manage dependencies and deliver initiatives.The teamThe Deloitte Real Estate function is an integrated, cross-functional team spanning strategy, workplace experience, design, operations, and delivery. This role will be based in Hyderabad as part of the USI Real Estate / Workplace Experience capability and will work directly with U.S. leadership to support a global workplace portfolio.Location: HyderabadShift Timings: 2 PM to 11 PMQualificationsRequired:• 5-10 years of experience in workplace strategy, workplace analytics, workplace transformation, or program management.• Bachelor’s degree in architecture, engineering, business, analytics, or a related field.• Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau and advanced Microsoft Excel.• Experience with workflow or project management tools such as Smartsheet or similar platforms.• Experience developing metrics, dashboards, or reporting to support planning and decision[1]making.• Experience managing multiple workstreams, project plans, or operational activities in a structured environment.• Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders in a global environment.Preferred:• Background in architecture, workplace design, environmental design, or workplace consulting.• Familiarity with LEED, WELL, or sustainability and wellness concepts in workplace environments.• Experience facilitating workshops or structured planning sessions.• Familiarity with collaboration tools such as Mural or Miro.• Experience in process improvement, tool implementation, or workflow design.A couple of review notes:• I tightened the qualifications for measurability and candidate clarity.• The derived posting title Specialist, Analytics and Insights is compliant with the intake format, but it may not be candidate-friendly if used on a posting

title: USI-EH27- G&P-R&I-L35 - Specialist, Strategic Market Insights and Thought Leadership (CFS-Investment Management) - Mumbai
description: Specialist – Investment Management (IM) Research – Center for Financial ServicesThe Center for Financial Services is one of the industry teams within the Research & Insights (MI&I) group, focusing primarily on Banking and Capital Markets, Investment Management, Private Capital, Insurance and Real Estate. The Center's goals are to:Develop forward-looking insights that help financial services leaders anticipate and respond to what’s coming nextStrengthen Deloitte’s market positioning through high-quality thought-wareBring rigor to research by applying industry analysis, data science, survey advisory, editorial, and visualization capabilitiesShape market conversations by working with internal stakeholders and subject-matter leaders to deliver relevant, impactful campaignsLearn more about the Center and have a peek into our work here – (Link)This role involves contributing to thought leadership and research projects across the full lifecycle, from design to delivery, examining critical challenges and opportunities in IM sector. The Center’s IM research agenda covers major industry campaigns such as the annual investment management outlook, AI-enabled transformation, private markets and alternative investment growth, ETF and product innovation, regulatory change, and the future of investment management talent.The candidate will contribute to the Center’s research and thought-leadership agenda in the Investment Management sector, with a focus on investment managers, institutional investors, wealth platforms, and alternative investment firms. Coverage areas may include mutual funds, ETFs, hedge funds, private equity, private credit, real assets, and multi-asset strategies, alongside themes such as AI-enabled investment processes, portfolio construction innovation, private markets growth, retirement and wealth trends, investment data platforms, digital assets, regulation, talent trends, changing operating model, and the evolving resilience of global capital markets.These include whitepapers, in-depth research reports, case studies, articles, data-based research tools, client presentations, and collaterals for specific client accounts. These deliverables would integrate information from a range of primary and secondary sources, including Deloitte subject-matter experts, primary research (surveys), publicly available data, third-party research, analyst reports, presentations, industry commentaries, and news articles.Responsibilities:As a Specialist focused on developing thought leadership, you will be required to –:Work across diverse FSI – IM topics, quickly build subject-matter familiarity, synthesize complex information, and deliver high-quality research insights.Identify novel topics, areas and trends to focus on, based on extensive analysis of competition thought-ware/articles and importance of issues based on market studies, industry reports and tracking.Design research proposals, build consensus, and formulate a research plan.Interact with internal and external subject matter experts on industry topics and synthesize takeaways and findings into concise and well-structured narratives, assisting senior research leads to shape internal/external thought-leadership content and collaterals. Apply established research tools and methodologies to support business decision-making.Work on varied data sets (e.g.survey data, publicly available data sets) to derive data-driven insights.Identify and use the relevant data analysis methods and work with the relevant data science and analytics professionals to analyze voluminous and complex datasets.Demonstrate strong writing skills as required for thought leadership reportsDisplay strong consultative and engaging presentation skills.Support all aspects of engagement/project to ensure outcomes and meet deadlines.Assist senior researchers and practice leaders with internal briefings and external client meetings/webinars – by performing customized data analysis and presenting results and insights into client-ready briefing decks.Develop an understanding of Deloitte’s solutions, services, and offerings.   Requisite experience and skillsExperience 3-6 years of experience in supporting/managing research projects in IM topic areas. Business research and thought-leadership development experience in the Investment Management sector or related financial services industries is preferred. Knowledge of the investment management value chain—including product, portfolio management, distribution, servicing, and investment operations—across asset managers, wealth managers, institutional investors, and alternative investment firms will be an advantage. A broad understanding of the forces shaping the investment management industry—including market evolution, product innovation, investor preferences, regulatory developments, operating model transformation, and competitive dynamics across public and private markets—will be an advantage. Familiarity with the evolving role of intermediaries, platforms, custodians, data, and technology providers within the broader investment ecosystem will be beneficial. Experience working with US/global clients and teams is preferred. Since the job requires working closely with US-based colleagues, the ability to work across cultures is important. Industry/sector/subsector skillsTechnical skills Sound analytical skills with experience in one or more of the following research methods: Primary research (surveys), secondary research, academic research, and case study research. Strong data analysis skills with the ability to work with quantitative and qualitative data – interpret, analyze, visualize, and provide data-driven insights. Managing relations with internal stakeholders. Using advanced data science and survey advisory capabilities to strengthen the credibility of insights. Using editorial and visualization capabilities to improve the stickiness of firm thoughtware. Ability to develop compelling and analytical data visualizations using one or more tools like Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or others. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Journalistic and narrative writing style is preferred, along with prior experience in report writing and research report development. Problem-solving and critical thinking skills to generate meaningful analytical insights.  Broad understanding of strategy models and frameworks, and the ability to apply them to research problems.  Ability to understand the impact of marketplace changes on the industry, sector, or sub-sector.  Proficiency in using generative AI-based platforms and tools to elevate research discovery, data insights, analytical rigor, and business writing.  Proficiency in using generative AI and related tools to identify early signals and trends shaping the market through continuous sensing will be preferred.  Familiarity with building custom GPTs and custom gen-AI research tools will be an added advantage. The broader Deloitte Research and Insights teamThe Deloitte Research and Insights teams’ mission is to conduct research and analysis to develop compelling, forward-looking perspectives that enable clients to anticipate, prepare for, and respond to “what’s coming next.”The team plays an integral role in strengthening the firm’s strategic positioning by developing high-quality thought-ware from end to end, published on Deloitte Insights and Deloitte.com.Their work includes:Qualifications, experience, work location, and timingAcademic qualification: Master’s Degree like MBA, PGDM, Economics, Business EconomicsCFA charter holders or candidates pursuing CFA are preferredWork experience: 3-6 yearsLocation: MumbaiWork hours: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM IST (hybrid set up with two mandatory in-office days)

title: USI-EH27 - TAX - UK GI3 R&D  -L45 - Senior Tax services - Bangalore
description: Tax Consultant/ Senior – Global Innovation and Investment Incentives (Gi3 UK)The OpportunityAre you interested to work with clients developing innovative and state-of-the-art technologies? Are you driven to contribute to the financing of new emerging technologies and applied sciences? Are you ready to fulfill your potential and have a significant impact to global initiatives?If the answer to above is “Yes,” come join us!Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited started operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP U.S. service lines and regions have been supported by Deloitte Tax in India. In very recent years, member firms, such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands or the United Kingdom have been supported within their tax practice by Deloitte Tax India practice.The UK government provides tax incentives to businesses performing R&D; Deloitte’s R&D tax services group is a market leader in helping clients secure these incentives and is the most experienced team in the UK. We are looking for an open minded Information Technology (IT) / Computer Science (CS) professionals with both technical and software development knowledge, coupled with excellent communication skills. Knowledge of the full development lifecycle is sought and an appreciation of the types of technical challenges encountered across this lifecycle.Work you’ll doAs a Senior within our team, you will be in a client-facing role from day one, managing engagements, engaging with financial and technical teams, undertaking detailed financial analyses, and utilising your communication skills to quickly understand client costing methodologies. You will review and prepare high-quality documentation to quantify eligible R&D expenditure for tax purposes. This will require you to draw on your existing financial and costing experience, applying it to various industries and R&D projects.You will work as part of a project team alongside tax practitioners to help companies prepare their claims. You will work on multiple projects in parallel and will therefore have to manage several competing demands on your time.Your day-to-day responsibilities will allow you to gain an understanding of the financial structures behind a wide variety of cutting-edge technologies across different industries. You’ll have the opportunity to take a different career route and to maintain exposure to/increase your knowledge of emerging areas of innovation from a financial perspective.To list some of those key responsibilities:• Conducting efficient financial interviews with clients’ finance teams to understand their R&D expenditure, cost allocation, and financial systems.• Working directly with clients, Deloitte Partners and Directors taking ownership of end-to-end engagement management of R&D tax claim projects.• Analysing financial documentation and data from clients to support the development of robust R&D claim methodologies and prepare detailed costing schedules.• Invest in, mentor and train a cohort of analysts.• Champion the one-team culture across our UK and offshore delivery teams.• Writing clear, compelling financial reports for appropriate authorities (typically HMRC), based on financial analysis to convey how a client’s R&D expenditure qualifies for tax relief.• Lead projects to ensure R&D claims are delivered to time and within budget.• Working effectively in diverse teams of tax technicians, costing specialists and technical personnel within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.• Coordinate data automation for multiple projects concurrently.• Develop expertise and aptitude towards innovation in financial quantification.The TeamOur “Global Investment and Innovation Incentives (Gi³)” service line is embedded within Deloitte’s T&L practice and focused on advising companies in their pursuit of the right incentives by developing and executing an effective incentives strategy for their specific needs. The large majority of our Gi³ team members are scientists and engineers. Gi³ team then offers specific related knowledge and added value consultancy. This expertise allows our clients to take advantage of various incentives and grants related to their priorities in terms of Research & Development [R&D], innovation and sustainability. Further development of their intellectual properties and R&D activities can then leverage on those governmental support.To assist our clients in dealing with those government incentives, our team based in the UK proposes the services of a multi-disciplinary team of over 100 specialists (Lawyers, Economists, Scientists, Engineers or IT-specialists) highly experienced in assisting companies with multi-jurisdictions compliance, dealing with the complexities of local regulations and procedures – such as communicating with local grant and tax authorities, setting up new registrations and preparation & filling of government incentives applications.We are principally a UK-based team with colleagues in the Deloitte USI at Bangalore and are looking to further build our Bangalore capability.What we’re looking forAs a senior you will be in a client-facing role from day one, managing projects, preparing R&D claims, delegating, and building the team. You will be working with a variety of team members from junior to senior grades and be the main point of contact for your clients.  Your responsibilities will include:• Lead projects being the main point of contact with a range of senior stakeholders such as financial controllers, finance directors and chief finance officers.• Taking ownership over design of costing methodology, and execution of R&D tax engagements through liaison with internal engagement team to deliver high quality work products under budget.• Build eminence in the market and look for opportunities to grow the practice.• Build an internal network within Deloitte and gain an understanding of the services the firm can offer to broaden client relationships and differentiate us in the market.• Work within a project team to ensure that robust R&D claims are prepared whilst building deep client relationships.• Preparing clear reports for submission to HMRC to explain how our clients R&D claims have been prepared.• Provide financial input into marketing and sales activity based on your area of costing and tax knowledge.• Work effectively in diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.• Project managing a variety of projects at any given time and being able to delegate and work with the technical and finance team around you.Work Location - BangaloreShift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM IST

title: USI-EH27-Firm Tax-L25-Transfer Pricing
description: Analyst, Direct Tax – USI Firm Tax – Transfer PricingWe are looking for professionals with sound working knowledge in Indian transfer pricing regulations and international tax law matters. Work you’ll do  The primary area of focus for this position is ensuring transfer pricing compliances (amongst other corporate tax compliances as well), supporting with information for defending tax litigation for the group of entities (information gathering), supporting with working on APA and other advisory related work. Responsibilities include compilation /preparation of transfer pricing report, transfer pricing documentation and any other transfer pricing compliance forms.Key Responsibilities include: Compilation /preparation of transfer pricing report in Form 3CEB Co-management of preparation of TP Documentation including benchmarking study and any other transfer pricing compliance Preparing submissions/appeals/letters in relation to transfer pricing litigation, appearing before the tax authorities, preparation of supporting work papers for transfer pricing related matters Coordinating with Auditors for Annual Statutory Audit / Tax Audit and other Internal Audit requirements. Compiling periodic MIS reports pertaining to various Tax compliance metrics for appropriate analysis. Supervising and controlling tax compliance activities, coordinating for the payment of taxes with finance team members, acting as a liaison person between Finance and Firms Tax team. Be available as a contact person for external stakeholders and for liaising Revenue authorities, external Counsels, Tax advisors, etc. Assist with training and knowledge sharing within the Firm Tax Team. Create and/or update process documentation as processes change. Perform other job-related duties as assigned. The team  The USI Firms Tax team is responsible for ensuring entity level tax compliances for all the US India companies, besides catering to the tax essentials and advise to USI companies’ business and enabling functions ecosystems. The team consists of tax professionals with adequate expertise in handling tax matters. This team works in close coordination with the USI finance, legal and enabling besides business teams to ensure optimum tax health of the USI companies named above.Location: HyderabadShift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PMQualificationsRequired: CA with 2 to 3 years’ experience with a large MNC or Big 4/consulting firm (preference would be a Big 4 or consulting firm) Basic understanding of transfer pricing provisions and regulations Knowledge about the transfer pricing compliances such as preparation of TP documentation, Form 3CEB and other compliance forms Knowledge about transfer pricing litigation on how to prepare response to TP notices (like show-cause notice, CIT(A) submissions, etc.) Ability to work independently and work together with a team in an energetic and dynamic work environment Proficiency in MS Office (including advanced Excel, Word and PowerPoint skills). A self-motivator, a team player cum individual contributor with knowledge of an ERP environment Good Communication, analytical skills, multi-tasking, and ability to work under pressure. Must be detail-oriented with a commitment to accuracy and quality work. Possess strong problem-solving skills with the ability to follow a transaction from beginning to end through various systems and reports.How you’ll grow At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. title: USI- EH27- Operations- TBM FINANCE - Hyderabad_ Financial Planning and Analysis
description: Specialist Manager, Financial Planning and AnalysisAs Deloitte Technology’s Technology Finance function continues to scale, this Manager role exists to lead a Center of Excellence (COE): building a high-performing team, driving financial planning and reporting quality, and serving as the accountable leader who connects team execution with global stakeholder priorities.You will partner with Service Area leaders and technology leaders, manage and grow a team of financial analysts, and ensure that deliverables meet the quality standards expected at Level 5 ITFM maturity. You will also lead your team's journey into AI-assisted workflows — building the capability, confidence, and culture that turns technology curiosity into real efficiency gains. If you are a strong financial professional who leads people well and thrives in a global, fast-paced environment — this is a rare opportunity to build something.What You'll DoFinancial Planning & Analysis• Lead financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and analysis activities for assigned stakeholders and business areas, ensuring accuracy and executive-level clarity in all deliverables.• Perform and review complex financial analysis, variance reporting, and reconciliations to identify trends, issues, and efficiency opportunities.• Develop financial narratives that help technology leaders understand cost drivers, including non-controllable factors.• Prepare clear, polished updates and communications for US and regional leadership on deliverables, risks, team capacity, and operational performance.Stakeholder Management• Partner with Service Area/Service line/Cost center leaders to provide financial analysis, planning support, and ad hoc insights that enable confident and fact-based decisions.• Coordinate with cross-functional team members, business stakeholders, and finance partners to address financial questions accurately and promptly.• Support the preparation of executive-ready financial presentations, translating analytical work into clear narratives for senior technology and business audiences.Cost Category Management & Governance• Own end-to-end financial management for an assigned cost category (e.g., labor, cloud, hardware, or software), ensuring accurate tracking, reporting, and accountability across the full budget lifecycle.• Lead detailed variance analysis, trend monitoring, and cost driver reporting for the assigned category, translating data into actionable insights for technology and finance leadership.• Govern master data integrity for the assigned cost category, including WBS codes, cost hierarchies, and allocation rules, ensuring alignment to ITFM/TBM standards and reporting accuracy.Cross-Functional Intelligence• Collaborate across Technology service areas to gather financial intelligence on activities, contracts, and purchases that could impact cost category budgets — enabling proactive planning and stakeholder readiness.• Identify and escalate financial risks or data quality issues early, maintaining the reporting integrity expected at Level 5 ITFM maturity.Local Team Leadership & Development• Oversee work assignment, delegation, supervision, and quality review for India based analysts supporting the COE Financials function.• Manage existing team members by setting priorities, providing coaching, monitoring performance, and supporting career development.• Lead hiring, onboarding, and integration of new team members to build a strong, scalable local delivery capability.• Establish consistent processes, operating rhythms, and quality standards across the team — creating a delivery model that stakeholders can depend on.• Identify process improvements that increase consistency, efficiency, and transparency in financial and operational reporting.AI & Innovation AdoptionOur team is expected to be at the leading edge of integrating AI and automation into its daily work. As Manager, you own that journey for your team.• Champion AI tool exploration and adoption — identifying where generative AI, automation platforms, and analytical assistants can reduce manual effort in reporting, reconciliation, and data governance workflows.• Create an environment where experimentation is encouraged and failure is a learning event — build the psychological safety and operational space for analysts to try new tools, share what they discover, and continuously improve how work gets done.• Identify automation opportunities within local delivery workflows — look critically at repetitive, high-volume tasks (data pulls, format standardization, variance tagging) and develop a plan to eliminate or reduce them through automation.• Develop your team's AI literacy alongside their financial acumen — ensure analysts are building skills in AI-assisted tools as part of their professional growth, not as a side project. Make it part of onboarding, coaching, and performance conversations.• Coordinate with senior leadership and peer managers on AI tooling strategy — share learnings, align on tool choices, and ensure the team's adoption contributes to a coherent, firm-appropriate approach across the global team.• Stay current on AI capabilities relevant to finance and operations — bring informed perspective to conversations about what is emerging, what is ready, and what requires caution.Who You'll Work WithThis role bridges local leadership and global stakeholder service:• Technology Service Area/Cost center Leaders• India-based Financial Analysts (direct reports)• Other TBM teams and COE’s• Finance & Accounting Partners• Director, Technology Finance• TBM CL5 Managers (peers)• Business Relationship Managers• Business LeadersRequired• 8+ years of experience in Technology Finance, FP&A, or technology business management• Experience leading or managing a team of financial professionals• Strong financial analysis skills including variance analysis, reconciliations, and cost allocation• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; ability to work effectively with globally distributed stakeholders• Demonstrated ability to build processes, establish operating standards, and drive consistency across a teamPreferred• ITFM/TBM platform experience (Apptio, ServiceNow ITFM, or equivalent); ATUM certification a plus• Experience with SAP, Qlikview/Qliksense, Tableau, or similar enterprise financial platforms• Familiarity with WBS structures, product hierarchies, and TCO modeling• Experience in a global or cross-border delivery model, supporting geographically distributed stakeholders and leadership teams• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted finance or operations tools — including automation platforms, generative AI writing tools, or data pipeline tools applied to financial workflows• A genuine track record of curiosity-driven adoption — examples of identifying a tool, piloting it, and scaling it within a team environment• Ability to coach and develop others in new technology — experience building team capability in tools or processes, not just using them personally

title: USI-EH27-Consulting Services-EP-SCNO-Critical Manufacturing-Senior Consultant
description: Critical Manufacturing – Senior Consultant, Technical TransformationDeloitte is seeking a Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation to support Manufacturing Execution System (MES) transformation initiatives within its Supply Chain & Network Operations practice. In this role, you will help clients design, implement, and optimize Critical Manufacturing MES solutions to improve operational performance across complex manufacturing environments. The ideal candidate brings strong technical and functional experience across MES architecture, integrations, and deployment, along with the ability to translate business needs into scalable digital manufacturing solutions.Work you'll doAs a Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for supporting clients through the design, implementation, and optimization of Critical Manufacturing MES solutions across manufacturing operations. Lead and support Critical Manufacturing MES implementations, including requirements gathering, functional design, prototyping, configuration, testing, training, and deployment. Serve as a technical and solution architect for manufacturing transformation initiatives spanning MES, plant systems, and enterprise integrations. Conduct client workshops to validate requirements, define solution design, and document future-state MES processes and data models. Design and develop integrations between Critical Manufacturing MES and enterprise or plant systems, including SAP, product lifecycle management, advanced planning systems, laboratory information management systems, and automation platforms. Collaborate with client stakeholders, plant users, and subject matter specialists to assess current-state environments and define scalable future-state solutions. Support practice growth through proposal development, thought leadership, and innovation in digital manufacturing and Industry 4.0-enabled MES offerings. The teamEnterprise PerformanceThe Enterprise Performance team leverages deep industry knowledge, strong analytical skills, and practical approaches to address clients’ toughest business challenges. Our professionals as part of the Supply Chain Network Operations (SCNO) service line within Enterprise Performance focus on helping organizations achieve sustainable competitive advantage throughout their operations, spanning product development, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution. We excel at translating strategic objectives into tangible, measurable outcomes at the operational level. By aligning high-level goals with frontline execution, we ensure our clients realize real value and improved performance across every stage of their supply chain and operations.Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / ChennaiShift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST, as per business requirementsQualificationsRequired: 6-9 years of experience with the Critical Manufacturing MES platform, including configuration, customization, and deployment in discrete manufacturing environments Experience using Critical Manufacturing MES DEE for custom development and Critical Manufacturing MES Connect for integrations Experience designing or supporting MES integrations using Hypertext Transfer Protocol application programming interfaces, web services, SECS/GEM, or OPC-UA Experience with C# .NET, JavaScript or TypeScript, SQL Server, and SQL stored procedures Knowledge of ISA-95 or ISA-88 standards and regulated manufacturing requirements, including GxP, GAMP, or 21 CFR Part 11 Experience working with MES functional areas such as quality management, work-in-process tracking, dispatch management, scheduling, genealogy or traceability, or maintenance management Ability to travel 20-40%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. Preferred: Experience with cloud or Internet of Things-enabled MES reporting and intelligence solutions, including Azure or Amazon Web Services Experience with Mendix or other low-code platforms used in manufacturing environments Experience integrating MES with enterprise resource planning, product lifecycle management, laboratory information management systems, or advanced planning systems Experience in semiconductor, electronics, or discrete manufacturing environments Bachelor of Technology or Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, or another engineering discipline Master of Computer Applications, Master of Technology, or Master of Science#SCNOFY27LinkedInbanner

title: USI FY27 | Cyber Operate- SOAR + Anthropic - Manager
description: Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design and technology as we partner with clients to transform their security posture. As a Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale SOAR programs across a portfolio of client engagements. You will own technical strategy, manage multi-disciplinary teams, drive practice growth through pursuit support and offering development, and serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders. Your role spans engagement leadership, people development, intellectual property creation, and shaping how Deloitte brings AI-augmented security automation to market. Work you'll do As a Manager on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for: Leading end-to-end delivery of security orchestration, automation, and response (SOAR) engagements across client environments, including scope, timelines, quality, and risk management Defining SOAR architecture, operating models, and implementation roadmaps, including platform selection, integrations, playbook design, and operationalization Designing and implementing artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled security automation use cases, including large language model (LLM)-supported triage, incident summarization, and human-in-the-loop workflows Managing teams of consultants and analysts, including work planning, delivery oversight, coaching, and performance development Supporting practice growth through proposals, solution design, effort estimation, reusable assets, and intellectual property development The team Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes managing the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security, business transformation, and ensuring continuous compliance. Services include Cyber-as-a-Service, Managed Application Security, and Managed Extended Detect & Respond (MXDR). Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai/Gurugram/Kolkata Shift Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST Qualifications Required: 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity 5+ years of experience in SOAR engineering, security automation, or security operations Experience leading enterprise SOAR programs, including architecture, integrations, playbook development, and operationalization Experience with one or more SOAR platforms, such as Cortex XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, Tines, Swimlane, Torq, or IBM Resilient Experience with security operations center operating models, security information and event management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), incident response processes, and threat intelligence integrations Experience managing teams across client engagements, including resource planning, delivery oversight, and performance management Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology, or another technical field Preferred: Experience leading AI-enabled SOAR programs, including LLM-based playbook generation, agentic workflows, machine learning-based alert triage, and human-in-the-loop decisioning Experience with foundation model platforms, such as Anthropic Claude or OpenAI, for security automation use cases Experience defining governance and control frameworks for AI in security operations, including output validation, audit logging, and bounded-autonomy policies Experience leading security automation across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Industry certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) Experience with regulatory and control frameworks such as National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework (NIST CSF), NIS2, DORA, HIPAA, or PCI DSS#Cyber_Cyber Operate

description: Your role will focus on translating talent data into actionable insights that support strategic decisions, workforce planning, and talent operations. As a Specialist Manager, Analytics and Insights, you will partner with Talent leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to design data-driven solutions, shape reporting strategy, and deliver executive-ready insights. You will be working mainly on providing end to end automation solutions including creation of frontend UI for the Tasks which falls with the scope of cloud infrastructure including but not limited to provisioning. Decommissioning, maintenance of resources using Scripting, orchestration tools. You would be extensively working on integration of other tools using APIs as part of developing automation in the respective areas. Being an Automation expert you should have skills to provide solution for ticketing automation. Also experience working on CAM team that focused on application-level monitoring, code level debugging, self-healing via automation and root cause analysis. strong expertise as an Automation Engineer with a focus on AIOps, Generative AI, and Conversational AI.·       Familiarity with observability tools (e.g., Dynatrace, New Relic) and ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow)·       Exceptional communication skills and the ability to communicate appropriately with business and technical teams.·       Good understanding of the principles and best practices of Software Cloud Automation and Monitoring in Agile, Scrum.·       Good Knowledge in Administration of Production, Development and Test environments carrying different operating system platforms like Windows, Ubuntu, Red Hat Linux, SUSE Linux, Centos.Experience with data analysis and visualization tools such as Python, R, SQL, Tableau, etc.How you will growAt Deloitte, we have invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. description: Data Analytics Engineer – Software Engineer IIRole Overview: We are seeking a proactive and solutions-oriented Data Analyst with 2.5–4 years of hands-on experience in data analytics and applied AI/ML techniques. In this role, you will leverage your strong technical foundation and business acumen to transform complex datasets into meaningful insights that guide decision-making and strategy. You will demonstrate expertise in modern data analytics tools (such as Python, SQL) and show enthusiasm for learning next-generation analytics platforms like Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA). The ideal candidate is passionate about turning data into value, comfortable collaborating across diverse teams, and committed to staying at the forefront of emerging analytics and AI trends. You excel at translating business needs into actionable analysis, communicating findings effectively to technical and non-technical audiences, and driving measurable outcomes through data.Work you will doConduct data analysis and prepare reports to support business decision-making using statistical and machine learning techniques. Utilize Python and/or R, along with AI-powered coding tools such as Cursor AI or GitHub Copilot, to accelerate scripting and enhance analytics workflows. Extract, clean, and transform data from various sources—applying SQL and data wrangling skills to ensure data quality and readiness for analysis. Collaborate with team members to understand data requirements, ensure alignment to business objectives, and contribute to project deliverables. Participate in requirements gathering and solution workshops with stakeholders and senior analysts. Communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences via presentations, dashboards, or written summaries. Demonstrate curiosity and initiative by proactively learning new tools and technologies, such as Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), and similar digital analytics solutions. Support ongoing enhancements to analytics processes, documentation, and team best practices. -oriented team culture by sharing knowledge and supporting others.Key Responsibilities:Outcome-Driven Accountability: Aligns with: Delivering business outcomes, transforming business needs into analytical solutions, upholding quality in analytics and code as stated in your technical and professional skills.Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Aligns with: Supporting technical best practices, code integrity, and active participation in key SDLC phases (requirement analysis, development, testing) in Python/R, SQL, and relevant analytics tasks. Collaboration with senior team members aligns well with the CL3 role.Engineering Craftsmanship: Aligns with: Clean code, adherence to standards, data wrangling, preparing documentation, and commitment to best practices. Directly supports your expectations for “Programming,” “Data Wrangling,” and “AI Coding Assistants” skills, and continuous learning.Customer-Centric Engineering: Aligns with: Focus on delivering what stakeholders need, rapid prototyping, experimentation, and direct engagement with business/product teams, reflecting “Analytical Thinking” and “Ability to transform business needs into analytical solutions”.Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Aligns with: Agile methodologies, growth mindset, and continuous improvement. Supports “Commitment to continuously improving analytics workflows” and your requirement for contributing to maintainable, supportable solutions.Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Aligns with: Collaboration, working with diverse teams, and integrating multiple perspectives. Matches “Collaboration,” “Communication,” and “Working across functions and with diverse teams.”Advanced Technical Proficiency: Aligns with: Python/R for analytics and ML, SQL, AI coding assistants, adopting new analytics tools like Adobe CJA, and embracing SDLC and Agile practices. Encourages continuous technical improvement per your “Willingness to learn” and “Technical Skills” requirements.Domain Expertise: Aligns with: Quickly acquiring business-relevant knowledge, understanding data designs, and supporting business use cases with technical solutions. Supports “Domain knowledge,” “Transform business needs into analytical solutions,” and related technical skills.Effective Communication and Influence: Aligns with: Excellent communication skills, presenting complex ideas to varying audiences (technical/non-technical), and contributing to team and stakeholder discussions.Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Aligns with: Building strong team and stakeholder relationships, collaborative mindset, and co-creation of value-driven analytics/workflows—underpinning “Collaboration,” “Participation in hackathons,” and your supportive team culture.The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering drives Deloitte’s success by delivering innovative analytics and data science solutions through a modern, scalable, and value-focused delivery model. As the firm’s premier internal development team, we empower business units and internal operations to make smarter, data-driven decisions by transforming complex business needs into actionable insights and robust digital products. Leveraging advanced analytics tools, machine learning, and a responsive talent structure, our team consistently delivers measurable outcomes that enhance Deloitte’s efficiency, effectiveness, and market leadership—upholding our tradition of excellence and commitment to impactful results.Key Qualifications:2.5–4 years of professional experience in data analytics or data science Proficiency in Microsoft Fabric and SACProficiency in Python and/or R for analytics and machine learning Strong SQL skills for data querying and transformation Hands-on experience with AI-powered coding tools (e.g., Cursor AI, GitHub Copilot) Excellent communication and collaboration skills Ability to transform business needs into analytical solutionsGood to have skills: Experience with cloud analytics (AWS, Azure, GCP) 2.       Knowledge on BI tools like Tableau, SAP BOE is preferred Exposure to unstructured data or MLOps Participation in analytics competitions, hackathons, or holding relevant certifications Domain knowledge in a relevant business vertical How You will Grow: Opportunity to work on impactful analytics projectsSupport for ongoing professional development and learning new technologiesCollaborative environment with experts across analytics and business domains

Key Responsibilities Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes.
