title: USI FY27 | Cyber Operate- Wiz.io - Senior Consultant
description: Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance. Work you'll do As a Senior Consultant on the Security Platform team, you will be responsible for supporting clients in securing cloud environments using Wiz. Advise clients on Wiz capabilities, including Wiz Compute, Data Security, Threat Detection and Response, Code Scanning, Software as a Service (SaaS), and Container Security. Support client transitions to Wiz, including migration, integration, and optimization of security controls and processes. Evaluate cloud services against standards such as Center for Internet Security (CIS), National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), and General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and assess environment coverage within Wiz. Monitor vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and compliance issues, and deliver cloud security reports with actionable recommendations. Support policy development, incident response, data protection, access control, resource configuration activities, and documentation of technical issues and resolutions. The team Security Platform teams embed security in all aspects of digital transformation by securing a client’s “technical backbone” while also enabling a secure platform for the cloud environment. Services include security architecture, secure development and deployment, end-to-end cyber cloud capabilities, application security, and security for emerging technologies and connected products. Examples of work include Secure by Design, Cloud Security Orchestration & Automation, Core Infrastructure Security, and Secure Software Enablement. Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive Secure.Vigilant.Resilient.TM cyber programs. Cloud Infrastructure supports organizations through the complete cycle of migrating business processes to the cloud, with capabilities and solutions focused on development, transformation, and resilience of cloud security. Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai Shift Timings: 24*7 rotational shifts; flexibility for night, weekend, and holiday coverage is essential; on-call support required based on project assignment Qualifications Required: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology, or another technical field 5+ years of experience in technical consulting, including architecting and designing security solutions 4+ years of experience implementing security posture models using Wiz.io Experience developing code or policy using REGO, Open Policy Agent, Terraform, Python, or CloudFormation Experience with Cloud Security Posture Management and Cloud Workload Protection Platform capabilities Experience working across Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform environments Preferred: Certified Cloud Security Professional or Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals, Google Cloud Digital Leader, or another cloud or security certification#Cyber_Cyber Operate

description: Services Associate, Firm Risk, Compliance, and Governance Services- Market Business RelationshipDeloitte’s Enterprise Portfolio Management (EPM) team plays a crucial and growing role in helping the firm achieve its Multi-Disciplinary Model (MDM) objectives. EPM is seeking a high performing Analyst for a highly visible team working with senior business, industry, and account leaders to help modernize the Firm’s management of its third-party relationships to support critical MDM agility. The position sits in Growth & Purpose as part of the EPM team and is part of the larger Office of MDM that reports to the Chief Growth & Purpose Officer and business CEOs. The role offers a unique opportunity to help operationalize a new capability aimed at enabling Deloitte’s three world-class businesses to thrive. Work you'll do As a Services Associate, Firm Risk, Compliance, and Governance Services on the Enterprise Portfolio Management (EPM) team, you will be responsible for: Manage third-party risk data and processes, including data entry, verification, maintenance, audits, renewals, and closure of third-party engagement records in Deloitte compliance systems Support implementation of the MBR Modernization initiative to help operationalize a centralized capability that improves visibility into Deloitte’s sell-with relationships and supports growth Activate the new MBR operating model by gathering relationship information, confirming segmentation, identifying Relationship Owners, engaging LCSPs, and ensuring appropriate signaling in internal systems Engage with stakeholders across the firm to support the navigation of third-party relationships through the lifecycle, from early-stage discussions through establishment of strategic relationships Enable firm-wide visibility and accountability by managing high-volume MBR data and maintaining accuracy across firm systems throughout the relationship lifecycle The team EPM is a “heart of the business” multi-function, integrated team that brings deep MDM insights to tackle some of the firm’s most complex challenges. EPM’s mandate is to optimize our business footprint and unlock revenue by effectively navigating cross-business conflicts and Independence constraints while reducing MDM tension. Optimization requires EPM to proactively inform our business leaders on MDM implications for strategy and investment considerations, as well as vision to see beyond the firm’s current state to influence and optimize for our business of tomorrow. title: USI-EH27-Consulting Services-EP-SCNO-Windchill PTC-Consultant
description: Windchill PTC – Consultant, Technical TransformationEnterprise PerformanceOur Enterprise Performance team helps organizations improve business performance by connecting strategy, operations, and technology across product development, supply chain, and enterprise platforms. We work with clients to deliver digital transformation initiatives that improve efficiency, strengthen processes, and support scalable business outcomes.As part of this team, you will support Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and technical transformation efforts with a focus on Windchill and the broader PTC ecosystem. Our professionals help clients modernize product data, enhance engineering and change processes, and integrate PLM solutions with enterprise systems to drive more connected and effective operations.Position SummaryAs an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.Work you'll doAs a Consultant, Technical Transformation on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for: Design, develop, and customize end-to-end Windchill product lifecycle management (PLM) solutions across migration, configuration, and integration workstreams Configure Windchill components including lifecycles, workflows, change management, business rules, and bill of materials management to support business requirements Develop and support integrations between Windchill and enterprise systems such as SAP, computer-aided design (CAD) platforms, and visualization tools Build and support technical solutions using Java, Java 2 Platform, Enterprise Edition (J2EE), JavaScript, and Extensible Markup Language (XML) within Windchill environments Support testing, validation, and deployment activities across development, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and production environments The teamEnterprise PerformanceOur Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions.The Enterprise Performance team leverages deep industry knowledge, strong analytical skills, and practical approaches to address clients’ toughest business challenges. Our professionals as part of the Supply Chain Network Operations (SCNO) service line within Enterprise Performance focus on helping organizations achieve sustainable competitive advantage throughout their operations, spanning product development, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution. We excel at translating strategic objectives into tangible, measurable outcomes at the operational level. By aligning high-level goals with frontline execution, we ensure our clients realize real value and improved performance across every stage of their supply chain and operations.Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/ChennaiShift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST as per business requirementsQualificationsRequired: 3-6 years of experience in Windchill data migration using Windchill Bulk Migrator (WBM) or custom migration utilities Experience delivering 2-3 end-to-end Windchill implementation and data migration projects Experience with computer-aided design (CAD) data migration for SolidWorks and AutoCAD Experience configuring Windchill 10.x and 11.x, including business configuration, change management, workflows, and bill of materials management Experience developing or supporting Windchill technical solutions using Java, Java 2 Platform, Enterprise Edition (J2EE), JavaScript, and Extensible Markup Language (XML) Experience reviewing or supporting PLM code, integration configurations, install scripts, build scripts, deployment scripts, cron jobs, and custom utilities across development, quality assurance, and production environments Experience in automotive, manufacturing, or consumer goods industries Preferred: Experience with multiple product lifecycle management (PLM) frameworks Experience creating business solution assets Experience aligning PLM enterprise architecture to client roadmaps Experience using planning tools or enterprise resource planning platforms such as Oracle, SAP, o9, Kinaxis, or Anaplan Master of Business Administration (MBA) degree or equivalent from an accredited university #SCNOFY27LinkedInbanner

title: USI FY27 | OSH - Cyber Operate - Pre Sales - Manager
description: As a Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you’ll work as Cyber Solution Architect within the Operate Solution Hub, you will be responsible for coordinating the design of large and complex managed cybersecurity deals. These deals require solutioning for multi-domain within Cyber such as Infrastructure Security, IAM, GRC, Data Security, Vulnerability Management. The Solution Hub is designed to drive an optimum process for solutioning and pricing cross-cyber-domain managed security deals, reducing friction for cross-Offering Portfolio pursuits and optimizing review. By providing services such as inputs for deal qualifications, cyber benchmarks/effort estimation, and solution/pricing review, the Cyber Operate Solution Hub will be a focused space to increase win rates and profitability. Work you'll do As a Manager on the Cyber Operate Solution Hub team, you will be responsible for solution design and architecture activities: Leading development of cyber solution storyboards, total cost of ownership analyses, estimation frameworks, and pricing model inputs for managed security engagements across multiple cyber domains Designing differentiated deal structures and commercial models, including service tiers, outcome-based service level agreements, and cross-domain pricing strategies Collaborating with cyber subject matter specialists and pursuit stakeholders across Infrastructure Security, Identity and Access Management, Security Operations Center, Governance Risk and Compliance, and Vulnerability Management towers Supporting client discussions, orals, due diligence, and solution presentations that address threat landscape, regulatory obligations, security maturity gaps, and measurable risk reduction outcomes Working with transition and delivery teams to align pricing strategies with onboarding complexity, tool integration timelines, and steady-state managed security operations The team Cyber Operate Practice is focused on helping our clients identify and manage the cyber risks arising from their association with third parties or service providers. We help our clients to define their overall third-party cyber risk strategy, design and implement enterprise-wide programs and technology that focus on identifying and reducing risks; help them evaluate their objectives, priorities, strengths and weaknesses and roll out large scale organizational changes to achieve goals. Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai Qualifications Required: 9-15 years of experience in cybersecurity, including 6+ years in cybersecurity presales Experience solutioning enterprise cybersecurity services across multiple domains Experience developing business cases, estimation models, and pricing frameworks for managed security services Experience designing cyber managed service solutions across security domains Experience working in matrixed teams during deal pursuits with changing project requirements and timelines Advanced Microsoft Excel skills Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent Preferred: Master of Business Administration (MBA)#Cyber_Cyber Operate

title: USI-EH27-GPS (G&P National)-L35-Services Specialist- Market Business Relationship (EPM)- Hyderabad
description: Services Specialist, Firm Risk, Compliance, and Governance Services- Market Business RelationshipDeloitte’s Enterprise Portfolio Management (EPM) team plays a crucial and growing role in helping the firm achieve its Multi-Disciplinary Model (MDM) objectives. EPM is seeking a high performing Analyst for a highly visible team working with senior business, industry, and account leaders to help modernize the Firm’s management of its third-party relationships to support critical MDM agility. The position sits in Growth & Purpose as part of the EPM team and is part of the larger Office of MDM that reports to the Chief Growth & Purpose Officer and business CEOs. The role offers a unique opportunity to help operationalize a new capability aimed at enabling Deloitte’s three world-class businesses to thrive.Work you'll doAs a Services Specialist, Firm Risk, Compliance, and Governance Services on the Enterprise Portfolio Management (EPM) team, you will be responsible for: Managing third-party risk data and processes, including data entry, verification, maintenance, audits, renewals, and closure of third-party engagement records in Deloitte compliance systems Supporting implementation of the MBR Modernization initiative to improve visibility into Deloitte’s sell-with relationships and support growth Activating the MBR operating model by gathering relationship information, confirming segmentation, identifying relationship owners, engaging LCSPs, and ensuring appropriate signaling in internal systems Engaging with stakeholders across the firm to support third-party relationships through the lifecycle, from early-stage discussions through establishment of strategic relationships Developing recurring reporting, dashboards, and status summaries for leadership on volumes, aging, segmentation, renewal status, and operational performance Supporting governance, quality control, process standardization, and issue resolution across Risk, Independence, and business relationship teams The teamEPM is a “heart of the business” multi-function, integrated team that brings deep MDM insights to tackle some of the firm’s most complex challenges. EPM’s mandate is to optimize our business footprint and unlock revenue by effectively navigating cross-business conflicts and Independence constraints while reducing MDM tension. Optimization requires EPM to proactively inform our business leaders on MDM implications for strategy and investment considerations, as well as vision to see beyond the firm’s current state to influence and optimize for our business of tomorrow.Location: HyderabadShift Timings: 2 PM to 11 PMQualificationsRequired: 3+ years of professional experience in consulting, client service, project management, program management, compliance operations, governance operations, or data management Experience maintaining records and data in business systems or compliance platforms Experience performing data entry, data verification, reporting, audits, and record remediation activities Experience developing dashboards, status reporting, or operational summaries for leadership Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders in a virtual team environment Strong English oral and written communication skills Ability to work the 2 PM to 11 PM shift Preferred: Experience supporting third-party risk, independence, compliance, governance, or marketplace business relationship processes Experience working with internal business systems and tools Experience supporting process improvement, playbook development, or operating procedure standardization Experience partnering with Risk, Independence, or business relationship stakeholders Experience working in ambiguous or evolving business environments

title: USI FY27 | Cyber - Consultant - FDE
description: Cyber Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Deloitte’s Cyber team helps our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. We simplify complexity, and enable businesses to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage their security posture.The Team:Deloitte’s Cyber Engineering is a new team that is spearheading the buildout of Cybersecurity technology that will underpin the next generation of our Cybersecurity services. Join us as we work with technologies shaping the future of Cybersecurity to build future capabilities today. Position SummaryAs a Cyber Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you will work at the intersection of client engagement and hands-on engineering, embedding directly with client engagement teams to design, build, and deliver high-quality cybersecurity and AI-enabled solutions. You will support end-to-end technical delivery while contributing to solution shaping, influencing product direction, and providing appropriate support when needed for clients’ post-deployment. Must-have skillsCore Engineering & Architecture·       5-8+ years of hands-on experience in full stack development across frontend and backend technologies.·       Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern frameworks (React, Angular, or Next.js).·       Backend expertise in Node.js, Python (Django/Flask), or Java (Spring Boot). ·       Experience with relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Redis).·       Experience building and integrating REST APIs, microservices, and serverless architectures.·       Experience deploying applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP.·       Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and development lifecycle tools (e.g., Git, Azure DevOps).AI / GenAI Capabilities·       1+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying Agentic AI/GenAI/LLM-powered solutions in client or production environments·       1+ years of experience with one of the following Frontier Gen AI Platforms: Anthropic, Google or Open AI, including hands on experience with one of the following key platforms/products; Claude API, Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, Gemini API, Vertex AI Agent Builder, Grounding, Google Workspace integration, GPT-4o, Assistants API, Responses API, OpenAI Agents SDK·       Understanding of AI system architectures and ability to align application pipelines to support them.Client-Facing & Delivery Ownership·       Ability to independently own defined scope end-to-end with consistent, high-quality output.·       Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.·       Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts, risks, and trade-offs.·       Strong accountability and ownership mindset in achieving client outcomes.Good-to-Have Skills Familiarity with cybersecurity domains (e.g., application security, cloud security, identity, detection engineering). Familiarity with product engineering environments Experience with DevSecOps practices and secure software development lifecycle. Exposure to search/analytics platforms (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch) or graph databases (Neo4j). Knowledge of Kubernetes, GitOps, or advanced cloud-native patterns. Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP). Basic familiarity with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch). Work you will do:1. Solution Delivery & Engineering Translate business and cybersecurity needs into high-quality technical solutions (including AI/GenAI-enabled capabilities where applicable), and deploy them for clients in alignment with their requirements and architecture Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues within scope 2. Technical Pre-Sales & Solution Shaping Partner with stakeholders to help shape technical solutions during pursuits, including leading demos/POCs/prototypes Contribute to solution design, ensuring alignment between client needs and delivery feasibility. 3. Product Feedback & Continuous Improvement Capture and translate delivery learnings into actionable product or platform improvements, distinguishing reusable enhancements from client-specific needs. Enable client teams through structured knowledge transfer, clear documentation, and practical runbooks. Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: USI-EH27-Consulting Services-EP-SCNO-Critical Manufacturing-Consultant
description: Critical Manufacturing – Consultant, Technical TransformationDeloitte is seeking a Consultant, Technical Transformation to support Manufacturing Execution System (MES) transformation initiatives within its Supply Chain & Network Operations practice. In this role, you will help clients design, implement, and optimize Critical Manufacturing MES solutions to improve operational performance across complex manufacturing environments. The ideal candidate brings strong technical and functional experience across MES architecture, integrations, and deployment, along with the ability to translate business needs into scalable digital manufacturing solutions.Work you'll doAs a Consultant, Technical Transformation on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for supporting clients through the design, implementation, and optimization of Critical Manufacturing MES solutions across manufacturing operations. Lead and support Critical Manufacturing MES implementations, including requirements gathering, functional design, prototyping, configuration, testing, training, and deployment. Serve as a technical and solution architect for manufacturing transformation initiatives spanning MES, plant systems, and enterprise integrations. Conduct client workshops to validate requirements, define solution design, and document future-state MES processes and data models. Design and develop integrations between Critical Manufacturing MES and enterprise or plant systems, including SAP, product lifecycle management, advanced planning systems, laboratory information management systems, and automation platforms. Collaborate with client stakeholders, plant users, and subject matter specialists to assess current-state environments and define scalable future-state solutions. Support practice growth through proposal development, thought leadership, and innovation in digital manufacturing and Industry 4.0-enabled MES offerings. The teamEnterprise PerformanceThe Enterprise Performance team leverages deep industry knowledge, strong analytical skills, and practical approaches to address clients’ toughest business challenges. Our professionals as part of the Supply Chain Network Operations (SCNO) service line within Enterprise Performance focus on helping organizations achieve sustainable competitive advantage throughout their operations, spanning product development, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution. We excel at translating strategic objectives into tangible, measurable outcomes at the operational level. By aligning high-level goals with frontline execution, we ensure our clients realize real value and improved performance across every stage of their supply chain and operations.Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / ChennaiShift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST, as per business requirementsQualificationsRequired: 3-6 years of experience with the Critical Manufacturing MES platform, including configuration, customization, and deployment in discrete manufacturing environments Experience using Critical Manufacturing MES DEE for custom development and Critical Manufacturing MES Connect for integrations Experience designing or supporting MES integrations using Hypertext Transfer Protocol application programming interfaces, web services, SECS/GEM, or OPC-UA Experience with C# .NET, JavaScript or TypeScript, SQL Server, and SQL stored procedures Knowledge of ISA-95 or ISA-88 standards and regulated manufacturing requirements, including GxP, GAMP, or 21 CFR Part 11 Experience working with MES functional areas such as quality management, work-in-process tracking, dispatch management, scheduling, genealogy or traceability, or maintenance management Ability to travel 20-40%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. Preferred: Experience with cloud or Internet of Things-enabled MES reporting and intelligence solutions, including Azure or Amazon Web Services Experience with Mendix or other low-code platforms used in manufacturing environments Experience integrating MES with enterprise resource planning, product lifecycle management, laboratory information management systems, or advanced planning systems Experience in semiconductor, electronics, or discrete manufacturing environments Bachelor of Technology or Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, or another engineering discipline Master of Computer Applications, Master of Technology, or Master of Science #SCNOFY27LinkedInbanner

description: Product Engineering Manager Fullstack Engineering Manager IThe Engineering Manager is an integral part of the technical application development team and primarily responsible for building and delivering the enterprise IT solutions. This position provides opportunity to lead and manage projects and programs for internal IT organization. title: USI-EH-FY27- L45 - NSE TAX Pursuit - Senior Consultant
description: Pursuit - Senior, Tax ServicesAbout Deloitte GES and GPO Deloitte's Global Employment Solutions (GES) practice is one of the world’s largest, serving more than 300 multinational organizations. Our professionals work with companies operating internationally to design and administer human resources and tax programs and policies that support employees living and working outside their home countries. Within GES, the Global Payroll Operate (GPO) team provides both domestic and international payroll services, including payroll technology and process implementation, ongoing operations management, and coordination between internal and external teams.Role Overview This role is responsible for supporting and managing complex, strategic payroll pursuits across the full sales lifecycle. In addition to bid execution, the individual will help shape differentiated client propositions, drive pursuit governance, improve proposal quality, and support stronger win outcomes on strategic opportunities. The role requires close collaboration with account teams, solution leaders, commercial stakeholders, delivery SMEs, and leadership to ensure a compelling, compliant, and commercially sound pursuit process.Key Responsibilities1) Bid Management and Pursuit Coordination Respond to RFx opportunities, including proposal authoring and presentation support. Project-manage pursuits across the full sales lifecycle, acting as the central point of coordination for stakeholders to drive bid outcomes, manage reviews, and ensure effective communication from qualification through submission and deal closure. Develop and own the pursuit plan, including key milestones, deliverables, interdependencies, and accountability across contributors, and manage pursuit meetings and logistics. Establish and maintain pursuit working files/sites using tools such as Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and other approved collaboration platforms. Contribute to win strategy development, value proposition refinement, solution reviews, oral presentations, negotiations, and business case preparation. Deliver pricing quote requests with a solid understanding of key commercial elements. description: Join Deloitte’s Cyber Engineering organization as a Data Scientist, Assistant Manager, Cyber Engineering supporting the US Attack Surface Management team. In this role, you will help transform cyber and operational data into meaningful insights that inform risk-based decisions, improve remediation outcomes, and strengthen visibility across the attack surface. You will work across metrics, reporting, automation, and analytics to support leaders and technical stakeholders with clear, actionable intelligence. This role is well suited for a professional with deep experience in data analytics and cybersecurity reporting who can turn complex data into practical business value.Work you'll doAs a Data Scientist, Assistant Manager, Cyber Engineering on the US Attack Surface Management team, you will be responsible for: Own and develop the metrics, dashboards, and recurring reporting portfolio for the US Attack Surface Management team, including leadership, operational, stakeholder, and service-level reporting. Design and maintain data models, reporting logic, analytical views, scripts, and automation supporting data ingestion, transformation, validation, and recurring analysis. Apply statistical analysis, predictive modeling, anomaly detection, clustering, classification, and other data science techniques to identify trends, anomalies, and risk signals across attack surface management data. Translate complex cyber and operational data into concise narratives, visualizations, and recommendations that help stakeholders prioritize remediation and measure risk reduction outcomes. Partner with cybersecurity, infrastructure, business, and data platform teams to improve data quality, resolve reporting issues, and continuously enhance key performance indicators, key risk indicators, data definitions, data lineage, playbooks, and runbooks. The teamAt Deloitte, we’re all about collaboration. And nowhere is this more apparent than among our 2,000-strong internal services team. With our combined specialist skills, we provide all the essential support and advice our client-facing colleagues need, right across the firm. This enables them to focus all of their efforts on delivering the best service possible to their clients. Covering seven distinct areas; Human Resources, Clients & Industries, Finance & Legal, Practice Support Services, Quality & Risk Services, IT Services, and Workplace Services & Real Estate, together we live, breathe and deliver the Deloitte experience.Location: Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, PuneShift Timings: 9:00 AM to 11:00 PM ISTQualificationsRequired: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or another quantitative field 10+ years of experience in data analytics, data science, data engineering, cybersecurity analytics, application development, or information security Experience developing metrics, dashboards, and recurring reporting for cybersecurity, technology, or risk programs Experience using Python and SQL for data analysis, automation, and reporting Experience building dashboards and visualizations in Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms Experience supporting data pipelines, extract, transform, load or extract, load, transform processes, application programming interfaces, data ingestion, validation, and data quality controls Experience defining and maintaining data definitions, data lineage, metric logic, quality controls, playbooks, and runbooks Preferred: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or Cybersecurity Certification in data analytics, data science, cybersecurity, or cloud technology Experience applying predictive modeling, anomaly detection, clustering, or classification techniques Experience with cloud services or cloud data platforms Experience analyzing vulnerability, asset, exposure, ownership, or remediation data Experience supporting executive reporting, audit requests, or urgent cyber response reporting

title: USI-EH27-F&A-A&C- L10-Services Support Associate II- Contracts Lifecycle Mgmt (R&C) - Hyderabad
description: Services Support Associate II, Contracts Lifecycle ManagementDo you have an aptitude for Contract review, AI, data analytics and creating positive user experiences? If so, you may be a good fit for this role. At Deloitte, we provide client services and develop new products and services to sustain competitive advantage, while managing a diverse collection of systems, processes, and functions. As a Records & Contracts (R&C) Services Support Associate II, you’ll help facilitate compliance with policies and practices related to records and contracts management by providing technology, tools and processes tailored to meet customer needs. Work you'll do As a Services Support Associate II, Firm Risk, Compliance, and Governance Services on the R&C team, you will be responsible for: Interpret contract conditions, review contract specifications, and identify potential risks. Utilize AI for trend analysis, contract review, and extraction of insights from contract data, including transforming contract-related business questions into actionable, repeatable generative artificial intelligence prompts. Participate in technology upgrade and enhancement projects and perform user acceptance testing. Coordinate and manage assigned processes, projects, technologies, and initiatives, including identifying required actions and improvements and working with the R&C team to support compliance. Execute research, data analysis, queries, and report generation within contracts management and related systems, while maintaining project documentation and standard operating procedures. The team The R&C team consists of an integrated, cross-functional group of team members, with every role critical to our successful project delivery. R&C partners with each Deloitte business to facilitate compliance with policies and practices related to records and contracts by providing technology, tools and processes tailored to meet their needs. We also play a key role in coordinating with the Office of General Counsel for document preservation requests. The team works closely with stakeholders in developing new processes and collaborates to enhance existing operations. Location: Hyderabad Shift Timings: 2 PM to 11 PM Qualifications Required: Bachelor’s degree 1-3 years of work experience Advanced Microsoft Office skills English language proficiency, written and verbal Experience providing customer service support Ability to collaborate with team members in India and the United States Attention to detail for accuracy in work output Preferred: Experience analyzing contract data and using AI to support reporting and strategic insights

title: USI-EH-FY27- L35 - NSE TAX ERP- SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) - Tax Technology Services Consultant II
description: SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) - Tax Technology Services Consultant II Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP ("Deloitte Tax") U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a much sought-after career option. At Deloitte, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.Work you’ll do We are looking for an innovative Technical SAP ABAP on HANA, CDS, OData, RAP Plus Gen AI develop and implement systems architecture that meet business needs, along with ensuring that our clients’ can keep pace with the changing tax and legal landscape. Design, build, and support performance SAP S/4HANA extensions and services using ABAP on HANA, RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), Core Data Services (CDS), and OData to enable modern Fiori/UI and integration scenarios. To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best SAP Tax design for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group. You will also need to continually assess the SAP product suite and development roadmap to integrate any updated specifications and requirements into SAP system architecture. You will also need to integrate with the wider client project team (whether that is delivered by Deloitte Consulting or another Systems Integration partner). This will involve an understanding of how the tax design interacts with other process flows and also the inter-personal skills to build the required relationships.Key responsibilities -ü  Develop and enhance ABAP solutions on SAP S/4HANA using clean, modular, and testable patterns. ü  Build Gen AI applications and AI Agents.ü  Code Python is a plus.ü  Ability to navigate fragmented landscapes through API-calls and MCP- servers is key.ü  Build end-to-end RAP artifacts (behavior definitions/implementations, validations, determinations, actions, draft handling, locking, authorization concepts). ü  Create and optimize CDS views (interface/consumption views, associations, annotations) with strong focus on pushdown and performance. ü  Design, expose, and support OData services (preferably OData V4 via RAP; maintain OData V4 where required). ü  Implement Fiori-enablement via CDS annotations and support UI integration with SAP Fiori elements (as applicable). ü  Integrate with SAP and non-SAP systems using SAP-recommended patterns (e.g., APIs, events, messaging where applicable). ü  Apply performance tuning (SQL optimization, buffering strategy, ST05/SAT/SQLM analysis, CDS performance best practices). ü  Follow SAP extensibility guidelines (in-app/extensibility, key-user vs developer extensibility, released APIs, clean-core approach where applicable). ü  Produce technical designs, code documentation, unit tests, and participate in code reviews. ü  Support testing cycles, defect triage, hyper care, and production support with strong root-cause analysisQualification and Experience Required -ü  Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience). ü  2-5 years of Experience in SAP or SAP4HANA.ü  Hands-on experience in building Gen AI applications, AI Agents.ü  SAP Business AI certification is a plus.ü  SAP certifications (ABAP for S/4HANA, RAP, BTP) are a plus.ü  Strong hands-on experience with ABAP in SAP S/4HANA / ABAP on HANA environments.ü  Proven delivery experience with: ü  RAP (managed/unmanaged as needed, behavior implementation, draft, authorization)ü  CDS (views, annotations, associations, table functions if needed)   ü  OData service exposure and troubleshooting (RAP/OData V4 strongly preferred)ü  Strong understanding of HANA-optimized development: SQL/CDS pushdown, avoiding SELECT-in-loops, efficient joins, pagination, etc.ü  Familiarity with modern ABAP practices (e.g., ABAP OO, clean code, exception handling, unit testing mindset).ü  Experience working in Agile delivery (user stories, estimation, sprint ceremonies).ü  Preferred / Nice to Haveü  SAP BTP exposure (e.g., Integration Suite, API Management, Event Mesh, ABAP environment/Steampunk—if relevant).Preferred - ü BTP, Joule and SAP business AI certification. ü Proven knowledge of Tax touchpoints within SAP.How you’ll grow At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal in creating a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in exactly the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team- based learning, and eLearning. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state-of-the-art, world-class learning Center in the Hyderabad offices is an extension of the Deloitte University (DU) in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. [1] Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India. Deloitte supports your progression through a well-defined career path by providing challenging assignments, mentoring, and targeted trainings. Recent post graduates begin as a consultant. The career path from there is to senior consultant, then manager, senior manager and onto a path to director or partner or principal.Deloitte’s culture Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer well-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. [2] Learn more about Life at Deloitte.Corporate citizenship Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. title: USI-EH27-Consulting- Full Stack Developer (Node.js/Python) - Zora - Software Engineer III
description: National Consulting Services The National Office, a key Strategic Enabler in our new model, is comprised of professionals with various areas of focus that collectively provide mission critical services to support Deloitte’s overall success. Whether focused on project financial, quality and risk management, methods and tools, sales excellence, talent, leadership support, or other activities these professionals ensure that our Firm operates efficiently, and our people are able to effectively serve clients every day. Join a collaborative team delivering production-grade web applications that create real business impact. As a Senior Consultant, you will design and build enterprise-scale solutions across both backend and frontend, with a focus on API development and seamless integration. You’ll use modern AI tools to boost productivity, work with technologies like Docker for deployment, and help guide projects from planning to delivery. This role offers a chance to work on innovative projects blending predictive analytics and cutting-edge technology, while mentoring junior engineers and partnering with global teams.Work you'll doAs a Software Engineer III on the Innovation and Technology team, you will be responsible for: Designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications across backend and frontend components Building and supporting secure application programming interfaces and services using Java, Node.js, and Python Translating design concepts into functional user interfaces using React.js and TypeScript and integrating them with backend services Applying engineering practices across testing, code quality, containerization, continuous integration, and continuous deployment to support reliable delivery Collaborating with product, DevOps, and engineering teams to deliver features, improve productivity through AI-assisted development tools, and mentor junior team members The teamInnovation and Technology anticipates how technology will shape the future and begins building future capabilities and practices today. I&T drives the Ideation, Incubation and scale of hybrid businesses and tech enabled offerings at prioritized offering portfolio and industry interactions.It drives cultural and capability transformation from solely services – based businesses to hybrid businesses. While others bet on the future, I&T builds it with you. title: USI-EH27- G&P-Client Relationship Development-L35-Specialist, Experience Specialist/ Producer- Hyderabad
description: Specialist, Client Experience - Experience Specialist/ ProducerAbout the teamThe Deloitte Client Experience team works with senior account leaders to design and deliver high-impact experiences for visiting clients in India. The team partners with leaders to tell an executive-ready story, facilitate meaningful dialogue, influence commercial decisions and enhance Deloitte's brand and reputation in the marketplace.What you'll doAs an Experience Specialist/Producer, you will own end-to-end activities to deliver a meaningful and impactful experience for clients during their visit to the Deloitte offices in India. From evaluative and scoping through agenda/run-of-show design, content and experience asset curation, logistics orchestration, and day-of delivery, you will act as a primary point-of-contact for account teams and support teams for visit requirements, coordinating the end-to-end experience of client visits to deliver a seamless journey.Key responsibilitiesSupport end-to-end experience planning and coordinate logistics for client visits with guidance, partnering with internal teams to track progress, milestones, anticipate bottlenecks and resequence work to drive timely completion of key activities with regular and proactive communicationHelp draft agendas, modules and storyboards, while coordinating reviews/approvals.Manage clear communications with the Client Experience Lead and key stakeholders, turning feedback and pivoting as neededBuild and manage the run-of-show, own content readiness, coordinate speakers and ensure executive-ready materials by managing versioning, reviews and approvalsWork closely with support teams to understand changing visit requirements in detail and manage the analysis and input of those requirements into our client visit management system (Captivate) to enable the support teams to effectively deliver servicesSchedule and manage scoping calls for all requests logged in Captivate, and ensure all required details are updated in Captivate in real-time to ensure accuracy and visibility for support teams and stakeholdersManage service requests in Captivate in partnership with support teams and the Client Experience Coordinator, tracking progress and driving on-time delivery through proactive follow-ups and clear status communicationsSupport Experience Lead on creating client experience deliverables and surveys through various tools; capture and close out post-visit debriefs, and support follow-up actionsCollaborate with team, peers, and seniors with active knowledge development, transfer and share best practices to achieve team goalsProvide solutions and negotiate service conflicts (e.g., meeting space) with account teams to ensure critical visit requirements and expectations are metBuild effective relationships with support teams to ensure the best results for the processes and deliverables are well executedContinuous improvement activitiesFacilitate continuous improvement and innovation for ways in which services can be improved, targeting standardization, efficiency and qualitySupport the Client Experience Lead in preparing periodic reports to be shared with leadership and conduct feedback reviews with support teamsCurate and maintain best practices to add to the library for future visitsProvide insights and recommendations for service improvement to the Client Experience Manager and LeadRequired qualifications and skills:Academic qualification: Bachelor's degreeWork experience: 3 - 5 years in related fieldExperience working in a large organization, MNCs or similar professional services firmBig picture thinking to help in delivering improved and enhanced client experienceAbility to multi-task in a fast-paced environment; agility to pivot in crunch situationsInnovative mindset to offer value-added suggestions and alternate solutionsWork around tight timelines with agreed SLAs. Prioritize tasks and navigate ambiguity effectively while managing multiple assignments without missing deadlinesBuild relationships and interactions with key stakeholders, align well with diverse teams for seamless collaborationProvide regular status updates to stakeholders, leads and help keep execution on trackFlexibility and adaptability to dynamics of processes and working stylesStrong and clear communication skills, professionalism and executive presenceAbility to work well independently and as part of a team; collaborating with members at all levelsWork location and timingLocation: Hyderabad (flexible to travel as per business needs and work across locations in India)Hybrid work week; in-office as per business and client needs with spikes around live delivery dates.Periodic travel and on-site delivery depending on client/business needs; flexible to work across diverse time zones and geographical regions in India.Work timing: 11:00 a.m. to 08:00 p.m. regular. Flexible/alternate work hours and days in office based on the client visit/lab and stakeholder requirements.

title: USI-  EH27 - Consulting- Customer - S&S - PriceFX - Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation
description: #S&S2027Customer The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence. Position Summary We are seeking a Senior Consultant with experience in pricing transformation and Pricefx to support the design and delivery of pricing strategy, pricing technology, and commercial excellence solutions for clients. This role sits within the Sales & Service offering and supports Customer OP engagements focused on improving pricing effectiveness, margin performance, and sales execution. The Senior Consultant will work with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into Pricefx-enabled solutions and support implementation, testing, and client adoption. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions. As a Senior Consultant, you will analyze complex business challenges, mentor team members, and uphold exceptional standards while building trusted client relationships and navigating increasingly complex situations. This role offers the opportunity to deepen your technical expertise and collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and deliver impactful pricing strategies. Level: Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation Work you’ll do: Configure and extend Pricefx solutions to support enterprise pricing Collaborate with clients to analyze complex pricing challenges and deliver actionable recommendations. Support Pricefx implementations including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment Work with client stakeholders to assess current pricing processes, identify pain points, and define improvement opportunities Translate business requirements into functional specifications and user stories for pricing tools and workflows Assist in configuring Pricefx modules such as pricing logic, quoting, workflows, approvals, rebate management, analytics, and dashboards Conduct data analysis to support pricing strategy, segmentation, discount optimization, and margin improvement initiatives Collaborate with cross-functional teams on integrations across ERP, CRM, CPQ, and downstream reporting systems. Support SIT/UAT, and manage defect tracking and resolution Prepare client-ready deliverables including process maps, requirements documents, training materials, and status updates Support change management, end-user training, and business adoption activities Mentor junior team members and contribute to knowledge sharing and team capability building Collaborate with teams to drive impactful pricing strategies Help navigate complex project situations and drive execution of key project activities. Contribute to practice development through asset creation, internal knowledge sharing, and pursuit support The team: Step into our Sales & Service team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end-to-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service. Qualifications Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, information systems, or related field 6+ years of consulting and/or industry experience in pricing, commercial excellence, revenue management, or sales transformation Hands-on experience with Pricefx in implementation, configuration, or business process design Understanding of pricing processes including price setting, discounting, approvals, rebates, and margin analysis Experience working with large datasets and translating insights into business recommendations Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills Ability to work in a team-based, client-facing environment and manage multiple workstreams Willingness to travel based on client and business needs Multiple end to end implementation experiences in Pricefx Should have very good communication and presentation skills  Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: Experience with B2B pricing transformation programs Familiarity with ERP/CRM platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics Exposure to pricing analytics, CPQ, quote-to-cash, or commercial operations processes Experience in Agile delivery environments Advanced Excel, PowerPoint, and requirements documentation skills Prior experience in consulting, especially in customer, sales, or service transformation programs Pricefx certification preferred Understanding of Gitlab platform for project delivery Education: * BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university Location: * Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

Support Pricefx implementations including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment Work with client stakeholders to assess current pricing processes, identify pain points, and define improvement opportunities Translate business requirements into functional specifications and user stories for pricing tools and workflows Assist in configuring Pricefx modules such as pricing logic, quoting, workflows, approvals, rebate management, analytics, and dashboards Conduct data analysis to support pricing strategy, segmentation, discount optimization, and margin improvement initiatives Collaborate with cross-functional teams on integrations across ERP, CRM, CPQ, and downstream reporting systems. Support SIT/UAT, and manage defect tracking and resolution Prepare client-ready deliverables including process maps, requirements documents, training materials, and status updates Support change management, end-user training, and business adoption activities Mentor junior team members and contribute to knowledge sharing and team capability building Collaborate with teams to drive impactful pricing strategies Help navigate complex project situations and drive execution of key project activities. Contribute to practice development through asset creation, internal knowledge sharing, and pursuit support The team: Step into our Sales & Service team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end-to-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service. Qualifications Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, information systems, or related field 6+ years of consulting and/or industry experience in pricing, commercial excellence, revenue management, or sales transformation Hands-on experience with Pricefx in implementation, configuration, or business process design Understanding of pricing processes including price setting, discounting, approvals, rebates, and margin analysis Experience working with large datasets and translating insights into business recommendations Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills Ability to work in a team-based, client-facing environment and manage multiple workstreams Willingness to travel based on client and business needs Multiple end to end implementation experiences in Pricefx Should have very good communication and presentation skills  Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: Experience with B2B pricing transformation programs Familiarity with ERP/CRM platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics Exposure to pricing analytics, CPQ, quote-to-cash, or commercial operations processes Experience in Agile delivery environments Advanced Excel, PowerPoint, and requirements documentation skills Prior experience in consulting, especially in customer, sales, or service transformation programs Pricefx certification preferred Understanding of Gitlab platform for project delivery Education: * BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university Location: * Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

title: USI-EH-FY27- L55 - NSE TAX ERP- Oracle Fusion - Manager, Tax Technology
description: Oracle Fusion - Manager, Tax TechnologyDeloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as the Netherlands, United Kingdom etc.) taxation practice, a popular career option.At Deloitte, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.Work you’ll doWe are looking for dynamic professionals that are looking to broaden their careers in Tax and Oracle. As you build your career with us in Oracle within our Tax ERP team, you will be helping our clients to design, develop and implement systems architecture that best meets their business needs, in the rapidly changing tax and legal landscape.You will be working alongside an experienced and growing team, to support our clients in ensuring that they have the right data, business processes and systems set-up for the future. You would be required to coordinate with the UK engagement leaders and clients to implement ERP Tax solutions in Oracle.To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best Oracle design for Tax for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group.Your service line: Tax Technology Consulting – NSE USI Tax ERPWithin Tax Technology Consulting sits our NSE USI Tax ERP team who specialize in implementing tax requirements within finance transformation programmes or system remediation programmes. We are a fast-growing team with a super-growth ambition. We undertake Oracle Cloud implementations in ERP, and these need a combination of Tax knowledge and Oracle solution design capabilities. Tax in Finance Transformations is a key differentiator for our practice globally.As a Tax-focused Oracle Consultant, you will be part of the tax workstream on our engagements. You will have plenty of opportunities to work on large-scale projects as part of complex business transformations. You will work with a wide range of colleagues and clients around the world, exposing you to cutting edge tax technology work in a strategic, commercial, and business context. You will find opportunities to apply an impressive range of broad consulting and functional skills that will enhance your career.Key responsibilitiesYour professional experiencePreferredOur purposeDeloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our clients, our people, and in our communities. We are creating trust and confidence in a more equitable society. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. We are focusing our collective efforts to advance sustainability, equity, and trust that come to life through our core commitments. Our commitment has led to outstanding results in terms of attracting, retaining, and advancing a diverse workforce. We are regularly recognized as an employer of choice across a range of aspects, including inclusion, well-being, innovation, leadership, and a place to start your career. title: USI FY27 | OSH - Cyber Operate - Pre Sales - Senior Consultant
description: As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you’ll work as Cyber Solution Specialist within the Operate Solution Hub, you will be responsible for coordinating the design of large and complex managed cybersecurity deals during the pursuits. The Solution Hub is designed to drive an optimum process for solutioning and pricing cross-cyber-domain managed security deals, reducing friction for cross-Offering Portfolio pursuits and optimizing review. By providing services such as inputs for deal qualifications, cyber benchmarks/effort estimation, and solution/pricing review, the Cyber Operate Solution Hub will be a focused space to increase win rates and profitability. Work you'll do As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Solution Hub team, you will be responsible for solution design and architecture activities. Support cyber solution analysis, business case development, and pricing model reviews across Infrastructure Security, Identity and Access Management, Security Operations Center services, Governance Risk and Compliance, and Vulnerability Management Assist Solution and Capability Architects in shaping managed cybersecurity offerings, including service tiers, cost structures, and pricing strategies Contribute to estimation frameworks and pricing models for cyber managed services, incorporating cross-domain dependencies and cost drivers Support preparation of client-facing materials and pursuit activities, including presentations, client discussions, orals, and due diligence Collaborate with pursuit stakeholders to refine solution designs, address service level agreement considerations, and align estimates with client requirements The team Cyber Operate Practice is focused on helping our clients identify and manage the cyber risks arising from their association with third parties or service providers. We help our clients to define their overall third-party cyber risk strategy, design and implement enterprise-wide programs and technology that focus on identifying and reducing risks; help them evaluate their objectives, priorities, strengths and weaknesses and roll out large scale organizational changes to achieve goals. Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai Qualifications Required: 7+ years of experience in information security, cybersecurity, or technology engineering support Experience supporting solutioning for enterprise cybersecurity services across Infrastructure Security, Identity and Access Management, Security Operations Center services, Governance Risk and Compliance, and Vulnerability Management Experience developing business cases, estimation approaches, or pricing inputs for technology or managed service pursuits Experience contributing to cybersecurity managed service solution design across multiple security domains Experience working in matrixed teams during deal pursuits with changing requirements and timelines Advanced Microsoft Excel skills Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent Preferred: Master of Business Administration (MBA)#Cyber_Cyber Operate

title: USI-EH27- BO&I-BO&I Operate-L45-Specialist, Deputy Manager- Data Analytics Engineering-Hyderabad
description: Are you passionate about leveraging analytics to solve real business problems and enable impactful decision-making at the highest levels? Deloitte invites you to take on a pivotal role as a Analytics Engineer solving complex business problems and building new capabilities for a multi-billion Operate business. This is not a traditional analytics engineering role. Your focus will be on rapid development of working prototypes and production pilots—building on a local or cloud PostgreSQL environment, not waiting for enterprise infrastructure approvals—developing outputs that get used in real decisions within days/weeks, not months. When solutions earn business buy-in, they will graduate to enterprise platforms. You will support the design and delivery of analytics solutions, creating key proof cases and prototypes. This role will work closely with the Senior Analytics Engineer to build and maintain core analytics capabilities, including data ingestion, transformation, dashboard development, and data quality processes. The role requires strong execution, attention to detail, ability to prototype and iterate quickly, while effectively collaborating across teams and time zones. Work you'll do As a Specialist Deputy Manager, Data Engineering on the BO&I, US Operate – USI team, you will be responsible for: Loading and preparing structured data from sources such as CSV, Excel, and JSON for use in the analytics environment Building SQL transformations, joins, aggregations, and analysis-ready tables to support prototype and pilot analytics solutions Developing, updating, testing, and validating dashboards and reports in Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools Monitoring data quality, identifying issues and anomalies, and supporting traceability from source data to reporting outputs Documenting data sources, refresh schedules, transformation logic, metric definitions, and runbooks while maintaining version-controlled code and materials These responsibilities are drawn from the uploaded JD’s data engineering, SQL transformation, analytics/visualization, and documentation sections The team You will join a cross-business Operate team, focused on developing / innovating key measures of business performance and building dashboards and operational reporting that inform decisions and serve as foundation for new capabilities, key to US Operate business high growth. We operate with startup-speed mindset inside a large enterprise: prototype first, document second, and scale after proving the concept works. title: USI-EH-27-Tax-EMEA-Germany Payroll-L35 - Tax Consultant II-Hyderabad
description: Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (Deloitte Tax in India) offers professionals the opportunity to support U.S. and other international taxation practices, including Germany, while working in a dynamic and evolving global environment. As a Tax Consultant II, you will support German payroll, employee tax, and benefits processes, with a focus on accurate payroll delivery, compliance, and client service. This role is well suited for professionals with end-to-end German payroll experience who want to build deeper expertise in payroll operations and stakeholder support. Work you'll do As a Tax Consultant II on the Global Employer Services team, you will be responsible for supporting end-to-end German payroll activities and related stakeholder coordination. Handle end-to-end German payroll processing for multiple clients, including payroll data, overtime, bonuses, and deductions. Stay updated on German payroll legislation and support compliance with applicable payroll requirements. Interact with clients to gather payroll-related information, address queries, and provide live support through chat, phone, and email. Maintain employee records and payroll data, perform audits, and investigate payroll discrepancies and issues. Generate payroll reports, analyze payroll data for trends and discrepancies, and collaborate with internal teams to resolve payroll-related challenges. The team Deloitte's Global Employer Services (GES) practice based in London provides practical and creative solutions to clients. The GES practice is made up of several specialist groups, including Payroll Service delivery (PSD) team. This entails collating Payroll data from various predefined sources, preparing payroll instructions and providing these to the client’s payroll provide. On completion of the payroll processing, Deloitte will complete reconciliation checks and then produce management information reports to the clients. PSD services are delivered to agreed timetables under client Service Level Agreements (SLAs). The payroll team also supports new client implementations and the set-up of the payroll technology platform to facilitate the delivery of BAU services. Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, including experience managing expectations and driving executive-level conversations. title: USI-EH27- BO&I-BO&I Operate- L55-Specialist Executive Manager - Data Analytics Engineering-Hyderabad
description: Specialist Executive Manager, Data Engineering (Analytics)Are you passionate about leveraging analytics to solve real business problems and enable impactful decision-making at the highest levels? Deloitte invites you to take on a pivotal role as a Data Analytics Engineer to lead the design and delivery of new analytics solutions / capabilities for a multi-billion Operate business. This is not a traditional analytics engineering role. Your focus will be on rapid development of working prototypes and production pilots—building on a local or cloud PostgreSQL environment, not waiting for enterprise infrastructure approvals—producing outputs that get used in real decisions within days/weeks, not months. When solutions earn business buy-in, they will graduate to enterprise platforms. Work you'll do As a Specialist Executive Manager, Data Engineering on the BO&I, US Operate – USI team, you will be responsible for: Designing and building analytics infrastructure in local or cloud PostgreSQL, including schema, data models, and pipelines Developing scalable transformation frameworks using SQL, dbt, and related tools to support prototypes and production pilots Building executive-ready dashboards in Tableau or Power BI and validating metrics, reporting accuracy, and business insights Partnering with US and USI business leaders to gather requirements, explain trade-offs, and present dashboards, prototypes, and solutions Leading and mentoring a junior analytics engineer while driving code quality, technical documentation, reusable patterns, and team capability building The team You will join a cross-business Operate team, focused on developing / innovating key measures of business performance and building business intelligence and operational reporting that inform decisions and drive the US Operate business’ high growth. We operate with startup-speed mindset inside a large enterprise: prototype first, document second, and scale after proving the concept works. Location: Hyderabad Shift Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST Qualifications Required: 12+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or related roles Experience building analytics solutions from the ground up Advanced SQL and strong Python skills Experience with Tableau or Power BI and dashboard design Experience with dbt or similar transformation frameworks Strong PostgreSQL skills, including schema design, indexing, and query performance Experience mentoring or leading junior team members Preferred: Experience in product-driven technology organizations Experience working with consulting firms or US clients Familiarity with US business terminology and metrics Experience with data governance and lineage Contributions to open-source or technical communities
