title: USI - EH27 - Product Engineering DnA- SAP HANA. ADB Data Engineer – Software Specialist Engineer II
description: SAP HANA. ADB Data Engineer – Software Specialist Engineer IIRole Overview: As a Data Analytics Engineer, you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to multiple high-visibility projects. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering solutions that delight customers and users, while also driving tangible value for Deloitte's business investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftmanship across multiple programming languages and modern frameworks, consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy advanced software solutions.Key Responsibilities:Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations. Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring code integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals. Lead requirement analysis, component design, development, unit testing, integrations, and support. Engineering Craftsmanship: Maintain accountability for the integrity of code design, implementation, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code ensuring all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.Customer-Centric Engineering: Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time.Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a learning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions. Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.Advanced Technical Proficiency: Possess deep expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including Agile methodologies and DevSecOps to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from code check-in to production with all quality checks through SDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Demonstrate understanding of the full lifecycle product development, focusing on continuous improvement, and learning.Domain Expertise: Quickly acquire domain-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs, architectures, and data designs into technical specifications and code. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.Effective Communication and Influence: Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.Key Qualifications:§  A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline. An advanced degree (e.g., MS) is preferred but not required. Experience is the most relevant factor.§  Strong data engineering foundation with deep understanding of data-structure, algorithms, code instrumentations, etc.§  5+ years proven experience with data ETL and ELT tools (such as ADF, Databricks, Alteryx, cloud-native tools), data warehousing tools (such as SAP HANA, Snowflake, ADLS, Amazon Redshift, Google Cloud BigQuery).§  5+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering, using FaaS/PaaS/micro-services on cloud hyper-scalers like Azure, AWS, and GCP.§  Strong understanding of methodologies & tools like, XP, Lean, SAFe, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, etc.§  Strong preference will be given to candidates with experience in AI/ML and GenAI.§  Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.How You will Grow: At Deloitte, our professional development plans focus on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day and excel in everything they do.

title: USI-EH-FY27- L45 - NSE TAX ERP- SAP PMO - Senior, Tax Technology Services
description: SAP S/4HANA PMO - Senior, Tax Technology ServicesDo you have a passion to work for large multinational clients of Deloitte Tax and transform their current state of tax to the next generation of tax functions? Are you ready to take the next step in your career to find new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations? Are you ready to fulfill your potential and want to have a significant impact to global initiatives? If the answer to all of the above is “Yes,” come join Tax Technology Consulting group in Deloitte India.At Deloitte, we are leading clients through the tax technology transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.Work you’ll doWe are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA PMO professional to support large- and medium-scale transformation programs focused on tax, compliance, and statutory reporting processes. This role will lead program governance, planning, execution tracking, risk management, stakeholder coordination, and delivery oversight across business, tax, finance, compliance, and technology workstreams. The ideal candidate brings strong PMO discipline along with a practical understanding of SAP S/4HANA business processes, localization requirements, compliance obligations, and reporting needs. This role requires close collaboration with SAP functional teams, subject matter experts, system integrator partners, and business stakeholders to ensure timely, coordinated, and compliant delivery.Key responsibilities -? Establish and manage integrated project plans, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables across tax, finance, procurement, order-to-cash, and IT teams.? Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure design, build, testing, cutover, and deployment activities are delivered on schedule.? Track and govern key program artifacts including RAID logs, status reporting, issue escalation, decision logs, action trackers, and governance decks.? Support planning and execution of country-specific e-invoicing and statutory compliance requirements within the global SAP template and rollout model.? Work with tax and SAP teams to monitor progress on tax determination configuration, tax code design, condition records, integrations, and compliance controls.? Coordinate implementation activities related to SAP DRC, including statutory reporting, electronic document processing, and integration with tax authority platforms where applicable.? Manage dependencies between SAP functional areas such as FI, SD, MM, procurement, billing, and tax engines/tools.? Facilitate steering committee meetings, working sessions, and stakeholder reviews; prepare concise executive-level updates on scope, risks, and decisions.? Ensure strong change control and scope management, particularly where regulatory, localization, or compliance requirements affect timelines or design.? Support test strategy and readiness tracking for SIT, UAT, regression, and country compliance testing.? Coordinate cutover planning and deployment readiness for tax and compliance-related capabilities.? Drive collaboration between internal teams, external implementation partners, and business stakeholders across regions.? Maintain focus on regulatory timelines, auditability, and business continuity during transformation.Qualification and Experience Required – ? Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Finance, Accounting, Tax, Business, or related field.? 4-7 years of PMO, program management, or project management experience in SAP transformation programs.? Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA implementations or rollouts in a PMO or delivery governance capacity.? Good understanding of indirect tax / VAT / GST processes, tax determination, and statutory compliance requirements in ERP programs.? Exposure to e-invoicing, digital tax reporting, and/or SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC).? Strong experience in project planning, risk/issue management, stakeholder management, governance, and executive reporting.? Ability to manage multiple workstreams, competing priorities, and cross-functional dependencies in fast-paced environments.? Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate detailed delivery issues into clear leadership updates.? Experience working with global teams and third-party system integrators.Preferred Qualifications? Experience with SAP tax-related design and delivery, including collaboration with tax engines or localisation solutions.? Knowledge of global or regional e-invoicing mandates and continuous transaction controls.? Familiarity with SAP modules such as FI, SD, MM, and procurement/billing processes that impact tax determination and compliance reporting.? PMP, PRINCE2, SAP certification, or equivalent project/program management credential.? Experience in template-based global rollouts and country deployments.? Understanding of audit, controls, and compliance implications for tax technology programs.Key Skills? SAP S/4HANA Program Management Office (PMO)? Tax Determination? e-Invoicing / Statutory Reporting? Governance and Status Reporting? RAID Management? Integrated Planning and Dependency Management? Stakeholder and Vendor Management? Test / Cutover Readiness Tracking? Executive CommunicationSuccess Measures? On-time delivery of tax and compliance milestones? Effective management of risks, issues, and cross-workstream dependencies? Readiness for country go-lives and regulatory deadlines? Clear governance, reporting, and decision-making cadence? Stable deployment of tax determination, legal reporting capabilitiesThe TeamTax Technology Consulting (TTC) – Deloitte’s Tax Technology Consulting Team (TTC) has a market leading reputation; bringing together a unique blend of consulting, technology, tax technical and tax reporting experience to help businesses meet the challenges of multi-jurisdictional tax operations, including compliance, reporting, tax technology and tax risk management.Within TTC, sits our Tax ERP Value Proposition, with a fast-growing team and a super-growth ambition. We are undertaking an unprecedented wave of ERP implementations and these require specialist Tax Technology and Systems knowledge as a blended hybrid skillset. This proposition is uniquely positioned to be a key differentiator for the firm-wide ERP-enabled business transformation practice across EMEA. You will find opportunities to apply an impressive range of broad consulting and functional skills that will enhance your career.Our purposeDeloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our clients, our people, and in our communities. We are creating trust and confidence in a more equitable society. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. We are focusing our collective efforts to advance sustainability, equity, and trust that come to life through our core commitments. Learn more about Deloitte’s purpose, commitments, and impact.Our inclusive cultureAt Deloitte, we value our people and work to build an inclusive culture, where our people are encouraged to bring their authentic selves to work. Our commitment has led to outstanding results in terms of attracting, retaining, and advancing a diverse workforce. We drive multiple efforts focused on intentional hiring, increasing awareness and sensitization, and ensuring a safe work environment for all professionals. We are regularly recognized as an employer of choice across a range of aspects, including inclusion, well-being, innovation, leadership, and a place to start your career. To learn more, check out our latest accolades.Professional developmentAt Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state-of-the-art, world-class learning center in the Hyderabad office, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.Benefits to help you thriveAt Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

title: USI-EH-27-Tax-UK Tax Compliance-UK Employment Tax-L45 - Senior, Tax Services-Kolkata
description: This opportunity is with Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) in Kolkata, supporting the UK Employment Taxes practice. As a Senior, Tax Services, you will contribute to employment tax compliance, reporting, technical research, and client delivery activities for a leading UK practice. The role offers exposure to client-facing work, global coordination, and technology-enabled tax processes in a growing team environment.Work you'll doAs a Senior, Tax Services on the Kolkata Reward team, you will be responsible for… Preparation and submission of UK Forms P11D, including calculations of benefit in kind values according to the UK tax legislation Preparation and submission of UK Construction Industry Scheme Forms (CIS300) following a standardized approach Preparation and submission of UK PAYE Settlement Agreements (PSA), including carrying out data analysis in excel and using Deloitte’s in-house software Preparation of employment taxes technical advice, including tax technical research and drafting advice emails Joining calls with our clients to deliver employment taxes advice Assistance with coordinating global employment taxes projects, including liaison with employment taxes colleagues globally; monitoring client information, including client work status and client contact details; and assistance with management of client accounts, take on procedures and billing analysis The teamDeloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service offerings have obtained support services through the USI Tax teams. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom) taxation practice, a popular career option.We are looking for a tax consultant to join our successful and expanding Kolkata Reward team to support our UK Employment Taxes practice, which is the largest of its kind in the UK.Location: KolkataShift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PMQualificationsRequired: Full time master’s degree in finance or equivalent from reputed University 3-5 years of experience of working in a corporate environment A high level of IT user ability Specifically, a high level of experience with Microsoft Excel, including use of formulae such as ‘VLOOKUP’ A good working knowledge of Microsoft Office and PowerPoint Excellent administration and organizational skills, with the ability to work unsupervised within agreed processes, multi-task and prioritize workload to ensure deadlines are met Pro-active and able to take ownership of delivering projects Preferred: Excellent written and verbal communications skills at the business and technical level Solid analytical aptitude, critical thinking and problem-solving skills Good personal organizational skills and commitment to customer service Aptitude for learning technology, systems and processes Ability to exercise effective judgement and decision making Existing tax qualifications (including ATT and/or CTA qualifications) is highly desirable

title: USI - EH26 - Product Engineering DnA- SAP HANA, ETL Data Engineer- Software Engineer II
description: Data Analytics Engineer – Software Engineer IIRole Overview: As a Data Analytics Engineer, you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to multiple high-visibility projects. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering solutions that delight customers and users, while also driving tangible value for Deloitte's business investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftmanship across multiple programming languages and modern frameworks, consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy advanced software solutions.Key Responsibilities:Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations. Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring code integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals. Lead requirement analysis, component design, development, unit testing, integrations, and support. Engineering Craftsmanship: Maintain accountability for the integrity of code design, implementation, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code ensuring all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.Customer-Centric Engineering: Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time.Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a learning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions. Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.Advanced Technical Proficiency: Possess deep expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including Agile methodologies and DevSecOps to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from code check-in to production with all quality checks through SDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Demonstrate understanding of the full lifecycle product development, focusing on continuous improvement, and learning.Domain Expertise: Quickly acquire domain-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs, architectures, and data designs into technical specifications and code. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.Effective Communication and Influence: Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.Key Qualifications:§  A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline. An advanced degree (e.g., MS) is preferred but not required. Experience is the most relevant factor.§  Strong data engineering foundation with deep understanding of data-structure, algorithms, code instrumentations, data warehousing, architecture etc.§  3+ years proven experience with data ETL and ELT tools (such as ADF, SAP BODS, Glue, cloud-native tools), data warehousing tools (such as SAP HANA) - Mandatory§  Experience with DataBricks, Data Factory and Python§  3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering, using FaaS/PaaS/micro-services on cloud hyper-scalers like Azure, AWS, and GCP.§  Strong understanding of methodologies & tools like XP, Lean, SAFe, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, etc.§  Reporting Tools - Qlik  or Tableau or Power BI§  Strong preference will be given to candidates with experience in AI/ML and GenAI.§  Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.How You will Grow: At Deloitte, our professional development plans focus on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day and excel in everything they do.

title: USI Audit | EH | FY 27 | QRM | L30 - Analyst, Risk and Regulatory Services
description: Analyst, Risk and Regulatory ServicesWe are seeking an Analyst to support the Assurance Nonattest Quality & Risk Management team within the Audit & Assurance business. This role supports quality monitoring and risk-sensing activities across Assurance nonattest engagements and helps teams adhere to internal policies, quality standards, and established processes. The professionals in this role will analyze monitoring results, identify trends and risk indicators, and support reporting through Tableau/Power BI dashboards, insights, and management reporting. The role also requires awareness of product development concepts, including ideation, testing, and release cycles, to help enhance efficiency of monitoring solutions and reporting capabilities. The ideal candidate will be a critical thinker with relevant experience in compliance, quality monitoring, reporting, analytics, engagement operations, or related business support environments.Work you'll doAs a Analyst, Risk and Regulatory Services in the Assurance Nonattest Quality & Risk Management team, you will be responsible for:Support execution of quality and compliance tracking across Assurance nonattest engagementsPerform data validation, data cleansing, and trend analysis to improve the reliability and usability of reporting outputsExperience with Excel and structured data analysis. Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret data and convert findings into practical recommendationsTranslate business, risk, and process and policy requirements into meaningful metrics, reporting views, and actionable insightsTrack findings, remediation actions, and closure status to support timely follow-up and effective issue managementPrepare concise summaries, presentations, and reports for leadership and key stakeholdersCollaborate with Quality & Risk Management (QRM) and engagement teams to strengthen processes and report effectiveness. Contribute to continuous improvement of methodologies, templates, governance, and analytics capabilitiesIdentify opportunities for process improvement and efficiency through analysis of operational and performance data leveraging critical thinking. Support the evolution of reporting and monitoring capabilities by applying awareness of product ideation, testing approaches, user needs, and release cyclesStrong written and verbal communication skills, ability to navigate within and across cross-functional teamsHigh attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environmentThe teamThe Assurance Nonattest Quality & Risk Management team supports quality monitoring, risk-sensing, and reporting activities across Assurance nonattest engagements. The team works closely with Quality & Risk Management and business stakeholders to strengthen compliance, improve reporting effectiveness, and enhance monitoring processes through data-driven insights and operational rigor.Location: HyderabadQualificationsRequired:Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field2+ years of experience in engagement operations, project management, or data analytics2+ years of experience creating leadership level reporting, analyses, and presentations using Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint2+ years of experience supporting project-based work involving multiple stakeholdersHands-on experience with Tableau / Power BI, including dashboard development, data modeling/analytics, and report creationStrong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and translate findings into practical recommendationsExperience in Assurance related services, compliance, risk, quality tracking, reporting, data analytics, or related business operationsAwareness of product development concepts, including ideation, testing, and release cycles. Familiarity with Agile methodology is preferredYou should expect to co-locate with team members or other colleagues in a Deloitte office, and/or virtually, based on specific team and business expectationsSuccess in This Role Will Be Measured By :Timely completion of monitoring and reporting activitiesAccuracy, quality, and usability of dashboards and reportsValue of insights and trend analysis provided to stakeholdersEffective tracking and closure of findings and remediation actions leading to efficient decision-making processesEfficient use of time and ability to prioritize contributions to quality and process/policy mattersCollaboration with stakeholders, ability to work independently with minimal supervision and ability to effectively prioritize multiple assignmentsTakes ownership and demonstrates the highest ethical standards

title: USI-EH27-Tax-Canada BTS-Corp Tax-L55 - Manager-Hyd/Blr/Ggn/Kol
description: Deloitte Tax in India supports U.S.-based Deloitte Tax clients across a broad range of tax services, offering professionals the opportunity to build deep experience in U.S. taxation. In this role, you will help clients navigate tax transformation, improve tax operations, and address an increasingly complex global environment. This is an opportunity to contribute to high-impact client work while growing your career within Deloitte’s Business Tax Services group in India.Work you'll doAs a Manager, Tax Services on the Business Tax Services team, you will be responsible for supporting U.S.-based Deloitte Tax clients across corporate, mutual fund, and hedge fund tax engagements. Provide tax compliance services, including income tax return preparation, computations, projections, and tax accounting support for U.S. federal, state, and international tax matters. Perform detail-level reviews of tax research, regulated investment company tax work papers, financial statement provisions, related tax disclosures, federal and relevant state returns, excise calculations, and regulated investment company compliance tests. Perform detail-level review of partnership work papers, allocations, and tax returns, and prepare materials and research for consulting projects related to tax planning opportunities. Coordinate and communicate with client contacts to gather information required to complete tax returns and support client service delivery. Supervise tax consultants, support training and mentoring of staff, and attend required Deloitte Tax LLP and sector-specific training. The teamAccelerating globalization, growing regulatory and business complexity and the evolution of tax technology is creating ever-increasing expectations for tax executives. At Deloitte, we are leading clients through change, uncovering insights and providing strategic value to organizations. Our approach combines insight and innovation from multiple disciplines with business and industry knowledge to help serve our clients with distinction. You will be based in India and are part of the US team serving our U.S. based clients.Location: HyderabadShift Timings: 7 AM to 4 PM | 11 AM to 8 PM | 2 PM to 11 PMQualificationsRequired:8+ years of experience in US Federal Tax - Corporate, Partnership, Private Wealth, Trust, Investment Management Hedge Funds, Private Equity, Mutual Funds, Regulated Investment Companies - Forms 1120, 1065Enrolled Agent or other appropriate certification (or in the process of pursuing)Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or another business-related fieldPrior Big 4 experience a plus or equivalent experienceKnowledge of fund accounting and general ledger accounting a plusStrong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skillsStrong analytical and communication skills to be able to articulate conclusions, planning opportunities, and risks identified through the research projects.Experience with managing projects including scheduling, budgeting, client correspondence and billing, excellent technology (i.e., Microsoft Excel and compliance software), research and writing skills.A preparer tax identification number (PTIN) is required for tax returns. If you do not have a PTIN or if your PTIN is expired, you are requested to complete the new or renewal application process (as applicable) before joining Deloitte.

title: USI-EH27-Consulting Services-AI&E-EaaS- Lead Architect-Cloud Native Architect
description: Artificial Intelligence & Engineering AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations. Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.Position Summary:Role: Cloud Native ArchitectExperienced Cloud Native Architect to lead the design and implementation of cloud-native, microservices-based applications using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and Amazon Web Services (AWS). This role will help modernize legacy web technologies into scalable cloud-native solutions and define architecture across application, data, and integration layers. The Cloud Native Architect will drive technical direction, establish architecture patterns, review engineering outcomes, and collaborate with product, engineering, and cloud teams to deliver secure, performant solutions.Work you'll do·       Define end-to-end architecture across microservices, application programming interfaces (APIs), front-end, data, and cloud infrastructure layers. ·       Lead engineering teams in building secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, and observability practices. ·       Design RESTful services, JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) contracts, and microservices patterns, including versioning, resiliency, and integration approaches. ·       Define standardized approaches for GenAI-enabled application modernization across front-end and back-end application layers, including token usage optimization. ·       Collaborate with product, security, operations, and release stakeholders to evaluate trade-offs, manage technical risk, and align architecture decisions to delivery goals.The teamEngineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/PuneShift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM and 2 PM to 11 PMQualificationsRequired:·       14+ years of software development experience.·       5+ years of experience in an application architect or solution architect role.·       Experience designing cloud-native applications using Java SpringBoot, Angular, and Amazon Web Services.·       Experience designing RESTful application programming interfaces, JSON-based integrations, and microservices architectures.·      Experience with PostgreSQL design, performance tuning, migrations, and high availability or disaster recovery strategies.·       Experience with continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines, containerization, and cloud deployment practices.·       Experience with observability tools such as Datadog, Splunk, Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, or Amazon CloudWatch·       Experience with identity, access, and security platforms such as Azure Active Directory, Okta, or Apigee·       Experience with GenAI enabled application modernization with token usage optimization.·       Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.Preferred:·       Experience with event-driven architecture technologies, including Kafka, Amazon Simple Notification Service, Amazon Simple Queue Service, or Amazon EventBridge.·       Experience with infrastructure as code tools, including Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.·       Experience with contract testing, integration testing, and automated test strategies.·       Experience with load testing tools and capacity planning.·       AWS Solutions Architect certification.#FY27ReferralCampaign#2027_AI&E_Dscreen

title: USI-EH-27-Tax-Belgium-Stat Accounting-L35 - Tax Consultant II-Hyderabad
description: Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) provides professionals the opportunity to support U.S. and international tax practices across a broad global network. As part of the International Accounting & Corporate Income Tax Services (IACTS) team, you will help deliver statutory accounting compliance and corporate tax support across more than 30 countries. In this role, you will work on financial reporting, local GAAP conversions, and statutory filing activities while collaborating with cross-border teams and multinational clients. This is an opportunity to build experience in a complex, fast-changing regulatory environment while supporting high-quality, compliant reporting.Work you'll doAs a Tax Consultant II on the International Accounting & Corporate Income Tax Services (IACTS) team, you will be responsible for supporting pan-European statutory accounting compliance and reporting activities. Prepare conversions of accounts from management GAAP, including U.S. GAAP or International Financial Reporting Standards, to local GAAP, including preparation of statutory financial statements and support for timely filing. Assist clients with centralized and standardized statutory reporting packages using Deloitte tools, including BYG, Wdesk, and Intela. Coordinate with local GAAP specialists on country-specific accounting treatments to support compliant local financial statements. Work with multinational clients and cross-border teams to identify reporting challenges, assess tax considerations, and support statutory accounting requirements across jurisdictions. Analyze journals, trial balances, reconciliations, and other financial data to support reporting accuracy and broader financial statement review activities. The teamThe International Accounting & Corporate Income Tax Services (IACTS) team is a recognized Center of Excellence for pan-European statutory accounting compliance and corporate tax work. Based in Belgium, the team supports businesses with day-to-day financial reporting and compliance needs across multiple jurisdictions. description: Deloitte Cyber helps organizations navigate the evolving threat landscape with greater confidence and resilience. As an Encryption Security Engineer, you will help clients strengthen enterprise encryption and public key infrastructure (PKI) capabilities across complex environments. description: Help protect our company brand and reputation by assisting with risk management activities that ensure new and updated information technology solutions are secure.Work you'll doAs a Consultant, Cyber Engineering on the Cyber Security team, you will evaluate cyber risk, assess security controls, and support compliance with policies and standards across technology solutions. Review assessment questionnaires and interview project teams to validate responses and identify cyber risks. Coordinate risk management activities, including vulnerability scanning, dynamic scanning, and confidentiality and privacy reviews. Prepare assessment reports and supporting evidence for management review and approval. Evaluate technology solutions, architectures, and controls for compliance with company, regulatory, and legal requirements. Guide project and technology teams on secure design, cloud security practices, remediation actions, and governance expectations. The teamThe Cyber Security team works behind the scenes to protect Deloitte practitioners as well as information assets at Deloitte. We take this protective role very seriously, while simultaneously ensuring Deloitte meets client, legal, and regulatory requirements. This team works closely with project/technology teams to assess and remediation risks related to the implementation of information technology solutions. This team is also responsible for guiding project teams through risk evaluation and risk treatment processes. The team uses knowledge of cyber security risk management methodologies to determine other risk management activities that should be performed.Location: HyderabadQualificationsRequired: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent education and/or professional experience 3+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, systems engineering, information security, or systems administration Experience reviewing assessment questionnaires and interviewing project teams to validate responses Experience preparing assessment reports and documenting findings for management review Experience evaluating privacy, confidentiality, and security controls against company, regulatory, and legal requirements Preferred: Experience with Microsoft Azure and/or Amazon Web Services security Experience supporting the development of security architecture designs One or more of the following certifications: Certified Information Security Manager, Certified Information Systems Security Professional, Associate of ISC2, Certified Ethical Hacker, or Certified Cloud Security Professional Experience with identity and access management, encryption, multi-factor authentication, and security information and event management Knowledge of cyber security standards and frameworks such as ISO 27001 or National Institute of Standards and Technology frameworks

description: Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) offers professionals the opportunity to support U.S. and international tax practices across a broad global network. In this role, you will support statutory accounting and financial statement preparation activities for cross-border engagements, with exposure to multiple jurisdictions including Belgium and other European markets. Excellent written and verbal communications skills at the business and technical level Knowledge of Microsoft Office products — Excel, Word, etc. Knowledge of financial reporting tools such as Workiva, Thomson Reuters, CaseWare, and similar platforms. description: Data Analytics Engineer – Software Specialist Engineer IIRole Overview: As a Data Analytics Engineer, you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to multiple high-visibility projects. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering solutions that delight customers and users, while also driving tangible value for Deloitte's business investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftmanship across multiple programming languages and modern frameworks, consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy advanced software solutions.Key Responsibilities:Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations. Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring code integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals. Lead requirement analysis, component design, development, unit testing, integrations, and support. Engineering Craftsmanship: Maintain accountability for the integrity of code design, implementation, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code ensuring all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.Customer-Centric Engineering: Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time.Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a learning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions. Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.Advanced Technical Proficiency: Possess deep expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including Agile methodologies and DevSecOps to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from code check-in to production with all quality checks through SDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Demonstrate understanding of the full lifecycle product development, focusing on continuous improvement, and learning.Domain Expertise: Quickly acquire domain-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs, architectures, and data designs into technical specifications and code. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.Effective Communication and Influence: Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.Key Qualifications:§  A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline. An advanced degree (e.g., MS) is preferred but not required. Experience is the most relevant factor.§  Strong data engineering foundation with deep understanding of data-structure, algorithms, code instrumentations, etc.§  5+ Years in Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure SQL, Scala, Python. §  5+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering, using SaaS/PaaS on cloud hyper-scalers like Azure, AWS, and GCP.§  Strong preference will be given to candidates with experience in AI/ML and GenAI.§  Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.How You will Grow: At Deloitte, our professional development plans focus on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day and excel in everything they do.

title: USI-EH27-Consulting-AI&E-EaaS-Managed Services-Senior Manager
description: As a Senior Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will play the role of for managing large complex managed services engagements that includes the A-Z of delivering support engagements, including but not limited to, quality management, risk mitigation, disruptive innovations, service excellence, project onboarding, day-to-day operations, incident and change management, meeting contractual SLAs, and continuous operational improvement. A process driven mindset focused on client satisfaction and continuous optimization. You will lead and guide multidisciplinary, global teams and serve as a senior mentor to managers and junior staff. You will partner closely with clients and internal stakeholders to align solution strategies with business goals, contribute to sales and proposal development, and ensure rigorous management of end-to-end project delivery, including scoping, estimation, and executive reporting for successful project outcomes. Work you'll do As a Senior Manager/AVP on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for leading complex managed services engagements and driving delivery outcomes aligned to client and business objectives. Lead end-to-end managed services delivery across onboarding, steady-state operations, incident management, problem management, change management, and continuous improvement. Manage multidisciplinary and multi-vendor teams to deliver against contractual service-level agreements, quality standards, budgets, and timelines. Partner with client and internal stakeholders to define delivery strategy, govern risks and issues, and provide executive-level status reporting. Oversee delivery processes across Agile or Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), release management, quality engineering, and compliance with software development life cycle controls. Support business development by contributing to proposals, solutioning, estimations, and transition planning for new managed services opportunities. The team Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and maintain and sustain client business critical applications. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation. Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad Qualifications Required: 18+ years of software engineering experience, including delivery leadership for large-scale managed services engagements. Experience leading multi-team, multi-vendor managed services engagements with ownership of scope, planning, RAID, budgets, and executive stakeholder management. Experience with ITIL service management processes across incident, problem, change, and service operations. Experience with Java and at least one cloud platform: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure. Experience implementing Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) use cases in support operations, including preventive or predictive maintenance, with governance and measurable outcomes. Experience leading delivery using Agile or Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), quality engineering, release management, change management, and risk or compliance controls. Bachelor of Engineering (BE), Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech), Master of Computer Applications (MCA), Master of Science in Computer Science, Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.), Master of Technology (M.Tech), or equivalent degree from an accredited university. Preferred: ITIL certification. Experience in sector or subsector business use cases applicable to managed services environments. Experience mentoring senior teams and driving technical excellence across large-scale programs. #FY27ReferralCampaign

title: USI-EH27-Consulting Services-AI&E-EaaS-Gen AI Architect- Senior Manager
description: As a Senior Manager/Specialist leader at Deloitte Consulting, you will play the role of strategic architect who creates and(or) reviews enterprise grade architectures and also provides best practices for technical delivery for complex, enterprise-solutions. You will lead and guide multidisciplinary, global teams and serve as a senior mentor to managers and junior staff. You will partner closely with clients and internal stakeholders to align solution strategies with business goals, contribute to sales and proposal development, and ensure rigorous management of end-to-end project delivery, including scoping, estimation, and executive reporting for successful project outcomes. Work you'll do As an Associate Vice President, Architecture on the AI & Engineering team, you will be responsible for shaping enterprise artificial intelligence and generative artificial intelligence solution strategies, leading complex architecture decisions, and guiding technical delivery across large-scale transformation programs. Define and review enterprise architecture solutions for artificial intelligence and generative artificial intelligence platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, delivery standards, and enterprise technology strategies Lead multidisciplinary teams across architecture, engineering, data, and delivery functions to design, implement, and operationalize scalable artificial intelligence solutions for complex business processes Establish and apply architecture patterns for retrieval-augmented generation, agentic orchestration, tool calling, model integration, observability, and platform governance Guide end-to-end delivery activities including scope definition, effort estimation, risk management, executive reporting, and technical quality oversight across programs Contribute to business development by supporting proposals, shaping solution approaches, and presenting architecture recommendations to internal and client stakeholders The team Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation. Location: Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata Shift Timings: As per business needs Qualifications Required: 18+ years of experience in software engineering or architecture, including recent experience with artificial intelligence and generative artificial intelligence platforms in enterprise environments Experience designing and implementing multi-agent or workflow-based artificial intelligence solutions in production environments for business processes Experience defining architecture patterns for retrieval-augmented generation, agentic orchestration, function or tool calling, prompt and response schemas, guardrails, evaluation, and observability Experience designing end-to-end platforms spanning data ingestion, vector databases, model gateways, orchestration layers, application programming interfaces, user interfaces, monitoring, and cost controls Experience integrating artificial intelligence solutions with enterprise platforms such as enterprise resource planning, customer relationship management, information technology service management, or data platforms through application programming interfaces or event-based integration One or more certifications in Amazon Web Services Solutions Architect, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert, plus one architecture certification such as TOGAF or SABSA Ability to travel 30-40%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. We identify new and emerging risks that might impact the network, mitigate threats as they are identified, proactively engage with regulators and key stakeholders to develop identification and mitigation regulations and procedures, and build a clear voice around select policy topics. We encourage you to grow by providing formal and informal development programs, coaching, and mentoring. We want you to ask questions, take chances, and explore the possible. Compliance, Risk, Client Confidentiality, Audit, Legal and/or Technology is also helpful, but not a prerequisite • Experience and strong understanding of privacy by design concepts, tools, and methodologies • Knowledge of GDPR and similar constructs of privacy and data protection • Experience in conducting assessments (e.g., PIAs, DPIAs) on data assets and business processes • Privacy certification desirable (e.g., CIPP/E, CIPT, CIPM) • Experience working with risk frameworks and risk evaluation is desirable • Knowledge of DevOps, SAFe Agile, Project Management desirable

title: USI-EH27-Consulting Services-AI&E-EaaS-Mainframe Modernization-Senior Manager
description: As a Senior Manager/Specialist leader at Deloitte Consulting, you will play the role of Mainframe Modernization expert who leads technical delivery for complex, enterprise-wide modernization of legacy systems. You will lead and guide multidisciplinary, global teams and serve as a senior mentor to managers and junior staff. You will partner closely with clients and internal stakeholders to align solution strategies with business goals, contribute to sales and proposal development, and ensure rigorous management of end-to-end project delivery, including scoping, estimation, and executive reporting for successful project outcomes. Work you'll do As a Senior Manager/AVP on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for leading large-scale mainframe modernization programs and guiding engineering teams through complex transformation initiatives. Lead end-to-end delivery of mainframe modernization programs, from assessment and solution design through migration, cutover, and stabilization. Define target-state architecture, integration patterns, resiliency requirements, and modernization roadmaps aligned to business and technology objectives. Provide technical leadership across mainframe and distributed engineering teams working with COBOL, CICS, IMS, Db2, JCL, VSAM, Java, Python, APIs, and cloud platforms. Oversee program governance across scope, estimates, budgets, RAID management, quality, release planning, and executive stakeholder reporting. Support business development efforts by contributing to proposals, solutioning, and client discussions related to mainframe modernization and AI-enabled engineering transformation. The team Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation. Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata Qualifications Required: 18+ years of software engineering experience, including delivery leadership for large-scale enterprise programs. Experience leading mainframe modernization programs using replatform, refactor, replace, or strangler approaches from assessment through cutover and stabilization. Hands-on experience with COBOL and mainframe technologies including CICS, IMS, Db2, JCL, and VSAM. Hands-on experience with Java, Python, microservices, application programming interfaces, continuous integration/continuous deployment, and test automation. Experience leading multi-team, multi-vendor engineering engagements with responsibility for scope, plans, RAID logs, budgets, and executive stakeholder reporting. Experience implementing Generative Artificial Intelligence-assisted software development lifecycle use cases, including code modernization, test generation, documentation, or defect triage, with measurable outcomes and governance. Experience with Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, or Microsoft Azure; experience defining target-state architecture, integration patterns, data and messaging design, resiliency, and non-functional requirements; and at least one certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or TOGAF. Preferred: Experience publishing, presenting, or applying research-led approaches in mainframe modernization, Generative Artificial Intelligence, or agentic Artificial Intelligence. Experience supporting technology solutions for a defined industry sector or sub-sector. Experience mentoring senior engineering teams and driving technical delivery across large-scale programs. Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Science in Computer Science, Master of Technology, Ph.D, or equivalent degree from an accredited university.#FY27ReferralCampaign

title: USI-EH-27-Tax-Belgium-Accounting & Reporting-L55 - Manager-Hyderabad
description: Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) offers professionals the opportunity to support U.S. and other international tax practices while building experience in a complex global reporting environment. In this role, you will work closely with Belgium-based teams across accounting, reporting, and financial administration activities. You will contribute to annual financial statement support, reporting processes, and data analysis in a fast-changing landscape shaped by tax legislation, financial processes, and digitalization. Deloitte Tax combines technology and tax technical resources to help clients meet reporting requirements, uncover insights, and navigate complexity. Work you'll do As a Manager, Tax Services on the Belgium Accounting & Reporting team, you will support our Belgian teams through the fast-changing landscape of tax legislation, financial processes, and digitalization. You’ll be responsible for your portfolio of engagements. You will take care of their financial administration, processing invoices, etc., and assist on any queries relating to their questions about preparing their annual financial statements. Through your work with our diverse Belgian teams, you’ll get an opportunity to build your confidence and understanding of the critical importance of reporting. You will gain practical hands-on experience in aspects of financial statements and tax reporting and provide insights through reporting. Building your experience and confidence in the tools and techniques as tax accounting & reporting specialist. You will perform in-depth analysis of journals, trial balance, reconciliation & other financial data. Eventually, you’ll grow in a more senior role taking on other tasks such as review work. The team Our multidisciplinary team, based in Belgium, supports companies in their day-to-day business and empowers them to tackle challenging issues. Join our team and you will learn about financial processes and how to apply them in practice, develop your task management and tax technical skills. Location: Hyderabad Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM Qualifications Required: Understand that business insights gained from financial reporting drive better decision making. Analytical ability to analyze and possess problem-solving aptitude to provide insights. Ability to work both independently and as part of team with professionals at all levels. Hold a master’s or bachelor’s degree in economics, accountancy, or another financial orientation. Fluency in English language. French and Dutch language skills (optional - but definitely will help) Attention to detail & critical mindset for self-review of work.

title: USI-EH-27-Tax-ETI - Dev- L35 - Consultant - Provision & Compliance
description: Consultant - Tax Transformation Consulting – Provision & Compliance Do you have a passion to work for US based clients of Deloitte Tax and transform their current state of tax to the next generation of tax functions? Are you ready to take the next step in your career to find new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations? Are you ready to fulfil your potential and want to have a significant impact to global initiatives? If the answer to all the above is “Yes,” come join Tax Transformation Consulting group in Deloitte India (Offices of the U.S), a service line of Deloitte Tax LLP! Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines and regions have obtained support services through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a much sought-after career option. At Deloitte, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment. Work you’ll do Increasingly complex tax decisions can have a significant effect—positive or negative—on the future of our clients’ business. Our approach combines insight and innovation from multiple disciplines with business and industry knowledge to help our clients excel globally. Key responsibilities will be: - • Support tax provision and compliance engagements, with a focus on ASC 740 processes and controls. • Assist in the implementation, enhancement, and automation of various Tax software for provision and compliance workflows. • Analyse tax and financial data to identify process gaps, improve accuracy, and drive efficiency in reporting and compliance activities. • Process improvements, redesigning client tax departments and evaluating automation opportunities. • Prepare client ready documentation, status updates, and detailed process materials.• Work on design and development of tax solutions • Apply technology skills in areas like implementing the application, data wrangling and analytics.Qualification and Experience Required – • 3 to 5 years of experience.• Full time Masters/Bachelors in Finance/Accounts or equivalent from reputed University or MBA or Chartered Accountant with experience in Finance, Accounting, Taxation and Auditing • Experience in tax provision and compliance, including strong knowledge of ASC 740.• Execute data intensive tasks and facilitate organization of data for reporting requirements • Proficiency in MS Office applications, specifically Excel, Word and PowerPoint • Motivated to learn new technologies through self-study and work to develop prototypes and solve technical problems • Preferred experience in one or more of the areas below: o Provision software – Corptax, ONESOURCE Tax Provision, ONESOURCE Dataflow, Longview, SAP Direct Tax, Oracle FCCS and Oracle TRCS o US tax compliance software – Corptax, ONESOURCE Income Tax (Federal and International) and ONESOURCE State Apportionmento Experience in completing U.S. tax returns o Experience in completing provisions – quarterly and year end o Experience in Blueprinting, Chart of Accounts Designo Experience in automation/analytical tools such as: o Data wrangling tools - Alteryx, Power Query or others o Analytical tools – Power BI, Tableau, or others • Knowledge of business and tax processes, creating functional specifications, identifying and developing requirements for new reports and providing user training and support The Team Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business, while closely aligned with clients’ core business strategy. The TTC group helps tax departments pursue a streamlined, transparent and efficient tax function that addresses compliance and planning issues while expanding its strategic support of the broader business enterprise. Our services are focused on tax-sensitized data acquisition, efficient process design and deployment, enterprise and tax-specific software implementation, and organizational design. Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the digitization of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.

description: GenAI Engineer – Software Engineer IIRole Overview: As a GenAI Engineer, you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to multiple high-visibility projects. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering solutions that delight customers and users, while also driving tangible value for Deloitte's business investments. You will leverage your extensive GenAI & engineering craftmanship across multiple programming languages and modern frameworks, consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy advanced software solutions.Key Responsibilities:Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations. Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring code integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals. Lead requirement analysis, component design, development, unit testing, integrations, and support. Engineering Craftsmanship: Maintain accountability for the integrity of code design, implementation, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks with significant focus on infusing AI/ML/GenAI where possible/appropriate. Create technical specifications, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code ensuring all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.Customer-Centric Engineering: Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time.Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a learning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions. Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.Advanced Technical Proficiency: Possess deep expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including AI/ML/GenAI, Agile methodologies and DevSecOps to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from code check-in to production with all quality checks through SDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Demonstrate understanding of the full lifecycle product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.Domain Expertise: Quickly acquire domain-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs, architectures, and UX/UI designs into technical specifications and code. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.Effective Communication and Influence: Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.Key Qualifications:§  A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline. An advanced degree (e.g., MS) is preferred but not required. Experience is the most relevant factor.§  Strong software engineering foundation with deep understanding of OOPs, data-structure, algorithms, code instrumentations, beautiful coding practices etc.§  3+ years of experience with AI/ML, with last 2 years focused on GenAI as well as technologies like OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, LangChain, Agents, Vector databases, and approaches like Prompt Engineering, fine-tuning, etc. §  Proven experience in: Python, R, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, Julia, ML libraries, NLP, etc.§  Proven experience with big data technologies, Angular, React, NodeJS, Python, C#, .NET Core, Java, Golang, SQL/NoSQL.§  Proven experience with cloud-native engineering, using FaaS/PaaS/micro-services on cloud hyper-scalers like Azure, AWS, and GCP.§  Strong understanding of methodologies & tools like, XP, Lean, SAFe, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, etc.§  Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.How You will Grow: At Deloitte, our professional development plans focus on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day and excel in everything they do.#ProductEngineeringFY26
