title: USI-EH-27-Tax -ETI - Dev -L45 -Senior - Provision & Compliance
description: Senior Consultant - Tax Transformation Consulting – Provision & Compliance Do you have a passion to work for US based clients of Deloitte Tax and transform their current state of tax to the next generation of tax functions? Are you ready to take the next step in your career to find new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations? Are you ready to fulfil your potential and want to have a significant impact to global initiatives? If the answer to all the above is “Yes,” come join Tax Transformation Consulting group in Deloitte India (Offices of the U.S), a service line of Deloitte Tax LLP! Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines and regions have obtained support services through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a much sought-after career option. At Deloitte, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment. Work you’ll do Increasingly complex tax decisions can have a significant effect—positive or negative—on the future of our clients’ business. Our approach combines insight and innovation from multiple disciplines with business and industry knowledge to help our clients excel globally. Key responsibilities will be: - • Support and lead tax provision and compliance engagements, with a focus on ASC 740 processes and controls. • Support and execute the implementation, enhancement, and automation of tax software for provision and compliance workflows.• Analyse tax and financial data to identify process gaps, improve accuracy, and drive efficiency in reporting and compliance activities. • Partner with tax, finance, and technology teams to design and implement scalable tax process improvements. • Translate business requirements into practical automation and system solutions. • Prepare and manage client ready documentation, status updates, and detailed process materials.• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute as a strong team player in a fast-paced environment.Qualification and Experience Required – • 5 to 8 years of experience.• Full time Masters/Bachelors in Finance/Accounts or equivalent from reputed University or MBA or Chartered Accountant with experience in Finance, Accounting, Taxation and Auditing • Experience in tax provision and compliance, including strong knowledge of ASC 740.• Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. • Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving and organizational skills.• Execute data intensive tasks and facilitate organization of data for reporting requirements • Proficiency in MS Office applications, specifically Excel, Word and PowerPoint • Relentless focus on quality of work products while adhering to completing deliverables on time • Motivated to learn new technologies through self-study and work to develop prototypes and solve technical problems • Preferred experience in one or more of the areas below: o Provision software – Corptax, ONESOURCE Tax Provision, ONESOURCE Dataflow, Longview, SAP Direct Tax, Oracle FCCS and Oracle TRCSo US tax compliance software – Corptax, ONESOURCE Income Tax (Federal and International) and ONESOURCE State Apportionmento Experience in completing U.S. tax returns o Experience in completing provisions – quarterly and year end o Experience in Blueprinting, Chart of Accounts Designo Experience in automation/analytical tools such as: ? Data wrangling tools - Alteryx, Power Query or others ? Analytical tools – Power BI, Tableau, or others • Knowledge of business and tax processes, creating functional specifications, identifying and developing requirements for new reports and providing user training and support The Team Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business, while closely aligned with clients’ core business strategy. The TTC group helps tax departments pursue a streamlined, transparent and efficient tax function that addresses compliance and planning issues while expanding its strategic support of the broader business enterprise. Our services are focused on tax-sensitized data acquisition, efficient process design and deployment, enterprise and tax-specific software implementation, and organizational design. Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the digitization of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.

title: USI-EH-27-Tax-LBS-L55 - Manager- Legal Management Services (LMS)
description: Legal Business Associate Manager, Legal Management Services (LMS)Multinational organizations need personnel who can provide legal business services support in their full lifecycle of process and subject matter challenges and opportunities. Deloitte Legal Business Services (“LBS”) assists clients with all aspects of reporting and process for business as usual, as well as triggering and regulatory events. Bring your expertise and client service skills to Deloitte and click “apply” now!Work you’ll do:As a Senior in Deloitte’s Legal Business Services function for Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“Deloitte Tax in India”), you will provide corporate business legal services support on engagements for our clients’ large and complex organizations. Services include assisting supervising counsel with their business as usual contracting and negotiations; and review, , and remediation services in response to regulatory and corporate triggering events; assisting in calendaring, statutory filings, workflow coordination, information and records management. You will interact mainly with US and global team members, as applicable and will contribute directly to delivering first class service to our clients. You will be working with Deloitte Senior Managers and Managers of Legal Business Services (“LBS”) projects and engagements. You will support the engagement lifecycle from opportunity pursuit through service delivery and identification of expansion opportunities to continue to deliver benefits to our clients. Your primary responsibility will be ensuring the high-quality delivery of the work to the leads. As a part of the services, you will pursue and execute continuous service improvements through technology and process improvements. You need to consistently strive for excellence, taking pride in carrying out responsibilities efficiently and with impeccable execution. You should be a self- starter who works well within a team, is energized by a continuous learning environment, and possesses an ability to work well with deadlines.Responsibilities will include:·       Deliver legal business engagements for Deloitte clients – Assisting in drafting and negotiating playbooks-based buy side and sales side commercial contracts such as MSA, NDAs, SoWs, Work Orders, Change Notes·       Transitioning and setting up operate delivery teams·       Identify process and operational efficiencies within corporate business legal services clients’ contracting function·       Institute KPIs and metrics to govern, measure, and track client engagements·       Report against KPIs and metrics·       Review with the preparation of proposals·       Assist in executing engagement administration: document collection, data entry, tracking, records organization, contract review, and coordinating client logistics·       Review and project manage the entire contracting process i.e., coordinating with various stakeholders such as finance, legal, commercial, business, delivery and incorporating their feedback in the contract and assisting in closing the contract·       Review in researching technical and industry-specific issues·       Communicate effectively to all levels of engagement management and clients·       Ability to balance multiple projects and responsibilities·       Lead and deliver the CLM engagements end to end·       Prior experience of leading a team of 3-5 people is a must·       Assist in hiring, training and onboarding new hires on a client engagementDisclaimer: Deloitte Tax in India and its affiliates in the United States and India do not practice law or provide legal advice.The Team:Legal Business Services is a service line within Deloitte Tax in India that collaborates and works closely with other Deloitte business units, including Deloitte Advisory and Deloitte Consulting. As a part of the Deloitte network of member firms that spans many countries with thousands of professionals, Deloitte brings global perspectives and deep market and industry knowledge. Today’s multinational organizations need personnel who can support them with day-to-day and life event legal business services, across a multidisciplinary skillset. Deloitte has a long-standing reputation for helping clients navigate complex, cross-border issues.Qualifications Required:·       Legal training (LL.B/BA.LLB or equivalent)·       Strong substantive understanding the inhouse contracting process with various CLM tools·       8-10 years of relevant legal experience or alternative legal service industry experience·       Level of familiarity with legal technology and its application in the contract lifecycle management field·       Strong Microsoft Office and other technology skills such as Word, Excel and PPT.·       Experience in moderate complexity commercial contract drafting and negotiation skills·       Experience with legal services RFPs·       Familiarity with commercial agreement types such as NDAs, SOWs, MSAs, distribution agreements and license agreements·       Adept at working virtuallyPreferred:·       Aptitude and commitment to continue to learn various IT platforms and additional software skills·       Lean Six-Sigma and/or Project Management Professional certification·       Excellent interpersonal and people management skills·       Good communication (to both internal and external stakeholders) and collaboration skills·       Excellent client presentation skills·       High level of attention to detail, outstanding organization skills and well-developed critical thinking skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environmentWork Location: Hyderabad, Pune, Bangalore, GurgaonShift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM ISTOur purpose Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our clients, our people, and in our communities. We are creating trust and confidence in a more equitable society. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. We are focusing our collective efforts to advance sustainability, equity, and trust that come to life through our core commitments. Learn more about Deloitte’s purpose, commitments, and impact.  Our inclusive culture At Deloitte, we value our people and work to build an inclusive culture, where our people are encouraged to bring their authentic selves to work. Our commitment has led to outstanding results in terms of attracting, retaining, and advancing a diverse workforce. We drive multiple efforts focused on intentional hiring, increasing awareness and sensitization, and ensuring a safe work environment for all professionals. We are regularly recognized as an employer of choice across a range of aspects, including inclusion, well-being, innovation, leadership, and a place to start your career. To learn more, check out our latest accolades. Professional development At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state-of-the-art, world-class learning center in the Hyderabad office, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.  Benefits to help you thrive At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Your primary responsibility will be ensuring the high-quality delivery of the work to the leads. As a part of the services, you will pursue and execute continuous service improvements through technology and process improvements. You need to consistently strive for excellence, taking pride in carrying out responsibilities efficiently and with impeccable execution. You should be a self- starter who works well within a team, is energized by a continuous learning environment, and possesses an ability to work well with deadlines.Responsibilities will include:·       Deliver legal business engagements for Deloitte clients – Assisting in drafting and negotiating playbooks-based buy side and sales side commercial contracts such as MSA, NDAs, SoWs, Work Orders, Change Notes·       Transitioning and setting up operate delivery teams·       Identify process and operational efficiencies within corporate business legal services clients’ contracting function·       Institute KPIs and metrics to govern, measure, and track client engagements·       Report against KPIs and metrics·       Review with the preparation of proposals·       Assist in executing engagement administration: document collection, data entry, tracking, records organization, contract review, and coordinating client logistics·       Review and project manage the entire contracting process i.e., coordinating with various stakeholders such as finance, legal, commercial, business, delivery and incorporating their feedback in the contract and assisting in closing the contract·       Review in researching technical and industry-specific issues·       Communicate effectively to all levels of engagement management and clients·       Ability to balance multiple projects and responsibilitiesDisclaimer: Deloitte Tax in India and its affiliates in the United States and India do not practice law or provide legal advice.The Team:Legal Business Services is a service line within Deloitte Tax in India that collaborates and works closely with other Deloitte business units, including Deloitte Advisory and Deloitte Consulting. title: USI-EH27-Consulting-AI&E-HCI-EMS- Managed Services Engineer III-Apache Cassandra
description: Artificial Intelligence & EngineeringAI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.    Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses. As a Managed Services Engineer III, you will design, build, deploy, and optimize enterprise-scale AI solutions that help clients automate workflows and improve business and information technology operations. In this role, you will work across the full delivery lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution design through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions and support high-quality delivery in production environments. You will also contribute to implementation planning, issue resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives.Work you'll doAs a Managed Services Engineer III on the Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for designing, building, deploying, and optimizing AI-powered agents and enterprise AI solutions that automate complex workflows and transform IT and business processes.A Senior DataStax Cassandra Database Administrator (DBA) is responsible for the design, deployment, management, and optimization of enterprise-wide Cassandra and DataStax Enterprise (DSE) clusters. This role demands extensive experience in NoSQL database technologies, performance tuning, and collaboration with development and operations teams.  The teamAt Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure we deliver solutions spanning Hybrid Cloud, Advanced Connectivity, AI Data Centers, High-Performance Computing, and AI Infrastructure to help clients achieve their desired outcomes. Our offerings include engineered transformation services for hybrid cloud infrastructure and platforms, prioritizing resiliency, optimization, and extensive automation. We integrate advanced connectivity with AI infrastructure and enterprise networks to boost operational efficiency and enable real-time data processing. Additionally, we provide comprehensive management of all facets of operations for hybrid cloud infrastructure and field operations.Location: Bengaluru/HyderabadShift Timings: 24/7 RotationalQualificationsRequired: Minimum of 8 years of experience as a Database Administrator with expertise in Cassandra (Primary skill) , Redis and Kafka(secondary skill). Strong proficiency in database administration, including installation, configuration, and maintenance. In-depth knowledge of Cassandra architecture, data modeling, and query language (CQL). Experience with Redis data structures, replication, and clustering. Familiarity with database monitoring and management tools such as DataStax OpsCenter, Redis Enterprise Manager, and Confluent Control Center. Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively in a dynamic environment. 8 - 10 years of hands-on experience in in Database Administration, with at least 8+ years dedicated to DataStax Casandra Database Administration. BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university. Preferred:·          Experience with any one of the following databases is required: Netezza, PostgreSQL, Informix, Mainframe, SQL Server, Oracle, Cosmos DB, IBM Db2 (UDB), or an Enterprise Data Warehouse.

title: USI-EH-27-Tax-TTC-ETI- L35 - Consultant - Netsuite/Workday/Infor
description: Workday/INFOR/NetSuite - ConsultantWorkday, NetSuite, Zuora and Salesforce are some of the rising SaaS ERP technologies that are revolutionizing how tax is managed and how tax departments around the globe operate. If you are someone who thrives in navigating the growing tax landscape through a technology lens and partnering with passionate professionals to help companies achieve their tax objectives; then we would like to get to know you. Apply now!What you’ll do:As a professional in Deloitte’s Tax Technology Consulting (TTC) team, you will be a part of a team that provides an integrated approach to technology implementations that help tax departments maximize the strategic value to the organization. You will deliver services for companies that are implementing tax solutions related to enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems and tax applications.As a Senior you will contribute to the growth and success of Deloitte Tax LLP in a variety of ways, including:• Client Management: Participate in the day-to-day interactions with client’s project team members and Deloitte project leadership members• Delivery: Deliver components of Workday, INFOR and/or NetSuite, Integration, Supply Chain, HCM or third-party tax software implementations including designing, configuring, testing and training of the solution.• Solutions: With an emphasis on tax processes, identify business requirements, requirements management, functional design, prototyping, process design (including scenario design, flow mapping), testing, training, defining support procedures and supporting implementations.• Cross Functional Teaming: Understand and articulate the broader Tax practice and Deloitte overall. Maintain relationships and serve clients holistically.• People Development: Participate in the development of team members.• Business Development: Participate in and contribute to pursuit teams.QualificationsRequired:• 3 years’ experience in implementation of ERPs or tax software that include but not limited to experience with tax requirements for direct tax such as corporate income tax, operational transfer pricing, state income taxation and indirect tax such as sales & use tax, VAT, GST, property tax, or withholding tax solutions including but not limited to using native Workday, INFOR and/or NetSuite functionality, ONESOURCE Indirect Determination, Vertex, Avalara, SOVOS, Taxware• Bachelor’s degree in accounting, computer science or related field Workday, INFOR, NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, ONESOURCE, Vertex, CPA, Enrolled Agent, or other technology related certification (either in process or able/willing to obtain)• Travel up to 50% (While 50% of travel is a requirement of the role, due to COVID-19, non-essential travel has been suspended until further notice.)Preferred:• Experience with a Big 4 firm, large ERP/consulting organization, or a large IT department of a multinational company with tax related experience• Other leading Cloud based SaaS financial application implementation experience (i.e.: Fusion Intact, PeopleSoft, Oracle, SAP, Lawson)The teamAt Deloitte Tax LLP, our Tax Management Consulting (TMC) practice helps tax departments pursue a streamlined, transparent, and efficient tax function that enhances the core responsibilities of compliance, reporting and planning, while also positioning tax as a strategic business advisor for the digital era. We specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements and obligations. As technology specialists, we help clients make appropriate technology choices for both direct and indirect taxes across all business cycles that have a tax impact. Our team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients with a successful ERP implementation.Deloitte TMC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to support our clients’ objectives and address their challenges. description: Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM)Role Title: Oracle GTM  Techno - Functional ConsultantRole SummaryResponsible for designing, implementing, and supporting Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) solutions to enable compliant, efficient cross-border trade. This role translates global trade compliance and logistics requirements into Oracle GTM configuration and integrations, ensuring accurate classification, screening, licensing, duty/tax determination, documentation, and reporting across regions.Key Responsibilities1) Discovery & RequirementsLead workshops with Trade Compliance, Customs, Logistics, Order Management, Finance, and IT.Document end-to-end trade processes: import/export, FTAs, restricted party screening, embargo controls, licensing, customs filings support, and landed cost.Define business rules for product classification (HS/HTS), ECCN/dual-use, origin, valuation, preference, and trade document needs.Create functional specs, user stories, process maps, test scenarios, and traceability.2) Oracle GTM Solution Design & ConfigurationConfigure Oracle GTM objects and business rules, including (as applicable):Trade Item/Product Master trade attributes (HS, ECCN, origin, PGA attributes, etc.)Restricted Party Screening (RPS): party matching rules, escalation/holds, audit trailTrade compliance controls: embargo/sanctions, denied party, license determination, controls by country/product/end useLicense management: license types, decrements, usage tracking, expiry alertsFTA / Preference programs: qualification rules, supplier solicitations (if used), calculations, certificatesCustoms and filing readiness: declaration data prep, document sets, filing packets (where supported/required)Landed cost / duty & tax estimation and allocation (when in scope)Workflow, holds, approvals, notifications, and exception handlingDefine role-based access, compliance audit requirements, and retention needs.3) Integrations & DataDesign/validate integrations between Oracle GTM and enterprise systems, such as:ERP/Order-to-Cash (often Oracle EBS/Cloud ERP), OMS, WMS/TMS, PLM/PIM, broker/filing providersCollaborate with technical teams on:Interface mappings, canonical models, error handling, retries, monitoring, and reconciliationMaster data governance for item, party, country, and classification dataSupport data conversion/migration for items, parties, licenses, and historical transactions (as required).4) Testing, Cutover, and HypercarePlan and execute SIT/UAT, performance testing (if needed), and compliance scenario testing.Resolve defects, manage configuration iterations, and support cutover planning (controls, holds, and contingency plans).Provide hypercare support and transition to steady-state operations.5) Change Management & TrainingDevelop SOPs, work instructions, training materials, and end-user training for compliance and operational teams.Support operating model design (RACI), exception queues, and compliance governance.6) Reporting & Audit SupportDefine and validate trade compliance reporting needs: screening results, license usage, classification coverage, preference claims, audit logs.Support internal/external audits by ensuring traceability and control evidence.Required Skills & QualificationsOracle GTM Core2-4 years of Hands-on experience implementing/supporting Oracle GTM (functional or techno-functional).Strong understanding of at least several domains:Restricted party screening, sanctions/embargo complianceImport/export compliance, export controls (e.g., ECCN concepts)HS/HTS classification, country of origin, valuation conceptsLicensing and decrementation controlsFTA/preference concepts and qualification logicAbility to translate compliance policy into system-enforceable rules and workflows.Functional / BusinessKnowledge of cross-border trade process flows: order, ship, invoice, customs, logistics, returns.Strong documentation: BRDs/FRDs, user stories, process diagrams, test scripts.Technical (for Techno-Functional roles)Integration literacy: APIs, flat files, middleware (e.g., OIC or similar), data mapping, error handling.Data analysis skills for reconciliation and defect triage (SQL a plus, not always required).Familiarity with Oracle ecosystem integrations (ERP/SCM) is a plus.Professional SkillsStakeholder management across Compliance/Legal, Supply Chain, Finance, and IT.Ability to drive workshops, decisions, and scope control.Strong analytical thinking; comfort with ambiguity and regulatory nuance.Nice-to-HaveExperience with multi-country/global trade programs and complex org structures.Broker/filing provider integration experience.Experience modernizing trade compliance operating models and master data governance.Prior consulting delivery (estimation, RAID logs, status reporting, client leadership).Typical DeliverablesCurrent/Future state process maps, requirements backlog, functional design documentsConfiguration workbooks, rule matrices, integration mappingsTest strategy, SIT/UAT scripts, defect logsCutover plan, training materials, SOPsCompliance control evidence and audit artifactsKPIs / Success MeasuresReduction in compliance exceptions/false positives (screening)Improved classification and origin coverage/accuracyOn-time shipment release rate (fewer holds)Audit findings reduction and improved traceabilityDuty savings via preference optimization (when applicable)Experience Guidance (by level)Analyst/Consultant: test execution, configuration under guidance, documentation, defect triageSenior Consultant/Lead: lead workstreams, design rules/workflows, manage UAT and cutoverManager/Architect: end-to-end solution ownership, integration strategy, governance, stakeholder leadership

title: USI-EH-27-Tax-TTC-ETI-L55 -Manager- SAP FICO/SD/MM Integration with Direct or Indirect Tax experience
description: Manager – Tax Technology Consulting (TTC) - SAP FIOC/MM/SD integration with Direct or Indirect Tax experienceDo you like to be hands on with technology while leading teams with your strong project manager skills? We need entrepreneurial and passionate professionals to play active role in this world and lead implementations.What you will do:As a Manager/Senior Manager, you will contribute to the growth and development of Deloitte Tax India Pvt Ltd in a variety of ways, including:• Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies.• Client Management: Manage the day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors.• Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk.• Practice Development & Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought-ware" and "point-of-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals.• People Development: Perform role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices.The team:Deloitte’s Tax Technology Consulting (TTC) group helps our clients’ tax departments improve their operations by developing new technology-enabled, cutting-edge methods and processes. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients’ objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients’ global strategies and the options that exist to turn theory into an executable plan.TTC’s Enterprise Tax Integration (ETI) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.Experience Required –• 8 to 15+ years of total experience.• 5+ years of Implementation experience in SAP ECC 6.0 & S4 HANA with focus on Tax integration with SAP FICO/MM/SD integration with direct or indirect tax experience.• Experience with tax technology applications i.e., ONESOURCE /Global NEXT Integration, Vertex/Accelerator & Chain flow Accelerator Integration, Avalara, Sovos• Expert in Direct and Indirect Tax configuration, Withholding Taxes, local country indirect tax localizations, VAT customizations and Reporting.• Experience with User Exits, preparing functional specifications, executing test cycles, cutovers, go-live and Hypercare, providing user training and documentation.• Expert in cross functional integration of modules - SD-FI & MM-FI• Strong in project management, leadership abilities, and has tendency to independently execute project cycles and deliverables.• Relentless focus on quality of work products while adhering to completing deliverables on time.• Effective communications and strong presentation and team building skills. Initiative-taking participates in firm-based activities and owns his/her career.• Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparationPreferred Skills:• SAP MM or SD (ECC or S4 HANA) Certified• SAP DRC, Central Finance with Tax integration, Transfer Pricing, BRIM• Experience with New GL, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Intercompany, Materials Management, Logistics Invoice Verification, Asset Accounting implementation.• Experience with Ariba, Coupa, Hybris, Open Text, Read soft Integration with ERP.The TeamTax Technology Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. title: USI-EH-27-Tax-TTC-ETI-L45 -Senior - NetSuite/Workday/INFOR
description: Workday/INFOR/NetSuite - Senior ConsultantWorkday, NetSuite, Zuora and Salesforce are some of the rising SaaS ERP technologies that are revolutionizing how tax is managed and how tax departments around the globe operate. If you are someone who thrives in navigating the growing tax landscape through a technology lens and partnering with passionate professionals to help companies achieve their tax objectives; then we would like to get to know you. Apply now!What you’ll do:As a professional in Deloitte’s Tax Technology Consulting (TTC) team, you will be a part of a team that provides an integrated approach to technology implementations that help tax departments maximize the strategic value to the organization. You will deliver services for companies that are implementing tax solutions related to enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems and tax applications.As a Senior you will contribute to the growth and success of Deloitte Tax LLP in a variety of ways, including:• Client Management: Participate in the day-to-day interactions with client’s project team members and Deloitte project leadership members• Delivery: Deliver components of Workday, INFOR and/or NetSuite, Integration, Supply Chain, HCM or third-party tax software implementations including designing, configuring, testing and training of the solution.• Solutions: With an emphasis on tax processes, identify business requirements, requirements management, functional design, prototyping, process design (including scenario design, flow mapping), testing, training, defining support procedures and supporting implementations.• Cross Functional Teaming: Understand and articulate the broader Tax practice and Deloitte overall. Maintain relationships and serve clients holistically.• People Development: Participate in the development of team members.• Business Development: Participate in and contribute to pursuit teams.QualificationsRequired:• 5+ years’ experience in implementation of ERPs or tax software that include but not limited to experience with tax requirements for direct tax such as corporate income tax, operational transfer pricing, state income taxation and indirect tax such as sales & use tax, VAT, GST, property tax, or withholding tax solutions including but not limited to using native Workday, INFOR and/or NetSuite functionality, ONESOURCE Indirect Determination, Vertex, Avalara, SOVOS, Taxware• Bachelor’s degree in accounting, computer science or related field Workday, INFOR, NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, ONESOURCE, Vertex, CPA, Enrolled Agent, or other technology related certification (either in process or able/willing to obtain)• Travel up to 50% (While 50% of travel is a requirement of the role, due to COVID-19, non-essential travel has been suspended until further notice.)Preferred:• Experience with a Big 4 firm, large ERP/consulting organization, or a large IT department of a multinational company with tax related experience• Other leading Cloud based SaaS financial application implementation experience (i.e.: Fusion Intact, PeopleSoft, Oracle, SAP, Lawson)The teamAt Deloitte Tax LLP, our Tax Management Consulting (TMC) practice helps tax departments pursue a streamlined, transparent, and efficient tax function that enhances the core responsibilities of compliance, reporting and planning, while also positioning tax as a strategic business advisor for the digital era. We specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements and obligations. As technology specialists, we help clients make appropriate technology choices for both direct and indirect taxes across all business cycles that have a tax impact. Our team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients with a successful ERP implementation.Deloitte TMC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to support our clients’ objectives and address their challenges. Our team’s multi-disciplinary approach combines tax technical and technology skillsets, enabling greater impact and efficiency within our client’s organization. TMC’s business services help clients with operating model evaluation, roadmap development for a desired future state, data management solutions, automation opportunities, tax portal, cloud for enterprise systems, agile resourcing models, risk, provision and compliance. Learn more about Deloitte Tax Management Consulting.How you’ll growAt Deloitte, our professional development plan focuses on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer opportunities to help sharpen skills in addition to hands-on experience in the global, fast-changing business world. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs at Deloitte University, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career. Explore Deloitte University, The Leadership Center.BenefitsAt Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.Deloitte’s cultureOur positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer well-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. Learn more about Life at Deloitte.Corporate citizenshipDeloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. title: USI-EH27-Consulting-Customer-DFO&I- AEP & AJO- Senior Consultant, Managed Services
description: #DFO&I2027CustomerThe Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.Position SummaryLevel: Senior Consultant, Managed ServicesWe are seeking an Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) Developer to build and operationalize marketing analytics and activation solutions. This role partners with Marketing, Product, and Data teams to deliver trusted customer data pipelines, identity resolution, segmentation, and cross-channel journey orchestration, supported by strong engineering fundamentals in SQL, ETL, Python, cloud platforms, and data visualization.Work you’ll do: AEP / AJO deliveryDesign, develop, and maintain AEP schemas, datasets, dataflows, and data governance-aligned configurations to support marketing analytics and activation.Implement and optimize AJO journeys, message templates, and channel configurations (e.g., email/push/SMS, as applicable).Build and manage audience segmentation and support activation use cases (e.g., lifecycle, churn prevention, propensity-driven journeys).Partner with stakeholders to translate marketing measurement needs into AEP/AJO technical designs (events, attributes, profile enablement, and downstream consumption).Data engineering (SQL / ETL / Python)Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest and transform data from sources such as CRM, web/app analytics, ad platforms, and transactional systems into AEP and analytics layers.Write high-quality SQL for profiling, transformation, validation, and performance tuning across warehouses/lakes.Use Python for orchestration, automation, data quality checks, API integrations, and lightweight services/utilities supporting marketing data operations.Establish data quality controls: reconciliation, anomaly detection, lineage documentation, and runbook procedures.Cloud & platform operationsBuild and operate solutions on cloud ecosystems (e.g., AWS/Azure/GCP), leveraging managed services for compute, storage, orchestration, and monitoring.Implement secure data handling practices (PII controls, encryption, access management) and support audit/compliance requirements.Monitor and troubleshoot pipelines and journey execution; drive continuous improvements for reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.Analytics enablement & visualizationCreate curated datasets (semantic layers/marts) for marketing performance reporting and experimentation measurement.Build dashboards and automated reporting in tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker, enabling self-service insights for marketers and executives.Define and support KPI frameworks (e.g., conversion, retention, LTV, attribution inputs), ensuring metric consistency across teams.The team:Our Digital Foundry Operate & Innovations (DFO&I) team partners with organizations to rapidly design, build, and scale digital products and experiences that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, and operations specialists, we deliver end-to-end solutions—from initial concept and agile development to ongoing digital operations—enabling clients to experiment, iterate, and scale digital initiatives with confidence and agility. We support clients across domains such as strategy, commerce, marketing, sales, and service, helping them realize their digital ambitions through flexible, scalable teams. Our expertise spans the full digital lifecycle, including customer research, experience design, platform development, content production, and marketing automation. By bridging the gap between strategy and execution, we empower organizations to achieve measurable outcomes and deliver exceptional customer experiences in an ever-evolving digital landscape.QualificationsMust Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:6 - 10 years of hands-marketing data engineering, martech development, or marketing analytics engineering roles.Hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) implementations in production environments.Strong SQL skills (complex joins, window functions, performance tuning, data modeling).Strong ETL/ELT experience (batch and/or streaming), including data validation and observability.Proficiency in Python for data workflows and automation.Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and modern data stacks (data lake/warehouse concepts, orchestration, CI/CD).Experience delivering dashboards and analytical datasets for marketing and product stakeholders.Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:Familiarity with customer identity resolution, event-based data modeling, and customer 360/profile concepts.Experience with real-time/event streaming (e.g., Kafka/Kinesis/PubSub) and/or API-driven integrations. Knowledge of marketing measurement approaches (incrementality/experimentation, attribution concepts, funnel analytics). Exposure to data governance frameworks and marketing consent/privacy requirements.Experience implementing CI/CD, automated testing, and infrastructure-as-code (tooling varies). Technical skills (explicit) AEP/AJO: schemas/datasets/dataflows, segmentation, profiles, journey configuration, activation troubleshooting SQL: advanced querying, optimization, dimensional/behavioral modeling ETL/ELT: pipeline design, orchestration, data quality/observability Python: automation, APIs, transformations, validation Cloud: AWS/Azure/GCP services for data & analytics workloads; monitoring/logging Data visualization: Tableau / Power BI / Looker; KPI definitions and executive-ready dashboards Success measures (example outcomes) Reduced time-to-activate audiences and launch journeys through reliable, documented pipelines. Improved marketing reporting trust via automated data quality checks and reconciliations. Increased adoption of dashboards and self-service datasets across Marketing Analytics stakeholders.Education:BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university  Location:Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

description: Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM)Role Title : Senior Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) Lead / Solution LeadRole SummaryLead the end-to-end delivery of Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) programs, owning solution design, compliance controls, integrations, and governance to enable compliant and efficient cross-border trade. This role drives business outcomes (shipment release, auditability, duty optimization where applicable) by translating global trade policy into scalable Oracle GTM configuration, operating processes, and measurable controls.Key ResponsibilitiesProgram & Workstream LeadershipOwn the Oracle GTM workstream across discover → design → build → test → deploy → hypercare.Lead a cross-functional team (functional, technical, data, testing) and manage day-to-day priorities, dependencies, and delivery quality.Drive scope, RAID, estimates, and status reporting; align stakeholders across Trade Compliance, Logistics, Customer Service, Finance, Legal, and IT.Establish design authorities/guardrails (standards, reusable patterns, naming conventions, control objectives).Solution Architecture & Design AuthorityDefine the end-to-end trade architecture: Oracle GTM plus ERP/OMS/WMS/TMS, master data, and broker/filing providers (as applicable).Translate policy and regulatory requirements into enforceable GTM controls and workflows with audit-ready traceability.Make design decisions on rule strategy, performance implications, and global rollout patterns (template vs localization).Oracle GTM Configuration & Rule Design (hands-on leadership)Own design and oversight (and configure where needed) for:Restricted Party Screening (RPS): matching strategy, escalation/holds, queue design, false-positive reduction, audit trailEmbargo/sanctions and export controls: policy-to-rule mapping, country/product/end-use controlsClassification & product trade attributes: HS/HTS, ECCN concepts, origin, valuation attributes, PGA/agency data where relevantLicense management: determination, decrementation logic, usage tracking, alerts, exception handlingFTA / Preference programs: qualification approach, solicitation/data collection strategy, claim governanceTrade documentation & filing readiness: document sets, transaction completeness checks, handoff to brokers/providersLanded cost/duty & tax estimation (if in scope)Workflow/approvals/holds and exception queue managementEnsure global design supports multi-entity, multi-country operations, and aligns to compliance operating model.Integrations, Data, and ControlsLead integration design with ERP/SCM (often Oracle), OMS, WMS/TMS, PIM/PLM, and external screening/filing partners.Set data governance for trade-critical master data (item, party, country, classification, license) including stewardship and quality metrics.Define reconciliation, monitoring, and control evidence (logging, audit reporting, SOX-type controls where applicable).Testing, Cutover, and Hypercare LeadershipOwn end-to-end testing strategy: compliance scenarios, negative testing, performance/volume tests (as needed).Lead UAT with compliance and operations; define entry/exit criteria and sign-offs.Drive cutover planning (holds strategy, fallback, business continuity) and lead hypercare stabilization and transition to run support.Change Management & EnablementPartner with change leads to deliver training, SOPs, and role-based enablement for compliance and operations teams.Define operating model elements: RACI, exception handling SLAs, governance cadence, and KPIs.Required Qualifications8–12+ years experience in global trade/compliance technology delivery, with 3–6+ years in Oracle GTM implementation leadership (or equivalent depth).Demonstrated leadership of at least one full lifecycle Oracle GTM implementation or major transformation (multi-region preferred).Strong domain knowledge across several areas:Restricted party screening, sanctions/embargo controlsImport/export compliance concepts; export controls (ECCN/dual-use concepts)HS/HTS classification, origin, valuation basics, documentation requirementsLicensing and decrementation controlsFTA/preference concepts and claim governanceStrong stakeholder leadership and decision facilitation; comfortable translating legal/compliance policy into system rules.Delivery rigor: estimates, RAID, quality gates, and executive-ready communication.Technical / Tooling Expectations (for a Lead)Integration design literacy (APIs/flat files/middleware), mapping, error handling, monitoring, and reconciliation.Data migration/conversion leadership and validation approach.Working knowledge of adjacent Oracle ecosystem (ERP/SCM/OTM/OIC) is strongly preferred.SQL/data analysis capability is a plus.Nice-to-HaveBroker/filing provider integration experience and customs data handoff patterns.Experience building a global template with localized compliance extensions.Audit support experience (internal controls, evidence, traceability).Prior consulting lead experience (multi-client or multi-program delivery).Typical DeliverablesGTM solution blueprint, rule matrix, and workflow/holds designIntegration architecture and interface specificationsMaster data governance model and data quality KPIsTest strategy, UAT scripts, sign-off packs, defect triage governanceCutover/hypercare plan and operational runbookTraining/SOPs and compliance control evidence packKPIs / Success MeasuresReduced shipment holds and improved on-time release rateReduced screening false positives and faster exception resolutionImproved classification/origin/license coverage and audit traceabilityStable integrations (low error rate, fast recovery, strong monitoring)Duty optimization outcomes (where preference programs are in scope)

description: AI Engineer – Senior ConsultantAs you start your career, are you ready to take the next step to learn methods and process to provide business and individual tax return compliance support to Deloitte Tax? Are you ready to fulfill your potential and create an impact that matters? In this role, you will design, build, and deploy enterprise-grade AI and LLM-powered solutions that directly support Deloitte Tax professionals and clients. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI technology and large-scale enterprise systems, making a tangible impact on how tax services are delivered globally..As an AI Engineer, you will assist and support Deloitte Tax in the following areas:As an AI Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of AI solutions, from conception through production deployment. Your key responsibilities will include:·       Design and develop production-grade LLM-powered applications and Generative AI solutions that address complex business and tax-related challenges.·       Build and integrate AI capabilities — including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, agentic workflows, and prompt engineering frameworks — into enterprise applications and services.·       Help Architect and implement scalable AI integrations across cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), ensuring reliability, performance, and security.·       Develop, train, evaluate, and optimize machine learning models using structured and unstructured data, applying techniques such as supervised and unsupervised learning, NLP, and fine-tuning of large language models.·       Own MLOps practices including model versioning, CI/CD pipelines, performance monitoring, bias detection, data drift management, and model retraining workflows.·       Collaborate closely with data scientists, software engineers, business analysts, and tax professionals to translate complex requirements into scalable, maintainable AI solutions.·       Lead technical design discussions and contribute to architectural decisions, code reviews, and engineering best practices across the team.·       Produce comprehensive documentation covering AI architectures, data sources, model design, API specifications, and deployment processes.·       Champion responsible AI principles, ensuring adherence to data privacy, security, and regulatory compliance standards throughout the development lifecycle.·       Stay current with the rapidly evolving landscape of AI technologies, LLM frameworks, and industry best practices, bringing relevant innovations to the team.Qualifications and Requirements for assistance and support to Deloitte Tax:Education·       Full-time Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or Artificial Intelligence with a minimum of 60% or equivalent CGPA.Experience·       4  - 6+ years of hands-on professional experience in AI/ML engineering, with a strong focus on LLM applications and enterprise AI integration.Technical Skills·       Demonstrated experience building and deploying LLM-based applications, including prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and agentic systems using frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex.·       Proficiency in Python as a primary development language, with strong software engineering practices including modular design, testing, and version control (Git).·       Hands-on experience with cloud platforms — Azure, AWS, and/or GCP — including managed AI/ML services (e.g., Azure OpenAI Service, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI).·       Solid understanding of machine learning theory and techniques, including NLP, supervised and unsupervised learning, and model evaluation methodologies.·       Strong command of database technologies, including relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cosmos DB).·       Experience with MLOps tooling and practices, including experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights & title: USI-EH27-Consulting-FT-BF-VB.NET-Consultant, Functional Transformation
description: Finance TransformationFinance TransformationWe are looking for motivated and talented VB.NET/C# developers to join us. Upon joining, you will be cross-skilled on OneStream through a structured training program. This role is designed for practitioners with a strong VB.NET/C# foundation who are eager to transition into EPM consulting and bring communication and client-facing skills. Prior OneStream experience is not required; technical aptitude, willingness to reskill, and a consulting mindset are key.Work you'll doAs a Consultant, Functional Transformation on the Finance Transformation team, you will be responsible for: Supporting the design, configuration, testing, and deployment of OneStream solutions for financial consolidation, planning, and reporting engagements. Translating business and functional requirements into technical solutions using VB.NET, C#, .NET frameworks, and data integration approaches. Assisting with solution build activities including business rules, workflows, data loads, reports, and platform configurations. Collaborating with project teams across geographies to prepare deliverables, resolve defects, and support implementation milestones. Participating in structured OneStream training and certification activities to build delivery capability within the practice. The teamOur Finance Transformation team helps organizations improve finance operations, enterprise performance management, and reporting through a combination of process, technology, and industry knowledge. The team supports clients across transformation initiatives by bringing together functional understanding and technology delivery capabilities. In this role, you will work with practitioners focused on building scalable OneStream solutions for complex business needs.Location: Hyderabad / Bengaluru / PuneQualificationsRequired: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field 3-4 years of hands-on development experience using VB.NET and/or C# Experience applying object-oriented programming principles in application development Experience working with .NET libraries and frameworks Experience with relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, or equivalent Experience with application programming interfaces, data integration patterns, or extract, transform, load pipelines Experience working in client service, consulting, or project delivery environments Preferred: Experience with enterprise performance management, corporate performance management, or financial planning platforms such as OneStream, Anaplan, Hyperion, or TM1 Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud Platform Experience with Python or SQL in support of application development or integration work Experience with financial consolidation, close processes, or management reporting OneStream training or certification Experience using artificial intelligence tools or generative artificial intelligence technologies

description: Deloitte - Global Operate -Pricing - Specialist Assistant ManagerDo you thrive on developing creative and innovative insights to solve complex challenges? Want to work on next- generation, cutting-edge products and services that deliver outstanding value and that are global in vision and scope? Work with premiere thought leaders in your field? Work for a world-class organization that provides an exceptional career experience with an inclusive and collaborative culture?Want to make an impact that matters? Consider Deloitte Global.Work you’ll do:In this role, you would be a member of the Global Operate team, working with Global businesses (Consulting, Tax & Legal, Cyber and Financial Advisory) and various Deloitte Firms. You will provide project management expertise and develop deliverables for a variety of internal audiences, including Global Businesses, Deloitte Firms, and the Global Operate Council to engage, inspire and motivate people to embrace the significant changes that are required to achieve our ambition. You must demonstrate a deep understanding of project management best practices and apply them effectively in a global, complex environment. Strong writing abilities, high attention to detail and ability to juggle multiple projects is a must. Key responsibilities may include:Partner with business & Deloitte firm leaders to drive global alignment around strategic initiativesCollaborate across the firm to assess and prioritize strategic projects to best align with Deloitte’s Operate strategy and growth objectives.Loading and extracting data from pricing tools. Developing visualization according to businesses, portfolios and offerings.Closely work with USI team in India location on pricing, solutioning & contracting.Develop data automation and workflows. Maintaining project documentation, including but not limited to project plans, meeting minutes, status reports, dashboards.Developing current or former proficiency in Advanced Data Analytics and/or modelling. Excel being key skill.Coordinate activities across different workstreams and stakeholders, ensuring that timelines are met. Monitor project progress and identify potential risks and issues that may impact the project's success. Proactively track and work with teams to address themConnect with business leaders to gather updates, prepare & present specific updates during sessions with Operate leadersCreate executive level documents such as presentations, excel reports, tableau dashboards etc. for senior leadershipDrive onboarding standardization for businesses across workstreams. Define baseline and post onboard activitiesAssist with the management of project budgets and resources, including tracking project expensesConduct research and analysis to support the development of project strategies and solutionsMaintain content on Global Operate intranet site and on the knowledge management siteOrganize meetings and gather information to be presented during monthly check-ins with leaders and teamsAdditional responsibilities may include:Contribute to cross-functional projects, working alongside Sales, Learning and Development, Shared Services and CoRe Knowledge Services and liaise with other workstreamsSupporting adaption or evolution of the Operate strategy over timeImplementing strategic initiatives and projects, as requested What you’ll be part of—our Deloitte Global culture:At Deloitte, we expect results. Incredible—tangible—results. And Deloitte Global professionals play a unique role in delivering those results. We reach across disciplines and borders to serve our global organization. We are the engine of Deloitte. We develop and lead global strategies and provide programs and services that unite our network.In Deloitte Global, everyone has an opportunity to lead. We see the importance of your perspective and your ability to create value. We want you to fit in—with an inclusive culture, focus on work-life fit and well-being, and a supportive, connected environment; but we also want you to stand out—with opportunities to have a strategic impact, innovate, and take the risks necessary to make your mark. Who you’ll work with:The Global Operate Team is comprised of professionals with various areas of focus that collectively provide mission critical services to support Global Operate’s overall success. Whether focused on sales excellence, delivery transformation, quality and risk management, contracts management, finance and operations, capability build, communications and change management, knowledge management, marketing and market intelligence, or other activities, these professionals ensure that our Firm operates efficiently, and our people can effectively serve clients every day. QualificationsRequired:Master’s degree in business administration or managementSenior Specialist: 5-8 years relevant experience in professional services; experience in managing multiple projects; previous work experience with a top tier consulting firm preferredHave demonstrated experience in the extraction, analysis, and visualization of data using primarily MS Excel. Preferred any of the following skills SQL, Python, Tableau, and PowerBI.Demonstrated project management skills, preferably on a cross functional or cross departmental team or a complex projectExperience in working with benchmarking tools.Ability to prioritize and manage multiple threads, with strong organization and time management skillsExceptional attention to detail with strong writing skills and ability to communicate with senior leaders effectivelyAbility to work well in a matrixed team environment with individuals from different countries and cultureMake connections across projects, brainstorm ways to extend use of created materialsKnowledge of technology and business related tools and other relevant BI software, MS excel is key skill needed at advance level.Works well under pressure and can effectively and professionally navigate tough situationsWorking knowledge of brand templates; adherence to the brand standards preferredProfessional certification in MS excel required. Certification in BI tools - Tableau, and PowerBI would be an added advantage.Location: HyderabadComfortable working with team members and stakeholders across geographies and time zonesWork hours: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM (expected to be flexible with time zones)How you’ll grow:Deloitte Global inspires leaders at every level. We believe in investing in you, helping you embrace leadership opportunities at every step of your career, and helping you identify and hone your unique strengths. We encourage you to grow by providing formal and informal development programs, coaching and mentoring, and on-the-job challenges. We want you to ask questions, take chances, and explore the possible.Benefits you’ll receive:Deloitte’s Total Rewards program reflects our continued commitment to lead from the front in everything we do —that’s why we take pride in offering a comprehensive variety of programs and resources to support your health and well- being needs. We provide the benefits, competitive compensation, and recognition to help sustain your efforts in making an impact that matters.Corporate CitizenshipDeloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people, and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities.

title: USI-EH27-Consulting-AI&E-HCI-Lead Cloud Integrated Infrastructure Engineer II-AI Infra Strategy
description: Artificial Intelligence & EngineeringAI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.  Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.Level: Lead Cloud Integrated Infrastructure Engineer II As a Manager within Deloitte Consulting's Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure practice, you will lead AI infrastructure strategy and advisory engagements across three connected frontiers: AI compute & HPC infrastructure, Spatial AI, and Physical AI. You will manage multidisciplinary, global teams and coach junior practitioners while working directly with clients and internal stakeholders to translate business goals into technically grounded solution approaches. You will contribute to sales and proposal efforts and own day-to-day delivery across the project lifecycle – work planning, scoping, estimation support, and leadership reporting – to drive successful outcomes. description: Manager – Strategic Design & Delivery - DT-US OCIO - HyderabadDT-US | DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY | OCIO STRATEGYPosition summaryAbout the role:Are you a design-obsessed professional who finds satisfaction in transforming complex, information-dense content into visually compelling stories? As a Manager - Strategic Design & Delivery within the Deloitte Technology-US (DT-US) Office of the CIO (OCIO) Strategy team, you will play a critical role in producing executive-ready deliverables that inform and influence senior technology and business leaders. The ideal candidate combines exceptional design skills across Microsoft Office and graphic design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite) with a strong eye for detail, business acumen, storytelling, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment.The work you'll do• Own end-to-end design and production of high-stakes executive deliverables across a variety of formats• Bring complex ideas to life visually by translating dense and/or scattered data into clear and compelling narratives• Apply your full design toolkit (e.g., Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite) to produce outputs that reinforce DT-US’s strategic ambitions• Leverage AI-powered tools to accelerate deliverable production, enhance quality, and continuously elevate what the team can deliver• Partner with US- and India-based DT-US professionals as creative thought partners to shape how ideas are structured, visualized, and communicated• Develop and refine strategic communications for diverse audiences (e.g., executive stakeholders, large practitioner groups)• Promote a high level of stakeholder satisfaction by meeting deadlines, managing expectations, and communicating risks and issues effectively• Craft compelling visual narratives that translate strategic priorities into stories that resonate with executive leaders and broad audiences• Create and maintain a library of complex and customized templates (e.g., graphics, PowerPoint slides)Qualifications required• Design or visual communications professional with 10+ years of relevant experience in a corporate, professional services, or technology environment• Expert-level proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, and Excel — including custom layouts, executive presentation design, charting, data visualization, and slide master management• Demonstrated experience producing materials for executive or C-suite audiences, with a portfolio of high-quality, executive-ready deliverables• Proven success applying visual design principles — layout, hierarchy, color theory, typography, and information architecture — to complex business content• Demonstrated ability to support strategic communications for diverse audiences — from executive stakeholders to broader practitioner groups — adapting tone, format, and visual complexity to suit the channel and audience level• Solid organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to independently prioritize and deliver across multiple projects under overnight turnaround commitments• Strong executive presence and comfort interpreting ambiguous briefs, with the ability to produce high-quality outputs with minimal rework• Detail-oriented with exceptional follow-through; consistently delivers polished work that meets or exceeds stakeholder expectations• Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, including the ability to clearly articulate design decisions and incorporate feedback during daily syncs with US-based colleagues• Ability to work effectively in a matrixed, cross-functional, and virtual team environment; experience in large complex multinational organizations a plus• Proficient in Microsoft 365 collaboration tools including Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and co-authoring workflows• Demonstrated experience using graphic design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Figma) to create polished graphics, infographics, icons, and executive-ready visual assets• Experience in consulting and/or technology industry strongly preferred• Graduate or post-graduate degree, preferably in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Business, or a related field

description: As a consultant in the workforce solution/Technology team, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data integration and reporting solutions with a strong focus on SQL Server and SSIS (SQL Server Integration Services). You will work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver scalable data pipelines, ETL processes, and reporting solutions that enable data-driven decision-making. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.We provide opportunities to transform tax operations using contemporary technologies in the market. Individuals work to transform their current state of tax to the next generation of tax functions. Are you ready to take the next step in your career to find new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations using new technologies? title: USI - EH27 - Product Engineering - Delivery Leader - AVP
description: Delivery LeaderJob DescriptionOverview: As a Delivery Leader at Deloitte, you will own the delivery for multiple products across our portfolio, ensuring a cohesive strategy and seamless execution across various segments. Your extensive experience in program management and project leadership will be pivotal in driving strategic alignment, inspiring cross-functional teams, and delivering enterprise IT solutions that meet organizational goals. With a strong focus on operational excellence, customer-centric problem-solving, innovation and continuous improvement, you will guide teams to achieve peak performance and deliver high-quality outcomes on time and within budget. The ideal candidate will be a visionary leader and mentor, committed to driving success for Deloitte's clients and business investments.Responsibilities: Lead large-scale implementations, develop and articulate vision and objectives, and ensure alignment with business strategies. Demonstrating strategic vision evolution through continuous learning. Inspire product engineering teams, advocate for discovery and delivery practices, and educate the organization on product engineering models. Promote continuous improvement and spread knowledge through community sessions. Drive complex programs, define and measure product engineering maturity, and achieve Objectives/KPIs. Ensure tools and reports are available to track progress. Conduct quality audits and engage hands-on with delivery and team growth. Learn and experiment with new techniques/tools like GenAI. Coach delivery managers to develop strong capabilities. Advise on discovery and delivery methodologies, share learnings through evangelism, and provide examples of people development. Drive process optimization, quality and risk management, capacity planning, and resource utilization and drive operational excellence. Focus on addressing critical customer issues and aligning teams with business objectives. Engage cross-functional teams to achieve peak outcomes through continuous learning and collaboration. Identify inefficiencies, build problem-solving capabilities, and enhance the product engineering model to be lean and adaptable. Guide the organization to embrace lean principles and foster innovation. Influence decision-making processes, ensure effective communication, and resolve conflicts. Foster close collaboration within the product community. Establish risk management processes, identify and mitigate risks, and focus on early learning and fast feedback. Proactively solve problems and plan contingencies.The TeamUS Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary product development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. We develop and deploy cutting-edge go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.Qualifications 15+ years of experience in product management or project leadership, managing enterprise IT solutions across multiple teams, with demonstrated experience in strategic product management and leading multiple teams.Strong skills in developing and implementing strategic plans to meet organizational goals.Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to engage and manage stakeholders. Extensive knowledge of project management methodologies and tools, with a track record of delivering projects on time and within budget.Deep understanding of industry trends, market dynamics, and competitive landscape to drive business growth and innovation.Strong leadership capabilities with Customer-centric mindset. How You will Grow: At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities— including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in exactly the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team-based learning, and eLearning. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state-of-the-art, world- class learning Center in the Hyderabad offices is an extension of the Deloitte University (DU) in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India
