title: USI - EH27 - Product Engineering - Product Manager - SNOW- Assistant /Deputy Manager
description: A Lead Product Analyst (Assistant Manager) is a mid-level individual contributor responsible for ensuring a product’s value and viability within a product line. This role involves leading empowered, cross-functional product teams to solve customer problems that align with business needs. Being a mid-level product management role, you will have the opportunity to own products of lesser complexity that drive business value. The Lead Product Analyst, like any of our product managers, is accountable for the product’s success, from vision to execution, and collaborates closely with various functions and stakeholders to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. Work you'll do As a Product Management Specialist II on the product management team, you will be responsible for: Defining and advancing product vision, strategy, and roadmap priorities aligned with business objectives and customer needs Establishing, monitoring, and analyzing key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product performance and inform decisions Partnering with business, engineering, experience, and delivery stakeholders to translate priorities into actionable product plans Conducting user research, stakeholder engagement, and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and shape solutions Driving continuous improvement by removing obstacles, supporting experimentation, and sharing product management practices across the team The team You will join a cross-functional team focused on delivering product solutions that address business priorities and improve user outcomes. The team collaborates closely across business, engineering, experience, and delivery to shape strategy, evaluate opportunities, and bring scalable solutions to market. This environment emphasizes evidence-based decision-making, continuous learning, and shared ownership of product outcomes. Location: Hyderabad, Bengaluru Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM Qualifications Required: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field 5-8+ years of experience in product management, product analysis, product owner, or similar roles Experience defining product vision, roadmap, backlog priorities, or release plans for a product or product capability Experience establishing, tracking, and analyzing key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product outcomes Experience working with business stakeholders, engineering, user experience, and delivery teams in a cross-functional environment Experience conducting user research, market analysis, or competitive analysis to support product decisions Experience supporting product value, viability, and business objectives, including profit and loss (P&L) measures Preferred: Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or Kanban delivery environments Experience using product management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Confluence Experience using reporting or analytics tools such as Tableau or Power BI Experience facilitating roadmap reviews, backlog refinement, or stakeholder workshops Experience working across enterprise platforms or multiple business domains

title: USI-EH-27-Tax-ETI - Dev-L55 -Manager- Provision & Compliance
description: Manager - Tax Transformation Consulting – Provision & Compliance Do you have a passion to work for US based clients of Deloitte Tax and transform their current state of tax to the next generation of tax functions? Are you ready to take the next step in your career to find new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations? Are you ready to fulfil your potential and want to have a significant impact to global initiatives? If the answer to all the above is “Yes,” come join Tax Transformation Consulting group in Deloitte India (Offices of the U.S), a service line of Deloitte Tax LLP! Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines and regions have obtained support services through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a much sought-after career option. At Deloitte, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment. Work you’ll do Increasingly complex tax decisions can have a significant effect—positive or negative—on the future of our clients’ business. Our approach combines insight and innovation from multiple disciplines with business and industry knowledge to help our clients excel globally. Key responsibilities will be: - • Manage and lead tax provision engagements both domestic and global, with a focus on ASC 740 processes and controls. • Lead and oversee the implementation, enhancement, and automation of tax software solutions across provision workflows.• Lead the analysis of tax and financial data to identify process gaps, enhance accuracy, and drive efficiencies across reporting activities.• Partner with tax, finance, and technology teams to design and implement scalable tax process improvements. • Manage the translation of business requirements into scalable automation and system solutions.• Oversee the development and review of client ready documentation, executive level status updates, and standardized process materials.• Lead collaboration with cross functional teams, fostering formidable team performance in a fast paced client environment.Qualification and Experience Required – • 8 to 11 years of experience.• Full time Masters/Bachelors in Finance/Accounts or equivalent from reputed University or MBA or Chartered Accountant with experience in Finance, Accounting, Taxation and Auditing • Experience in tax provision, including strong knowledge of ASC 740.• Demonstrated ability to work independently while leading and collaborating effectively within diverse team environments.• Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving and organizational skills.• Oversee and guide execution of data intensive activities, ensuring effective data organization to meet reporting requirements.• Proficiency in MS Office applications, specifically Excel, Word and PowerPoint • Drive a strong culture of quality, ensuring high quality work products are delivered on time across engagements.• Motivated to learn new technologies through self-study and work to develop prototypes and solve technical problems • Preferred experience in one or more of the areas below: o Provision software – Corptax, ONESOURCE Tax Provision, ONESOURCE Dataflow, Longview, SAP Direct Tax, Oracle FCCS and Oracle TRCS o Experience in completing provisions – quarterly and year end o Experience in Blueprinting, Chart of Accounts Designo Experience in automation/analytical tools such as: ? Data wrangling tools - Alteryx, Power Query or others ? Analytical tools – Power BI, Tableau, or others • Apply deep knowledge of business and tax processes to guide development of functional specifications, reporting solutions, and user enablement.The Team Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business, while closely aligned with clients’ core business strategy. The TTC group helps tax departments pursue a streamlined, transparent and efficient tax function that addresses compliance and planning issues while expanding its strategic support of the broader business enterprise. Our services are focused on tax-sensitized data acquisition, efficient process design and deployment, enterprise and tax-specific software implementation, and organizational design. Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the digitization of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.

title: USI-EH27-Consulting-FT-BF-OneStream-Analyst, Functional Transformation
description: Finance TransformationJoin our Finance Transformation practice to help Deloitte client service teams define and execute Finance and Global Business Services agendas and strategies. This role sits at the intersection of financial strategy and emerging technology, enabling the organization to unlock new value through intelligent automation, predictive analytics, and AI-driven decision support.The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable building financial models and designing AI pipelines — translating complex financial requirements into scalable, intelligent solutions. You will serve as a bridge between the Finance function and the Data & Technology organization, driving transformation initiatives that improve speed, accuracy, and strategic insight across the business.Work you'll doAs an Analytics and Insights Engineer II on the Finance AI team, you will be responsible for:• Analyze finance and business requirements and translate them into conceptual, logical, and technical AI-enabled solutions • Collaborate with finance stakeholders, business analysts, data architects, and technology teams to define and deliver scalable solutions • Design, develop, and deploy artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions for finance use cases such as anomaly detection, cash flow prediction, forecasting, and expense classification • Develop generative AI, natural language processing, prompt library, retrieval-augmented generation, and multi-agent solutions to support finance planning, reporting, audit, and decision support activities • Build and maintain data pipelines and API-based integrations across cloud and data platforms, including AWS, Databricks, and Snowflake • Support AI governance, model risk, and explainability practices, and provide guidance to team members on AI tools, agentic AI, and prompt engineeringThe teamThe Finance AI team helps finance organizations apply data, analytics, and artificial intelligence to improve decision-making, automation, and business insight. The team works across finance, data, and technology stakeholders to design scalable solutions that support planning, reporting, and operational efficiency. This role contributes to the delivery of intelligent solutions that combine finance domain knowledge with emerging technology capabilities.Location: Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, ChennaiQualificationsRequired:• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field • 3+ years of experience building AI or machine learning solutions in enterprise environments • 3+ years of experience supporting finance processes such as financial planning and analysis, controllership, commercial finance, reporting, or forecasting • Experience developing solutions using Python, SQL, and data libraries such as Pandas or NumPy • Experience building generative AI, agent-based, natural language processing, or retrieval-augmented generation solutions • Experience integrating data from platforms such as AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform • Experience translating business requirements into technical solution designs and production-ready implementationsPreferred:• Experience with FastAPI, Node.js, or ReactJS • Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or vector database tools • Experience with AWS services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Amazon EC2, or API Gateway • Experience with data modeling • Experience working in Agile delivery environments#FY27_FT_Business Finance_Finance AI

title: USI-EH27-Consulting Services-AI&E-EaaS-Associate Architect-Application Architect - Mainframe
description: Artificial Intelligence & Engineering AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations. Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.Position Summary:Role: Associate ArchitectAs an Associate Architect at Deloitte Consulting, you will help deliver complex mainframe solutions for enterprise clients by combining deep technical knowledge with strong execution. In this role, you will contribute to solution architecture, lead defined workstreams, and support the delivery of high-quality outcomes across development, modernization, and transformation initiatives. You will also collaborate with cross-functional teams, guide junior practitioners, and help clients address evolving business and technology needs.Work you'll doAs an Associate Architect on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for:·       Designing and supporting end-to-end mainframe application solutions for large-scale enterprise programs.·       Leading technical workstreams across mainframe development, enhancement, and modernization initiatives.·       Collaborating with client stakeholders and onsite/offshore teams to translate functional and technical requirements into solution designs.·       Reviewing code, architecture, and delivery outputs to support quality, performance, and alignment with program objectives.·       Mentoring junior team members and contributing to delivery planning, issue resolution, and continuous improvement efforts.The teamEngineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/ChennaiShift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM and 2 PM to 11 PMQualificationsRequired:·       6+ years of hands-on experience in mainframe application development, architecture, and delivery, with at least 1-2 years in a technical lead or architect capacity.·       Deep expertise in z/OS, COBOL, JCL, DB2, CICS, IMS, VSAM, Sysplex, LPAR Design, Capacity Planning and Enterprise Architecture, with demonstrated ability to design and review enterprise-grade solutions.·       Proficiency with debugging and development tools: File-Aid, Xpeditor, Abend-AID; schedulers; and source/version control systems such as Endevor and Changeman.·       Proven experience leading client engagements and managing onsite/offshore delivery teams.·       Strong command of SDLC, Agile, and DevOps methodologies as applied to mainframe programs.·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills; experienced in facilitating workshops, architecture reviews, and executive briefings.·       Demonstrated ability to identify industry trends, technology disruptors, and articulate their relevance to current client engagements.·       BE / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc (CS) or equivalent degree from an accredited university.Preferred:·       Experience with mainframe modernization initiatives — legacy re-platforming, API-layer integration, or migration to hybrid cloud architectures.·       Advanced expertise in DB2 tuning, MQ integration, batch optimization, or automation via REXX scripting.·       Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and practical application in code modernization, anomaly detection, or intelligent automation contexts.·       Experience contributing to proposals, RFP responses, or practice-building initiatives.·       Experience with Assembler.·       Relevant certifications: SAFe for Architects, or equivalent.#FY27ReferralCampaign #2027_AI&E_Dscreen

attitude and presence, ability to interact with senior professionals and deal with conflict in a mature and professional manner Adapt communication style with ease when working with team members, clients, and stakeholders across different levelsExperience leveraging Gen AI tools to enable efficiencies and streamlining opportunities  Location: Hyderabad/bengaluruWork timing: 11 am to 8 pmHow you’ll growAt Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance. Advise clients on the use of Wiz capabilities, including Wiz Compute, Data Security, Threat Detection & Response, Code Scanning, SAAS, and Container Security. Support client transitions to Wiz, including migration, integration, and optimization of security controls and processes. Evaluate cloud services against standards such as CIS, NIST, and GDPR and assess environment coverage within Wiz. Monitor vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and compliance issues and deliver cloud security reports with actionable recommendations. Support policy development, incident response, data protection, access control, resource configuration activities, and documentation of technical issues and resolutions. The team Security Platform teams embed security in all aspects of digital transformation by securing a client’s “technical backbone” while also enabling a secure platform for the cloud environment. Services include security architecture, secure development and deployment, end-to-end cyber cloud capabilities, application security, and security for emerging technologies and connected products. Examples of work include Secure by Design, Cloud Security Orchestration & Automation, Core Infrastructure Security, and Secure Software Enablement. Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive Secure.Vigilant.Resilient.TM cyber programs. Cloud Infrastructure supports organizations through the complete cycle of migrating business processes to the cloud, with capabilities and solutions focused on development, transformation, and resilience of cloud security. description: Do you have a passion to work for US based clients of Deloitte Tax and transform their current state of tax to the next generation of tax functions? Are you ready to take the next step in your career to find new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations? Are you ready to fulfill your potential and want to have a significant impact to global initiatives? If the answer to all of the above is “Yes,” come join MTS group in Deloitte India (Offices of the U.S), a service line of Deloitte Tax LLP!Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a much sought-after career option.At Deloitte, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.Work you’ll doTax Technology professionals at Deloitte combine insight and innovation from multiple disciplines with business and industry knowledge to help our clients excel globally. We are looking for driven individuals having a passion for technology - whether its programming applications, automation or datacenter operational excellence. If you like to figure out how to make the new technologies work in a corporate environment, then our teams might be a fit for you.Key Responsibilities·       Architect, develop, and implement AI and data-driven solutions using Azure OpenAI, with a focus on prompt engineering and optimization.·       Write robust, efficient Python code for data processing, model integration, and workflow automation. Leverage Power Platform tools to automate business processes where needed.·       Design, maintain, and query databases (SQL and/or NoSQL) for high performance, reliability, and scalability.·       Translate business requirements into technical solutions. Apply strong business acumen to ensure delivered solutions drive measurable business value.·       Work closely with stakeholders, product managers, and other engineers to gather requirements, prioritize features, and ensure successful project delivery.·       Identify challenges proactively and develop innovative technical solutions to complex business problems.·       Present technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Document solutions, write technical reports, and provide training/support as required.Qualifications & Experience  6+ years professional experience in software/data engineering or related roles.  Minimum 3 years in Azure OpenAI, prompt engineering, and LLM solutions. Strong proficiency in Python programming. Expertise in SQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, etc.) and/or NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cosmos DB, etc.).Practical experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps).·       Proven ability to solve complex problems using both technical and analytical skills.·       Excellent teamwork, interpersonal, and communication skills.The Team The MDT group is focused on delivering differentiated service offerings through the use of new technologies such as Data Wrangling, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence (BI), Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Optical Character Recognition (OCR), and Machine Learning. This group enables the Multi-state Tax Services (MTS) practice to drive profitability and growth, through application of emerging and existing technologies and enhanced utilization of Tax tools and software. We support MTS teams by assessing and addressing their data and technology challenges on client engagements, internal processes and data intensive projects to help achieve efficiencies, win clients and create differentiated services. title: USI - EH27 - CoRe Knowledge Services - Assistant Manager - Reporting & Insights Lead – Hyderabad/ Bengaluru
description: Specialist Assistant Manager, Content Management CoRe Knowledge Services (KS), part of Deloitte’s global shared services organization, serves Deloitte’s member firms worldwide. The individual will support the Businesses & Industries (B&I) and Member Firm Engagement (MFE) teams through a centralized, One Team approach to reporting and analytics. This role is responsible for owning end-to-end metrics reporting across both teams and serving as the single point of contact for standard and custom reporting needs. The individual in this role will serve as a liaison across all Businesses & Industries (B&I) and Member Firm Engagement (MFE) Knowledge Leads to streamline reporting, improve consistency, and enhance the quality and usability of metrics-based insights. Work you'll do As a Specialist Assistant Manager, Content Management on the CoRe Knowledge Services team, you will be responsible for: Manage standard and custom reporting requests for Businesses & Industries Knowledge Leads and Member Firm Engagement teams. Produce recurring and ad hoc reports, translate data into stakeholder-ready insights, and support reporting-based recommendations. Align with Knowledge Leads and stakeholders on reporting requirements, priorities, and outcomes across B&I and MFE. Establish and maintain reporting governance, including intake processes, prioritization, documentation, and turnaround expectations. Validate metrics data, resolve reporting anomalies with the Metrics team, and improve reporting efficiency through standardization and automation. The team CoRe Knowledge Services (KS), part of Deloitte’s global shared services organization, serves Deloitte’s member firms worldwide. The Member Firm Engagement team strives to establish Knowledge Services across the CoRe and Non-CoRe Member Firms and demonstrate the value of Deloitte’s proprietary knowledge platform, Knowledge Exchange (KX), and related offerings globally. The B&I team delivers similar work from a Businesses and Industries perspective. Location: Hyderabad/Bengaluru Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM Qualifications Required: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Analytics, Statistics, Data Science, Information Systems, Knowledge Management, Economics, Finance, or Library and Information Science Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, charting, trend analysis, and report development Experience creating reports and dashboards using Tableau or similar data visualization tools Experience developing stakeholder-ready presentations using Microsoft PowerPoint Experience producing recurring and ad hoc reporting and analytics deliverables Experience documenting reporting definitions, business rules, and process guidance Experience working with SharePoint, databases, repositories, or knowledge management platforms Preferred: Master’s degree in Business Administration, Analytics, Data Science, Information Management, or Knowledge Management Certification in Tableau, Power BI, Microsoft Excel, or similar reporting and analytics tools Experience with reporting automation tools Experience supporting leadership presentations with data-driven storyboards and visuals Experience working with content types such as profiles, qualifications, and documents Experience supporting Knowledge Services, Businesses & Industries, or Member Firm Engagement environments

description: CyberDeloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.The TeamDigital Trust & PrivacyThe cyber risk services—IAM practice helps organizations in designing, developing, and implementing industry-leading IAM solutions to protect their information and confidential data, as well as help them build their businesses and supporting technologies to be more secure, vigilant, and resilient. The cyber risk services—IAM team delivers service to clients through following key areas of IAM: Application Onboarding Lifecycle Manager Compliance Manager Password Management Automated Provisioning Roles Management ITSM tools Integration Advanced Authentication Methods Strategy and Road Map One Identity Manager Key Responsibilities Architect, develop, and maintain custom IAM workflows and connectors within One Identity Manager to enable seamless, secure identity lifecycle management. Design and implement intuitive web interfaces using Angular for IAM self-service and administration, promoting user efficiency and automation. Integrate IAM solutions with enterprise systems including Active Directory, Azure AD, ServiceNow, HR systems, and databases via REST APIs and custom connectors. Oversee the complete user lifecycle—managing digital identities, access requests, approvals, provisioning, recertification, and business role assignments. Lead onboarding and access management for applications, security groups, shared mailboxes, distribution groups, file shares, local non-personal accounts (NPAs), and database assets within One Identity Manager. Administer and streamline access to cloud and infrastructure resources—including servers, network components, and Azure assets (PIM roles, RBAC, service principals, app registrations, CAP groups, and Entra account hygiene). Drive implementation and governance of business roles and Segregation of Duties (SoD) across the estate, ensuring compliance with security and audit standards. Collaborate with security architects, IT operations, and business stakeholders to define and deliver IAM strategies that align technology with organizational risk and compliance objectives. Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex integration issues and provide subject-matter expertise for IAM best practices and roadmaps.  Required Skills & Qualifications 7 –10+ years of hands-on experience with One Identity Manager (OneIM), including substantial exposure to custom development, configuration, and integration. Expert in Angular (or similar framework) for building responsive and secure web user interfaces tailored for IAM use cases. Deep technical knowledge of Active Directory, Azure (including RBAC, PIM, service principals, app registrations, CAP groups), ServiceNow, database onboarding, and cloud/hybrid IAM architectures. Proven experience developing and deploying custom connectors, workflows, and REST API integrations with third-party enterprise systems. In-depth understanding of the identity lifecycle—onboarding, provisioning, approval flows, recertification, access reviews, and role-based access control. Track record in designing and maintaining secure, scalable IAM solutions tailored for large, distributed enterprises, including cloud and on-premises environments. Familiarity with business role modeling and Segregation of Duties (SoD) controls in IAM implementations. Excellent communication skills, confident in interfacing with technical and non-technical stakeholders across teams. Qualification B.Tech/M.Tech/MS/MBA #Cyber_Digital Trust & Privacy

title: FY27 USI Audit Services | EH | L25 - Assistant, Valuation and Analytics Advisory
description: Assistant, Valuation and Analytics AdvisoryJoin Deloitte’s Audit & Assurance Valuation and Analytics team to support audit objectives through financial instrument pricing, valuation analysis, and data analytics. In this role, you will work with market data, valuation tools, and audit teams across industries to help assess complex instruments and document technical analyses. This opportunity offers exposure to valuation methodologies, structured products, and cross-functional collaboration in a dynamic professional environment.Work you'll doAs an Assistant, Valuation and Analytics Advisory in the Valuation and Analytics team, you will be responsible for:Serve as a team member for Valuation & Analytics  practice. Additionally candidates with background in probability and statistics with CFA/ FRM/PRM would be preferred.·       Background in financial derivatives, structured products and energy and commodities  including detailed knowledge of valuation model and techniques is a plus.·       Experience with handelling large data set for Interest rates, Fx, Credit and Equity from different market vendors is a plus.·       Strong analytical and computer skills including experience with quantitative analysis technical tools and techniques such as Refinitive, Markit, Capital IQ, Bloomberg, Monte-Carlo Simulation tools such as Crystal Ball and @Risk, FinCAD, Numerix, Savysoft TOPS, Principia, Super Derivatives, are a plus.·       Background in mathematical finance at the level of a Master's level degree in Mathematical Finance, Mathematics of Finance, Financial Engineering or Quantitative Finance is a strong plus.·       Experience with programming laguages including SAS, Python and R is highly desired.·       Familiarity with financial markets, financial instrument valuation (including derivatives and structured products), trading, deal structuring or risk management is desired.·       Experience with Asset Liability Management (ALM) or Counterparty Valuation Adjustment (CVA) is a plus.·       Experience with SPAN/clearing/margin models is a plus.·       Personal characteristics should include: presentation, consulting, project management, client, and training / mentoring skills; strong presence, good communication and interpersonal skills; conceptual and quantitative depth in valuation methodologies and concepts and underlying markets and models. ·       Ability to explain difficult financial modeling/valuation concepts to diverse audiences and to experts at various clients.·       Related consulting experience is a plus.

title: USI-EH27-TIS – Digital & Analytics - Skills Transformation (Solutions Workstream) - Specialist Manager
description: The USI D&A Skills Manager leads USI D&A delivery across next phase implementation and Wave 1 sustainment for the Skills landscape, ensuring alignment to program priorities, disciplined execution, and a mature support model. This role is critical to the effective delivery, evolution, and sustainment of the organization’s Skills landscape by: leading the Skills D&A operations team and owning the sustainment support model; partnering with Deloitte Consulting Services, DT, and program leadership to align and prioritize wave and sustainment work (including vendor interactions and SOW/MSA delivery); identifying and escalating risks across technology, scope, resources, and timeline; and providing advisory support as the program transitions to a post-Wave 2 sustainment model. Work you'll do As a Specialist Manager, Technical Project and Program Management on the TIS – Talent Innovation & Solution team, you will be responsible for leading implementation and sustainment activities across the Skills landscape. Lead the Skills D&A operations team to execute implementation and sustainment activities and meet support objectives. Own sustainment reporting for the Skills landscape, including monthly reporting for SkillsIQ and the Skills Management Tool. Oversee vendor interactions and service delivery to help ensure issues are addressed in line with service level expectations and signed statements of work. Partner with DT, Deloitte Consulting Services, and program leadership to align priorities across wave delivery, build, test, cutover, and sustainment planning. Provide advisory support for the post-Wave 2 sustainment model and escalate risks across technology, scope, resources, and timeline. The team TIS – Talent Innovation & Solution Digital Platform & Services within TIS - Digital & Analytics is the HR services center for the U.S. organization across all regions. The Digital Platform & Services team follows a standard approach on developing business-aligned solutions that provide an enhanced employee experience through innovative solutions which are efficient and effective. Our goal is to deliver high-quality service through world class technology solutions, strategic reporting, data visualization and analytics Location: HyderabadExperience - 10years+ Shift Timings: 2 PM to 11 PM Qualifications Required: Experience leading cross-functional delivery teams across multiple workstreams Experience managing program governance, prioritization, and risk escalation Experience managing vendor delivery, statements of work, and operational support activities Experience partnering with business, technology, and program leadership stakeholders Experience preparing written and verbal updates for leadership audiences Preferred: Experience supporting HR technology, talent, or skills platform initiatives Experience with implementation planning across build, test, cutover, and sustainment activities Experience with operational reporting, analytics, or dashboarding

title: USI- EH-27- Tax - L45- Multistate Tax services- Senior, Tax Services - Passthrough -
description: Deloitte Tax Services is seeking a Senior to support multistate tax compliance and related delivery activities across a nationally managed service offering. In this role, you will work with engagement teams and compliance center resources to help deliver timely, accurate tax compliance services for clients. The role offers exposure to large-scale delivery models, multijurisdictional compliance work, and collaboration across Deloitte’s US and USI teams.Work You'll Do –  As a tax compliance specialist in our Multistate Investment Management practice, you will collaborate daily as part of high-performing teams, work deeply in our tax compliance process, use cutting edge technology tools to meet our client’s compliance needs accurately and efficiently, and consult with other team members.  Daily tasks may include preparing tax returns across a broad range of clients and jurisdictions, researching tax regulations, understanding the applicable tax implications for specific clients and making recommendations based on your findings.  You will commonly work with multiple clients at the same time, providing you exposure to a variety of organizations and a stronger understanding of applicable tax implications for different clients. Performing a detailed technical review of partnership and corporate state tax returns and work papers with attention to multistate tax issues such as apportionment, state modifications, nexus, unitary filings, and flow-through taxation. Coordinating with an in-house tax preparation team within Deloitte and with the clients’ tax department. Performing detailed review of estimated payment and withholding calculations and related filings. Researching state tax legislation and assisting with impact on compliance. Assisting with various tax consulting projects including research and writing projects related to tax planning, restructuring, due diligence, audit defense, and accounting for income taxes. Assisting with engagement workflow management and supervising tax consultants and interns on assigned engagements. The Team: Multistate State is a rapidly expanding service offering at Deloitte. The offering is built on a scale that includes a highly-leveraged and nationally managed compliance center in our U.S. India (USI) offices, with the project oversight management based in the U.S. offices, primarily Chicago. Deloitte is currently in the process of aggressively increasing its market share in this service offering.Work Location: Hyderabad, Gurugram, Chennai, Bangalore, Kolkata, Pune, MumbaiShift Time – 11am – 8pm ISTQualifications - Required: Full time Masters degree from reputed University 4 -8 years’ experience in state and local partnership and corporate taxes (Operating Partnerships, Partnership Structures, state schedule K-1's, private equity, real estate) Excellent presentation and communication skills Supervisory experience Enrolled Agent Certification for Managers A preparer tax identification number (PTIN) is required for tax returns. If you do not have a PTIN or if your PTIN is expired, you are requested to complete the new or renewal application process (as applicable) before joining Deloitte.

The role offers exposure to large-scale delivery models, multijurisdictional compliance work, and collaboration across Deloitte’s US and USI teams.Work You'll Do –  As a tax compliance specialist in our Multistate Investment Management practice, you will collaborate daily as part of high-performing teams, work deeply in our tax compliance process, use cutting edge technology tools to meet our client’s compliance needs accurately and efficiently, and consult with other team members.  Daily tasks may include preparing tax returns across a broad range of clients and jurisdictions, researching tax regulations, understanding the applicable tax implications for specific clients and making recommendations based on your findings.  You will commonly work with multiple clients at the same time, providing you exposure to a variety of organizations and a stronger understanding of applicable tax implications for different clients. Performing a detailed technical review of partnership and corporate state tax returns and work papers with attention to multistate tax issues such as apportionment, state modifications, nexus, unitary filings, and flow-through taxation.Coordinating with an in-house tax preparation team within Deloitte and with the clients’ tax department.Performing detailed review of estimated payment and extensions calculations and related filings.Researching state tax legislation and assisting with impact on compliance.Assisting with various tax consulting projects including research and writing projects related to tax planning, restructuring, due diligence, audit defense, and accounting for income taxes. The Team: Multistate State is a rapidly expanding service offering at Deloitte. The offering is built on a scale that includes a highly-leveraged and nationally managed compliance center in our U.S. India (USI) offices, with the project oversight management based in the U.S. offices, primarily Chicago. Deloitte is currently in the process of aggressively increasing its market share in this service offering.Work Location: Hyderabad, Gurugram, Chennai, Bangalore, Kolkata, Pune, MumbaiShift Time – 11am – 8pm ISTQualifications - Required:Full time Masters degree from reputed University4 - 8 years’ experience in state and local partnership and corporate taxesExcellent presentation and communication skillsSupervisory experienceEnrolled Agent Certification for ManagerA preparer tax identification number (PTIN) is required for tax returns. If you do not have a PTIN or if your PTIN is expired, you are requested to complete the new or renewal application process (as applicable) before joining Deloitte.

title: USI - FY27 - Cyber Enterprise Security - ZScaler - Senior Consultant
description: CyberDeloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful insights and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable businesses to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure achievements.Position SummaryLevel: Senior ConsultantWork you’ll do:We are seeking an experienced Zscaler Architect / Senior Engineer to lead and support the implementation, configuration, and migration of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) solutions in enterprise environments. This role will help design and deliver Zero Trust access models, modernize remote access, and support migration from legacy VPN and proxy technologies. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on Zscaler delivery experience, solid network security fundamentals, and the ability to work across security, network, IAM, and endpoint teams.Roles and Responsibilities Lead and support implementation, configuration, and migration of Zscaler ZIA and ZPA solutions. Assess current-state network and security architecture and design target-state Zero Trust access models. Plan and execute migration from traditional VPN, proxy, and remote access solutions to Zscaler. Configure and manage security policies, URL filtering, SSL inspection, authentication, forwarding methods, and access controls in ZIA. Configure application segmentation, connector deployment, access policies, and user-to-app connectivity in ZPA. Integrate Zscaler with enterprise identity and security tools such as Azure AD / Entra ID, Okta, SAML, SCIM, SIEM, EDR, and CASB platforms. Troubleshoot user connectivity, performance, and policy issues across ZIA/ZPA deployments. Support pilot, rollout, cutover, and post-migration hypercare activities. Create technical documentation including architecture diagrams, runbooks, migration plans, and operational handover materials. Collaborate with network, security, endpoint, and IAM teams to ensure smooth deployment and adoption. The Team:Enterprise Security teams embed security in all aspects of digital transformation by securing a client’s “technical backbone” while also enabling secure digital transformation. Services include security architecture, secure development and deployment, end-to-end cyber cloud capabilities, application security, and security for emerging technologies and connected products. Examples of work include Secure by Design, Cloud Security Orchestration & Automation, Core Infrastructure Security, and Secure Software Enablement.QualificationsMust Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Zscaler, network security, cloud security, or enterprise security architecture Proven experience implementing and migrating Zscaler ZIA and ZPA in enterprise environments. Strong understanding of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), secure web gateways, and remote access transformation. Good understanding of routing and switching technologies. Experience with proxy technologies, VPN replacement strategies, DNS, TCP/IP, routing, firewall policies, and authentication protocols. Hands-on experience with user migration, app onboarding, policy tuning, and troubleshooting in Zscaler environments. Experience integrating Zscaler with identity providers and enterprise security ecosystems. Ability to translate business and security requirements into scalable technical designs. Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, and problem-solving skills. Good to Have: Experience with Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) for digital experience monitoring and user troubleshooting. Experience with Zscaler Client Connector deployment and endpoint integration. Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP. Experience in large-scale enterprise transformation or network security modernization programs. Education:·       Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.#Cyber_Enterprise

The team is responsible for designing and driving the future of management reporting for all levels of firm leadership. With a focus on innovation, we continuously seek ways to enhance and optimize existing deliverables and create new reporting solutions. title: USI-EH27-UK Tax - L25- Tax technology service consultant - Product Support - Hyderabad / Bangalore
description: USI UK Digital Innovation - Tax technology consultant I - Product support Do you have a passion to work for global clients and provide tax compliance support services? Are you ready to take the next step in your career by focusing on providing system support for Global clients of Deloitte? Are you ready to fulfill your potential and want to have a significant impact on global initiatives? If the answer to all of the above is "Yes," come join us! Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited ("Deloitte Tax in India") commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP ("Deloitte Tax") U.S. service lines and regions have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn, support and practice taxation, a much sought-after career option. In recent years, member firms, such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, etc. have obtained support in their tax practices through the Deloitte Tax in India. At Deloitte, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment. Work you’ll do Supporting multiple Tax software products and services throughout Deloitte, underpinning global and local country filing activities. Responsibilities include (but aren’t limited to) initial triage, internal and external user support, administration requests, maintenance and UAT. You will be part of the team that offers essential 1st line support to both internal and external users, ensuring that system updates, issues, admin requests and general support requirements are carried out efficiently and accurately to the highest standard, with onward escalation where appropriate. Key Responsibilities: · Provide system administration support across a number of tax applications and offerings · 1st line support for troubleshooting, assisting users with resolutions and escalation to appropriate global teams · Apply a methodical and logical approach to identifying and solving problems · Be involved in ad-hoc system/project implementation activities as part of a broader team · Be involved with User Acceptance Testing across a range of products/applications A successful candidate should have: · Strong Interpersonal skills · Ability to organize and prioritize workloads, together with the ability to handle deadlines and respond well under pressure · Ability to adhere to standard policies and procedures and recall/apply guidance and updates · Keen interest in problem solving · Ability to understand new applications · Ability to operate as a member of a team and work unsupervised · Good level of education with Math’s and English Language as part of their curriculum · Good IT skills and knowledge of Microsoft applications · Flexible in approach to work and adapt in accordance with business needs · Keen to learn new skills · Needs to be articulate, friendly and confident Qualifications & Skills: · Any graduate - With computers skills as part of their curriculum or experience in a Service Desk environment · 1+ years’ experience supporting MNC clients while working in a corporate environment · Experience in product support · Experience using entire MS office Suite · Good Presentation skills Required Experience: 1 to 4 years Work location: Hyderabad Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM IST How you’ll grow At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in exactly the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team-based learning, and eLearning. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state-of-the-art, world-class learning Center in the Hyderabad offices is an extension of the Deloitte University (DU) in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. [1] Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India Benefits At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. [2] Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you. Deloitte’s culture Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer well-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. [3] Learn more about Life at Deloitte. Corporate citizenship Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. description: Artificial Intelligence & EngineeringJoin our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients’ achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to business. Your contributions help Deloitte client service teams improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation. Position SummaryLevel: Associate Architect As a Specialist Senior(App Architecture), you will support and lead defined workstreams to design and deliver modern, scalable, secure applications for Fortune 1000 clients. Your work may include new application builds, application modernization, cloud/hybrid adoption, platform engineering, and multi-region deployments. You’ll contribute to target-state architecture, drive engineering quality within your scope, and deliver design inputs and POCs to enable operational readiness and continuous optimization.Work you’ll do: Lead architectural discussions with business and functional analysts to understand requirements and assess integration impacts on the overall business and technical architecture. Prepare and own the technical architecture and design, clarify requirements, and resolve ambiguities from an architectural perspective. Develop solutions that align with established architectural designs, integration standards, and quality processes. Create, enforce, and continuously improve technical design and development guides, templates, and architectural standards. Facilitate ARB meetings, manage architectural deliverables, and prepare weekly status reports for leadership review. Conduct detailed architectural reviews of deliverables and provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members. Collaborate with onsite clients, coordinators, analysts, and cross-functional teams to ensure architectural alignment. Design templates, frameworks, or scripts to automate and standardize routine development or operational tasks, supporting architectural consistency and efficiency.Technical ProficienciesExpertise in .NET: Strong proficiency in .NET, with a focus on ASP.NET Core for building web APIs and services Extensive experience in developing scalable, high-performance enterprise applications using .NET Cloud Computing (AWS/Azure/GCP): Hands-on experience designing and deploying solutions on one or more hyperscalers: AWS: EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFormation Azure: App Service, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Blob Storage, Azure Functions, API Management, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure Resource Manager (ARM) GCP: Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Firestore, Deployment Manager/Terraform Proficiency in designing and deploying microservices architectures on cloud platforms Microservices Architecture: Strong expertise in building and managing microservices using ASP.NET Core, with resilience libraries like Polly, and developing REST and GraphQL APIs Experience with inter-service communication using Eventgrid,gRPC or Kafka Performance Optimization: Proven experience in profiling, monitoring, and optimizing applications for performance using tools like dotnet-trace, dotnet-counters, and Visual Studio's Diagnostic Tools Expertise in .NET runtime (CLR) performance tuning, memory management (garbage collection), and SQL query optimization DevOps Practices and CI/CD: Hands-on experience with DevOps tools and methodologies, including: CI/CD tools: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure Pipelines, AWS CodePipeline, GCP Cloud Build Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, AKS) Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible Monitoring tools: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk Database and Data Storage: Strong experience with relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server) Experience with NoSQL and caching technologies and/or hyperscaler-native options Code Reviews and Best Practices: Expertise in conducting thorough code reviews to ensure adherence to SOLID principles, design patterns, and industry-standard best practices Proficiency in writing clean, modular, and maintainable code using tools like SonarQube or PMD for static code analysis API Management and Security: Experience in designing and managing APIs using Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, or API Gateway Knowledge of authentication/authorization protocols like OAuth2, JWT, and SAML System Architecture and Design: Experience producing architecture/design artifacts (diagrams, decision logs) using tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, or ArchiMate Strong experience in architecting scalable, distributed systems using microservices, event-driven architectures, and domain-driven design (DDD) Continuous Learning and Collaboration: Commitment to staying updated with the latest advancements in .NET and cloud-native technologies Excellent collaboration skills with cross-functional teams (Product, QA, DevOps) to ensure alignment and deliver high-quality solutions The team: Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.Qualifications Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications 7 - 12 years of industry experience, with at least 6+ years in a technical architect role designing applications and hosting solutions on cloud platforms At least 5+ years of hands-on experience in cloud native architecture design, implementation of distributed, fault-tolerant enterprise applications for cloud Should have knowledge to understand and create Target State Solutions Should be able to create Low level designs for Engineering teams For Ex: Flow charts, Sequence diagrams, class diagrams Should have knowledge of reusable components such as Middleware and Action Filters, using an ORM like Entity Framework Core (EF Core), and implementing robust Logging and Monitoring Should have Hands-On experience on ASP.NET Core Web API development, including implementing authentication and authorization processes (e.g., using ASP.NET Core Identity, JWTs) Project and package management using NuGet and the .NET CLI Using Entity Framework Core (EF Core), including database connection pool configuration Event-Driven Implementation: Integrating with Kafka using .NET client libraries Should define Interfaces and re-usable components to avoid duplicate effort - For Ex: Circuit breaker, Retry, Error Handling Experience in application migration and modernization of legacy applications to cloud platforms. Deep expertise in architecting and designing end-to-end cloud solutions, recommending architecture patterns aligned to business needs Experience designing approach and leading migrations from on‑premises to cloud, leveraging database migration services and application migration/assessment tooling (e.g., discovery, wave planning, cutover, validation) Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, and managed/container platforms (e.g., cloud-managed Kubernetes services and/or OpenShift) Working knowledge of cloud-native CI/CD and developer platforms (source control, build, artifact repositories, pipeline orchestration), distributed tracing/observability, and security services Strong understanding of microservices architecture, with experience in designing and implementing cloud-based solutions Strong understanding of the cloud native development practices and architectural patterns Experience in leading and managing teams within specialist areas from project planning to execution Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: Awareness of industry trends, challenges, technology adoption levels and solution landscape Strong understanding of BigData architecture, design and implementation creating cloud architecture leveraging PaaS Strong understanding of the cloud native development practices and architectural patterns Understanding of data services and when to use each Understanding of the impact of technology on client business processes and plan the risk mitigation steps Understanding of backup, replication, disaster recovery and high availability technologies Understanding on network architectures including integration of software components such as web / application servers, middleware, RDBMS, development environments, operational components and data center operations Understanding of cloud security and regulatory policies and governance mechanisms Experience in cloud infrastructure design of data, storage and networking infrastructure, addressing disaster recovery and business continuity planning requirements Certification from any cloud service provider (AWS, Azure, GCP) AI-related awareness: demonstrated AI-first delivery mindset, including familiarity with Generative AI (GenAI) concepts, agentic workflows/automation, and practical considerations (data privacy, security, model risk) when incorporating AI capabilities into enterprise applications Education: BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university   Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai#FY27ReferralCampaign #2027_AI&E_Dscreen

title: USI FY27 | Cyber Operate- SOAR + Anthropic - Consultant
description: Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape and technology transformation as we partner with clients to strengthen their security posture. As a Consultant, you will support the design, development, and optimization of security orchestration, automation, and response (SOAR) solutions across client environments. You will work with security operations teams to automate workflows, improve incident response processes, and enhance operational efficiency through platform integrations and playbook development. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to AI-enabled security automation capabilities that help organizations scale and mature their cyber operations. Work you'll do As a Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for: Designing, developing, and maintaining SOAR playbooks for alert triage, investigation, enrichment, and response activities Integrating SOAR platforms with security and enterprise tools, including security information and event management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), threat intelligence, ticketing, email, identity and access management (IAM), firewall, and cloud security platforms Collaborating with security operations center analysts, incident responders, and engineering teams to identify automation opportunities and improve response workflows Troubleshooting and enhancing playbooks, connectors, integrations, dashboards, reports, and operational metrics to improve reliability, performance, and automation outcomes Supporting AI-enabled SOAR use cases, including AI-assisted playbook development, alert triage, incident summarization, and decision support within governed workflows The team Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes managing the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security, business transformation, and ensuring continuous compliance. Services include Cyber-as-a-Service, Managed Application Security, and Managed Extended Detect & Respond (MXDR). Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai/Gurugram/Kolkata Shift Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST Qualifications Required: 4+ years of experience in cybersecurity Experience with SOAR platforms such as Cortex XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, Swimlane, IBM Resilient, or Tines Experience with security operations center processes, security information and event management (SIEM) workflows, incident response, and case management Experience integrating application programming interfaces (APIs), webhooks, and third-party security tools into automation workflows Experience with scripting or automation languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, or JSON-based workflow logic Knowledge of one or more security domains, including endpoint, email, identity, network, cloud, or threat intelligence Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, Engineering, or Information Technology Preferred: Experience with cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and their security services Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, threat detection engineering, and response orchestration practices Experience with ticketing or information technology service management (ITSM) tools such as ServiceNow or Jira Security, automation, or vendor platform certifications Experience with AI-enabled SOAR capabilities, including AI-assisted playbook generation, natural language automation building, or machine learning-based alert triage Familiarity with large language model (LLM) concepts for security automation, including prompt engineering, incident summarization, and human-in-the-loop workflows #Cyber_Cyber Operate

Intro: Our team specializes in effective technology-enabled methodologies and providing leading practices for global trade programs that address both international and local requirements, as well as embed international trade controls into day-to-day business operations.Work You'll Do -: •As a developer specializing in ABAP for SAP HANA, you will be responsible for analyzing, designing, implementing, and deploying SAP solutions to meet specific business objectives.•Your role involves aligning S/4HANA technologies and associated tools and frameworks with the overall business strategy.•You will collaborate with onshore teams or directly with clients to ensure project alignment and success.•Part of your duties includes reviewing code written by other programmers to ensure quality and adherence to standards.•You will engage in requirement gathering to understand and document business needs.•Addressing and fixing bugs will be a critical part of your responsibilities to maintain system integrity.•You will conduct testing to ensure the solutions meet the required specifications and perform as expected.•Documenting and implementing software systems will be essential to ensure proper usage and maintenance of the solutions developed.•Align S/4HANA technologies and related tools with the business strategy.•Gather and document requirements to understand business needs.•Conduct thorough testing to verify that solutions meet specifications and perform correctly.The Team: The GTA practice is composed of operations specialists, Global Trade Management technology specialists, customs brokers, auditors, and trade management professionals who help importers and exporters achieve worldwide compliance and realize efficiencies and advantages in their global supply chain. You will be based in India and support Deloitte Tax to serve clients with international operations and supports their global trade compliance requirements.Location: Mumbai, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata, PuneShift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PMQualifications - title: USI FY27 | Cyber Operate- SOAR + Anthropic - Senior Consultant
description: Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design and technology as we partner with clients to transform their security posture. As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions. Work you'll do As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for: Serving as a primary point of contact for client stakeholders and supporting security automation strategy and value realization Designing, developing, and managing SOAR playbooks for triage, enrichment, investigation, containment, escalation, and remediation Leading integrations across security platforms, including security information and event management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), identity and access management (IAM), threat intelligence, ticketing, firewall, email, cloud, and endpoint security tools Building and optimizing AI-augmented SOAR workflows, including alert triage, contextual enrichment, incident summarization, escalation logic, and governed decisioning Defining automation metrics, dashboards, technical documentation, and workflow improvements to enhance reliability, scalability, and security operations maturity The team Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes managing the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security, business transformation, and ensuring continuous compliance. Services include Cyber-as-a-Service, Managed Application Security, and Managed Extended Detect & Respond (MXDR). Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai/Gurugram/Kolkata Shift Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST Qualifications Required: 6+ years of experience in cybersecurity, SOAR engineering, security automation, or security operations Experience with SOAR platforms such as Cortex XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, Swimlane, IBM Resilient, or Tines Experience with security operations center processes, security information and event management (SIEM) workflows, and incident response lifecycle activities Experience integrating application programming interfaces (APIs), webhooks, and third-party security technologies into automated workflows Experience with Python, PowerShell, Bash, JSON, REST APIs, or similar scripting and automation technologies Experience designing AI-augmented SOAR workflows that include large language model (LLM)-based reasoning, prompt engineering, output validation, and human-in-the-loop decisioning Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, Engineering, or Information Technology Preferred: Experience with multi-cloud security environments across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, detection engineering, and incident response practices Experience with information technology service management (ITSM) or case management tools such as ServiceNow or Jira Relevant certifications in cybersecurity, cloud security, or SOAR or SIEM platforms Experience with AI-assisted playbook generation, machine learning-based alert triage, or automated incident summarization in enterprise SOAR platforms Experience architecting Claude-based or equivalent agentic security operations center capabilities, including tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), extended reasoning, or structured outputs#Cyber_Cyber Operate

title: USI-EH27-Tax-Belgium-Accounting & Reporting-L45 - Senior-Hyderabad
description: Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“Deloitte Tax in India”) commenced operations in June 2004. All Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) US service lines have Deloitte Tax in India professionals aligned with US counterparts to deliver tax services to clients. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, United Kingdom) taxation practice, a popular career option. We are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment. Work you'll do As a Senior, Tax Services on the Belgium Accounting & Tax Reporting team, you will be responsible for supporting client accounting, reporting, and compliance activities in a fast-changing regulatory environment. Manage a portfolio of clients and support financial administration activities. Review journal entries and analyze accounting data to support accuracy and compliance. Maintain and reconcile general ledger accounts on a periodic basis. Lead month-end and year-end close activities, including preparation and finalization of annual accounts. Prepare and review financial statements and corporate income tax computations. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve accounting discrepancies and improve processes. The team Our multidisciplinary team in Belgium supports Small & Medium Enterprises (SME) clients with their day-to-day business, accounting, and tax reporting needs. As part of an integrated, multidisciplinary model, we work closely with our Belgium colleagues to deliver high-quality support that goes beyond compliance and creates tangible value for the client’s business. With deliverables closely aligned to client priorities, our work often contributes to meaningful business decisions and outcomes. Join our team and you will learn about financial processes and how to apply them in practice, develop your task management and technical skills. Location: Hyderabad Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM Qualifications Required: 4+ years of experience in Record to Report (R2R) processes, preferably supporting SME client. Strong experience in general ledger accounting, journal entry review and analysis, and month-end and year-end closing activities. Understanding of how financial reporting drives business insights and supports better decision-making. Experience with Belgian accounting and reporting requirements is preferred, but not mandatory. Exposure to Luxembourg GAAP or French GAAP is preferred, but not mandatory. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail and a critical mindset for self-review. Ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt to change, and work effectively in a dynamic environment. Good communication and stakeholder management skills. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in economics, accountancy, or another finance-related discipline. Fluency in English; French and Dutch language skills are optional but beneficial.

title: USI-EH27-Consulting Services-FT-FinOps-SCON-Implementation Specialist
description: Finance Operate – Implementation Specialist – Senior Consultant Role Description Join our rapidly growing team as an Implementation Senior Consultant focused on deploying proprietary software products for clients in the Financial Services industry, including Banking and Investment Management. In this role, you will work directly with clients and internal teams to deliver technology solutions that streamline operations, enhance analytics, and support complex financial processes. You will play a key part in requirements gathering, system configuration, and the successful adoption of our software platforms, helping clients transform their business through technology. Work you’ll do As a Senior Consultant, you will work on client teams supporting our technology platforms - including onboarding new client implementations, performing data analytics, and expanding existing business features and functionality to meet client needs. You will be working with other analysts and developers to identify and address technical and non-technical issues. Key Responsibilities: • Helping clients streamline operations, automate tasks, and improve processes in their finance, accounting, portfolio monitoring and operations functions • Conduct data analysis and implement client financial models leveraging industry leading and Deloitte proprietary technology. • Facilitating use of technology-based tools or methodologies to review, design and/or implement products and services • Gathering and analyzing client requirements, and configuring products and implementation to meet those requirements • Conducting User Acceptance Testing of system enhancements and new applications, including initial root cause analysis of failures • Preparing and presenting complex written and verbal materials such as reports, findings, and systems training • The desired candidate is a team player who is passionate about learning and working with technology, finance, and alternative investments. The candidate will be detail oriented, possess strong listening, verbal/written communication skills, and able to collaborate well with others. Qualifications: • Bachelor's (or higher) degree in Accounting, Finance, Management Information Systems, or related field (or foreign equivalent) • A minimum of 5-8 years of experience in the banking, investment management or financial services marketplace • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (proficiency with Lookups, Pivot Tables, and Array operations at a minimum) and other data analysis tools • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills • Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment Preferred Skills • Experience in Fund Finance (Subscription, NAV and Hybrid facilities) and/or Asset Backed Finance is preferred • Understanding of database systems and financial technologies • Understanding of alternative investment vehicles • Experience improving business processes and modeling/translate financial concepts • SQL, and/or Oracle and additional knowledge of other programming languages (e.g. Python or R) is a plus

description: Mergers & Acquisitions - ConsultantMergers & Acquisitions (M&A) as the name suggests is intriguing and complex.
