used for financial due diligence engagements:·       Analyze financial data from statements, trial balances, and supporting schedules for accuracy and insight·       Prepare and organize Excel databooks, including charts and graphs, from both hard copy and online data sources·       Review due diligence reports for inconsistencies within the reports and against financial workbooks·       Support Deloitte teams before deals by conducting company profiling, identifying potential buyers, and tracking industry events·       Identify unusual financial trends or variances and develop targeted questions for management insight·       Collect, validate, and consolidate data to strengthen financial analysis and reporting·       Contribute to detailed due diligence reports to support robust deal analysis·       Coordinate communications with clients and collaborate with onshore US teams for seamless project execution·       Enhance reporting and insights through expert use of analytics and data visualization tools (Alteryx, Tableau)The teamMergers & Acquisitions Transaction Services team provides support for Financial due diligence (‘FDD’) services to the Client, both sustainable cash flows, highlighting the value and risks of a transaction, and identifying issues for reflection in SPA and completion accounts.Required:·       CA/CPA/MBA Regular (Finance) with 2 to 3 years’ relevant experience in financial analysis and interpretation preferably with experience of working in M&A transactions·       Having basic to advanced knowledge of MS Excel, with basic knowledge of preparing templates, graphs, charts, etc., from information provided in hard copies and downloaded from data sites ·       Have an eye for detail ·       Analyze financial data sourced from financial statements and supporting schedules ·       Be able to add industry specific key performance indicators (KPI’s) ·       Reconcile databook with source information, before sending to the onsite team ·       Be able to do basic secondary research to understand the target better ·       Work within the set timelines and communicate deviations/updates to Project Lead and/or Onsite users ·       Willingness to help other team members once own work is completed.

title: USI - EH27 - L45 - Senior, Tax Services-Global Trade Service (GTS) - Technical
description: Do you have a passion to support Deloitte Tax in helping global clients transform their Global Trade solution? Are you a team player with a practical, business-oriented mindset? Do you enjoy working in an ever-changing global environment with fast-moving markets and evolving business models? If the answer to all the above is “Yes,” come join us in the International Tax group.We are a recognized leader in solving some of the complex business problems for our clients, differentiated by our ability to execute on the insights we provide. Our multi-disciplinary competencies allow us to address CXO issues from several angles.Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through USI Tax practice. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a sought-after career option.Deloitte Tax is leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace by offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to their clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.Work You'll Do - Intro: Our team specializes in effective technology-enabled methodologies and providing leading practices for global trade programs that address both international and local requirements, as well as embed international trade controls into day-to-day business operations.Work You'll Do -: • Collaborate with clients and stakeholders to gather and document detailed business requirements for GTS projects. • In your role, you will lead and/or facilitate business process definition and modeling. • Translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications for development and configuration. • Coordinate with project teams, clients, and stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of project milestones. • Identify opportunities for process improvements and automation within SAP GTS solutions. • You will guide a team to implement and configure the software to replicate the required business processes and analytical/reporting needs. • Develop training materials and conduct training sessions for end-users and client teams. • Ensure that SAP GTS solutions comply with relevant regulations, standards, and organizational policies. • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including development, infrastructure, and business teams, to ensure seamless service delivery and support. • You will contribute to the development and growth of the SAP GTS practice globally.The Team: The GTA practice is composed of operations specialists, Global Trade Management technology specialists, customs brokers, auditors, and trade management professionals who help importers and exporters achieve worldwide compliance and realize efficiencies and advantages in their global supply chain. You will be based in India and support Deloitte Tax to serve clients with international operations and supports their global trade compliance requirements.Location: Mumbai, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata, PuneShift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PMQualifications - Required: • Bachelor / Master degree in relation to Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business or similar • Minimum 5 years of experience in SAP GTS project implementation, and thus have significant knowledge of the SAP GTS Solution, in one of the following domains: Compliance Management, Customs Management, Trade Preference • Good understanding of supply chain management processes • Ability to travel up to 0-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve • Experience in other SAP modules than SAP GTS is an asset • Technical knowledge (e.g. ABAP, SAP PI) is an asset • Good analytical and modeling skills • Team player with strong communication skills • Strong written and verbal communication in English • Ability to perform job responsibilities within a hybrid work model that requires professionals to co-locate in person 2-3 days per weekQualifications - Preferred: • Education with SAP focus (S/4 or ECC Sales and Distribution, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Material Master, Transportation Management) • Software aptitude in PowerPoint, MS Project, Access, Excel, and/or Visio • Experience presenting to clients or other decision makers • Knowledge of export regulations including ITAR/EAR • Demonstrated interest in international trade or international business • Strong research, writing, verbal communication, and project management skills • Ability to bring out-of-the-box solution design aligned to leading practices and differentiated business outcome • Understanding of end-to-end processes and attention to detailed design • Strong team and organizational skills, ability to self-manage time and tasks • Ability to manage client and cross functional team expectations#TAXGTS

title: USI-EH27-Consulting-AI&E-HCI-Lead Cloud Integrated Infrastructure Engineer II-Physical & Spatial AI Architect
description: Artificial Intelligence & EngineeringAI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.  Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.Level: Lead Cloud Integrated Infrastructure Engineer II As a Lead Cloud Integrated Infrastructure Engineer II at Deloitte Consulting, you will help clients apply physical AI and spatial technologies to operational environments such as data centers, sports venues, and consumer or retail settings. You will translate business and operational needs into scalable architecture, platform, and transformation solutions across NVIDIA, Google Cloud Platform, and Amazon Web Services ecosystems. This role combines client-facing solution design, delivery leadership, and hands-on technical direction across the project lifecycle. You will also support proposal efforts, guide multidisciplinary teams, and help deliver measurable outcomes for complex transformation programs.Work you'll doAs a Lead Cloud Integrated Infrastructure Engineer II on the Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for… Leading end-to-end physical AI delivery, from synthetic data generation and simulation-based policy training through hardware commissioning and production deployment. Partnering with sales and customer success teams to scope engagements, lead technical discovery workshops, and develop reference architectures and proof-of-concept deliverables. Driving platform selection decisions across simulation, perception, robot orchestration, and edge compute, including documenting trade-offs and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders. Connecting spatial engineering and physical AI engineering efforts to align simulation outputs, autonomy development, and deployed system performance. Building reusable architecture patterns, blueprints, and best practices across NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac, Metropolis, and partner ecosystems. The teamDeloitte’s AI & Engineering practice helps clients build, deploy, and operate integrated solutions across software, data, artificial intelligence, networks, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. Within Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, the team delivers solutions spanning hybrid cloud, advanced connectivity, AI data centers, high-performance computing, and AI infrastructure to help clients achieve targeted business outcomes. The practice focuses on resiliency, optimization, automation, and operational performance across infrastructure platforms and field operations. Team members work across engineering, connectivity, and AI-enabled infrastructure to support real-time processing and critical operational technology environments.Location: Hyderabad/BengaluruShift Timings: As per Business RequirementsQualificationsRequired: 8-12+ years of experience in consulting, industry, or a combination of both. Experience aligned to NVIDIA and/or Google Cloud Platform or Amazon Web Services ecosystems for physical AI and spatial AI, including technologies such as Omniverse, Cosmos, Isaac, Metropolis, Jetson, Orin, NeMo, Groot, Google Distributed Cloud Edge, Anthos, Vertex AI, TensorFlow, Immersive Stream, Earth Engine, Gemini, Agent Builder, Amazon Outposts, Elastic Kubernetes Service, SageMaker, AppStream, and Bedrock. Experience leading end-to-end physical AI delivery, including simulation-based training, synthetic data generation, hardware integration, and production deployment on robot platforms. Experience with NeRFStudio and 3D Gaussian Splatting, including capture and processing of real-world scans and maintenance of Universal Scene Description export pipelines in Nucleus. Experience architecting and training 3D perception models, including point-cloud networks, spatial transformers, and implicit neural representations. Experience with motion planning tools such as MoveIt 2, CuRobo, and Isaac Manipulator. Experience with simultaneous localization and mapping tools such as ORB-SLAM3, LIO-SAM, or RTAB-Map. Preferred: Consulting experience in client-facing strategy, architecture, or transformation delivery roles. Experience in data center, sports venue, consumer, or retail environments. Experience with hardware calibration, including intrinsic and extrinsic camera calibration, LiDAR-camera extrinsic estimation, and sensor noise characterization. Experience with hand-eye calibration, including calibration rig setup, integration into ROS 2 TF trees, and end-effector accuracy validation. Experience with sim-to-real transfer methods, including fidelity gap metrics, distribution shift analysis, domain randomization, and transfer learning. Experience optimizing edge inference for 3D perception using TensorRT, INT8 or FP16 quantization, and CUDA kernels on Jetson hardware.#FY27ReferralCampaign#AIE2027 #HIE2027_AI

title: USI - EH27 - Tax - GESTC - .Net API Integration + Gen AI - L25 - BTA - Hyderabad
description: Design and develop scalable, high-quality, and high-performance integrations using Microsoft and AWS native technology. You will work with a team of analysts, developers, and tax consultants to build high performing user-friendly systems & applications. The incumbent needs to have a high level of attention to detail, ability to execute and deliver high quality project deliverables on budget and on time, and multi-task in a dynamic environment. Incumbent should be able to function effectively in a team environment. You will also be responsible for certain delegation activities and help the team with day to day workload. Work you'll do As a Tax Consultant II on the Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC) team, you will be responsible for: Designing, developing, and debugging applications in C# .NET and integration solutions Writing SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and other SQL scripts for data extraction and manipulation Creating Boomi processes for application programming interfaces (APIs), data exchange automation, and system integrations Developing and supporting API endpoints using tools such as Visual Studio or Boomi Following project and coding standards, implementing process improvements, and escalating complex issues as needed The team Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“Deloitte Tax in India”) commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines and regions have obtained support services through Deloitte Tax in India. We provide support through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment. We provide opportunities to transform tax operations using contemporary technologies in the market. Individuals work to transform their current state of tax to the next generation of tax functions. Are you ready to take the next step in your career to find new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations using new technologies? If the answer is “Yes,” come join Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC). title: USI-EH27-Consulting-Customer-Digital Foundry-GCP GKE-Senior Consultant, Managed Services
description: #DFO&I2027Customer The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence. Position Summary Level: Senior Consultant As an experienced Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements. Work you’ll do: Lead the development lifecycle, from planning and design to implementation, testing, and deployment. Design and operate GKE clusters (Standard and Autopilot) supporting multi-tenant client workloads. Implement workload isolation, namespace strategies, network policies, and quota / priority class governance. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and GitOps flows (ArgoCD, Flux). Develop and maintain Helm charts, Kustomize overlays, and Terraform infrastructure-as-code. Configure GKE networking: VPC-native clusters, private clusters, ingress/egress controls, Cloud Load Balancing, Anthos Service Mesh or Istio. Implement security best practices: Workload Identity, Binary Authorization, Policy Controller, secret management (Cloud KMS, Secret Manager, External Secrets), CIS benchmarks. Stand up observability: Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Cloud Trace, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana. Drive FinOps on GKE — right-sizing, Autopilot vs Standard trade-offs, spot/preemptible workloads, Kubecost or native cost reporting. Participate in on-call rotation, incident response, RCA, and capacity planning. The team: Our Digital Foundry Operate & Innovations (DFO&I) team partners with organizations to rapidly design, build, and scale digital products and experiences that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, and operations specialists, we deliver end-to-end solutions - from initial concept and agile development to ongoing digital operations - enabling clients to experiment, iterate, and scale digital initiatives with confidence and agility. We support clients across domains such as strategy, commerce, marketing, sales, and service, helping them realize their digital ambitions through flexible, scalable teams. Our expertise spans the full digital lifecycle, including customer research, experience design, platform development, content production, and marketing automation. By bridging the gap between strategy and execution, we empower organizations to achieve measurable outcomes and deliver exceptional customer experiences in an ever-evolving digital landscape. Qualifications Must Have Skills / Project Experience / Certifications: 6+ years of hands-on experience. 6+ years operating Kubernetes in production; 4+ years specifically on GKE. Strong Linux, container, and networking fundamentals (Docker, OCI, CNI). Production experience with Terraform and Helm; proficiency in Go, Python, or Bash. Hands-on with GitOps tooling — ArgoCD or Flux. Solid grasp of GCP IAM, Workload Identity, Cloud KMS, VPC networking. CI/CD pipelines and progressive delivery patterns (canary, blue/green, feature flags). Observability stacks: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Cloud Operations suite. GCP Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, CKA, or CKAD certification preferred. Good to have Skills / Project Experience / Certifications: Anthos / Anthos Service Mesh experience. Service mesh fluency: Istio, Cilium, Linkerd. FinOps on Kubernetes (Kubecost, GKE cost allocation, sustained-use and committed-use discounts). Experience running ML / AI workloads on GKE (training, model serving, GPU / TPU node pools, KServe, Ray). Multi-cloud or hybrid Kubernetes exposure. Prior Operate / managed services delivery experience Education: BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

title: USI-EH27-G&P-USI Digital- L25 - Services Associate, Integration and Development - Hyderabad
description: Do you thrive on developing creative and innovative insights to solve complex challenges? Want to work on next-generation, cutting-edge products and services that deliver outstanding value and that are global in vision and scope? If yes, we need your expertise!Work you'll do As a Services Associate, Integration and Development on the USI Digital team, you will be responsible for delivering business solutions to internal stakeholders through helpdesk tickets, mini-implementation projects, and initiatives aimed at enhancing productivity and innovation. Manage helpdesk tickets and deliver resolutions aligned with quality standards and service level agreements. Create reports in Adobe Workfront based on stakeholder requirements and customize the Workfront instance, including custom forms, layout templates, access levels, and user management. Support implementation activities by managing project tasks, documenting meeting notes, setting up project plans in Workfront, and collaborating with team members. Plan and conduct training sessions on tool navigation and respond to stakeholder questions through tickets and meetings. Perform data governance activities, collaborate with teams within USI Digital and CMG in a consultative role, and support team workload during high-volume periods.The team About USI Digital team USI Digital team offers innovative solutions that enable CMG to execute with agility, drive closed-looped marketing, and achieve operational excellence by optimizing data, tools, people, and processes. Partners with various CMG channels to deliver data-driven insights in the form of dashboards and reports that help make informed decisions. Provides end-to-end support around database management, reporting, and maintenance activities. Proactively identifies opportunities for automation and reporting.Location: Hyderabad Shift Timings: 2 PM to 11 PM Qualifications Required: 1-3 years of experience working in Adobe Workfront. Bachelor of Technology or Bachelor of Engineering. Experience creating reports in Adobe Workfront based on stakeholder requirements. Experience customizing Adobe Workfront, including custom forms, layout templates, access levels, and user management. Experience translating business requirements into technical requirements. Experience working in Agile methodologies. Preferred: MBA. Experience managing helpdesk tickets aligned with quality standards and service level agreements. Experience planning and conducting tool training sessions. Experience supporting implementation projects in Adobe Workfront. Experience working with internal stakeholders across cross-functional teams.How you’ll growAt Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities— including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in exactly the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team-based learning, and eLearning. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state-of-the-art, world class learning Center in the Hyderabad offices is an extension of the Deloitte University (DU) in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in IndiaBenefitsAt Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you. Deloitte’s cultureOur positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer well-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives.  Learn more about Life at Deloitte.Corporate citizenshipDeloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people and our communities.  We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities.  Learn more about Deloitte’s impact on the world.

title: USI-EH27-Consulting-Customer-Digital Foundry-Veeva CRM-Consultant, Managed Services
description: #DFO&I2027 Customer The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence. Position Summary Level: Consultant, Managed ServicesA skilled Veeva CRM Consultant with experience in designing, configuring, and supporting Veeva CRM solutions for life sciences organizations. The candidate should have strong knowledge of Veeva CRM, Salesforce platform fundamentals, pharmaceutical commercial processes, and stakeholder management. This role will support business teams in improving CRM effectiveness, sales operations, and customer engagement capabilities. Work you’ll do: Gather and analyse business requirements related to Veeva CRM processes Configure and support Veeva CRM functionalities including call reporting, account management, territory alignment, and CLM Work with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions Support integrations between Veeva CRM and upstream/downstream systems Participate in defect resolution, testing, deployment, and post-production support Prepare functional specifications, process documentation, and training materials Ensure solutions align with life sciences compliance and regulatory requirements Support enhancements, releases, and continuous improvement initiatives The team:Our Digital Foundry Operate & Innovations (DFO&I) team partners with organizations to rapidly design, build, and scale digital products and experiences that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, and operations specialists, we deliver end-to-end solutions—from initial concept and agile development to ongoing digital operations—enabling clients to experiment, iterate, and scale digital initiatives with confidence and agility. We support clients across domains such as strategy, commerce, marketing, sales, and service, helping them realize their digital ambitions through flexible, scalable teams. Our expertise spans the full digital lifecycle, including customer research, experience design, platform development, content production, and marketing automation. By bridging the gap between strategy and execution, we empower organizations to achieve measurable outcomes and deliver exceptional customer experiences in an ever-evolving digital landscape. Qualifications Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: Hands-on experience with Veeva CRM platform administration covering: MyInsights dashboard configuration and KPI design. CLM (Closed Loop Marketing) content deployment and management. Approved Email configuration and template management. Sample management, order management, and field inventory workflows. Veeva CRM Events Management — event creation, approval, and lifecycle management. Advanced knowledge of commercial Life Sciences business processes and the ability to translate them into scalable Veeva CRM solutions, including field force effectiveness, territory management, HCP/HCO engagement tracking, and multi-channel commercial operations Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: Experience in life sciences/pharmaceutical domain Exposure to Veeva Vault or related Veeva ecosystem tools Knowledge of integrations, data migration, and release management Experience working in Agile delivery environments Veeva CRM certification Salesforce certification Experience with commercial operations or field force enablement initiatives Education:Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Business, or related fieldLocation: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

description: Join Deloitte Tax in India’s Global Employer Services (GES) – Process Technology Team as a Tax Consultant II supporting tax technology transformation. In this role, you will work with product engineering teams and business leaders to design and improve technology-enabled processes and products that enhance the digital experience for clients and customers. You will help shape modern generative AI solutions, support product design efforts, and contribute to scalable delivery aligned to evolving business needs.Work you'll doAs a Tax Consultant II on the Global Employer Services – Process Technology Team, you will be responsible for: Design and develop agentic AI and generative AI solutions with a strong focus on Python-based engineering and modern implementation patterns Partner with developers, project managers, and business stakeholders to build persona-based experiences and workflows aligned to business outcomes Define adoption goals, track usage and impact metrics, and refine solutions based on feedback to improve operational efficiency Maintain technical documentation, including architecture materials, prompts or agents, evaluation results, and runbooks, while providing status updates across concurrent projects Collaborate with stakeholders and GES leadership to prioritize the GenAI roadmap, manage trade-offs, and support delivery against business objectives The teamDeloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“Deloitte Tax in India”) commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines and regions have obtained support services through Deloitte Tax in India.We provide support through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.We provide opportunities to transform tax operations using contemporary/niche technologies in the market. Individuals work to transform their current state of tax to the next generation of tax functions. Are you ready to take the next step in your career to find new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations using new technologies? If the answer is “Yes,” come join Global Employer Services – Process Technology Team!Location: HyderabadShift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PMQualificationsRequired: 3-6 years of experience in Python software engineering, including application programming interfaces, testing, and packaging Experience building large language model applications using agent frameworks, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector stores, guardrails, or evaluations Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise systems using application programming interfaces and secure implementation patterns Experience defining and tracking usage, cycle-time, accuracy, or quality metrics for digital or AI solutions Experience preparing technical documentation, including architecture materials, evaluation results, or runbooks Bachelor of Engineering or Bachelor of Technology Preferred: Experience with GenAI-based document processing or optical character recognition workflows, such as Azure Document Intelligence Experience operationalizing AI applications, including monitoring, prompt or agent regression testing, and human-in-the-loop review Experience applying data privacy or security considerations to enterprise GenAI implementations Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Analytics, or Engineering, or industry-recognized professional certification.#CA-GSD #CA-HPN

description: Engineering LeaderRole Overview: As a Engineering Leader, you will help shape and communicate a strategic vision for modern software engineering. You will provide hands-on leadership across multiple high-impact products, ensuring our solutions are innovative, effective, and aligned with business goals.  You will contribute to and execute a forward-looking technology roadmap, driving simplification, scalability, and efficiency. Leveraging your deep expertise in software engineering—including application and data integration, modern frameworks, and diverse technologies—you will guide teams in delivering robust, high-quality solutions.  As a role model and mentor, you will foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and collaboration. Your ability to inspire and develop engineering talent, while partnering with cross-functional teams, will be essential to our ongoing success and the value we deliver to Deloitte’s business.Key Responsibilities:Strategic Vision and Alignment: Contribute to defining, communicating, and continuously refining a compelling engineering vision that translates business objectives into actionable strategies. Ensure engineering teams are aligned and engaged, collaborating closely with product, experience, delivery, infrastructure, and security teams. Leverage technical artifacts and feedback loops to illustrate and evolve the vision.Advocacy and Technology Roadmap: Champion the integrated engineering strategy and technology roadmap, ensuring organizational awareness of objectives, KPIs, maturity, and compliance. Promote a culture of reuse, quality, and speed to maximize outcomes. Actively engage and energize teams around the engineering vision and its alignment with business and technology goals.Craft Mastery and Objectives Realization: Drive achievement of engineering KPIs, including system performance, scalability, security, and maintainability. Maintain and evolve engineering dashboards (planning, code quality, CI/CD, performance, security, operations). Contribute hands-on to design and code, mentor engineers, and resolve technical challenges. Inspire teams to adopt new technologies and best practices, fostering a passion for engineering excellence.Capability Evolution and Development: Being an engineering expert, mentor and develop full-stack engineering talent in modern practices such as frontend, microservices, cloud-native design, AI/ML/GenAI, data engineering, DevSecOps, and advanced deployment techniques like, Blue-Green, Canary to minimize down-time, enabling A/B testing approaches. Lead by example through thought leadership—speaking at conferences, publishing, R&D, or collaborating with academia. Cultivate a growth mindset and modern engineering behaviors across the team.Iterative Value Delivery: Embrace an iterative and incremental product development, favoring action, prioritizing rapid learning, and adaptation over extensive upfront planning. Apply leaning-forward approach and empirical methods to navigate complexity, ensuring each iteration delivers value and aligns with customer and business needs.Customer-Centric Problem Solving: Maintain a relentless focus on solving the most critical customer challenges. Align technical solutions with business outcomes, minimize unnecessary complexity, and drive teams toward high performance through continuous learning and collaborative execution.Tech/Quality Risk Management: Establish and evolve engineering standards, coding practices, and quality benchmarks to ensure robust, secure, and scalable solutions. Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks, ensuring operational excellence and resilience.Influential Communication: Influence, persuade, and drive decision-making processes. Communicate effectively in both written and verbal forms. Craft clear, structured arguments and technical trade-offs, supported by evidence.Organizational Engagement and Collaboration: Engage stakeholders at all levels of the organization, from team members to middle management to executives. Build collaborative and constructive relationships, co-creating and driving momentum and value across multiple organizational levels.The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.Key Qualifications:A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline. title: USI-EH27-Consulting-AI&E-HCI-Cloud Integrated Infrastructure Engineer II-Physical & Spatial AI
description: Artificial Intelligence & EngineeringAI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.  Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.Level: - Cloud Integrated Infrastructure Engineer IIAs a Cloud Integrated Infrastructure Engineer II at Deloitte Consulting, you should have a strong product implementation mindset and hands-on experience helping clients apply digital twin and spatial technologies to real-world operational environments. The ideal candidate has worked across OT-heavy environments such as data centers, sports venues, and consumer/retail operations, and can help translate business and operational needs into scalable architecture, platform, and transformation solutions. Client experience aligned to NVIDIA and/or Google Cloud Platform/ AWS stacks, with exposure to either OT transformation design or hands-on technical solution architecture is ideal. You will work within multidisciplinary, global teams and support junior practitioners while working directly with clients and internal stakeholders to help translate business goals into technically grounded solution approaches. You will support sales and proposal efforts and contribute to day-to-day delivery across the project lifecycle – work planning, scoping, estimation support, and status reporting – to drive successful outcomes.Work you’ll do: As a Senior Consultant/ Consultant at Deloitte, you are expected to bring solid hands-on expertise in Physical and Spatial AI, support the definition of business or technology architecture, contribute to delivery planning for large-scale projects, help with solution design and implementation, track team progress, and ensure quality of your work products. The role also includes mentoring junior team members, sales support, and contribution to market eminence. You will participate in discussions with business and functional analysts to understand requirements and assess integration impacts on business architecture. Support the preparation of technical architecture and design, clarify requirements, and help resolve ambiguities. Develop solutions in line with established technical designs, integration standards, and quality processes. Apply and help maintain technical design and development guides, templates, and standards. Facilitate daily scrum meetings, track deliverables, and prepare weekly status reports for leadership review. Support detailed deliverable reviews and provide technical guidance to junior team members. Collaborate with onsite clients, coordinators, analysts, and cross-functional teams. Support clients on leading practices in digital twin, spatial AI, OT modernization, edge-to-cloud integration, and physical environment transformation Help translate business and operational priorities into transformation roadmaps and technical strategies Help guide clients on platform choices and ecosystem decisions aligned to NVIDIA and/or GCP-based architectures including the role of edge, data, AI, and simulation platforms in enterprise transformation Contribute to architecting client solutions focused on digital twins, spatial intelligence, simulation, and OT transformation Help clients define future-state capability stacks aligned to NVIDIA and GCP/AWS ecosystems, including edge compute, AI model services, simulation platforms, vision services, data platforms, and enterprise integration layers Support the definition of technical architectures for environments requiring coordination across sensing, telemetry, OT systems, edge infrastructure, AI/ML services, spatial context, and enterprise applications ·       Implement integration of physical/spatial AI capabilities into operational workflows, including OT systems, IoT platforms, facilities systems, robotics-related ecosystems, and enterprise platforms·       Contribute to differentiated points of view, offerings, demos, and proposal content that position Deloitte as a preferred transformation partner·       Support the development of Deloitte’s market-facing capabilities focused on digital twins, OT transformation, and spatial/physical AI use cases across priority sectors The team:  At Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, we deliver solutions spanning Hybrid Cloud, Advanced Connectivity, AI Data Centers, High-Performance Computing, and AI Infrastructure to help clients achieve their desired outcomes. Our offerings include engineered transformation services for hybrid cloud infrastructure and platforms, prioritizing resiliency, optimization, and extensive automation. We integrate Advanced Connectivity, with AI Infrastructure and AI to boost operational efficiency and enable real-time data processing, crucial for critical low-latency enterprise operational technology (OT) applications. Additionally, we provide comprehensive management of all facets of operations for hybrid cloud infrastructure and field operations.Location: Hyderabad/BengaluruShift Timings: As per Business RequirementQualificationsRequired: 3-8 years of relevant experience in consulting, industry, or a combination of both Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Nucleus and Isaac Replicator for programmatic synthetic data generation at scale. Solid understanding of 3D perception models – point-cloud networks, depth models, spatial transformers and their role in embodied AI pipelines. Proficiency in USD scene composition layers, references, variants and architecting digital twin scenes with live telemetry integration. Experience evaluating, finetuning and integrating VLA foundation models (OpenVLA-OFT, GR00T, RDT-1B) benchmarking policies on structured task suites in simulation. Ability to author Omniverse Kit extensions in Python/C++ for custom sensors, simulation behaviors, or non-standard action spaces. Working knowledge of Isaac ROS 2 for sensor simulation, topic bridging, and integration with policy inference nodes. Familiarity with Cosmos / NVIDIA foundation models for world modelling and scene generation as part of the simulation stack. ·       BE/B. Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc. (CS)/ M. Tech degree or equivalent from accredited university   Preferred: Experience with 3D scene reconstruction techniques like NeRF, Gaussian Splatting, or photogrammetry – for enriching simulation asset libraries. Exposure to edge-optimized inference for 3D perception like TensorRT graph optimization, int8/fp16 quantisation, and custom CUDA kernels for point-cloud operations. Knowledge of sim-to-real transfer methodology – fidelity metrics, distribution shift analysis, dataset augmentation strategies, and transfer learning experiments. Understanding of motion planning and trajectory optimization for robotic manipulation –experience with planners such as MoveIt 2, MPPI, or CuRobo, and the ability to validate planned trajectories inside Isaac Sim before real-world execution. Exposure to imitation learning and behavior cloning pipelines – collecting and curating teleoperation demonstrations, training policies with ACT or Diffusion Policy, and assessing policy generalization on out-of-distribution spatial scenarios in sim. #FY27ReferralCampaign#AIE2027 #HIE2027_AI

title: USI-EH-FY27-Enabling Areas-GFS Data Management-Manager-Specialist Manager
description: Specialist Manager- Data Management - Deloitte Support Services India Private LimitedWe are looking for professionals with strong accounting skills, who are looking forward to making a career in the Finance field. This is a dynamic opportunity for a high-energy professionals to be part of the Finance team supporting Global businesses and member firmsWork you’ll doThe key job responsibilities include the following:Functional Expertise: • In the role of a catalyst, exemplify a comprehensive grasp of all accessible data related to clients, vendors, personnel, entities, and opportunities. Capacity to navigate and comprehend information to facilitate informed decision-making and strategic actions. By displaying an in-depth understanding of these datasets to address business challenges and harnessing opportunities across various dimensions • Possessing the ability to collect and document intricate client requirements offering proficient user support, play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between client expectations and operational execution. Adeptness in understanding complex to capture project specifications accurately, develop tailored solutions that align with client objectives, troubleshooting issues, providing guidance, and enhancing the overall user experience.• Comprehensive management of a team to support Member firms in effectively organizing and categorizing their information within Deloitte systems. This encompasses the cultivation of best practices and the propagation of consistent processes, collective knowledge and methodologies sharing, enhancing efficiency, collaboration, and alignment across various platforms through established standards and optimized workflows.     • Build a high-performing team through a strategic blend of periodic reviews, SMART goal sharing, and the formulation of tailored developmental plans. Eestablish clear performance benchmarks that drive motivation and accountability. • Actively foster an environment of ongoing improvement by motivating Cluster leads, AMs and DMs to consistently pinpoint opportunities for enhancement. Identify areas within their respective domains for refinement, proactive problem-solving, facilitate the evolution of practices and processes. • Implement overall group strategy to team level by formulating clear steps so firm wide goals and objectives are met.                                                                                                                         • Has proven success and 10+ years of experience in Entity Data Management processes and procedures that include managing Client Data Profiling effort like inspecting data for errors, inconsistencies, redundancies and incomplete information. • Has proven knowledge and 8+ years of experience in Data Quality Management/ Quality Control including Data Cleansing processes and procedures that include managing Client Data Profiling effort monitoring, and quality control cleansing capabilities aimed at improvement of the level of trust that leaders and practitioners have in the data. • Design and manage the implementation end-to-end Data updating techniques to validate and enhance Firm’s client master that involves finding, evaluating and integrating additional sources of information. • Has proven success using CDI methodologies to design, implement, and improve the Client Data Hub by managing efforts to intelligently match, merge and link information from various data source; to develop and maintain internal to external data point-to-point links;  to receive and process adds, deletes, and changes related to internal and external data sources and to propagate these changes through our Client Data Hub. • Has proven success in Client Segmentation techniques to classify and segment clients using the Market Refresh (Parent Client population, attributes, & hierarchy); improve parent client industry classification etc. • Expert knowledge on internal and external platforms and information sources (Eg: Salesforce, ServiceNow, MDM Informatica, D&B Hoovers, Compustat, EDGAR, MergerStat, etc.) • Has 8+ years of relevant experience in implementing advanced Data Architecture concepts that includes Implementing Change Data Capture (CDC) techniques; process for capturing master data across multiple time horizons; maintain the Firm’s dimensional hierarchies; to normalize and develop multi-dimensional data models. • Has 8+ years of relevant experience in using BPI methodologies (e.g., V-Model, DMAIC, Six-Sigma, Agile, Lean) to optimize utilization, increase throughput (workflow), and improve quality. • Make significant enhancements to existing complex data management, research and workflow methodologies. • Actively cultivate expertise across various domains, positioning yourself as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in multiple areas through comprehensive learning and exploration, gaining mastery over diverse subjects. Should be go-to resource for intricate queries, solutions, and informed guidance. • Assists in data management, governance, and data quality of master data requirements with other functional data owners to ensure functional master data integrity across multi-subject systems is consistent and meets stated business rules and requirements. • Experience in master data governance strategy, processes, and operations. Knowledge of master data management and governance leading practices (data governance, data modeling, data quality, data lineage, master data management, metadata management, data analytics etc.). • Establish new sub-processes for enhancement/improvement of the processes. • Proven business acumen, including ability to communicate across all levels of an organization, ability to work across cultures, and success in meeting organizational goals. • Designing and implementing ETL processes, facilitate the seamless integration of external data into a unified storage platform. This involves conceptualizing efficient workflows to extract data from various sources, transform it into a consistent format, and load it into a centralized repository. Project / Process Management: • Analyze a broad range business risks and suggest resolutions. • Act as Project Manager/ functional process team lead- Works on Large Engagements and multiple small Processes. • Manages/work on multiple Processes simultaneously, plan delivery and assess/raise risks • Responsible for Design, Development and Delivery of end-to-end project. • Provides design, integration, documentation and implementation related advice on complex problems that need extensive knowledge of the subject matter for effective implementation. • Manage delivery of business SLAs/project timelines and conduct regular audits of the current processes and quality • Establish new processes to manage ambiguity and streamline implementation • Guide Assistant Managers and Deputy Managers to lead metrics analysis and recommends opportunities for enhancements to product roadmap • Build relationships with stakeholders and partner on defining and designing next level of services • Accountable for delivery of the teams KPIs • Initiate (and/or drive) process improvisation changes to process(es) within specific domain area • Proactively look for improving the portfolio of the team by seeking new opportunities. • Drive knowledge sharing and documentation of best practices and lessons learnt from the projects. • Evaluate stakeholder/customer satisfaction and bring in process efficiencies • Serve as the point of escalation for aligned customers & stakeholders • Handle the entire product suite development cycle end to end, along with strategic input to the  product suite roadmap • Act as a trusted advisor on the technical implementations for Business stakeholders • Serve as the single point of contact for a suite of technical products, including responsibility for interoperability, interdependencies and cross application synergies for the product suite Business knowledge: • Lead a vertical of Deputy Managers/AMs as a lead for a group of knowledge sharing applications • Cultivate a profound mastery in one or multiple specialized domains, thus assuming role of a Subject Matter Expert (SME). As an SME, become a go-to resource for intricate queries, innovative solutions, and guidance. • Foster cross-training and mentor new team members on intricate data management, research, and workflow methodologies. • Self upskill on supplemental skills for research and workflow methodologies through e-room, publications, etc. • Manage end-to-end processes including the collaborating with key stakeholders and responding to data inquiries. • Recognize and document when process produces unexpected results and create and own process documentation and training materials. • Recognize and document QA processes including research and documentation of complex data change requests. • Decision making and impact: Take decisions independently, demonstrate executive presence and have a strong hold on the team • Keep the team motivated by encouraging teaming and best practice sharing • Understand the bigger picture and share alignment with strategic priorities with the team members. Break down complex strategy into small action-oriented tasks • Have in depth understanding of the process roadmap priorities, ensure that the DMs have the same level of understanding and should be able to clarify any questions/concerns that they have independently • Collaborate with the leads across business ecosystem and relevant technology leads, to operate as one team • Encourage leads to continuously identify opportunities for improvement and initiatives to improve overall service standards • Innovation, Creativity and problem solving : Collaborate with EMs and above and contribute to innovation and strategic assignments. Define the overall approach to work for DMs and independently handle all the queries that they have • Support leadership with designing business decks/presentations, standardize process documents etc. • Drive and encourage strategic thinking in the team to generate innovative ideas as part of proposed solutions • Proactively identify training requirements, build training plans and conduct trainings for the team. • Lead change & provide guidance to the project teams during change/ambiguity • Recruit, mentor, and administratively manage teams, including performance assessment. • Mentor and coach the team members, have career conversations with team members and recognize them to keep them motivated • Handle the entire cycle of performance management - regular coaching sessions, due diligence, performance metrics and reviews, presentation of performance reviews and ability to influence stakeholders • Take the initiative to define business processes with the aim of eliminating ambiguity and optimizing implementation procedures involving a meticulous examination of existing workflows, identification of potential bottlenecks or unclear steps, and the formulation of clear, well-structured processes. • Complexity and independent judgement - Able to drive things independently. Also should be able to handle highly complex issues and processes with ability to make their own judgement based on the data available • Take a proactive role in steering master data management Processes by spearheading the identification of project requirements, delineating their scope, and executing strategic plans. This responsibility entails a comprehensive understanding of the project's objectives and the intricacies of the data involved. • Cultivate stakeholder relationships to manage expectations and enrich/enhance the depth and value of service. • Demonstrate the ability to anticipate client needs by proactively identifying their requirements and offering customized solutions with a perceptive understanding of clients' goals, challenges, and preferences. • Guide and support Assistant Managers and Deputy Manager to lead metrics analysis and recommends opportunities for Global Program Efficacy. Firm / Industry knowledge: • Demonstrate deep understanding of Deloitte’s businesses, industries and trends in business domain. • Work with senior leaders in business and resource planning, recruiting strategy, process development and implementation, broader team wide change management projects / initiatives • Demonstrate strong understanding of firm policies and risk management elements • Demonstrate understanding of evolution of knowledge sharing processes, including history and current trends in the professional services space. Also, keep track of general technology/automation advancements, with an outlook to implement within the technology spectrum Relationship Management: • Leadership and autonomy - Understand the objective of the projects and overall business approach and should be able to independently give guidance to others. Should be able to run the show on their own and should take decisions even in ambiguous situations • Maintain strong relationships and conduct regular meetings with key global stakeholders and counterparts to understand expectations & match delivery • Act as trusted independent advisor for the aligned team • Coordinate and maintain internal and external communication with all stakeholders.Work Location: HyderabadShift Timings: 2 PM to 11 PMThe teamUSI supporting GFS will provide world-class Finance services to Deloitte’s Member Firms using the latest generation SAP technology supported by a team of highly skilled and engaged professionals. Through a common Finance infrastructure and system platform, the team will enable Member Firms to share leading practices across the network. This team began serving the founding member firms in 2018, and additional Member Firms will enter the program in 2020.Qualifications and experience required:Master’s degree in Computer Information, and Business Administration or related field; Minimum of 11-14 years of relevant work experience.  Minimum 9+ years of work experience in data management role

title: USI-EH27-Consulting-Customer-Digital Foundry-GCP GKE-Consultant, Managed Services
description: #DFO&I2027Customer The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence. Position Summary Level: Consultant, Managed Services As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements. Work you’ll do: Design and operate GKE clusters (Standard and Autopilot) supporting multi-tenant client workloads. Implement workload isolation, namespace strategies, network policies, and quota / priority class governance. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and GitOps flows (ArgoCD, Flux). Develop and maintain Helm charts, Kustomize overlays, and Terraform infrastructure-as-code. Configure GKE networking: VPC-native clusters, private clusters, ingress/egress controls, Cloud Load Balancing, Anthos Service Mesh or Istio. Implement security best practices: Workload Identity, Binary Authorization, Policy Controller, secret management (Cloud KMS, Secret Manager, External Secrets), CIS benchmarks. Stand up observability: Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Cloud Trace, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana. Drive FinOps on GKE — right-sizing, Autopilot vs Standard trade-offs, spot/preemptible workloads, Kubecost or native cost reporting. Participate in on-call rotation, incident response, RCA, and capacity planning. The Team: Our Digital Foundry Operate & Innovations (DFO&I) team partners with organizations to rapidly design, build, and scale digital products and experiences that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, and operations specialists, we deliver end-to-end solutions - from initial concept and agile development to ongoing digital operations - enabling clients to experiment, iterate, and scale digital initiatives with confidence and agility. We support clients across domains such as strategy, commerce, marketing, sales, and service, helping them realize their digital ambitions through flexible, scalable teams. Our expertise spans the full digital lifecycle, including customer research, experience design, platform development, content production, and marketing automation. By bridging the gap between strategy and execution, we empower organizations to achieve measurable outcomes and deliver exceptional customer experiences in an ever-evolving digital landscape. Qualifications Must Have Skills / Project Experience / Certifications: 3 - 6 years of hands-on experience. 4+ years operating Kubernetes in production; 2+ years specifically on GKE. Strong Linux, container, and networking fundamentals (Docker, OCI, CNI). Production experience with Terraform and Helm; proficiency in Go, Python, or Bash. Hands-on with GitOps tooling — ArgoCD or Flux. Solid grasp of GCP IAM, Workload Identity, Cloud KMS, VPC networking. CI/CD pipelines and progressive delivery patterns (canary, blue/green, feature flags). Observability stacks: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Cloud Operations suite. GCP Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, CKA, or CKAD certification preferred. Good to have Skills / Project Experience / Certifications: Anthos / Anthos Service Mesh experience. Service mesh fluency: Istio, Cilium, Linkerd. FinOps on Kubernetes (Kubecost, GKE cost allocation, sustained-use and committed-use discounts). Experience running ML / AI workloads on GKE (training, model serving, GPU / TPU node pools, KServe, Ray). Multi-cloud or hybrid Kubernetes exposure. Prior Operate / managed services delivery experience Education: BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

description: Analytics Insights – Senior AnalystSenior Analyst – Data Analytics Are you a professional who enjoys exploring data, identifying insights, and developing impactful dashboards and reporting solutions? Are you someone with strong analytical thinking and design sensibility who can build business-focused visualization solutions using Microsoft Power BI?Work you’ll do You’ll develop and maintain dashboards and analytics solutions that support Deloitte Member Firms and help drive consistency, quality, and efficiency for Tax & Legal services delivered through the Global Tools Delivery Center. This role is primarily focused on Microsoft Power BI, DAX, SQL, and data analysis, with exposure to AI concepts considered a plus, not a requirement.Dashboard development, maintenance, and optimization · Develop and maintain dashboards and advanced reports using Microsoft Power BI and SQL. · Work independently in Power BI, with strong expertise in DAX and visual elements. · Prepare dashboards using data visualization and data wrangling tools. · Analyze data using Excel and other analytics tools to identify trends, patterns, and insights. · Gather and analyze existing best practices and templates to develop data-driven, insightful dashboards. · Support dashboard development and continuous improvement initiatives. · Provide recommendations to improve reporting processes, frameworks, and consistency across projects.Data management and reporting standards · Apply strong knowledge of SQL, DBMS, ETL tools/processes, and data management technologies to support analytics and reporting solutions. · Apply development frameworks, guidelines, and standards to tools and ensure integrity and consistency across deliverables. · Support testing, validation, and release readiness of dashboards and reports. · Contribute ideas to enhance reporting efficiency, usability, and standardization. · Work effectively in a global environment with changing priorities and tight deadlines.Compliance and documentation · Use Deloitte standards and templates in all deliverables. · Execute internal testing and user acceptance processes. · Develop and maintain internal project documentation. · Support consistency, quality, and compliance across analytics projects.The teamAt Deloitte, Shared Services center improves overall efficiency and control while giving every business unit access to the company’s best and brightest resources. It is also letting business units focus on what really matters – satisfying customers and developing new products and services to sustain competitive advantage.A shared services center is a simple concept but making it work is anything but easy. It involves consolidating and standardizing a wildly diverse collection of systems, processes, and functions. And if requires a high degree of cooperation among business units that generally are not accustomed to working together – with people who do not necessarily want to change.USI shared services team provides a wide array of services to the U.S. and it is constantly evaluating and expanding its portfolio. The shared services team provides call center support, Document Services support, financial processing and analysis support, Record management support, Ethics and compliance support and admin assistant support.QualificationsRequired:·       Educational Qualification: MCA, B.E./B.Tech·       Technical Skill Set:Overall, 3 to 5 years of experience in Data Analytics fieldHands on experience in Power BI, should be well versed with DAX and visual elements. Possess in depth knowledge in SQL, ETL and Data management technologiesExperience working on Tableau Knowledge of R/Python would be highly beneficial: Basic understanding of these statistical/analytical programming skills is necessary.Familiar with visual design and best practices of UI/UX, reports and dashboards and scorecardso   Sound understanding of advanced excel functions Understanding of agile software development practices and release of software products Knowledge in statistics and machine learning would be highly beneficial: The candidate should have a strong developed mentality with a focus on measuring and metrics o   Knowledge of Quality processes & Dashboard Testing processeso   Good to have knowledge on AI concepts and implementations in Data Analytics and Automation·       Business Skill Set: Role works in a global culture which is under constantly changing conditions and tight deadlines Familiar with consulting role Must have Analytical/problem solving ability Trouble-shooting skills, strong initiative, critical thinking skills, detail oriented It is necessary to have strong Verbal and written communication skills ·       Interpersonal Skill Set: Be able to combine timely and tactful influence to accomplish difficult tasks Have excellent communication skills with good oral and written communication capabilities Have thorough understanding and possess creativity to implement through technology o   Time management and organization skills Passion and the ability to learn new things o   Creative thinkingHow you’ll growAt Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. description: #S&S2027CustomerThe Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.  Position SummaryLevel: Consultant, Technical Transformation or equivalentAs an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.  Work you’ll do: Configure and enhance CXone ACD: skills, queues, routing strategies, priorities, agent profiles, and business rules. Build and maintain IVR/call flows (voice and digital) using CXone scripting/tools (as applicable) and best practices for containment and handoff to agents. Develop integrations using CXone APIs (REST) for customer lookup, case creation, call/activity logging, dispositioning, callbacks, and workflow automation. Implement CRM/CTI capabilities (screen pops, click-to-dial, interaction logging) with platforms like Salesforce or Dynamics 365. Support digital channels (chat, SMS, email, social) routing and configuration where used. Configure and maintain reporting/analytics: interaction data extracts, KPI dashboards, and reconciliation with source-of-truth systems. Troubleshoot and resolve issues across routing, agent desktop behavior, integrations, and data flows; perform root-cause analysis and prevention. Ensure solutions meet security, privacy, and compliance requirements (PII/PCI handling, access controls, auditability). Produce technical documentation: design specs, configuration inventories, test plans, deployment/runbooks, and operational handover. Collaborate in Agile delivery: estimation, sprint execution, UAT support, and release management. The team:Step into our Sales & Service team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end-to-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service!    QualificationsMust Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:3 - 6 years of hands-on experience in contact center engineering/development with 1–2+ years hands-on with NICE CXone (inContact).Strong experience with ACD/routing configuration (skills, queues, priorities, SLAs, overflow/after-hours, callbacks).Hands-on experience with CXone REST APIs and integration patterns (auth, retries, error handling, logging, observability).Proficiency in at least one integration language (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, C#) and solid JSON/data mapping.Experience implementing CRM/CTI integrations (screen pop, click-to-dial, interaction logging, dispositions).Working knowledge of telephony fundamentals (SIP/PSTN concepts, call flows, DTMF) sufficient for troubleshooting with voice/network teams.Strong debugging skills and ability to translate business requirements into technical designs.Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: NICE CXone certifications (or comparable CCaaS certifications). Experience with WFM/QM/analytics modules (if in scope), speech analytics, or conversational AI/IVA tools. Experience with SSO/SAML, role-based access control, and enterprise identity patterns. Data/BI skills: SQL and dashboarding tools (Power BI/Tableau). Experience in regulated environments (PCI, HIPAA, SOX) and secure SDLC. Education:BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited universityLocation:Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai#FY27ReferralCampaign

description: Customer The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence. Position Summary Level: Consultant, Technical Transformation or equivalent As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements. Work you’ll do: Independently design, build, and deliver medium/high complexity stories. Use standard estimation methods for user stories. Own medium-complex modules; perform PoCs, grooming, present design options to TLs. Drive technical grooming; participate in solutioning and PoCs with option analysis. Engage juniors to follow best practices; perform code reviews and fixes with minimal oversight. Coordinate with onshore/client teams; ensure juniors understand requirements; build client rapport. Define release management strategy, pipeline management, repository integration with DevOps. Drive meeting agendas; support weekly status reports. Elevate industry knowledge; leverage Delivery Excellence/automation/Smartstarts. Configure and extend Agentforce/GenAI components; perform PoCs for GenAI-powered features. Mentor Analysts on technical tasks; support technical solutioning and PoCs. The team: Step into our Sales & Service team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end-to-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service! Qualifications Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce, Integration APIs). Proven experience leading technical teams in Salesforce project delivery. Strong understanding of Salesforce configuration, security, sharing rules, and platform best practices. Experience with data integration, migration, and deployment strategies. Proficiency in source control systems (e.g., Git) and Agile methodologies. Salesforce Platform Developer certification required; additional Salesforce certifications are a plus. Excellent communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. Project experience on Life science and Health clients (Patient experience, Commercial, Med Tech, Provider and/or Payer)Good understanding on Einstein Trust Layer, GuardrailsGood understanding on LLM, Different types of prompt templates and their usageGood knowledge on different ModelsGood knowledge on Standard agentsHaving hands on experience on agent creation, usage of standard/ custom actionsGood understanding on DataCloud Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:Salesforce Certified AI Associate Education:BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai#FY27ReferralCampaign S&S Hashtag- #S&S2027
