This role combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership capabilities and exceptional client management skills. You will serve as a bridge between complex technical implementations and business objectives, leading development teams while effectively communicating with stakeholders at all levels.  Work you’ll do:  Technical Leadership & ArchitectureClient Engagement & Solution DesignTeam Management & DevelopmentService Delivery Excellence The team:   Our Sales & Service team focuses on delivering marketing and growth objectives aligned with our clients’ brand values for measurable business growth. We help clients turn business values into measurable growth through creatively driven, personalized content, communications, and experiences that engage and inspire people to act. We implement and operate the technology platforms that enable personalized content, commerce and marketing user-centric experiences. In doing so, we transform our clients’ marketing and engagement operations into modern, data-driven, creatively focused organizations. Our team brings deep experience in creative and digital marketing capabilities by a combination of key focus areas i.e, Brand, Advertising, Experiences, Content, Marketing, Commerce, Products, Data and measurement/analysis.   Qualifications  Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:·       9–10+ years of hands-on experience in the Salesforce ecosystem, with a track record of leading delivery — not just building on it. ·       Deep, current Agentforce expertise — agent design and lifecycle; standard and custom topics; standard and custom agent actions (via Apex, Flow, and Prompt Templates); the reasoning engine; Agentforce Testing Center; the Agentforce Data Library; and connecting agents to channels such as Experience Cloud, email, and Slack. ·       Agent security & selection — strong command of the Agent User model and how it applies to Employee, Service, and Sales agents, and the judgment to choose the right agent type for a given use case. ·       Prompt engineering & grounding — Prompt Builder, prompt template types and their appropriate use, grounding techniques, and Data 360 (formerly Data Cloud) retrievers for accurate, personalized responses. ·       Trust & responsible AI — solid understanding of the Einstein Trust Layer, guardrails, LLM behavior, and responsible, governed AI usage. ·       Program management — proven ability to manage estimation, planning, staffing coordination, risk, and delivery tracking for large or complex implementations across multiple workstreams or releases. ·       Stakeholder leadership — demonstrated ability to manage stakeholders, lead client discussions, and communicate technical concepts clearly to business and technical audiences alike. ·       Platform breadth — strong understanding of Salesforce configuration, the security and sharing model, platform governance, and enterprise design best practices, plus data integration, migration, deployment strategy, and release management across complex environments. ·       Engineering fluency (direct and review, not necessarily author) — strong familiarity with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce, and Integration APIs, and with Git, Agile delivery, and DevOps / CI-CD practices — enough to set standards, review work, and make sound architectural calls. ·       Required certification — Salesforce Certified Agentforce Specialist. ·       Strong problem-solving, leadership, mentoring, and team-management skills. Good to have ·       Salesforce Certified AI Associate. ·       Salesforce Platform Developer, Administrator, or other platform certifications. ·       Project experience with Life Sciences and Health Care clients — patient experience, commercial, MedTech, provider, and/or payer. Education:   ·       BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university   Location:  ·       Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata S&S Hashtag- #S&S2027

title: USI-EH27-Consulting-Customer-DFO&I-Google Cloud Platform- Consultant, Managed Services
description: CustomerThe Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.Position SummaryLevel: Consultant Managed Service or equivalentDesign and engineer next-generation commerce experiences on Google Cloud, combining Universal Commerce Platform building blocks with emerging agentic commerce patterns — AI agents that browse catalogs, negotiate, decide, and transact on behalf of consumers and businesses. The role sits at the intersection of GCP, headless commerce, and Vertex AI / Gemini-based agent stacks, supporting DF&O AM&C client engagements end to end from architecture through Operate.Work you’ll do:Architect commerce solutions on GCP across catalog, cart, checkout, fulfillment, and post-purchase domains.Implement agentic commerce capabilities: agent orchestration, tool use, MCP / A2A integrations, and conversational shopping flows.Build and integrate APIs and microservices across commerce engines (commercetools, Shopify, SAP CC, or Google's Universal Commerce stack) and Google's commerce AI services — Vertex AI Search for Commerce, Recommendations AI, Discovery AI.Design event-driven architectures using Pub/Sub, Eventarc, Cloud Functions, and Cloud Run.Integrate with Google's data and merchant ecosystem (Merchant Center, Shopping APIs, Product Studio).Partner with experience in design, frontend, and martech teams on agent-driven customer journeys and personalization.Contribute to Operate runbooks, observability standards, and AI agent guardrails for production deployments.The team:Our Digital Foundry Operate & Innovations (DFO&I) team partners with organizations to rapidly design, build, and scale digital products and experiences that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, and operations specialists, we deliver end-to-end solutions—from initial concept and agile development to ongoing digital operations—enabling clients to experiment, iterate, and scale digital initiatives with confidence and agility. We support clients across domains such as strategy, commerce, marketing, sales, and service, helping them realize their digital ambitions through flexible, scalable teams. Our expertise spans the full digital lifecycle, including customer research, experience design, platform development, content production, and marketing automation. By bridging the gap between strategy and execution, we empower organizations to achieve measurable outcomes and deliver exceptional customer experiences in an ever-evolving digital landscape.QualificationsMust Have Skills·       3 - 6 years building production solutions on Google Cloud Platform.·       Hands-on with core GCP services: Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Firestore, Spanner, Apigee.·       Experience with one or more commerce platforms (commerce tools, SAP Commerce Cloud, Shopify, BigCommerce, or Google's Universal Commerce stack).·       Working knowledge of agentic AI patterns: LLM orchestration, function calling, tool use, retrieval, MCP and A2A protocols.·       Strong API design (REST, GraphQL) and proficiency in Python, Node.js, or Java.·       Familiarity with Vertex AI, Gemini, and Agent Builder / Conversational Agents.·       GCP Professional Cloud Developer or Cloud Architect certification preferred.Preferred Skills:·       Prior delivery experience on Vertex AI Search for Commerce or Recommendations AI.·       Exposure to retail, CPG, travel, hospitality, or financial services commerce.·       Experience with payment orchestration (Stripe, Adyen, Braintree).·       Familiarity with composable commerce and MACH architecture principles.Education:·       BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited universityLocation:·       Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

description: #S&S2027Customer The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence. Position Summary Level: Associate Business Transformation ArchitectAs an Associate Business Transformation Architect/ Specialist Senior at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.Work you’ll do:Design and build OIC integrations across Oracle Fusion ERP, CX, CPQ modules — applying orchestration, choreography, and scheduled patterns appropriate to each use case Configure OIC adapters for Oracle SaaS, REST, SOAP, FTP/SFTP, JMS, Database, and third-party platforms like Salesforce, MSD, etc. Author data mapping and transformation logic using XSLT, JEXL, and JavaScript mapper — with canonical data model alignment and schema versioning discipline Implement error handling frameworks: dead-letter queue configuration, retry logic, idempotency controls for retry-safe payloads, and structured fault handling Design and enforce API contracts using OAS 3.0: REST API design, OAuth 2.0 / JWT security policies, rate limiting, and versioning standards Monitor OIC integration health in production: triage failures, diagnose payload errors, document root cause, and coordinate resolution with upstream and downstream system owners Execute regression testing ahead of Oracle quarterly updates: maintain integration test scripts, document results, and escalate failures with clear reproduction steps Maintain integration documentation: interface specifications, data mapping workbooks, error handling runbooks, and environment governance logs Support technical workshops with functional and IT stakeholders at director level, translating process requirements into integration design decisionsThe team: Step into our Sales & Service team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end-to-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service! Qualifications Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:6–9 years of enterprise integration or Oracle cloud implementation experience 4+ years of hands-on Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) delivery: integration build, adapter configuration, data mapping, and go-live support on production engagements Demonstrated experience integrating Oracle Fusion ERP, HCM, or CX modules with third-party platforms via OIC Proficiency with OIC integration patterns: orchestration, choreography, scheduled batch, file-based, and event-driven flows Hands-on experience with OIC adapter configuration: Oracle SaaS, REST, SOAP, FTP/SFTP, Database, and at least one third-party SaaS adapter Experience designing REST APIs using OAS 3.0 and implementing OAuth 2.0 / JWT security policies in Oracle API Gateway or OIC Data mapping proficiency: XSLT, JEXL, and JavaScript mapper with experience applying canonical data models Working knowledge of error handling design: retry patterns, dead-letter queues, idempotency controls, and fault envelope standards Experience supporting Oracle quarterly update cycles: regression test execution, release note review, and integration impact assessment Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experienceGood to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:Active Oracle certifications: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2025/2024 Certified Application Integration Professional Experience with Oracle B2B for document exchange: EDI (X12, EDIFACT), AS2/SFTP transport configuration, partner profile setup, and document routing rules Exposure to Oracle Process Automation (OPA) or Oracle Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS) for low-code workflow and UI development Experience with ERP-specific integration patterns: P2P (Procure-to-Pay), O2C (Order-to-Cash), R2R (Record-to-Report), L2C (Lead-to-Cash) Exposure to middleware co-existence or migration scenarios (MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, Informatica alongside OIC)Education:BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

Experience with WFO/WFM/QM integrations, speech analytics, or AI/IVA platforms. Data/BI skills: SQL, Power BI/Tableau, building KPI layers for contact center reporting. Experience with SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, and enterprise identity patterns. Prior work in regulated environments (HIPAA, PCI, SOX, CJIS) and secure SDLC. Education:BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited universityLocation:Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai#FY27ReferralCampaign

description: Join Deloitte’s Global HR Technology organization and help deliver SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central capabilities that support our member firm network around the world. description: #DFO&I2027CustomerThe Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.Position Summary-Managed Services Engineer II or equivalentAs a Managed Services Engineer II at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions. Work you’ll do:Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable ETL/ELT pipelines using enterprise tools like Informatica and cloud-native services like Azure Data Factory.Lead and execute critical data migration projects, moving marketing and customer data from legacy systems to modern cloud platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks.Architect and implement data models within cloud data warehouses, ensuring data is optimized for performance, reliability, and accessibility for analytics and reporting.Write advanced, high-performance SQL and Python scripts to perform complex data transformations, build data validation frameworks, and ensure high data quality.Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including architects, developers, and marketing analysts—to gather requirements and deliver holistic data solutions.Engage in requirement gathering, solution design, and technical decision-making aligned with client marketing analytics goals.Support post-deployment activities, including pipeline maintenance, performance tuning, and client communication.Take ownership of your data engineering deliverables and proactively identify opportunities for improvement in client data architectures.Uphold Deloitte’s values of integrity, client focus, and making an impact that matters.The team:Our Digital Foundry Operate & Innovations (DFO&I) team partners with organizations to rapidly design, build, and scale digital products and experiences that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, and operations specialists, we deliver end-to-end solutions—from initial concept and agile development to ongoing digital operations—enabling clients to experiment, iterate, and scale digital initiatives with confidence and agility. We support clients across domains such as strategy, commerce, marketing, sales, and service, helping them realize their digital ambitions through flexible, scalable teams. Our expertise spans the full digital lifecycle, including customer research, experience design, platform development, content production, and marketing automation. By bridging the gap between strategy and execution, we empower organizations to achieve measurable outcomes and deliver exceptional customer experiences in an ever-evolving digital landscape. QualificationsMust Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:3- 6 years of hands-on experience in a Data Engineering role with a strong focus on ETL development and data warehousing.Cloud Platform Expertise (At least one required):AWS: Deep hands-on experience with Glue, Redshift, S3, Athena, EMR, Lake Formation, and MSK/Kinesis.Azure: Deep hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF), ADLS Gen2, Event Hubs, Databricks (Delta Lake), and Synapse.GCP: Deep hands-on experience with GCS, BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Composer (Airflow).Cloud Serverless & Event-Driven Data Architecture: Hands-on experience designing and deploying event-driven, serverless workflows using at least one of the following:-AWS: Lambda, Step Functions, and SQS/SNS.GCP: Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, GCP Workflows, and Pub/Sub.Azure: Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Queue Storage/Event Grid.Agnostic Lakehouse Expertise: Expert-level use of Databricks and/or Snowflake.Medallion Architecture: Proven experience implementing Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers to manage data quality, ACID transactions, and lifecycle within a Data Lakehouse.Data Formats: Deep understanding of Parquet, JSON, CSV, Avro, and Delta/Iceberg trade-offs (performance, compaction, partitioning, and schema evolution).Data Governance & Security: Experience with lineage/catalog, access controls, encryption, and policy-driven sharing. Proficiency in implementing Fine-Grained Access Control (column/row-level security) and Data Masking for sensitive data.ETL & Migration:Strong background in Informatica (PowerCenter/IICS) for legacy and cloud-native workflows.Experience leading/supporting a Data Migration project from on-premises systems (Oracle, Teradata, SQL Server, Postgres, DB2, etc.) to a modern cloud environment.Programming & Scripting:SQL Mastery: Expert-level skills in Schema building, complex joins, window functions, and query tuning.Python: Strong proficiency for transformations (Pandas, PySpark), task automation, and API-led ingestion.Shell Scripting: Expert-level Linux/Unix Bash for environment setup, automated file transfers, and orchestrating job schedules.Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:AWS: Certified Data Engineer - Associate or Specialty.Azure: Azure Data Engineer AssociateGCP: Professional Data Engineer.Agnostic: Snowflake Pro Core or Databricks Certified Data Engineer.Education:BE/B.Tech/MCA/MSc Degree    Location:·       Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai/

description: #S&S2027Customer The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence. Position Summary Level: Senior Consultant, Data and InsightsAs a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions. Work you’ll do:Lead scrum teams for Epics/Features; provide technical design and develop stories per sprint. Lead estimation for Epics/Features; support project plan/timeline, upsell/cross-sell via estimations. End-to-end ownership of functional modules; lead story grooming/solutioning with onshore/client teams. Ensure quality with unit/peer review; conduct RCA on defects and provide timely fixes. Lead code reviews; ensure team adherence to standards; guide on customization vs configuration. Lead demos to clients; prepare status/QRM reports; present risks/issues in project meetings. Prepare process flows, release notes, pipeline management; leverage Delivery Excellence/automation assets. Prepare Gantt charts, RACII/dependency matrix; maintain project leverage with Manager. Prepare engagement review documentation; support upsell/cross-sell in account/project. Architect, lead, and optimize Agentforce/GenAI integrations; drive adoption of GenAI/Agentic solutions. Lead technical solutioning, code reviews, and customization/configuration decisions for Agentic solutions. Drive innovation in GenAI/Agentforce use cases; ensure best practices in AI/ML integration with Salesforce.The team: Step into our Sales & Service team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end-to-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service! Qualifications Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 7+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps engineering with a strong focus on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Proven expertise in designing, implementing, and managing CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Tekton on GCP Strong hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and/or Deployment Manager for provisioning and managing GCP resources Proficiency in containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker, Kubernetes (GKE), and Helm Hands-on experience with GCP core services: Compute Engine, Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, VPC, IAM, and Secret Manager Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tools including Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, and Prometheus/Grafana Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or Go for automation of operational and deployment tasks Experience with GitOps practices and tools such as ArgoCD or Flux Ability to drive end-to-end DevOps transformation for large-scale cloud projects across multiple client environments Collaborate with cross-functional teams including developers, architects, and security engineers to ensure seamless delivery pipelines Participate in pre-sales, proposals, and client engagement activities as neededGood to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid cloud DevOps setups (GCP + AWS or Azure) Familiarity with GCP Anthos for hybrid/multi-cloud Kubernetes management Knowledge of SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) principles and practices GCP Professional DevOps Engineer or Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer certification preferred Experience with security scanning tools such as SonarQube, Snyk, or Artifact Registry vulnerability scanning Education: BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

strong user story writing for onshore/offshore teams. Experience leading functional teams and bridging cross-application process gaps (e.g., upstream/downstream integrations, reporting requirements). Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/CertificationsCertifications: Oracle CPQ Implementation Specialist, Oracle Sales cloud Implementation Specialist, Oracle Field Service Cloud Implementation Specialist Experience with complex commercial models such as bundling, tiered/volume pricing, discount governance, renewals, co-terming, and mid-term subscription amendments. Exposure to integration patterns and downstream handoffs (e.g., CPQ/CRM to order management, subscription to billing/finance) and master data governance for customer/product/pricing. Familiarity with reporting/analytics requirements for sales pipeline, service performance (SLA), and subscription KPIs.Experience supporting cutover activities, release/regression planning, and post-go-live hypercare operations. Education:  BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university   Location:Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

Position Summary Level: Consultant, Data and Insights As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements. Work you’ll do: Independently design, build, and deliver medium/high complexity stories. Use standard estimation methods for user stories. Own medium-complex modules; perform PoCs, grooming, present design options to TLs. Drive technical grooming; participate in solutioning and PoCs with option analysis. Engage juniors to follow best practices; perform code reviews and fixes with minimal oversight. Coordinate with onshore/client teams; ensure juniors understand requirements; build client rapport. Define release management strategy, pipeline management, repository integration with DevOps. Drive meeting agendas; support weekly status reports. Elevate industry knowledge; leverage Delivery Excellence/automation/Smartstarts. Configure and extend Agentforce/GenAI components; perform PoCs for GenAI-powered features. Mentor Analysts on technical tasks; support technical solutioning and PoCs. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end-to-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service! We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.Position Summary Level: Senior Consultant, Managed Services As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions. Work you’ll do:Analyze business requirements, identify gaps, and translate needs into functional epics and user stories aligned to Oracle capabilities and best practices. Document requirements as epics/user stories, facilitate grooming sessions with stakeholders, and secure client approvals/sign-offs.Conduct requirement prioritization sessions; maintain a healthy product backlog and manage product and sprint backlogs. Define and apply effective product backlog management techniques; ensure goals, scope, and product domain are well understood by the Scrum team. Partner with technical/development teams to communicate product vision, clarify functional queries, resolve functional issues, and recommend fit-to-standard solutions vs. extensions. Demo working solutions (configured Oracle functionality and end-to-end process flows) to business stakeholders; capture feedback and translate it into backlog items for subsequent sprints/releases. Develop and maintain project deliverables across phases (e.g., process maps, functional specifications, configuration workbooks, fit-gap logs, decision logs). Support testing: prepare test scenarios/scripts, coordinate system integration testing (SIT) and user acceptance testing (UAT), triage defects, and validate fixes. Support data activities: define data requirements, support migration approach and validation/reconciliation (as applicable to the module). Prepare and conduct knowledge transfer sessions for application support teams; contribute to hypercare readiness. The team:Our Digital Foundry Operate & Innovations (DFO&I) team partners with organizations to rapidly design, build, and scale digital products and experiences that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, and operations specialists, we deliver end-to-end solutions—from initial concept and agile development to ongoing digital operations—enabling clients to experiment, iterate, and scale digital initiatives with confidence and agility. We support clients across domains such as strategy, commerce, marketing, sales, and service, helping them realize their digital ambitions through flexible, scalable teams. Our expertise spans the full digital lifecycle, including customer research, experience design, platform development, content production, and marketing automation. By bridging the gap between strategy and execution, we empower organizations to achieve measurable outcomes and deliver exceptional customer experiences in an ever-evolving digital landscape.  QualificationsMust Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:6-10 years of as a Functional Consultant/Business Analyst delivering CX solutions in CPQ, CRM/Sales, Service, and/or Subscription domains. Strong understanding of end-to-end CX business processes, including quoting/ordering and case management. Demonstrated ability to lead requirements workshops, produce clear functional documentation, and obtain stakeholder alignment/sign-off. Hands-on experience supporting or performing functional configuration (e.g., workflows/approvals, routing/assignment, validations, SLAs/entitlements, product/pricing rules). Experience creating and executing end-to-end functional testing and supporting UAT with business users. Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain functional designs and process impacts to both business and technical audiences. Experience working in Agile/Scrum full-lifecycle implementations; strong user story writing for onshore/offshore teams. Experience leading functional teams and bridging cross-application process gaps (e.g., upstream/downstream integrations, reporting requirements). Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/CertificationsCertifications: Oracle CPQ Implementation Specialist, Oracle Sales cloud Implementation Specialist, Oracle Field Service Cloud Implementation Specialist Experience with complex commercial models such as bundling, tiered/volume pricing, discount governance, renewals, co-terming, and mid-term subscription amendments. Exposure to integration patterns and downstream handoffs (e.g., CPQ/CRM to order management, subscription to billing/finance) and master data governance for customer/product/pricing. Familiarity with reporting/analytics requirements for sales pipeline, service performance (SLA), and subscription KPIs.Experience supporting cutover activities, release/regression planning, and post-go-live hypercare operations. Education:  BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university   Location:Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

description: Zuora Consultant, Technical Transformation (Revenue Recognition)Looking for a world of opportunities and a fulfilling career?We are a creative digital consultancy. We combine leading digital and creative capabilities with the deep industry knowledge and experience Deloitte is known for. That means, our clients can bring us their biggest challenges, knowing we have what it takes to bring a business vision to life.Work you’ll doAs a Zuora Consultant, you’ll work within an engagement team and be responsible to:·       Lead the end-to-end implementation and configuration of Zuora Billing solutions to meet the organization's billing and revenue recognition needs.·       Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, including finance, sales, and operations, to gather and analyze requirements and translate them into effective Zuora configurations.·       Configure and customize the Zuora platform to support complex billing scenarios, pricing models, and subscription plans.·       Manage and maintain the Zuora billing system, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and reliability.·       Troubleshoot and resolve any billing-related issues or discrepancies, working closely with technical teams as needed.·       Stay updated on industry best practices and Zuora product updates to recommend and implement process improvements.·       Provide training and support to end-users on how to effectively use the Zuora Billing system.·       Participate in cross-functional projects related to billing, revenue recognition, and process optimization.Our Digital Customer team focuses on designing and implementing sales and service experiences, capabilities, and architectures to bring customer strategies to life. Our ambition is to be the best in the world at driving customer transformation through the development of clever commercial strategies, distinctive experiences, and the application of digital technologies. We help make the “creative digital consultancy” real and in doing so, make new markets.The TeamThe Customer & Marketing Offering Portfolio integrates our most differentiated, globally recognized customer and marketing businesses. It focuses on owning the commercial agenda through growth strategy, enhanced user experiences, and engagement through the entire customer lifecycle. From our core strengths in creative design, to strategy, platforms and solutions, as well as our continued growth through acquisitions, we are specifically positioned to bring fully integrated solutions to our clients.We are all consumers and personal marketers. This reality is what makes the Customer & Marketing Offering Portfolio so exciting. What we deliver in the market each and every day directly impacts who we are as customers. We are able to deliver on outcomes for the very products and services that we have the privilege of engaging with ourselves.Professionals will serve our clients through the following types of work:·     Sales Excellence & Service Excellence | delivers sales and service strategies and plans, operating model definition, incentive design and implementation, and operations support for digitally-enabled sales, channel, and customer service capabilities·     Digital Experience | creates engaging omni-channel digital experiences across web, mobile, AR/VR, voice, gesture, IoT, and video·     Flexible Consumption | the commercial strategy, operating model definition, and capability delivery of subscription/flexible consumption business models·     Digital Foundry | a flexible, end-to-end delivery model emphasizing innovation and disruption·     DigitalMix | an integrated set of platforms to enable business re-platformingQualifications and ExperienceRequired:·       Should have 3 to 6 years of experience in Zuora Billing.·       Should be able to translate business problems into solution leveraging the out of the box configuration capabilities of Zuora as well as technical solution based on Zuora APIs, data exports and advanced configuration.·       Should have strong knowledge of Zuora Workflows.·       Should be expert in Zuora Product Catalog, Bill Runs, Payment Runs concepts.·       Should know how to build Invoice Templates, Email templates and Communication Profiles.·       Should know Subscription management via amendments, renewals etc.·       Should know about Zuora Salesforce packages and how to configure those.·       Should have knowledge of Zuora REST APIs and Call Outs.·       Should know how to set up roles and permissions in Zuora.·       Should know Zuora reporting module·       Should we aware of Zuora object model.·       Should be able to provide technical expertise in integrating Zuora with other applications.·       Should be able to train other resources in Zuora·       Salesforce basic knowledge/experience is preferable.·       CPQ experience is preferable.·       Zuora Revenue Recognition is preferable.Preferred:·       Should we aware of Zuora object model.·       Should be able to provide technical expertise in integrating Zuora with other applications.·       Should be able to train other resources in Zuora·       Salesforce knowledge/experience preferable.·       CPQ experience is preferable.·       Zuora order metrices is preferable.·       ERP systems experience is preferable.·       Experience with solution implementation in the areas of order-to-cash, finance, accounting is preferable. #S&S2027

title: USI-EH27-Consulting-C&M-DFO&I-Adobe Magento-Consultant, Managed Services
description: #DFO&I2027CustomerThe Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.Position SummaryLevel: Consultant, Managed ServicesAs an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements. Work you’ll do:Develop and customize Adobe Commerce (Magento 2) modules, themes, and integrations.Implement checkout, cart, catalogue, pricing, promotions, and customer/account features.Build and consume REST/SOAP APIs; integrate with payment, tax, shipping, ERP/CRM, and PIM systems.Work with EAV schema, product types (simple/configurable/bundle), and multi-store setups.Create/extend service contracts, plugins (interceptors), observers, and cron jobs.Troubleshoot performance issues (indexers, caching, cron, DB queries) and improve site reliability.Collaborate with QA, DevOps, and product teams, support code reviews and documentation.The team:Our Digital Foundry Operate & Innovations (DFO&I) team partners with organizations to rapidly design, build, and scale digital products and experiences that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, and operations specialists, we deliver end-to-end solutions—from initial concept and agile development to ongoing digital operations—enabling clients to experiment, iterate, and scale digital initiatives with confidence and agility. We support clients across domains such as strategy, commerce, marketing, sales, and service, helping them realize their digital ambitions through flexible, scalable teams. Our expertise spans the full digital lifecycle, including customer research, experience design, platform development, content production, and marketing automation. By bridging the gap between strategy and execution, we empower organizations to achieve measurable outcomes and deliver exceptional customer experiences in an ever-evolving digital landscape. QualificationsMust Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:3 - 6 years of hands-on experience in Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce development (B2B & B2C). Strong PHP (OOP), MySQL, JavaScript, HTML/CSS; Composer and Git. Understanding of Magento architecture: DI, layout XML, UI components, EAV, repository/service layer.Experience with GraphQL and REST API customization. Familiarity with caching (Redis/Varnish), OpenSearch, and message queues (RabbitMQ) is a plus. Good debugging skills (Xdebug/logs) and familiarity with Magento CLI. Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:Experience with PWA Studio, headless builds, or custom storefront integrations. CI/CD familiarity (GitHub Actions/Jenkins), Docker, and cloud hosting. Education:·       BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university   Location:·       Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

description: #DFO&I2027CustomerThe Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.Position SummaryManaged Services Engineer I or equivalentAs an experienced Managed Services Engineer I at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements. Work you’ll doBuild, optimize, and maintain web applications using Ember.js (routing, templates, components, services, data flow, performance)Collaborate with client/business stakeholders, product managers, and designers to clarify requirements, define/review acceptance criteria, and deliver incremental value.Create accessible, responsive user interfaces aligned to design systems; contribute reusable components and UI patternImplement and maintain automated testing (unit/integration/acceptance) using QUnit, Ember Test Helpers, and Ember CLI Mirage (as applicable). Participate in code reviews; uphold engineering standards for readability, maintainability, performance, and security. Integrate front ends with APIs and data sources using Ember Data (REST/JSON:API and/or GraphQL as applicable), including error handling and caching strategies. Implement authentication/authorization patterns (sessions, tokens, route guards) and collaborate with back-end teams on secure integration. Participate in Agile delivery (planning, standups, demos, retros) and provide estimates, delivery status, and risk/issue visibility. Use GenAI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery while applying human verification, secure coding practices, and IP/data-handling rules. The team:Our Digital Foundry Operate & Innovations (DFO&I) team partners with organizations to rapidly design, build, and scale digital products and experiences that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, and operations specialists, we deliver end-to-end solutions—from initial concept and agile development to ongoing digital operations—enabling clients to experiment, iterate, and scale digital initiatives with confidence and agility. We support clients across domains such as strategy, commerce, marketing, sales, and service, helping them realize their digital ambitions through flexible, scalable teams. Our expertise spans the full digital lifecycle, including customer research, experience design, platform development, content production, and marketing automation. By bridging the gap between strategy and execution, we empower organizations to achieve measurable outcomes and deliver exceptional customer experiences in an ever-evolving digital landscape. QualificationsMust Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:4 - 4 years of hands-on professional front-end experience, including production experience with Ember.js. Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, and modern front-end patterns. Solid understanding of Ember fundamentals: Ember CLI, routing, components, services, helpers/modifiers, and state management patterns. Proficiency with Git workflows and participation in CI/CD pipelines. Strong automated testing experience with QUnit/Ember testing (writing and maintaining tests). Working knowledge of web performance fundamentals (bundle/runtime optimization, rendering performance, asset strategy). Working knowledge of accessibility best practices (WCAG/ARIA). Experience using code-assist/GenAI tools with an emphasis on correctness, security, and maintainability. Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:Experience with TypeScript in Ember applications. Familiarity with modern Ember patterns (e.g., Octane, Glimmer components, tracked properties). GraphQL experience and/or schema-driven UI development. Authentication and secure front-end practices (OAuth/OIDC, JWT/session management; OWASP basics). Observability experience (error tracking, logging, performance monitoring, RUM). Experience upgrading legacy Ember apps, dependency management, and codemods.Participation in AI-assisted development pilots/trainings. Education:BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university   Location:Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

title: USI-EH27-G&P-BM&C-Virtual Events Producer-Specialist AM-Hyderabad
description: Virtual Event Production & Strategist- Specialist Assistant ManagerDeloitte’s full-service Brand Marketing & Communications (BM&C) is seeking collaborative creatives, skillful strategists, and marketing masterminds to lead our businesses in exciting new directions. At Deloitte, we combine world-class creativity and business knowledge, insightful strategic thinking, and Deloitte’s powerful brand equity to create undeniable impact. If you find opportunity where others don’t, thrive in a supportive and diverse team environment, keep your finger on the pulse of cultural trends and the latest technology, and apply new ideas to challenge the status quo, then we want your talents in our mix. Together we’ll discover new ways to transform out-of-the-box concepts into work that feels like marketing magic.Work you’ll do:As a Virtual Events (webcasts, webinars on other online platforms) Strategist and coordinator, you would focus on marketing, production and execution of an event. Your role will be to collaborate with marketers and play a key role in bringing their campaigns to target audiences and help in the growth of the organization.Key Job responsibilities:Develop and implement marketing strategies to promote virtual events. This includes leveraging social media, email marketing, and other digital channels to drive attendance and engagement.Collaborate with marketers and vendors to deliver virtual events that meet stakeholder objectives and create impactful experiences.Execution of virtual events such as LinkedIn Live sessions, webcasts, webinars, and roundtable discussions through effective usage of technology.Track and analyze the performance of virtual events to measure success and identify areas for improvement. Use metrics such as attendance, engagement, and lead generations to evaluate the effectiveness of the events.Deliver meaningful user experiences by interacting with clients and addressing their questions through multiple communication channels.Skills and Abilities: Experience producing and directing webcasts and other virtual experiences from pre-production process to post-production (programs such as ON24, GlobalMeet, webinar.net, Zoom, Microsoft teams, Socialive, etc.). Good understanding of Martech tools (Salesforce, Eloqua, Adobe Experience Manager) Strong communication skills, capable of precise interactions with clients and colleagues across all organizational levels. Strong customer-centric focus with an emphasis on effective client service attitude. Practical experience with Agile methodologies, highlighting adaptive planning, iterative development, and team collaboration. Strong team management, upward management, problem-solving, and handling difficult conversations. Experience working in agency marketing would be a plus. Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational skills and excellent attention to detail. Education and Experience:·       MBA / Master degree in Marketing or relevant domain. At least 7-8 years of relevant professional experience. Work Timing 6.00 PM to 3.00 AM Location – Hyderabad Office The Team Virtual Events Strategist and coordinator is a part of BM&C team. We provide value to the firm through impactful virtual events using dynamic promotion strategies and cutting-edge technologies to create memorable client experiences. The innovative solutions and seamless omni-channel integration enhance client engagement, foster strong relationships, and contribute significantly to Deloitte's growth.

title: USI-EH27-Consulting-C&M-DFO&I-Oracle Functional-Analyst, Managed Services
description: #DFO&I2027CustomerThe Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.Position Summary Level: Analyst, Managed ServicesAs a Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions. Work you’ll do:Analyze business requirements, identify gaps, and translate needs into functional epics and user stories aligned to Oracle capabilities and best practices. Document requirements as epics/user stories, facilitate grooming sessions with stakeholders, and secure client approvals/sign-offs.Conduct requirement prioritization sessions; maintain a healthy product backlog and manage product and sprint backlogs. Define and apply effective product backlog management techniques; ensure goals, scope, and product domain are well understood by the Scrum team. Partner with technical/development teams to communicate product vision, clarify functional queries, resolve functional issues, and recommend fit-to-standard solutions vs. extensions. Demo working solutions (configured Oracle functionality and end-to-end process flows) to business stakeholders; capture feedback and translate it into backlog items for subsequent sprints/releases. Develop and maintain project deliverables across phases (e.g., process maps, functional specifications, configuration workbooks, fit-gap logs, decision logs). Support testing: prepare test scenarios/scripts, coordinate system integration testing (SIT) and user acceptance testing (UAT), triage defects, and validate fixes. Support data activities: define data requirements, support migration approach and validation/reconciliation (as applicable to the module). Prepare and conduct knowledge transfer sessions for application support teams; contribute to hypercare readiness. The team:Our Digital Foundry Operate & Innovations (DFO&I) team partners with organizations to rapidly design, build, and scale digital products and experiences that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, and operations specialists, we deliver end-to-end solutions—from initial concept and agile development to ongoing digital operations—enabling clients to experiment, iterate, and scale digital initiatives with confidence and agility. We support clients across domains such as strategy, commerce, marketing, sales, and service, helping them realize their digital ambitions through flexible, scalable teams. Our expertise spans the full digital lifecycle, including customer research, experience design, platform development, content production, and marketing automation. By bridging the gap between strategy and execution, we empower organizations to achieve measurable outcomes and deliver exceptional customer experiences in an ever-evolving digital landscape.  QualificationsMust Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:2-3 years of as a Functional Consultant/Business Analyst delivering CX solutions in CPQ, CRM/Sales, Service, and/or Subscription domains. Strong understanding of end-to-end CX business processes, including quoting/ordering and case management. Demonstrated ability to lead requirements workshops, produce clear functional documentation, and obtain stakeholder alignment/sign-off. Hands-on experience supporting or performing functional configuration (e.g., workflows/approvals, routing/assignment, validations, SLAs/entitlements, product/pricing rules). Experience creating and executing end-to-end functional testing and supporting UAT with business users. Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain functional designs and process impacts to both business and technical audiences. Experience working in Agile/Scrum full-lifecycle implementations; strong user story writing for onshore/offshore teams. Experience leading functional teams and bridging cross-application process gaps (e.g., upstream/downstream integrations, reporting requirements). Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/CertificationsCertifications: Oracle CPQ Implementation Specialist, Oracle Sales cloud Implementation Specialist, Oracle Field Service Cloud Implementation Specialist Experience with complex commercial models such as bundling, tiered/volume pricing, discount governance, renewals, co-terming, and mid-term subscription amendments. Exposure to integration patterns and downstream handoffs (e.g., CPQ/CRM to order management, subscription to billing/finance) and master data governance for customer/product/pricing. Familiarity with reporting/analytics requirements for sales pipeline, service performance (SLA), and subscription KPIs.Experience supporting cutover activities, release/regression planning, and post-go-live hypercare operations. Education:  BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university   Location:Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence. Position SummaryLevel: Consultant, Data & Insights or equivalentAs an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements. Work you’ll do:Independently design, build, and deliver medium/high complexity  stories. Use standard estimation methods for user stories.Own medium-complex modules; perform PoCs, grooming, present design options to TLs. Drive technical grooming; participate in solutioning and PoCs with option analysis.Engage juniors to follow best practices; perform code reviews and fixes with minimal oversight. Coordinate with onshore/client teams; ensure juniors understand requirements; build client rapport.Define release management strategy, pipeline management, repository integration with DevOps. Drive meeting agendas; support weekly status reports. Elevate industry knowledge; leverage Delivery Excellence/automation/Smartstarts.Configure and extend Agentforce/GenAI components; perform PoCs for GenAI-powered features. Mentor Analysts on technical tasks; support technical solutioning and PoCs.The team:Step into our Sales & Service team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end-to-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service!    QualificationsMust Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:3 - 6 years of hands-on experience in development of IRIS React frontend and Node.js backend servicesFrontend Leadership: Lead development of React 18 + TypeScript + Vite application with Tailwind CSS and complex UI libraries (Radix, Chakra, MUI) Backend Architecture: Design and implement Node.js + Express APIs with Prisma ORM and PostgreSQL database API Development: Build RESTful APIs with OpenAPI documentation, JWT authentication, and rate limiting Performance Optimization: Implement caching strategies, database query optimization, and frontend performance tuning Code Quality: Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews, and maintain 80%+ test coverage Integration Work: Connect frontend with AI services, CRM integrations, and MCP server protocols Frontend: 5+ years React (hooks, context, React Query), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite Backend: 4+ years Node.js, Express.js, REST API design, database design Database: PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, query optimization, migrations Tools: Git, npm/yarn, PM2, JWT authentication, OpenAPI/ Swagger Testing: Jest, React Testing Library, integration testing Hands-on experience designing and architecting agentic AI solutionsEducation:BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university    Location:Mumbai/ Hyderabad

do:Integrate and learn from talented colleagues who specialize in core domainAdopt a growth mindset and invest in expanding your understanding of Deloitte’s integrated solutions and marketplace As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, and operations specialists, we deliver end-to-end solutions—from initial concept and agile development to ongoing digital operations—enabling clients to experiment, iterate, and scale digital initiatives with confidence and agility. We support clients across domains such as strategy, commerce, marketing, sales, and service, helping them realize their digital ambitions through flexible, scalable teams. Our expertise spans the full digital lifecycle, including customer research, experience design, platform development, content production, and marketing automation. title: USI-EH27-Consulting-Customer-CS&D-Sales Strategy-Manager, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation
description: Customer  The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.   Position Summary   Level: Manager, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation The USI Sales Strategy and Transformation team within CS&D works in close collaboration with global teams to deliver significant impact for its clients, providing thought leadership and specialization in areas such as GTM strategy, selling motion design, sales quota and territory planning, pay for performance strategy, partner strategy and activation, sales enablement, and optimizing seller experience (including AI). Work you’ll do:  As a Manager, you shall be responsible for leading engagements for CXOs and Sales Leaders in defining the future of sales strategy to drive profitable growth, while also identifying the operational capabilities and technologies required for optimal sales organization. As part of your role, you may be required to including, but not limited to: Assess clients’ GTM strategy and selling motions to inform what good looks like, benchmarking against leading practices Improve operational efficiencies through process redesign and use of automation/AI as applicable, and creating prioritization roadmap including feasibility model/business case Re-define/assess sales capabilities and tech stack, including but not limited to Lead and opportunity management, quota and territory planning, salesforce incentive management and other lead to order tools Additionally, you will drive commercial growth by leading practice development & eminence and acting as a key driver of proposals or other business development work in the Sales Strategy and Transformation space and helping track operational metrics (utilization, project pipeline etc.) You will also contribute to building Sales Strategy expertise and driving thought leadership by creating and publishing solutions and methodologies, and building repeatable toolkits for use by project teams The team:  The Customer Strategy & Design (CS&D) team is a core part of Deloitte’s Customer portfolio, helping organizations reimagine customer engagement, drive growth, and enhance experiences across the lifecycle. We operate at the intersection of strategy, design, and digital transformation, bringing together strategists, designers, analysts, and industry experts. We work with C-level leaders to tackle complex challenges—from launching new ventures and redefining go-to-market strategies to shaping omnichannel experiences and driving marketing, sales, pricing, and service excellence. Our strength lies in delivering executable strategies that balance long-term vision with practical implementation. Partnering across industries, we ensure that our solutions deliver both measurable impact and meaningful customer outcomes, guiding clients from insight to execution. Qualifications   Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:  Functional expertise: Experience in GTM strategy, commercial strategy projects at top consulting firms catering B2B or B2C sales, covering selling motions, sales planning, incentive structure design, and/or partner strategy; hands on experience leading large scale technology transformation across CRM and Planning tools is a plus Industry experience: Across Financial Services and Insurance, Telecommunication, Media & Technology preferably. Project Leadership: Experience in leading consulting projects from inception to completion, ensuring high-quality delivery and client satisfaction, providing strategic advice and solutions. Team Management: Experience in managing and mentoring junior consultants, providing guidance and support to develop their skills and careers. Strategic Analysis: Ability to conduct in-depth analysis of client business challenges and opportunities, developing actionable insights and recommendations. Collaboration: Proven track record of working closely with senior leadership to align on and drive growth strategies Analytical skills: A strong foundation in delivering actionable, data-driven insights with good exposure on complex data sets, performing quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary); synthesizing and presenting insights and recommendations from data Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: Exposure to working in non-India Geographies (preferably US) and/or interacting with global stakeholders. Education:  MBA from a premier school in India or abroad 6 – 9 years post MBA experience for Managers  Location:   Bengaluru/Hyderabad  #FY27ReferralCampaign

description: As a Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will lead vulnerability management programs and teams across a portfolio of enterprise clients, owning service quality, client relationships, and commercial outcomes. You will drive the strategic vision for AI-augmented VM delivery, championing the adoption of Anthropic Claude-based agentic capabilities across Deloitte's Cyber Operate practice. You will develop and mentor a high-performing team, shape go-to-market offerings and represent Deloitte's thought leadership in vulnerability management.Work you'll doAs a Manager on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for leading vulnerability management programs across a portfolio of enterprise clients. Own end-to-end vulnerability management program delivery, including service quality, service level agreement adherence, client satisfaction, and remediation outcomes across enterprise environments. Lead executive client relationships, provide strategic guidance on vulnerability risk management and program maturity, and translate complex exposure data into board-level reporting and investment priorities. Define and execute the strategy for integrating Anthropic Claude and agentic artificial intelligence capabilities into vulnerability management services, including automation, orchestration, and operating model improvements. Oversee integration of vulnerability management platforms with security orchestration, security information and event management, and information technology service management systems, and align delivery to client security architecture and regulatory obligations. Manage and develop team members, support offering development and sales collaboration, and oversee engagement financial performance including budgeting, forecasting, utilization, and profitability. The teamCyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes managing the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security, business transformation, and ensuring continuous compliance. Services include Cyber-as-a-Service, Managed Application Security, and Managed Extended Detect & Respond (MXDR).Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai Shift Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST, title: USI-EH27- G&P-R&I-L35 - Specialist, Strategic Market Insights and Thought Leadership (CGI) - Mumbai
description: Specialist, Strategic Market Insights and Thought Leadership (CGI)The Center for Government Insights is one of the industry teams within the Research & Insights (R&I) group, focusing primarily on the government and public sector. The Center's goals are to:Assess opportunities and challenges facing the public sector – including disruptive technologies, changing citizen expectations, and the future of workShare inspiring stories of government innovation, looking at what's behind the adoption of new technologies and management practicesThrough research, forums, and immersive workshops, we aim to provide public officials, policy professionals, and members of the media with fresh insights that advance their understanding of what is possible in government transformation.Learn more about the Center and have a peek into our work here – Deloitte Center for Government InsightsThis role involves contributing to thought leadership and research projects across the full lifecycle—from design to delivery—examining critical challenges and opportunities in government sectors such as public health, defense and security, and other cross-cutting topics; with a focus on how technology and public policy are shaping these areas.The candidate will contribute to advancing the quality of the Center's research and thought-leadership work on cross-government sectors, including those identified above, covering topics such as AI in transportation, future of food/nutrition, public health campaigns, and defense procurement. These include whitepapers, in depth research reports, case studies, articles, data-based research tools, client presentations, and collaterals for specific client accounts. These deliverables would integrate information from a range of primary and secondary sources, including Deloitte subject-matter experts, primary research (surveys), publicly available data, third-party research, analyst reports, presentations, industry commentaries, and news articles.Responsibilities:As a Senior Analyst focused on developing thought leadership, you will be required to –Work across diverse government and public sector topics, quickly build subject-matter familiarity, synthesize complex information, and deliver high-quality research insights.Identify novel topics, areas and trends to focus on, based on extensive analysis of competition thoughtware/ articles and importance of issues based on market studies, industry reports and tracking.Design research proposals, build consensus, and formulate a research plan.Interact with internal and external subject matter experts on industry topics and synthesize takeaways and findings into concise and well-structured narratives, assisting senior research leads to shape internal/external thought-leadership content and collaterals. Liaison with U.S. colleagues and senior researchers to understand, refine, and manage internal client expectations and priorities. Apply established research tools and methodologies to support business decision-making. Work on varied data sets (e.g., survey data, publicly available data sets) to derive data-driven insights.Identify and use the relevant data analysis methods and work with the relevant data science and analytics professionals to analyze voluminous and complex datasets. Demonstrate strong writing skills as required for thought leadership reports. Display strong consultative and engaging presentation skills.Support all aspects of engagement/project to ensure outcomes and meet deadlines. Assist senior researchers and practice leaders with internal briefings and external client meetings/webinars – by performing customized data analysis and presenting results and insights into client-ready briefing decks.Develop an understanding of Deloitte’s solutions, services, and offerings.Requisite experience and skillsExperience3-6 years of experience in supporting/managing research projects. Experience working with US/global clients and teams is preferred. Since the job requires working closely with US-based colleagues, the ability to work across cultures is important. Industry/sector/subsector skillsBusiness research/thought leadership development in the public sector industry or sub-sectors is preferred. Knowledge of the U.S. public sector market or a few public policy areas, such as health care, public health, defense, security, infrastructure, and transportation, will be an advantage. A broad understanding of the US political and public policy ecosystem will be an advantage.Understanding of the impact of AI and other emerging technologies on government operations and public policy will be an advantage.Technical skillsSound analytical skills with experience in one or more of the following research methods: Primary Research (surveys), secondary research, academic research, and case study research. Strong data analysis skills with the ability to work with quantitative and qualitative data – interpret, analyze, visualize, and provide data-driven insights.Ability to use statistical and advanced data analysis methods to analyze large and complex datasets, including surveys.Ability to develop compelling and analytical data visualizations using one or more tools like Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or others.Strong verbal and written communication skills. Journalistic and narrative writing style is preferred, along with prior experience in report writing and research report development. Problem-solving and critical thinking skills to generate meaningful analytical insights. Broad understanding of strategy models and frameworks, and the ability to apply them to research problems.Ability to understand the impact of marketplace changes on the industry, sector, or sub-sector. Proficiency in using generative AI-based platforms and tools to elevate research discovery, data insights, analytical rigor, and business writing.
