title: USI FY27 | Cyber - Strategy and Transformation - Manager - ServiceNow - ITOM
description: CyberDeloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.Position SummaryLevel: ManagerAs an Engineering Manager II, you will design and deliver ServiceNow-based solutions with a focus on Configuration Management Database (CMDB), Information Technology Asset Management (ITAM), and platform optimization. This role offers the opportunity to work with clients, sales teams, and cross-functional Deloitte teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. You will also help drive governance, implementation quality, and platform best practices across complex engagements.Work you'll doAs an Engineering Manager II on the Cyber Strategy & Transformation team, you will be responsible for… Configuring and developing ServiceNow solutions across CMDB, ITAM, and platform capabilities to support client technical and business objectives Analyzing CMDB data, identifying data quality issues, determining root causes, and implementing solutions to improve data integrity Collaborating with clients and internal stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical designs and implementation plans Leading solution development activities, including architecture documentation, configuration, integration design, and deployment to higher environments Supporting governance activities such as configuration management plans, policies, standards, operating models, and roadmaps Participating in pre-sales efforts, solution demonstrations, client presentations, and technical discussions with Deloitte US and member firm teams The teamCyber Strategy & Transformation teams develop and transform cyber programs in line with a client's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite. They keep the enterprise a step ahead of the evolving threat landscape and give stakeholders confidence in the organization's cyber posture. Services include the design of cyber organization, governance, and risk assessments. Services also encompass Cybersecurity Assessments and Frameworks, Cyber Transformation Management, Technology Software and Asset Compliance Management, Third Party Risk Management, Cyber Risk and Compliance, Solution Design and Implementation, and Cyber Risk Analytics and Quantification Reporting.QualificationsRequired: 9-13 years of ServiceNow experience, including implementation of Information Technology Service Management, Information Technology Asset Management, Configuration Management Database, Software Asset Management Professional, or Hardware Asset Management Professional solutions Experience configuring ServiceNow Workspace, UI Builder, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, Script Includes, Access Control Lists, Update Sets, and Flow Designer Experience designing and developing ServiceNow integrations, application programming interfaces, automations, and workflow solutions Experience with Common Service Data Model framework, configuration item relationships, and CMDB Query Builder Experience delivering 4+ end-to-end ServiceNow projects from requirements gathering through go-live ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology or a related field Preferred: Experience with ServiceNow platform deployments, upgrades, and troubleshooting Experience conducting ITAM assessments and developing governance documentation, including policies, standards, and procedures Experience creating epics, user stories, client demos, and technical solution documentation Experience working with Functional Consultants and Business Analysts to estimate stories and define technical solutions Experience with other software asset management or hardware asset management tools ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect or Certified Implementation Specialist certificationLocation: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/ChennaiShift Timings: General Shift

title: USI-EH27-Tax-Global Employer Services- HNI-L55- Manager
description: Tax Manager – US Global Employer ServicesDo you have a passion to work for US based clients of Deloitte Tax and transform their current state of tax to the next generation of tax functions? Are you ready to take the next step in your career to find new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations? Are you ready to fulfill your potential and want to have a significant impact to global initiatives? If the answer to all of the above is “Yes,” come join Business Tax Services group in Deloitte India (Offices of the U.S), a service line of Deloitte Tax LLP!Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a much sought-after career option.At Deloitte, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace.  We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment. Work you’ll do To list some of key responsibilities: -• The U.S. India Tax Compliance Group works with global clients to provide tax compliance services, including income and several other tax return preparations, and computations.• Reviewing U.S. federal tax workpapers and filings, including hands on experience in the following:• U.S. Individual Income Tax Return – Form 1040• Tax equalization calculations.• Gift Tax Returns – Form 709• Estate Tax Returns – Form 706• Trust Returns – 1041• Foreign Gifts / Bequests received – 3520• K-1 – Hedge Funds / PTP / Basis calculations / At Risk reporting and associated foreign forms (K3 Reporting) 926 / 8886 / 8621/ 8865 / 5471 / QBI reporting• High Risk / informational reporting forms – 3520 / 8865 / 8858• Instalment Sales & Like Kind Transactions, IRAs• Tax Planning / Extension / Estimate tax planning• In depth knowledge of depreciation methods and recapture• This role will primarily concentrate on delivering individual tax return compliance process services for High Net Worth Individuals (HNI) and Mobility Tax. The services encompass tax accounting, research related to income tax compliance for U.S. federal, state, and international tax issues, and the identification and preparation of advisory services concerning income tax matters.• Responsibilities will include preparation and review of individual income tax returns, conduct US tax law research and manage tax consulting projects.• The ideal candidate for this position would embrace the opportunity to work with Deloitte US and global member firms around the world, and to build extensive knowledge in the field of U.S. income tax, be detail oriented, and have excellent people, team management, project management, and leadership skills.The Team Accelerating globalization, growing regulatory and business complexity, and evolution of tax technology is creating ever-increasing expectations for tax executives. At Deloitte, we are leading clients through change, uncovering insights and providing strategic value to organizations. Our approach combines insight and innovation from multiple disciplines with business and industry knowledge to help serve our clients with distinction.  You will be based in India and are part of the US team serving our U.S. based clients. Qualifications and ExperienceRequired:Full time Masters in Business Administration (MBA) in Finance or equivalent from reputed University8- 12 or more years in handling complex tax returns for High-Net-Worth Individuals (HNI) and private wealth clients, or Global Mobility Tax - international assignee populations of multi-national clients with signing experience.Knowledge of Forms 1040, 709, 706, Trust returns 1041, Foreign Gifts / Bequests received – 3520, K-1 – Hedge Funds, foreign forms 926 / 8886 / 8621/ 8865 / 5471Adequate level of familiarity with US federal and state income tax legislation including foreign national and expatriate tax issues.Proficiency in tax software (e.g., CCH Axcess, ProSystem fx) and Microsoft Office Suite.Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English languageStrong accounting knowledgeCritical thinking and analytical skillsKnowledge on Microsoft Office products — Excel, Word, etc.Aptitude for learning technology (proprietary tools such as Tracker)Enrolled Agent (EA) accreditation required.Work Location: Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurgaon, Pune, Mumbai & Kolkata offices.Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM IST | 2 PM to 11 PM IST#CA-GSD #CA-HPNAccountingFY26

title: USI FY27 | Cyber Operate- Vulnerability Management + Anthropic - Senior Consultant
description: As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will support end-to-end vulnerability management engagements, assisting in the identification, assessment, prioritization, and remediation tracking of security vulnerabilities across client environments. You will work alongside senior practitioners and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality outcomes, leveraging both traditional VM tooling and emerging Anthropic / Agentic AI capabilities to accelerate threat detection and response. Work you'll do As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for leading vulnerability management engagements across client environments. Lead vulnerability assessment engagements across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, and manage the vulnerability management lifecycle from policy design through remediation verification. Serve as a primary client contact, align vulnerability management strategies to business risk priorities and regulatory requirements, and produce risk-based dashboards and reporting for leadership. Design and implement Anthropic Claude-powered automation workflows for vulnerability ingestion, triage, prioritization, and remediation guidance. Integrate vulnerability management platforms with security orchestration, security information and event management, and information technology service management systems to automate workflows and reduce manual effort. Define and improve operating procedures, service level agreements, and quality metrics; mentor junior team members; and coordinate remediation tracking across stakeholder groups. The team Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes managing the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security, business transformation, and ensuring continuous compliance. Services include Cyber-as-a-Service, Managed Application Security, and Managed Extended Detect & Respond (MXDR). Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai  Shift Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST, with flexibility required based on client expectations, engagement demands, time zone coverage, on-call support, and after-hours operational needs Qualifications Required: 5-10 years of experience in cybersecurity, including 4+ years of vulnerability management experience in enterprise or managed service environments Experience with vulnerability management platforms such as RiskSense, ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, Armis VIPR, Tenable.sc, Tenable.io, Qualys VMDR, Rapid7 InsightVM, Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, or Prisma Cloud Experience integrating Anthropic Claude application programming interfaces into security workflows, including prompt engineering, function calling, and tool use for triage, summarization, and remediation guidance Experience with vulnerability risk scoring frameworks, including Common Vulnerability Scoring System version 3 or version 4, Exploit Prediction Scoring System, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities, and business-risk contextualization Experience scripting application programming interface integrations, data pipelines, and automation of vulnerability management reporting workflows Experience with security information and event management platforms, cloud security posture management, container or Kubernetes vulnerability scanning, and security orchestration, automation, and response platforms Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent Preferred: Experience building retrieval-augmented generation pipelines using Claude or similar large language models against vulnerability knowledge bases Experience with artificial intelligence or machine learning-based anomaly detection integrated with vulnerability management tooling for predictive risk scoring CISSP, CISM, Tenable Certified Security Professional, Qualys Certified Specialist, AWS Security Specialty, or Azure Security Specialty certification Experience with attack surface management platforms such as Mandiant ASM, CrowdStrike Falcon Surface, or Cortex XPANSE#Cyber_Cyber description: Senior, Tax Technology ServicesJoin Deloitte’s Tax Technology Services practice and help clients modernize tax operations through SAP-enabled transformation. In this role, you will support SAP Cloud Platform Integration and S/4HANA tax efforts by connecting tax, technology, and business processes across complex environments. You will work with cross-functional teams to build scalable integrations between SAP and non-SAP systems and help deliver technology solutions that support client business needs. Professionals on this team work across tax, finance, and information technology stakeholders to design and deliver scalable solutions that support compliance, reporting, and process efficiency. title: USI-EH27- G&P-R&I-L40 - Specialist Assistant Manager, Strategic Market Insights and Thought Leadership (CGI-GPS) -Mumbai
description: Specialist Assistant Manager, Strategic Market Insights and Thought Leadership (CGI)The Center for Government Insights is one of the industry teams within the Research & Insights (R&I) group, focusing primarily on the government and public sector. The Center's goals are to:Assess opportunities and challenges facing the public sector – including disruptive technologies, changing citizen expectations, and the future of workShare inspiring stories of government innovation, looking at what's behind the adoption of new technologies and management practicesThrough research, forums, and immersive workshops, we aim to provide public officials, policy professionals, and members of the media with fresh insights that advance their understanding of what is possible in government transformation.Learn more about the Center and have a peek into our work here – Deloitte Center for Government InsightsThis role involves contributing to thought leadership and research projects across the full lifecycle—from design to delivery—examining critical challenges and opportunities in government sectors such as public health, defense and security, and other cross-cutting topics; with a focus on how technology and public policy are shaping these areas.The candidate will contribute to advancing the quality of the Center's research and thought-leadership work on cross-government sectors, including those identified above, covering topics such as AI in transportation, future of food/nutrition, public health campaigns, and defense procurement. These include whitepapers, in depth research reports, case studies, articles, data-based research tools, client presentations, and collaterals for specific client accounts. These deliverables would integrate information from a range of primary and secondary sources, including Deloitte subject-matter experts, primary research (surveys), publicly available data, third-party research, analyst reports, presentations, industry commentaries, and news articles.Responsibilities:As an Assistant Manager focused on developing thought leadership, you will be required to –Work across diverse government and public service topics, quickly build subject-matter familiarity, synthesize complex information, and deliver high-quality research insights.Design research proposals, build consensus, and formulate a research plan.Interact with internal and external subject matter experts on a topic. Liaison with U.S. colleagues to understand, refine, and manage internal client expectations and priorities. Apply established research tools and methodologies to support business decision-making. Work on survey data as well as publicly available data sets to derive data-driven research insights.Use statistical and advanced data analysis methods to analyze voluminous and complex datasets.Demonstrate strong writing skills as required for thought leadership reports. Display strong consultative and engaging presentation skills.Support all aspects of engagement/project to ensure outcomes and meet deadlines. Assist senior researchers and practice leaders with internal briefings and external client meetings/webinars – by performing customized data analysis and presenting results and insights into client-ready briefing decks.Develop an understanding of Deloitte’s solutions, services, and offerings.Requisite experience and skills6-9 years of experience in supporting/managing research projects in government and public sector topic areas.Business research/thought leadership development in the public sector industry or sub-sectors is preferred. Knowledge of the U.S. public sector market or a few public policy areas, such as health care, education, human services, infrastructure, and transportation, will be an advantage. Understanding the impact of AI and other emerging technologies on government operations and public policy.Sound analytical skills with experience in one or more of the following research methods: Primary research (surveys), secondary research, academic research, and case study research. Strong data analysis skills with the ability to work with quantitative and qualitative data – interpret, analyze, visualize, and provide data-driven insights. Ability to use statistical and advanced data analysis methods to analyze large and complex datasets, including surveys.Ability to develop compelling and analytical data visualizations using one or more tools like Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or others.Strong verbal and written communication skills. Journalistic and narrative writing style is preferred, along with prior experience in report writing and research report development. Problem-solving and critical thinking skills to generate meaningful analytical insights. Proficiency in using generative AI-based platforms and tools to elevate research discovery, data insights, analytical rigor, and business writing. Familiarity with building custom GPTs and custom gen-AI research tools will be an added advantage.Broad understanding of strategy models and frameworks, and the ability to apply them to research problems.Experience working with US/global clients and teams is preferred. Since the job requires working closely with US-based colleagues, the ability to work across cultures is important.The broader Deloitte Research and Insights teamThe Deloitte Research and Insights teams’ mission is to conduct research and analysis to develop compelling, forward-looking perspectives that enable clients to anticipate, prepare for, and respond to “what’s coming next.”The team plays an integral role in strengthening the firm’s strategic positioning by developing high-quality thoughtware from end to end, published on Deloitte Insights and Deloitte.com.Their work includes:• Managing relations with internal stakeholders.• Using advanced data science and survey advisory capabilities to strengthen the credibility of insights.• Using editorial and visualization capabilities to improve the stickiness of firm thoughtware.Qualifications, experience, work location, and timing• Academic qualification: Master’s Degree like MBA, PGDM, Economics, Business Economics• Work experience: 6-9 years• Location: Mumbai• Work hours: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM IST

title: USI FY27 | Cyber Operate - Digital Identity - Saviynt - Consultant
description: As an experienced Solution Delivery Lead at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements. Work you'll do As a Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for supporting Saviynt operations, service delivery, and IAM platform stability. title: USI-EH27- MF Canada- Disaster Recovery Specialist- L35 Senior Analyst
description: Senior Analyst Disaster recovery Specialist supports the planning, testing, and continuous improvement of disaster recovery capabilities across technology environments. Covering seven distinct areas; Human Resources, Clients & Industries, Finance & Legal, Practice Support Services, Quality & Risk Services, IT Services, and Workplace Services & Real Estate, together we live, breathe and deliver the Deloitte experience.Location: HyderabadShift Timings: 2 PM to 11 PM ISTQualificationsRequired:Bachelor’s degree or equivalent3+ years of experience in disaster recovery, business continuity, information technology security, or information technology infrastructure rolesExperience developing and maintaining disaster recovery plans, recovery procedures, and supporting documentationExperience conducting business impact analyses, risk assessments, and recovery planning activitiesExperience coordinating and executing disaster recovery testing exercises, including tabletop simulations or failover testsExperience with backup, failover, or recovery technologies such as Veeam, Azure Site Recovery, Amazon Web Services Backup, or ZertoPreferred:Experience with cloud-based disaster recovery strategies in Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google CloudExperience supporting compliance, control, or audit activities aligned to ISO 22301, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or NIST 800-34Experience with ServiceNow Business Continuity, Integrated Risk Management, or Governance, Risk, and Compliance modulesExperience with automation or scripting using PowerShell or PythonOne or more certifications such as Certified Business Continuity Professional, Certified Information Systems Security Professional, Information Technology Infrastructure Library, or Disaster Recovery Institute International certification

Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.Position SummaryLevel: Manager Build and lead engineering teams that deliver scalable, secure, and high-quality technology solutions aligned to cyber transformation objectives. As an Engineering Manager II, you will drive execution across the software development lifecycle, partner with cross-functional stakeholders, and help modernize engineering practices to support client and business needs. This role requires strong delivery management, technical oversight, and the ability to guide teams through complex implementation work.Work you'll doAs an Engineering Manager II on the Cyber Strategy & Transformation team, you will be responsible for… Leading engineering teams in the design, build, testing, deployment, and support of technology solutions Managing project delivery plans, team priorities, and execution timelines across multiple workstreams Partnering with product, architecture, cyber, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions Establishing engineering standards, delivery controls, and quality practices across the development lifecycle Coaching engineers and technical leads to improve delivery consistency, issue resolution, and team performance The TeamCyber Strategy & Transformation teams develop and transform cyber programs in line with a client's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite. They keep the enterprise a step ahead of the evolving threat landscape and give stakeholders confidence in the organization's cyber posture. Services include the design of cyber organization, governance, and risk assessments. Services also encompass Cybersecurity Assessments and Frameworks, Cyber Transformation Management, Technology Software and Asset Compliance Management, Third Party Risk Management, Cyber Risk and Compliance, Solution Design and Implementation, and Cyber Risk Analytics and Quantification Reporting.QualificationsRequired: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field 9+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, or cyber technology delivery 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams, technical leads, or delivery workstreams Experience managing application development, system integration, or platform implementation programs Experience with Agile delivery, sprint planning, backlog management, and release coordination Experience working with cloud platforms, application architecture, and secure development practices Preferred: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or Cybersecurity Experience supporting cyber transformation, risk, compliance, or security technology programs Experience with DevSecOps, continuous integration, and continuous deployment practices Experience with engineering governance, metrics reporting, and delivery quality controls Experience working with enterprise stakeholders across product, architecture, operations, and risk teams Industry certifications in cloud, cybersecurity, Agile, or program deliveryLocation: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/ChennaiShift Timings: General Shift #FY27ReferralCampaign

title: USI-EH27-Tax-BTS-Tax Operate-GCC -L45-Tax Senior
description: BTS Tax Operate – Tax SeniorRole summary The Tax Senior will support day-to-day engagement management across U.S. domestic and global tax compliance engagements, helping drive delivery coordination, governance, status visibility, and issue resolution. The role is execution-focused, with responsibility for tracking workplans, monitoring deadlines, supporting deliverable management, and maintaining a strong client and internal service experience across the engagement lifecycle.Engagement Management and Delivery Support Support day-to-day governance and project management across tax compliance engagements, ensuring transparency into the client’s tax compliance and reporting process through Deloitte platforms. Plan and execute against client service plans and maintain detailed workplans covering scope, timelines, dependencies, roles, and deliverables. Monitor engagement activity against established protocols and filing calendars; proactively flag delays, risks, and follow-up actions. Track deliverables and return status across teams to help ensure completeness, timeliness, and accurate reporting. Document issues, actions taken, and resolutions thoroughly and in line with engagement protocols. Identify and escalate delivery issues promptly, and actively support issue resolution. Prepare periodic status reports, dashboards, and trackers to support visibility for clients and engagement leadership. Contribute ideas for process improvements and support implementation of more efficient ways of working. U.S. Tax Compliance Responsibilities Support governance and project management across U.S. corporate income tax and investment management tax compliance engagements, including federal and state compliance, tax provisions, extensions, quarterly estimates, partnership returns, K-1 preparation and distribution, fund and entity-level reporting, and related activities. Coordinate day-to-day U.S. compliance activities, including document and data requests, workpaper tracking, review readiness, and filing support. Monitor service line activity and filing deadlines across workstreams, and help drive timely follow-up with the right teams. Manage staffing assignments and task allocations across service lines based on timing, complexity, and team capacity. Support engagement financial tracking, including budget monitoring, variance analysis, billing support, and scope renewal coordination. Coordinate with service line teams as needed, including SALT, international tax, credits and incentives, and tax controversy. Global Tax Compliance Responsibilities Support global governance and project management for global tax compliance engagements and help provide transparency into the client’s compliance and reporting process through the Deloitte platform. Monitor execution against global client service plans and support consistent delivery across jurisdictions. Track local member firm compliance with engagement protocols and filing deadlines. Monitor whether engagement deliverables are posted and whether return status is accurately documented by local territory teams. Identify and escalate local country issues promptly in accordance with communication protocols, and actively support issue resolution. Work with local and regional member firms to resolve issues, share insights, and improve delivery efficiency. Prepare or review periodic engagement status reports for client use. Support recurring calls with clients, Global Engagement Coordinators, and local country teams to discuss compliance status, obligations, and open items. Transitions, Scope, and Fee Management Support transition activities for new engagements and client onboarding, including status tracking, documentation, and coordination across teams. Work with Staff and Deloitte teams to set up web-based platforms for service delivery tracking. Maintain transition trackers and follow up on milestones to keep onboarding activity current and visible. Draft or support drafting the Statement of Work, including scope boundaries, assumptions, deliverables, and scope and fee management. Track scope and fee changes and escalate to engagement leadership as appropriate. Pursuits and Commercial Support Review RFPs and assist with setup of new opportunities in Pursuit Manager for new clients. Follow up with local member firms on pursuit inputs and response timelines. Review fees provided by local member firms against indicative fees and raise questions on assumptions or gaps. Prepare client-facing fee files and assumptions for Manager or Senior Manager review. Client Communication and Stakeholder Coordination Build strong working relationships with client tax and finance stakeholders, Deloitte engagement leaders, and internal delivery teams. Facilitate recurring calls with clients and internal teams to discuss status, open items, deadlines, and issue resolution. Translate engagement activity into clear status updates, actions required, and next steps for both client and internal audiences. Maintain disciplined follow-up on actions, deliverables, and unresolved items to strengthen visibility and trust. Team Support and Development Coach and support Staff team members through day-to-day guidance, training, and timely feedback. Contribute to a positive learning environment that encourages accountability, collaboration, and operational discipline. Continue building technical and operational knowledge by staying current on developments in tax compliance, reporting, and engagement management practices. Apply training and experience to real-life engagement scenarios with sound judgment and attention to detail. Qualifications / Experience Post-graduation/master’s in business administration or a related field preferred. 5+ years of relevant experience in engagement management, project management office support, tax operations, or related service delivery roles. Experience supporting U.S. corporate income tax compliance, investment management tax compliance, tax accounting/provision, and/or global tax compliance and reporting environments. Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to facilitate meetings, take structured notes, and communicate clearly with clients and senior stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple engagements and workstreams simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and adapt to changing timelines and scope. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving ability, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues. Comfort with regular interaction with client stakeholders, Partners, Directors, Senior Managers, and broader engagement teams. Strong technology skills, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, and SharePoint. Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity and workflow tools is a plus.

Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn and support practice U.S. taxation, a much sought-after career option. In recent years, member firms, such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, etc. have obtained support in their tax related practice through the Deloitte Tax in India.At Deloitte, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.Position Summary Drive German business tax compliance activities for corporate entities by leading the preparation and review of tax reporting, tax returns, dividend withholding tax returns, and law firm tax return submissions. This role offers the opportunity to manage complex deliverables, guide team members across experience levels, and support a high-quality, deadline-driven tax compliance process. The Senior Manager, Tax Services will also help strengthen operating effectiveness through onboarding, work allocation, training, and process documentation initiatives.Work you'll doAs a Senior description: Tax Manager – US Global Employer ServicesDo you have a passion to work for US based clients of Deloitte Tax and transform their current state of tax to the next generation of tax functions? Are you ready to take the next step in your career to find new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations? Are you ready to fulfill your potential and want to have a significant impact to global initiatives? If the answer to all of the above is “Yes,” come join Business Tax Services group in Deloitte India (Offices of the U.S), a service line of Deloitte Tax LLP!Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a much sought-after career option.At Deloitte, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace.  We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment. Work you’ll do To list some of key responsibilities: -·   The U.S. India Tax Compliance Group works with global clients to provide tax compliance services, including income and several other tax return preparations, and computations.·   Specifically, this position will focus on providing individual tax return compliance process services, including assignment cost projections, tax accounting, and related income tax compliance research for U.S. federal, state, and international tax matters, and identification and preparation of advisory services related to income tax matters. ·   Responsibilities will include review and concur review (signing) of individual income tax returns, conduct US tax law research, manage tax consulting projects, and assist in the administration of international assignment programs.·   The ideal candidate for this position would embrace the opportunity to work with Deloitte US and global member firms around the world, and to build extensive knowledge in the field of U.S. income tax, be detail oriented, and have excellent people, team management, project management, and leadership skills. ·   The position includes comprehensive and potential opportunity to visit the US on a short-term (less than six months) assignment.The Team Accelerating globalization, growing regulatory and business complexity, and evolution of tax technology is creating ever-increasing expectations for tax executives. At Deloitte, we are leading clients through change, uncovering insights and providing strategic value to organizations. Our approach combines insight and innovation from multiple disciplines with business and industry knowledge to help serve our clients with distinction.  You will be based in India and are part of the US team serving our U.S. based clients. Qualifications and ExperienceRequired:ü  Full time Masters in Business Administration (MBA) in Finance or equivalent from reputed University ü  5-8 or more years of related experience of international assignee populations of multi-national clients, with at least 3 years in expatriate and foreign national tax compliance and preparation of tax equalization calculations, and general understanding of tax equalization process/implementation.ü  Adequate level of familiarity with US federal and state income tax legislation including foreign national and expatriate tax issues.ü  Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English languageü  Strong accounting knowledgeü  Critical thinking and analytical skillsü  Knowledge on Microsoft Office products — Excel, Word, etc.ü  Aptitude for learning technology (proprietary tools such as Tracker)ü  Enrolled Agent (EA) designation required Work Location: Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Mumbai, Pune, Kolkata and Gurgaon#CA-GSD #CA-HPNAccountingFY26

title: USI-EH-27-Tax-TTC-CLM-L55 - Manager- DocuSign
description: Manager - Tax Technology Consulting - DocuSign - CLMThe role of technology in tax and legal functions has grown exponentially in importance as resource needs change and tax regulations and legal management become more rigorous.   If you are someone who thrives in navigating the growing tax and legal landscape through a technology lens and partnering with passionate professionals to help companies achieve their objectives; then we would like to get to know you.  Apply now! What you’ll doAs a professional in Deloitte’s Tax Technology Consulting (TTC) team, you will be a part of a team that provides an integrated approach to technology implementations, automation, data wrangling, managed legal services and analytics that help tax and legal departments maximize the strategic value to the organization.  You will deliver technical services for companies that streamline their process and increase efficiency; leveraging, integrating with numerous applications, and creating custom solutions.Key responsibilities will be to:       Ø  Configure contract management technologies based on requirements documented by the TMC client facing team.       Ø  Conduct user acceptance testing to compile comprehensive test scenarios and identify flaws as well as improvements to newly built systems and processes       Ø  Gather and document contract management requirements for business and performing system fit and gap analysis.Experience Required –       Ø  5 to 10 years of total experience.       Ø  5 - 10 years of implementation experience in DocuSign CLM application.       Ø  Expert in configuring and troubleshooting DocuSign workflows.       Ø  Experience with DocuSign and API integrations is an added advantage.       Ø  DocuSign CLM Consultant certified (proctored exam).       Ø  Strong documentation skills       Ø  Lead and manage POC of latest DocuSign functionalities.       Ø  Expert in CLM configuration with template rationalization and harmonization, guide or playbook creation and the design of the contracting processes and related functionality.       Ø  Multiple successful project implementation experience in DocuSign.       Ø  Strong in project management, leadership abilities, and has tendency to independently execute project cycles and deliverables.      Relentless focus on quality of work products while adhering to completing deliverables on time       Ø  Effective communications and strong presentation and team building skills.       Ø  Proactive, participates in firm-based activities, and owns his/her career.       Ø  Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparation.       Ø  Team Management experience (For Senior Professionals). Preferred Skills:  Ø  Certifications with any of the tools mentioned, as well as PMP or PMI-ACP, and/or Scrum Master  Ø  Experience with DocuSign CLM implementation  Ø  Experience in DocuSign AI, would be added advantage.Education/Background:·       Engineering with overall experience in functional consulting and coding.The teamAt Deloitte Tax LLP, our Tax Technology Consulting (TTC) practice helps tax departments pursue a streamlined, transparent, and efficient tax function that enhances the core responsibilities of compliance, reporting and planning, while also positioning tax as a strategic business advisor for the digital era. We specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. As technology specialists, we help clients make appropriate technology choices for both direct and indirect taxes across all business cycles that have a tax impact tax. Our team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients with a successful ERP implementation.Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to support our clients’ objectives and address their challenges. Our team’s multi-disciplinary approach combines tax technical and technology skillsets, enabling greater impact and efficiency within our client’s organization. TTC’s business services help clients with operating model evaluation, roadmap development for a desired future state, data management solutions, automation opportunities, tax portal, cloud for enterprise systems, agile resourcing models, risk, provision, and compliance.  Learn more about Deloitte Tax Management Consulting.Our purpose Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our clients, our people, and in our communities. We are creating trust and confidence in a more equitable society. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. We are focusing our collective efforts to advance sustainability, equity, and trust that come to life through our core commitments. Learn more about Deloitte’s purpose, commitments, and impact.  Our inclusive culture At Deloitte, we value our people and work to build an inclusive culture, where our people are encouraged to bring their authentic selves to work. Our commitment has led to outstanding results in terms of attracting, retaining, and advancing a diverse workforce. We drive multiple efforts focused on intentional hiring, increasing awareness and sensitization, and ensuring a safe work environment for all professionals. We are regularly recognized as an employer of choice across a range of aspects, including inclusion, well-being, innovation, leadership, and a place to start your career. To learn more, check out our latest accolades.  Professional development At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state-of-the-art, world-class learning center in the Hyderabad office, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.  Benefits to help you thrive At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.  Recruiting tips From developing a standout resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. title: USI | FY27 | Audit & Assurance | L35 - Senior Assistant, Valuation and Analytics Advisory
description: Senior Assistant, Valuation and Analytics AdvisoryJoin Deloitte’s Valuation and Analytics Advisory practice to support clients through complex valuation, financial analysis, and advisory matters. In this role, you will contribute to analyses used in strategic decision-making, financial reporting, transactions, and other business-critical situations. The role offers exposure to cross-functional teams, analytical problem-solving, and client-facing deliverables in a dynamic professional services environment.Work you'll doThe key job responsibilities include the following:• The work will focus on independent pricing of financial instruments, building and executing data analytics to support audit objectives, using vendor data and tools such as Capital IQ, Refinitive Eikon, Markit, Superderivatives, FinMechanics etc.• Serve as a team member on engagements where responsibilities include detailed execution of valuation and modeling projects and documentation of modeling methodologies and results.• Preparing audit documentation of valuations.• Ability to collaborate with audit teams across companies of all sizes and across multiple industries.• Handling price challenges from the audit team and ability to explain difficult financial modeling/valuation concepts to diverse audiences and to experts at various clients• Responsible for building and managing relationships and communications with audit team members.Location: Gurugram/ BengaluruQualifications:• 2-4 years of experience with graduation in Financial Engineering/ Quantitative Finance/ BE/ BTech/ MBA(Finance)/ Statistics.• CFA/ FRMRequired• Exposure to Derivatives, Fixed Income instruments, Private Debt, MBS, ABS, CLOs, Energy & Commodities, probability, statistics and risk management.• Familiarity with analytical and visualization software packages/tools/languages (i.e. Python , SAS, R, SQL, Power BI, Python, Visual Basic).Preferred:• Strong undergraduates with engineering/ mathematics and statistics background and/or relevant work experience in financial services and capital markets would be considered. Additionally, candidates with background in probability and statistics with CFA/ FRM/PRM would be preferred.• Background in financial derivatives, structured products and energy and commodities including detailed knowledge of valuation model and techniques is a plus.• Experience with handling large data set for Interest rates, Fx, Credit and Equity from different market vendors is a plus.• Strong analytical and computer skills including experience with quantitative analysis technical tools and techniques such as Refinitive, Markit, Capital IQ, Bloomberg, Monte-Carlo Simulation tools such as Crystal Ball and @Risk, FinCAD, Numerix, Savysoft TOPS, Principia, Super Derivatives, are a plus.• Background in mathematical finance at the level of a Master's level degree in Mathematical Finance, Mathematics of Finance, Financial Engineering or Quantitative Finance is a strong plus.• Experience with programming laguages including SAS, Python and R is highly desired.• Familiarity with financial markets, financial instrument valuation (including derivatives and structured products), trading, deal structuring or risk management is desired.• Experience with Asset Liability Management (ALM) or Counterparty Valuation Adjustment (CVA) is a plus.• Experience with SPAN/clearing/margin models is a plus.Personal characteristics should include:• Presentation, consulting, project management, client, and training / mentoring skills; strong presence, good communication and interpersonal skills.• Conceptual and quantitative depth in valuation methodologies and concepts and underlying markets and models.• Ability to explain difficult financial modeling/valuation concepts to diverse audiences and to experts at various clients.• Related consulting experience is a plus.

title: USI FY27 | Cyber Operate - One Identity Manager - Senior Consultant
description: Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance. Work you'll do As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for supporting identity and access management delivery through One Identity Manager development, integration, and access governance activities. Architect, develop, and maintain custom workflows and connectors within One Identity Manager to support secure identity lifecycle management. Design and implement Angular-based interfaces for IAM self-service and administration and integrate IAM solutions with enterprise platforms using REST APIs and custom connectors. Manage user lifecycle activities, including access requests, approvals, provisioning, recertification, business role assignments, and Segregation of Duties controls. Lead onboarding and access administration for applications, security groups, shared mailboxes, distribution groups, file shares, local non-personal accounts, database assets, and Azure resources. Troubleshoot complex integration issues and collaborate with security architects, IT operations, and business stakeholders to support IAM strategy, compliance, and operational improvements. The team Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes: Managing Identity Lifecycle Security Operations Threat Intelligence Application Security Business Transformation Continuous Compliance. Cyber Operate team focuses on efficiently running operations by enabling automation, reducing manual effort and adhering to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) based on the standards set by clients. Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai Shift Timings: 24*7 rotational shifts; night, weekend, and holiday coverage required; on-call support based on project assignments Qualifications Required: Experience developing and maintaining workflows, connectors, and configurations in One Identity Manager Experience building Angular-based interfaces for identity and access management use cases Experience integrating identity and access management solutions with Active Directory, Azure Active Directory, ServiceNow, human resources systems, and databases using REST APIs or custom connectors Experience administering identity lifecycle processes, including access requests, approvals, provisioning, recertification, and business role assignments Experience managing access for applications, security groups, shared mailboxes, distribution groups, file shares, local non-personal accounts, and database assets Experience supporting cloud and infrastructure access governance, including Privileged Identity Management, role-based access control, service principals, and app registrations Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Science in Computer Science, or equivalent degree Preferred: Experience implementing business role governance and Segregation of Duties controls Experience troubleshooting complex identity and access management integration issues Experience with other identity and access management platforms used in managed services environments Experience supporting process improvement or internal training initiatives#Cyber_Cyber Operate

title: USI-EH27 - US Individual Tax - Private Client Service -L35 - Tax Consultant II - Hyderabad/Bangalore
description: Tax Consultant I/II - UK Tax - US- UK Private Position Overview Our purpose is to build a world class team for US-UK Private team (as part of UK Private Client Services team) to win and deliver the quality work and provides opportunities for the growth and development of our professionals. Our vision is to work towards full integration with the UK engagement teams to deliver all the compliance work from USI. Having this vision, we want to recruit an experienced tax technical professional to facilitate the planned financial growth and development of the team and to meet our objective of consistently being able to deliver a quality service on various engagements. The Team The UK USI PCS team is spread across five locations in India. Our US-UK Private team is involved in the preparation of US returns for high-net-worth individuals, law firm partners and corporate executives. Additionally, we do the UK returns of these US individuals as they have UK tax return filling requirement. The team executes end-to-end processes and delivers to a wide range of services in various work stream. Key responsibilities: · Analysis of the data, extracting and processing information to produce and prepare US and UK Individual Tax returns of HNIs, partners of law firms and corporate executives. · Identification and documentation of issues and preparation of client queries. · Ensure quality is of the highest standard and the client service is exceptional. · Working with the UK team as part of a wider team to complete required volumes of work and building a long-term relationship with the engagement managers. · Other US and UK Individual Tax compliance related tasks as part of our full engagement service. Qualifications and Experience · 1-2 years of experience in preparation of US and UK Individual Tax returns (for HNIs corporate execs and law firm partners). · Proficiency in US concepts such as residency, investment portfolio; foreign account reporting is desired. · Good working knowledge of US forms (such as K-1, 1099, 1042-S; 8865; 926), Additional knowledge on Passive foreign Investment Companies (PFIC); Foreign tax credit and sourcing of income could be a bonus point. · Experience of assisting in developing and maintaining relationship with client teams. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. · EA qualification, or equivalent, is desirable but not essential. Support will be available to sit these exams or to expand any existing qualifications, together with further applicable learning. · Strong attention to detail and ability to stay calm under pressure. · Ability to follow defined procedures and protocols. Methodical and organised working skills. · Proactive approach to work and completing work by required deadlines. · Excellent IT skills including a good understanding of Excel. title: USI - EH27 - Product Engineering CSG - Full Stack Software Engineer - Deputy Manager
description: L45 - Software Specialist Engineer IIRole Overview: As a Full-stack Software Engineer, you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to multiple high-visibility projects. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering solutions that delight customers and users, while also driving tangible value for Deloitte's business investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftmanship across multiple programming languages and modern frameworks, consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy advanced software solutions.Key Responsibilities:Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations.Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring code integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals. Lead requirement analysis, component design, development, unit testing, integrations, and support.Engineering Craftsmanship: Maintain accountability for the integrity of code design, implementation, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Be hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code ensuring all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.Customer-Centric Engineering: Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time.Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions.Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.Advanced Technical Proficiency: Possess deep expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including Agile methodologies and DevSecOps to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from code check-in to production with all quality checks through SDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Demonstrate understanding of the full lifecycle product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.Domain Expertise: Quickly acquire domain-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs, architectures, and UX/UI designs into technical specifications and code. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.Effective Communication and Influence: Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.Key Qualifications:§  A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline. An advanced degree (e.g., MS) is preferred but not required. Experience is the most relevant factor.§  Strong software engineering foundation with the understanding of OOPs, data-structure, algorithms, code instrumentations, beautiful coding practices, etc. §  5+ years proven experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python, C#, .NET Core, Java, Golang, SQL/NoSQL.§  5+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering, using FaaS/PaaS/micro-services on cloud hyper-scalers like Azure, AWS, and GCP.§  Strong understanding of methodologies & tools like, XP, Lean, SAFe, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, etc. to deliver high quality products rapidly.§  Strong preference will be given to candidates with experience in AI/ML and GenAI.§  Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.How You will Grow: At Deloitte, our professional development plans focus on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day and excel in everything they do.#ProductEngineeringFY26

We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.Position SummaryLevel: Consultant, Managed Services or equivalentAs an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, and operations specialists, we deliver end-to-end solutions—from initial concept and agile development to ongoing digital operations—enabling clients to experiment, iterate, and scale digital initiatives with confidence and agility. We support clients across domains such as strategy, commerce, marketing, sales, and service, helping them realize their digital ambitions through flexible, scalable teams. Our expertise spans the full digital lifecycle, including customer research, experience design, platform development, content production, and marketing automation. Hands-on experience of C#, VB.net, ASP.NET, HTML and Java scriptIn depth knowledge of Dynamics product offerings and featuresHands on experience with Data Conversion and Data LoadingHands on experience with real-time and batch integration with proficiency in SSISHands on experience with SSRS report, or Power BI developmentShould have working knowledge of version control systems like GitHub, etc.Must be well verse with release management processesMust have hands-on experience of working in projects in agile cadenceWorking experience of JIRA/ADO or similar toolGood to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:Knowledge of SQL Server, Active Directory, Azure Activity Directory, ADFS, SharePoint, Office365, Yammer, Windows Server stackEducation:BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university   Location:Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

title: USI - EH27 - Product Engineering - Product Manager - Assistant /Deputy Manager
description: A Lead Product Analyst (Assistant Manager) is a mid-level individual contributor responsible for ensuring a product’s value and viability within a product line. This role involves leading empowered, cross-functional product teams to solve customer problems that align with business needs. Being a mid-level product management role, you will have the opportunity to own products of lesser complexity that drive business value. The Lead Product Analyst, like any of our product managers, is accountable for the product’s success, from vision to execution, and collaborates closely with various functions and stakeholders to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. Work you'll do As a Product Management Specialist II on the product management team, you will be responsible for: Defining and advancing product vision, strategy, and roadmap priorities aligned with business objectives and customer needs Establishing, monitoring, and analyzing key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product performance and inform decisions Partnering with business, engineering, experience, and delivery stakeholders to translate priorities into actionable product plans Conducting user research, stakeholder engagement, and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and shape solutions Driving continuous improvement by removing obstacles, supporting experimentation, and sharing product management practices across the team The team You will join a cross-functional team focused on delivering product solutions that address business priorities and improve user outcomes. The team collaborates closely across business, engineering, experience, and delivery to shape strategy, evaluate opportunities, and bring scalable solutions to market. This environment emphasizes evidence-based decision-making, continuous learning, and shared ownership of product outcomes. Location: Hyderabad, Bengaluru Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM Qualifications Required: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field 5-8+ years of experience in product management, product analysis, product owner, or similar roles Experience defining product vision, roadmap, backlog priorities, or release plans for a product or product capability Experience establishing, tracking, and analyzing key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product outcomes Experience working with business stakeholders, engineering, user experience, and delivery teams in a cross-functional environment Experience conducting user research, market analysis, or competitive analysis to support product decisions Experience supporting product value, viability, and business objectives, including profit and loss (P&L) measures Preferred: Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or Kanban delivery environments Experience using product management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Confluence Experience using reporting or analytics tools such as Tableau or Power BI Experience facilitating roadmap reviews, backlog refinement, or stakeholder workshops Experience working across enterprise platforms or multiple business domains

description: As an experienced Consultant Lead at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Lead high-priority Okta identity and access management managed services operations, ensuring service excellence, stability, and client satisfaction. title: USI-EH27-G&P-BM&C-Internal Comms (Web Development) - Software Engineer III - Hyderabad
description: Deloitte US-India Communications – Software Engineer III Project Management – Web Development & Technical Delivery – Communications, Media & Technology, USI Growth and Purpose About the role As a Project Management – Web Development & Technical Delivery Lead, you will lead planning and delivery of web solutions across Deloitte’s internal platforms, with a primary focus on SharePoint-based solutions and associated front-end/custom development. You will own end-to-end project management, drive delivery excellence through strong governance and stakeholder management, and bring a hands-on technical expertise to translate requirements into clear delivery plans and actionable execution. With 7 to 9 years of experience, you will also coach and mentor junior team members, collaborate closely with stakeholders, and champion innovative, user-focused solutions. This role offers opportunities to drive design excellence, influence digital strategy, and manage complex projects within a dynamic, high-performing environment. What you’ll do Lead end-to-end delivery of web development projects on SharePoint and related internal platforms, managing scope, schedule, resourcing, risks, and quality from intake to launch. Establish and run project governance including workplans, RAID (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) tracking, decision logs, change control, status reporting, and stakeholder readouts—ensuring predictable execution across multiple concurrent initiatives. ·       Technical Planning & Coordination: Translate business needs into well-defined technical requirements and delivery plans; partner closely with developers, designers, content owners, and platform stakeholders to ensure feasible solutions aligned to standards and constraints. ·       Hands-on Technical Contribution: Provide technical oversight and occasional hands-on support related to SharePoint configuration, front-end development, web components/scripts, or code review to ensure quality, maintainability, and adherence to standards. ·       Stakeholder & Communication Excellence: Serve as a primary point of contact for internal stakeholders—facilitating requirements workshops, managing expectations, communicating tradeoffs, and maintaining strong alignment on priorities, timelines, and outcomes. ·       Quality, Risk, and Compliance Mindset: Ensure solutions align with brand standards, accessibility expectations, and applicable risk/technical policies; define quality checks and acceptance criteria and drive disciplined UAT (user acceptance testing) and release readiness. ·       Team Leadership & Performance Management: Manage performance and development for team members through goal setting, regular feedback, coaching, and formal performance inputs; build an environment of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. ·       Continuous Improvement & Innovation: Identify delivery bottlenecks and implement process improvements; promote best practices in agile/iterative delivery, documentation, and operational excellence. Leverage AI tools (e.g., for summarization, drafting, backlog grooming support, test case generation, documentation acceleration) for improving team productivity and quality. Qualifications required: Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related fields. 7–9 years of experience in digital delivery/project management, preferably including SharePoint-based web development in an enterprise environment.Project Management Expertise: Demonstrated experience managing end-to-end delivery using established project management methodologies (agile, hybrid, or waterfall as appropriate).Strong command of project management tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, MS Project, Smartsheet, Confluence, SharePoint lists/planners, or equivalent).Ability to manage scope, estimates, timelines, dependencies, budget/resource constraints (where applicable), and change control.Technical & Platform Understanding (SharePoint/Web):Strong working knowledge of SharePoint (Online preferred) and web delivery concepts (information architecture, publishing, permissions, environment management, release cycles).Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and common front-end patterns; able to collaborate effectively with engineering teams and review technical approaches for feasibility and risk.People Leadership & Performance Management:Prior experience leading small teams and managing performance outcomes; skilled at coaching, delegation, quality review, and developing talent.Ability to set clear expectations, provide actionable feedback, and create development plans aligned to team needs and individual growth.Business & Communication Skills:Excellent written and verbal communication skills; confident presenting status, decisions, and tradeoffs to internal stakeholders and leadership.AI Fluency:Comfortable using AI tools to improve delivery efficiency (documentation, meeting notes, backlog refinement, drafting communications, test/support artifacts), with sound judgment on confidentiality and quality validation.Detail-oriented, proactive, and outcomes-driven; strong collaboration skills; ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-visibility environment. This role will be based out of Hyderabad. Work timings: 11 a.m. – 8 p.m. (IST) About the team USI Communications is a team of professionals who specialize in Internal Communications, Public Relations and Communication Technology. The team reinforces the culture and brand of Deloitte internally and monitors our external reputation – intervening where necessary. They also play the role of a strategic and trusted business advisor for leaders and ensure that professionals are equipped with the right information in a timely manner to excel at work and enjoy well-being. Other priorities include creating an open and transparent environment for leadership communications, leveraging internal channels creatively, effectively disseminating information, and measuring the impact of communications.

Are you passionate about advancing content strategy and leveraging GenAI to transform how business problems are solved? If so, you may be a strong fit for our First Draft Proposal team. As a First Draft Support member, you will focus on developing timely, high-quality first drafts of proposals and other pursuit materials using approved templates, standard language, and provided inputs such as client information, partner details, and engagement specifics.This is an execution-focused role that supports the early stages of the pursuit lifecycle by assembling content efficiently, accurately, and consistently. In this role, you will collaborate with pursuit professionals, build foundational proposal and content development skills, and contribute to Deloitte’s pursuit success.Work you'll doAs a First Draft Support team member, you will: Develop initial drafts of proposal documents and related pursuit materials using approved templates and standardized content. Play a lead role in advancing content strategy for First Draft team within the Pursuit Management organization. Participate in the design, curation, and optimization of pursuit content including templates and AI-enhanced proposal drafts, while integrating advanced technologies. Customize templates with client-specific details, engagement information, and other provided inputs. Leverage data-driven insights and stakeholder feedback to enhance the relevance, consistency, and impact of proposal content. Use approved GenAI tools and standard prompts to support rapid first-draft creation, content assembly, and formatting within defined guidelines. Follow established content management practices, including repositories, file-naming conventions, and version control standards, to support efficient review and reuse. Assemble and format proposal components such as cover pages, template-based executive summaries, resumes, credentials, and qualifications. Compile inputs from multiple sources and ensure content is complete, accurate, and correctly placed within documents. Provide guidance and training to the First Draft team on integrating GenAI tools into content management workflows. Apply brand, formatting, and compliance standards to ensure materials meet quality expectations prior to handoff. Perform editing, proofreading, and quality checks to ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness. Leverage content libraries, repositories, and leading practice materials to support quick turnaround times. Support the development of client-facing deliverables, including first-draft proposals, presentations, and meeting materials. Work independently or as part of a broader pursuit support team, depending on business needs and deadlines. The teamOur team culture is collaborative, supportive, and focused on continuous learning.
