title: USI-EH27-G&P-BM&C-Internal Comms(Sports comms)-Assistant Manager-Hyderabad
description: Communications – Specialist Assistant Manager Sports SGM Commercialization, Strategic Growth Market About the role: Are you energized by the power of storytelling and eager to shape the conversation within a dynamic organization? As a communications professional supporting the Sports Strategic Growth Market (SGM) team, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving change management and crafting internal communications that help convert Deloitte’s Sports platform—especially LA28 (Los Angeles 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games) and related sponsorship/market activity (e.g., McLaren Racing, Women’s National Basketball Association (WNBA), U.S. Open, United States Golf Association (USGA), U.S. Soccer, National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL))—into clear, consistent internal narratives, enablement, and operating rhythms that mobilize stakeholders and drive pipeline, pursuits, and wins. The ideal candidate will connect the dots across a complex, matrixed environment—partnering with Sports leadership, commercialization, sponsorship activation, ecosystem/alliance teams, and offering/portfolio stakeholders—to increase adoption of new ways of working, improve readiness for market moments, and ensure measurable outcomes. The work you will do • Support change management for Sports SGM commercialization • Support delivery of change initiatives tied to the evolving Sports SGM commercialization model (e.g., new operating rhythms, “ways of working,” measurement expectations, activation workflows). • Conduct stakeholder analysis and change impact assessments to identify who is affected (account teams, practice leaders, alliance teams, brand/marketing, experience teams) and what must change (behaviors, tools, approvals, cadence). • Build and maintain a change plan (readiness, communications, training/enablement, reinforcement) aligned to priority cohorts and go-to-market plays. • Design and facilitate adoption mechanisms: office hours, listening sessions, pilot feedback loops, retrospectives, and continuous improvement backlog. • Execute the Sports SGM internal communications strategy • Execute an integrated internal communications plan that educates and engages cross-firm stakeholders on Sports SGM priorities, sponsorship activations, go-to-market (GTM) plays, and measurable outcomes. • Translate strategy into crisp, action-oriented messaging with clear “what’s changing / what to do next / who owns it.” • Maintain an editorial calendar and publishing cadence (weekly/biweekly) aligned to market moments, priority pursuits, and leadership milestones. • Create enablement and “activation-ready” assets • Produce high-quality communications and enablement materials: leader updates, newsletters/blurbs, intranet copy, “market moment” briefs, FAQs, talk tracks, executive-ready slides, and ready-to-forward messages for account teams. • Collaborate with Brand, Marketing, and Communication teams to enable the design of assets, creation of digital and media assets to support key activations and campaigns, and management of the end-to-end creation process • Develop practical tools that drive adoption (quick reference guides, role-based toolkits, checklists, readiness briefs, stakeholder maps, post-event follow-up kits). • Package Sports sponsorships and experiences into internal storylines that make it easy to activate (who to target, why now, what to say, what to do). • Activate stakeholders around market moments and sponsorship programming • Support communications and change readiness for major events/activations (pre/during/post), including run-of-show comms, escalation paths, and post-market “speed-to-action” workflows. • Coordinate “post-market” reinforcement: action prompts for account teams, pursuit activation checklists, and capture of wins/lessons learned. • Navigate governance, rights, and brand requirements • Help make “what’s allowed / what’s recommended / what needs approval” easy to understand by coordinating with brand, sponsorship, alliance, and legal/rightsholder stakeholders. • Coordinate reviews/approvals and manage version control to deliver accurate, timely, compliant materials. Qualifications: Required • Graduate or postgraduate degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Advertising, English, or a related field. • 6–8 years of experience in a communications function, with at least three years in a large-scale or global organization. • 4+ years of experience in change management support, change communications/enablement, internal communications, or related consulting/project delivery roles (professional services or similarly matrixed environment preferred). • Proven success in developing and executing internal communications strategies/plans for a large business, preferably in professional services. • Demonstrated ability to translate complex, ambiguous topics into clear narratives and actionable enablement. • Strong stakeholder management skills; comfort working with senior leaders and cross-functional teams through influence. • Solid organizational and project management skills with the ability to prioritize and manage expectations across multiple complex projects/priorities with tight timelines. • High attention to detail, strong follow-through, and comfort operating in fast-paced environments, with cross-functional virtual teams. • Proficient in MS Office suite—including Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint and One Drive; knowledge of the latest internal communications measurement platforms a plus • Analytical mindset, with ability to interpret data into meaningful insights and strategies. Preferred • Experience working with integrated stakeholders to define visual identity and creation of digital assets to enable communications strategy • Experience conducting stakeholder analyses, change impact assessments, and readiness activities for enterprise initiatives. • Experience working across time zones and collaborating with USI teams. • Familiarity with sponsorship/partnership communications constraints (rights, approvals, brand governance). Work location: Hyderabad Work timings: 11 a.m. – 4 p.m. and 7 p.m. - 11 p.m. (IST) The team: The USI Communications team provides strategic communications that build the Deloitte brand, strengthen our reputation, and drive business performance. This is a team of trusted advisors that delivers experienced counsel and superior results to the Deloitte U.S. Firms. Specifically, we seek to link communications to business objectives and deliver "quality" over "quantity." With a focus on measurable results, we strive to identify and manage opportunities that will deliver the highest impact for our clients. The Communications Team provides strategic counsel to its clients, developing appropriate communication ideas and programs to further leadership and organizational goals.

description: Regional Audit and Assurance Delivery, Senior AnalystAs a Senior Analyst, you will be responsible for executing daily audit tasks and supporting audit operations for clients across the globe. You will work closely with onshore and offshore teams to deliver high-quality results.You will use audit tools and technology. This role requires involvement in all audit stages: planning, execution, and reporting. You will support the Team Leader to plan, execute, and report on engagements effectively.Work you’ll doAs a Senior Analyst your responsibilities include:• Performing selected audit activities as part of delivery of high-quality audits of financial statements. Audit activities will include auditing low risk low complex account balances with very limited scope of judgement.• Preparing audit documentation on limited-service catalogue in Deloitte audit software using templates to support the audit teams in all audit phases. Provide recommendations and opinions for decision making, knowing when to involve others in the process.• Using proven Deloitte audit methodologies and developing an understanding of the Deloitte Way. Use experience and knowledge to propose solutions.• Participating in a customized training program as well as coaching by senior to acquire technical know-how and become more independent.• Interacting with your team and team leader about data and information issues to ensure accuracy and high standard of work, highlighting issues as they arise.• Delivering and executing your work to the highest standard, taking ownership for your allocated tasks and completing them within stated timelines.• Taking on the role of reviewing simple audit activities completed by your junior colleagues. Acting as a buddy and coach new joiners and less experienced colleagues.• Understanding and following Deloitte policies and complying with personal and other independence requirements set by regulatory bodies and Deloitte policies relating to engagement acceptance, relationships with the client.• Acting with honesty and integrity in all areas of activity. Understanding expectations and demonstrating personal accountability for keeping performance on track and acting as a role model for other team members.• Identifying and embracing our purpose and values, put these into practice in your professional life and encourage others to do the same.• Understanding how your daily work contributes to the priorities of the team and the business. Contributing ideas to develop solutions, consulting with others as appropriate to initiate change.• Leading by example, building relationships and communicating effectively to positively influence peers and other stakeholders, both internally and externally.The TeamThe team will actively participate in the substantive and concluding phases of the audit process, focusing on low-risk, low-complexity account balances where professional judgment required is minimal.Location: HyderabadQualificationsRequired:To qualify for the role, you must have:• Graduation degree - B. Com with 2+ years of work experience at a top-tier accounting firm.• Graduates who have completed their ACCA or pursuing ACCA certification with 2+ years of relevant work experience can be considered.• Good communication skills, with ability to provide feedback and coach others.• Good analytical skills.• Systematic approach to work and ability to prioritize workload under pressure.• Attention to detail, with a sense of responsibility and delivery of results.• Good command of the Microsoft Office package (mainly Excel and Word), ability to learn new technologies effectively.• Able to work in a team and be proactive.

description: Level: Senior Consultant Work you'll do As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for: Own day-to-day Oracle Cloud ERP security operations across FSCM and HCM in a production support model. Administer and maintain user access, custom roles, data roles, security profiles, AOR assignments, and HDL-related security activities. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes: Managing Identity Lifecycle Security Operations Threat Intelligence Application Security Business Transformation Continuous Compliance Cyber Operate team focuses on efficiently running operations by enabling automation, reducing manual effort and adhering to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) based on the standards set by clients. Experience maintaining custom roles, data roles, security profiles, Area of Responsibility assignments, and HCM Data Loader security activities. Experience supporting quarterly update impact analysis, regression testing, user access reviews, audits, segregation of duties analysis, and mitigation tracking. Experience securing Oracle BI / OTBI reports, analyses, data models, and subject areas. Experience working in a ticket-based support model with service level agreements, including intake, triage, incident management, problem management, root-cause analysis, and recurring issue reduction. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent. Preferred: Experience with Oracle GRC or Oracle Risk Management Cloud operations across Advanced Access Controls, Advanced Financial Controls, and Financial Reporting Compliance. description: Regulatory, Risk & ForensicOur Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team supports client leaders to translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform organizations. Leverage advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with deep domain and industry insights to help bring clarity from complexity and accelerate the path to value creation.Position SummaryLevel: Senior Consultant or equivalentAs a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.Work you’ll do: As part of the team, you will engage closely with investment management and capital markets clients, gaining insights into their unique challenges, business contexts, and processes to devise solutions tailored to their needs. Also, an integral part of your responsibilities will encompass directing and overseeing Proof-of-Concept endeavors and consulting projects with our Process Intelligence prospects and clients. This includes defining business requirements, analyzing processes, preparing data, and deploying solutions. You will be responsible for transforming the operations of large, complex financial services organizations by analyzing the current state, identifying the gaps, building the suitable target state, and operating them further (as applicable). Additionally, you will be involved in the process of identifying, evaluating, and mitigating potential risks that could hinder the organization’s objectives. You will also be expected to work in large teams, making client conversations and providing regular updates to clients as well as Deloitte leadership.The team: Our Enterprise Operations & Risk professionals help organizations effectively navigate business risks and opportunities—from strategic, reputation, and financial risks to operational and regulatory risks—to gain competitive advantage. We apply our experience in ongoing business operations and corporate lifecycle events to help clients become stronger and more resilient. Our market-leading teams help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries. We help organizations in their efforts to achieve regulatory and legal compliance and transform their departments to add greater value to the business. We combine highly specialized skills focused on process, risk and controls to produce transformative insights. Our team:Enable profitable growth and competitive advantage by optimizing “heart of the business” operations.Leverage deep domain expertise to extend enterprise resilience, agility, and remediation.Drive enterprise- wide impact across strategy, operations, performance, and reputation.QualificationsMust Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: ·       Minimum 8 years of relevant industry experience with a financial services consulting organization or a large bank or a broker-dealer or investment management firm or GCC (Global Capability Centres) of these financial services firms.Experience and understanding of the U.S. or International Banking and Securities and Wealth Management industry. Understanding of derivatives—including Swaps, Options, Forwards, and Futures—across asset classes (Equities, Fixed Income, Foreign Exchange, Commodities).Experience in Trade Life Cycle (Onboarding/Trade Confirmation/Reconciliation/Corporate Actions/ Settlement/Transfers/Reporting) of Securities (Equities, Fixed Income, Foreign Exchange, Derivatives), Order/Execution Management Systems, and Front Office Support.Experience of end-to-end onboarding of institutional clients for derivatives products, including KYC/AML Due Diligence, Account Setup, Legal/Agreement Negotiation (e.g., ISDA/CSA documentation), Operational Go-Live.Exposure in one or more of the key areas in Capital Markets and Investment Management domains, such as Compliance Testing, Investment Compliance, Accounting, Management or similar fields.Master’s degree in finance, Business Analytics, IT, or Master of Business Administration (MBA) is preferred.Location:·       Bengaluru/Hyderabad

title: USI EH27 | Cyber Operate- Oracle SaaS ERP Security- Consultant
description: Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance. Level: Consultant Work you'll do As a Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for: Own day-to-day Oracle Cloud ERP security operations across FSCM and HCM in a production support model. Administer user access, role assignments, data security context, profiles, custom roles, data roles, security profiles, Area of Responsibility assignments, and HCM Data Loader security activities. Support secure end-to-end business processes by aligning Oracle application security with business, risk, and control requirements. Perform quarterly update impact assessments, regression testing support, access reviews, audit support, segregation of duties analysis, and mitigation tracking. Resolve security issues in an SLA-driven support model while coordinating with functional teams, developers, business owners, and information security and risk stakeholders. The team Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes: Managing Identity Lifecycle Security Operations Threat Intelligence Application Security Business Transformation Continuous Compliance Cyber Operate team focuses on efficiently running operations by enabling automation, reducing manual effort and adhering to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) based on the standards set by clients. Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai Shift Timings: 24*7 rotational shifts; flexibility for night, weekend, and holiday coverage is essential; on-call support required based on project assignment Qualifications Required: 3-6 years of experience supporting Oracle Cloud ERP security in a production support model across FSCM and HCM modules. Experience using Oracle Cloud Security Console to administer users, roles, data security context, profiles, and access changes. Experience maintaining custom roles, data roles, security profiles, Area of Responsibility assignments, and HCM Data Loader security activities. Experience supporting quarterly update impact analysis, regression testing, user access reviews, audits, segregation of duties analysis, and mitigation tracking. Experience securing Oracle BI / OTBI reports, analyses, data models, and subject areas. Experience supporting SOX-related controls and Oracle Risk Management Cloud processes in a ticket-based support model with service level agreements. Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Science in Computer Science, or equivalent. Preferred: Experience with Oracle Governance, Risk, and Compliance or Oracle Risk Management Cloud across Advanced Access Controls, Advanced Financial Controls, and Financial Reporting Compliance. Experience supporting Oracle Cloud implementation and enhancement activities. Experience across additional Oracle Cloud ERP or HCM modules. Experience in a consulting environment. Experience with automation for recurring security support activities. Experience using PL/SQL for troubleshooting and issue investigation.#Cyber_Cyber Operate

Architecting and guiding implementation of containerized, automated, and policy-driven platforms using technologies such as Kubernetes, Slurm, Run:ai, Terraform, Ansible, and GitOps. Defining infrastructure standards for observability, site reliability engineering, resilience, high availability, security, and compliance across mission-critical artificial intelligence and high-performance computing workloads. Experience designing or operating distributed compute clusters for artificial intelligence or high-performance computing in hybrid cloud environments, including multi-GPU topologies, scheduler integration, and edge-to-cloud scalability. Experience building containerized platforms using Kubernetes or Red Hat OpenShift, including GPU operators, drivers, CUDA container runtime, and cluster lifecycle automation. Experience automating infrastructure as code using Terraform, Ansible, or both. Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Science in Computer Science, Master of Technology, or equivalent from an accredited university. Preferred: Experience implementing artificial intelligence or high-performance computing cluster scheduling using Slurm, Kubernetes, or both, including multi-tenant queues, quotas, and GPU-aware policies. Experience managing generative artificial intelligence infrastructure patterns, including multi-node distributed training. Experience with artificial intelligence agents and artificial intelligence frameworks. Experience with high-throughput storage architectures for artificial intelligence or high-performance computing workloads. Experience supporting pre-sales or sales engineering activities, including discovery, solution demonstrations, proposals, or request for proposal responses. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering solutions that delight customers and users, while also driving tangible value for Deloitte's business investments. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations.Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring architectural integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals, NFRs, and applicable architecture and engineering standards—being responsible for product architecture blueprints, high-level architecture designs (e.g., “4+1 model” or relevant others), and integration architecture into the technical landscape and technology stack.Engineering Craftsmanship: Possess passion and experience as an individual contributor, responsible for the engineering designs and technical feasibility of solutions, being hands-on with design, configuration and code part of the time, contributing to team velocity. Actively get engaged with engineers to ensure architecture is understood and can be implemented, working with them closely during sprints, helping resolve any technical issues through to production operations: reviewing code, actively driving technology debt reduction, and helping drive engineering quality. Be self-driven to learn new technologies, experiment with engineers, and inspire the team to learn and drive application of those new technologies.Customer-Centric Engineering: Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams to deliver the right architectural solution for the product in the right way at the right time.Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Exhibit a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions.Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, delivery, infrastructure, and security. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.Advanced Technical Proficiency: Possess deep expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including OOD/OOP, Agile methodologies, DevSecOps, Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment, deployment techniques like Blue-Green, Canary to minimize down-time and enable A/B testing approaches. Act as a Role-Model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery, ensuring high-quality outcomes with minimal waste. Demonstrate proficiency in product development, from conceptualization and design to implementation and scaling, with a focus on continuous improvement and learning.Domain Expertise: Quickly acquire domain-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs and UX/UI designs into technical requirements and designs. Navigate various enterprise functions such as business and enabling areas as well as product, experience, delivery, infrastructure, and security to drive product value and feasibility as well as alignment with organizational goals.Effective Communication and Influence: Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence stakeholders at all levels through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence, evaluations, and research. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage and collaborate with stakeholders at all organizational levels, from team members to senior executives. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.Key Qualifications:§  A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline. An advanced degree (e.g., MS) is preferred but not required. Experience is the most relevant factor.§  Excellent software engineering and product architecture/design foundation with deep understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/ER/DFD diagrams, OOP/OOD, data-structures, algorithms, code instrumentations, etc.§  10+ years proven experience with programming languages like Angular, React, NodeJS, Python, Streamlit, C#, .NET Core, Golang, SQL/NoSQL, unit testing frameworks with 5 years’ experience in architecting enterprise solutions.§  5+ years of hands-on experience with cloud-native engineering, using FaaS/PaaS/micro-services on cloud hyper-scalers like Azure, AWS, and GCP.§  3+ years of experience with AI/ML and GenAI is preferred.§  Deep understanding of methodologies & tools like, XP, Lean, SAFe, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, etc. to deliver high quality products rapidly.§  Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.How You will Grow: At Deloitte, our professional development plans focus on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day and excel in everything they do.

description: SAP ABAP Senior ConsultantEnterprise PerformanceOur Enterprise Performance team helps clients unlock value from enterprise technology across finance, supply chain, and IT operations. As an SAP ABAP Technical Senior Consultant, you will support large-scale transformation initiatives by designing, developing, and delivering SAP technical solutions that enable core business processes.In this role, you will work with cross-functional teams to build and enhance SAP objects across reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, and workflows. You will apply your technical development experience, problem-solving skills, and delivery focus to support scalable solutions, improve system performance, and help clients advance their digital transformation objectives.Level: Senior Consultant or equivalentAs a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.Work you'll doAs a Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for: Design, build, test, and support SAP technical objects across testing and production environments. Review functional requirements and translate them into technical designs, development specifications, and solution deliverables. Develop and maintain reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, and workflow components to support business process requirements. Perform unit testing, defect analysis, deployment support, task tracking, and technical documentation to support quality and timely delivery. Collaborate with functional and global delivery teams, participate in project reviews, and mentor junior team members as needed. The teamEnterprise PerformanceOur Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions.The Enterprise Operations Portfolio is a suite of offerings designed to help clients maximize value from their Finance, Supply Chain, and IT operations. By taking a holistic approach—from strategy development to process design and technology enablement—we support clients in overcoming operational challenges and managing key business functions. As organizations pursue digital transformation, these areas become vital in shaping interactions with customers, suppliers, and stakeholders. By integrating strategy, operational improvement, implementation, and managed services, we creatively deploy resources and drive innovation, ensuring clients achieve impactful, sustainable results at the speed demanded by today’s dynamic market.Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai Shift Timings: 24*7 including night shift as per business requirementsQualificationsRequired: 6-10 years of experience in SAP ABAP technical development Experience developing SAP reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, and workflows Experience with Application List Viewer (ALV) reports, file-based interfaces, user exits, customer exits, Business Add-Ins (BAdI), SAPscript, Smart Forms, Adobe Forms, batch data communication (BDC), business application programming interfaces (BAPI), or Legacy System Migration Workbench (LSMW) Experience in at least 1 SAP implementation project Experience translating functional requirements into technical specifications and development deliverables Experience performing unit testing, peer review support, and technical documentation for SAP development objects Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Science in Computer Science, or equivalent degree from an accredited university

title: USI - EH27 - Product Engineering - Salesforce Software Engineer - Sr Analyst
description: L35 - Salesforce Software Engineer IIRole Overview: As a Salesforce Engineer, you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to multiple high-visibility projects. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering solutions that delight customers and users, while also driving tangible value for Deloitte's business investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftmanship across multiple programming languages and modern frameworks, consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy advanced software solutions.Key Responsibilities:Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations.Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring code integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals. Lead requirement analysis, component design, development, unit testing, integrations, and support.Engineering Craftsmanship: Maintain accountability for the integrity of code design, implementation, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Be hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code ensuring all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.Customer-Centric Engineering: Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time.Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions.Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.Advanced Technical Proficiency: Possess deep expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including Agile methodologies and DevSecOps to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from code check-in to production with all quality checks through SDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Demonstrate understanding of the full lifecycle product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.Domain Expertise: Quickly acquire domain-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs, architectures, and UX/UI designs into technical specifications and code. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.Effective Communication and Influence: Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.Key Qualifications:§  A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline. An advanced degree (e.g., MS/MTech) is preferred but not required. Experience is the most relevant factor.§  Strong software engineering foundation with the understanding of OOPs, data-structure, algorithms, code instrumentations, beautiful coding practices, etc. §  3+ years proven experience with most of the following: Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components, JavaScript, SOQL, Salesforce AppExchange.§  3+ years of hands-on experience with cloud-native engineering, leveraging Salesforce Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) capabilities like Service Cloud/Sales Cloud/Marketing Cloud/Experience Cloud.§  Strong understanding of methodologies and tools like XP, Lean, SAFe, DevSecOps, SRE, and Salesforce-specific CI/CD tools like Salesforce DX, GitHub, and SonarQube, etc. to deliver high-quality Salesforce solutions rapidly.§  Strong preference will be given to candidates with experience in AI/ML and GenAI like Salesforce Einstein.§  Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.How You will Grow: At Deloitte, our professional development plans focus on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day and excel in everything they do.

title: USI-EH27-Consulting Services-EP-EO-SAP SD-Consultant
description: SAP SD Consultant Functional TransformationEnterprise PerformanceOur Enterprise Performance team helps organizations unlock value from enterprise platforms and digital technologies across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations. As an SAP SD Functional Consultant, you will work with business, operations, and technology teams to support transformation initiatives that strengthen order-to-cash processes, sales operations, customer fulfillment, and enterprise performance.In this role, you will help design, configure, and optimize SAP Sales and Distribution solutions that align business requirements with operational goals. With Deloitte’s industry knowledge, functional experience, and collaborative delivery approach, you will help clients improve process efficiency, enhance business operations, and deliver scalable outcomes across their transformation journey.Level: Consultant or equivalentAs an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.Work you'll doAs a Consultant, Functional Transformation on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for: Support SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) application activities across implementation, enhancement, and support engagements. Gather business requirements and translate them into functional designs, configuration decisions, and test scenarios for SAP SD processes. Perform hands-on configuration and support for sales, deliveries, transportation, shipment, and billing processes. Collaborate with business stakeholders, technical teams, and global delivery teams to support issue resolution, testing, deployment, and timely project delivery. Contribute to project meetings, documentation, user training, and continuous learning initiatives while supporting junior team members as needed. The teamEnterprise PerformanceOur Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise package insights and platform technology, working across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations to support delivery of holistic performance improvement and package led large scale digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business insights and collaborate with the businesses as they navigate their enterprise growth and transformation journeys.The Enterprise Operations Portfolio is a suite of offerings designed to help clients maximize value from their Finance, Supply Chain, and IT operations. By taking a holistic approach—from strategy development to process design and technology enablement—we support clients in overcoming operational challenges and managing key business functions. As organizations pursue digital transformation, these areas become vital in shaping interactions with customers, suppliers, and stakeholders. By integrating strategy, operational improvement, implementation, and managed services, we creatively deploy resources and drive innovation, ensuring clients achieve impactful, sustainable results at the speed demanded by today’s dynamic market.Location: Bengaluru / Chennai / Hyderabad / PuneShift Timings: 24x7 shifts, including night shift as per business requirementsQualificationsRequired: 3-6 years of experience in full lifecycle SAP implementations, application support, or integration with one or more SAP modules Experience gathering requirements, designing solutions, prototyping, testing, training, and supporting SAP business applications Experience conducting solution design workshops and translating business requirements into functional deliverables Experience with hands-on SAP SD configuration in sales, deliveries, transportation, shipment, and billing processes Experience with solution testing, defect analysis, end-user training, and deployment support Experience collaborating with business users, technical teams, and global delivery teams across project phases BE, BTech, MCA, MSc (Computer Science), or equivalent degree from an accredited university Preferred: Experience with SAP S/4HANA Experience with SAP Global Trade Services (GTS), SAP Transportation Management (TM), or SAP Hybris Experience working across both small and large delivery teams

description: Artificial Intelligence & EngineeringAI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated sector solutions across software, data, artificial intelligence, networking, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. The team works at the intersection of business strategy and technical architecture to help clients improve resiliency, scalability, efficiency, and innovation.Location: Hyderabad/BengaluruShift Our team partners with organizations drive profitable growth, manage costs strategically, and navigate financial risks. description: SAP FI Consultant Enterprise PerformanceOur Enterprise Performance team helps organizations unlock value from enterprise platforms and digital technologies across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations. As an SAP FI Functional Consultant, you will work with business, finance, and technology teams to support transformation initiatives that strengthen financial processes, controls, and operational performance.In this role, you will help design, implement, and support SAP Finance solutions that align business requirements with enterprise goals and regulatory expectations. With Deloitte’s industry knowledge, functional experience, and collaborative delivery approach, you will help clients modernize finance operations, improve reporting, and deliver scalable business outcomes.Level: Consultant or equivalentAs an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.Work you'll doAs a Consultant, Functional Transformation on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for: Support SAP Financial Accounting and Controlling (FI/CO) implementation and support activities across finance processes and system enhancements. Conduct current-state and future-state business process workshops, gather requirements, and map business needs to SAP functionality and solution design. Configure SAP finance capabilities across areas such as general ledger, accounts receivable, accounts payable, banking, asset accounting, cost center accounting, internal orders, and product costing. Prepare functional specifications, configuration documents, test scenarios, and implementation deliverables in coordination with business and technical teams. Support issue resolution, testing, deployment, and post-go-live activities across finance operations and transformation initiatives. The teamEnterprise PerformanceOur Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise package insights and platform technology, working across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations to support delivery of holistic performance improvement and package led large scale digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business insights and collaborate with the businesses as they navigate their enterprise growth and transformation journeys.The Enterprise Operations Portfolio is a suite of offerings designed to help clients maximize value from their Finance, Supply Chain, and IT operations. By taking a holistic approach—from strategy development to process design and technology enablement—we support clients in overcoming operational challenges and managing key business functions. As organizations pursue digital transformation, these areas become vital in shaping interactions with customers, suppliers, and stakeholders. title: USI-EH27-Consulting-FT-BF-Profitability & Cost Management-Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation
description: Finance Transformation As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.Work you'll doAs a Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation on the Finance Transformation team, you will be responsible for leading Oracle EPCM solution delivery across finance transformation engagements. Lead the design and development of Oracle Enterprise Profitability and Cost Management applications based on business and functional requirements. Design allocation rules, custom calculations, and Groovy business rules to support profitability, cost management, and financial performance analysis. Architect and implement data integration processes using Data Management to load data from Oracle Fusion General Ledger and other Oracle Enterprise Performance Management applications. Design and deliver customized reports, dashboards, and Excel-based financial models; perform data validation, reconciliation, and integration with other Oracle Enterprise Performance Management modules. Contribute across all project phases from requirements gathering through Hypercare, including end-user training, system performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and mentoring junior team members. The teamBusiness Finance, part of our Finance Transformation portfolio, delivers solution-as-a-service offerings focused on digital finance strategies, financial planning and analysis, and enterprise performance technologies. We take a holistic approach, integrating strategy development, process design, and technology enablement to help clients overcome challenges and achieve sustained business success. Our team partners with organizations to drive profitable growth, manage costs strategically, and navigate financial risks. We are seeking a highly motivated individual with strong analytical skills and business acumen to join us in delivering innovative solutions and supporting clients in their transformation journey.Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / ChennaiQualificationsRequired: Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) or equivalent from an accredited university. 8+ years of experience implementing Oracle Enterprise Profitability and Cost Management or Profitability and Cost Management Cloud Service solutions. Experience designing and developing allocation rules, data models, and workflows to support financial performance analysis. Experience developing data integration processes using Data Management to load data from Oracle Fusion General Ledger and other Oracle Enterprise Performance Management applications. Experience building allocation and custom calculations and developing Groovy business rules in Oracle Enterprise Profitability and Cost Management. Experience designing customized reports and dashboards, developing Excel-based financial models, and performing data validation, reconciliation, and integration with Oracle Enterprise Performance Management modules including Financial Consolidation and Close Service and Planning and Budgeting Cloud Service. Experience supporting end-user training, monitoring system performance, troubleshooting issues, applying updates, and delivering work across project phases from requirements gathering through Hypercare. Experience mentoring junior team members and working independently with technical and functional direction from leads. Preferred: Experience with Oracle Enterprise Profitability and Cost Management Agent. Experience using generative artificial intelligence tools or integrated features, including Intelligent Performance Management Insights. Experience with financial planning or cost allocation tools in addition to Oracle Enterprise Profitability and Cost Management. Oracle certification in Enterprise Performance Management Cloud, Enterprise Profitability and Cost Management, or a comparable Oracle certification. #FY27_FT_BF

title: USI-EH27-Consulting Services-EP-EO-SAP CFIN-Senior Consultant
description: SAP CFIN Senior Consultant Enterprise PerformanceOur Enterprise Performance team helps organizations unlock value from enterprise platforms and digital technologies across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations. As a CFIN Functional Senior Consultant, you will work with strategic advisors, functional specialists, and technology professionals to support large-scale finance transformation programs and enterprise modernization efforts.In this role, you will help clients design and implement SAP Central Finance (CFIN) solutions that improve financial processes, enhance visibility across the organization, and support more informed business decision-making. With Deloitte’s industry depth, process knowledge, and collaborative delivery approach, you will help organizations navigate complex transformation journeys and deliver sustainable business outcomes.Level: Senior Consultant or equivalentAs a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.Work you'll doAs a Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for: Lead functional workstreams for SAP finance transformation projects by gathering requirements, conducting current-state and future-state process discussions, and supporting solution design aligned to client objectives. Translate business requirements into functional design documents, configuration specifications, test scenarios, and other project deliverables across SAP finance processes. Configure and support SAP solutions across finance areas such as general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, banking, controlling, product costing, and asset accounting. Collaborate with cross-functional, onsite, and offshore teams through all phases of the project lifecycle, including design, build, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support. Guide junior team members, manage assigned deliverables, and support issue resolution to help deliver high-quality, sustainable client solutions. The teamEnterprise PerformanceOur Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise package insights and platform technology, working across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations to support delivery of holistic performance improvement and package led large scale digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business insights and collaborate with the businesses as they navigate their enterprise growth and transformation journeys.The Enterprise Operations Portfolio is a suite of offerings designed to help clients maximize value from their Finance, Supply Chain, and IT operations. By taking a holistic approach—from strategy development to process design and technology enablement—we support clients in overcoming operational challenges and managing key business functions. As organizations pursue digital transformation, these areas become vital in shaping interactions with customers, suppliers, and stakeholders. By integrating strategy, operational improvement, implementation, and managed services, we creatively deploy resources and drive innovation, ensuring clients achieve impactful, sustainable results at the speed demanded by today’s dynamic market.Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / ChennaiShift Timings: 24x7 rotational shifts, including night shifts, based on business requirementsQualificationsRequired: 6-10 years of experience in SAP projects, finance transformation, or SAP finance support Experience with at least 1 SAP implementation, upgrade, or transformation project Experience with SAP finance processes, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, banking, or financial supply chain management (FSCM) Experience with at least 2 of the following SAP areas: product costing, contract accounts receivable and payable (FICA), public sector collection and disbursement (PSCD), financial services collection and disbursement (FSCD), controlling-profitability analysis (COPA), or asset accounting Experience with cost center accounting, cost element accounting, internal orders, project systems, investment management, cash management, or treasury Experience facilitating blueprint workshops and translating business requirements into functional design or configuration documents Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Science in Computer Science, or equivalent degree from an accredited university Preferred: Experience implementing recent SAP releases in production environments Experience with New General Ledger and segment reporting SAP certification in a finance, controlling, or functional module #FY27EOSAPSKILLSDELOITTEUSI

description: Enterprise PerformanceOur Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutionsPosition SummaryServiceNow - Technical-ArchitectThe ServiceNow Architect is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing ServiceNow solutions to meet business requirements. With over 11 years of experience, the architect will lead technical strategy, provide guidance to development teams, and ensure best practices are followed across ServiceNow implementationsWork You’ll DoPractitioners with a passion for helping clients solve complex Finance, Supply Chain, and IT challenges will be brought together under one group. This enables professionals to interact with and learn from their colleagues who understand the specific challenges that exist in each domain.Practitioners can further their skill development and grow their careers while working across the Advise, Implement, and Operate spectrum.The TeamTSO Offering enables our clients to achieve their objectives of Digital transformation of enterprise services and IT transformation across enterprise functions through our advice & implement services. USI team with its technology and process skills expertise, experience & scale is an integral part of offering . USI team works through the lifecycle of these transformation programs.Qualifications required:Must have skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 11+ years of IT experience, with at least 6 years in ServiceNow architecture and development. Deep expertise in multiple ServiceNow modules (e.g., ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM). Strong experience with ServiceNow scripting (JavaScript, Glide API), Flow Designer, and Service Portal. Proven track record in designing integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, web services, and third-party tools. ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications required; Certified Application Developer (CAD) and Certified Technical Architect (CTA) preferred. Design and architect ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, or other ServiceNow modules based on business needs. Lead and mentor ServiceNow developers and administrators; review code and solution designs. Architect integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems using APIs, MID Servers, and integration tools. Plan and manage ServiceNow upgrades, performance tuning, and platform optimization. Create and maintain architecture diagrams, technical documentation, and solution design documents. Ensure solutions adhere to security, compliance, and data privacy requirements. Good to have skills/Project Experience/Certifications: Oversee custom application development, scripting (client/server), and workflow automation within ServiceNow. Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable ServiceNow solutions. title: USI EH | FY27 | Cyber Operate - TPRM - Consultant
description: Level: Consultant Work you'll do As a Consultant on the Third Party Risk Management team, you will be responsible for supporting ongoing third-party cyber risk assessment delivery for client engagements. Perform ongoing third-party cyber risk assessments to identify and evaluate business and technology risks associated with third parties and service providers Provide recommendations to help clients manage cyber risks arising from third-party relationships Assist in the selection and tailoring of third-party cyber risk management approaches, methods, and tools to support assessment delivery Prepare periodic status updates, including potential risks and delays, for project managers and clients Support engagement delivery by documenting findings and contributing to project execution against client requirements and timelines The team Cyber Operate : Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) capability is part of the wider Cyber Operate Practice. The TPRM team is focused on helping our clients identify and manage the cyber risks arising from their association with third parties or service providers. We help our clients to define their overall third-party cyber risk strategy, design and implement enterprise-wide programs and technology that focus on identifying and reducing risks; help them evaluate their objectives, priorities, strengths and weaknesses and roll out large scale organizational changes to achieve goals. Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune Shift Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST, with flexibility required based on client expectations, engagement demands, time zone coverage, on-call support, and after-hours operational needs Qualifications Required: 3-5 years of experience in information security Experience applying information security and risk frameworks or standards, including ISO 27001/2, National Institute of Standards and Technology 800 series, or Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard Experience performing cyber risk, compliance risk, or regulatory risk assessments Experience in one or more cyber risk domains, including security governance and management, application security controls, access controls, network security operations, security architectures, identity management, disaster recovery and business continuity, incident response, privacy and data protection, or encryption Experience with internal controls, risk assessments, business process reviews, internal information technology control testing, or operational auditing Experience preparing project status updates, including risks and delays, for project managers or clients Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in information technology or a related field Preferred: Certification such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional or Certified Information Systems Auditor Experience with legal and regulatory requirements related to information security and data privacy, including Office of the Comptroller of the Currency Bulletin 2013-29, Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council guidance, or Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act requirements Experience in a consulting environment Experience supporting third-party cyber risk management programs or assessments#Cyber_Cyber Operate

description: L40 - Mobile Software Engineer IIRole Overview: As a Lead Mobile Software Engineer, you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to multiple high-visibility projects. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering solutions that delight customers and users, while also driving tangible value for Deloitte's business investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftmanship across multiple programming languages and modern frameworks, consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy advanced software solutions.Key Responsibilities:Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations.Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring code integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals. Lead requirement analysis, component design, development, unit testing, integrations, and support.Maintain accountability for the integrity of code design, implementation, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Be hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code ensuring all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time.Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions.Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.Possess deep expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including Agile methodologies and DevSecOps to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from code check-in to production with all quality checks through SDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Demonstrate understanding of the full lifecycle product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.Quickly acquire domain-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs, architectures, and UX/UI designs into technical specifications and code. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.The successful candidate will possess:§  Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.Required Qualifications:§  A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.§  2 to 5+ years of experience in native and/or cross-platform mobile development, with hands-on exposure to several of the following technologies: SwiftUI (or prior iOS frameworks), Kotlin, Xamarin, SQLite, Hive, and SkiaSharp.§  3+ years of experience developing with Flutter and its ecosystem, including Dart, Dio, Freezed, Lottie, and RealmDB.§  3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering, using FaaS, PaaS, and micro-services on cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS (mandatory), or GCP.§  1+ years of experience with AI/ML and GenAI.§  Prior software engineering experience with an understanding of OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations.§  Prior experience using one or more of the methodologies and tools such as XP, Lean, SAFe, DevSecOps, SRE, Azure DevOps, GitHub, SonarQube, etc., to deliver high-quality products rapidly.

description: We are seeking a dynamic, detail-oriented Assistant Manager to support our Learning & Development Learner Experience portfolios across the US and USI regions. This role is critical to deliver consistent, high-quality learner experience by coordinating and standardizing processes, activities, and touchpoints across regions. Preferred: Master's degree Experience supporting learning portfolios across US and USI stakeholders Experience using learning management systems or reporting tools Experience coordinating facilitators, venues, or external vendors for learning delivery

title: USI - EH27- CoRe Knowledge Services - Assistant Manager - Member Firm Communications Coordinator - Hyderabad/ Bengaluru
description: Specialist Assistant Manager, Communications CoRe Knowledge Services (KS), part of Deloitte’s global shared services organization, serves Deloitte’s member firms worldwide. Member Firm Communications Coordinator will serve as a key bridge between the Member Firm Engagement (MFE) team and the Practitioner Engagement (PE) team, helping translate centrally driven knowledge platform campaigns into localized, Member Firm-specific execution. PE team drives awareness of the knowledge platform and services to cultivate knowledge sharing culture within the organization that empowers professionals to make use of Deloitte’s collective experience in serving their clients. MFE team strives to establish Knowledge Services across the CoRe and Non-CoRe Member Firms and demonstrate the value of Deloitte’s proprietary knowledge platform, Knowledge Exchange (KX), and related offerings. This individual contributor role will work closely with Member Firm Knowledge Leaders (MFKLs), MFE, and PE teams to support end-to-end campaign planning, localization, quality assurance, outreach governance, reporting, and process improvement. The role will help drive awareness and adoption of Deloitte’s knowledge platform, Knowledge Exchange (KX), and related knowledge services by ensuring campaigns are tailored to local market, language, channel, and audience needs while remaining aligned to global strategy and standards. This role has no people-management responsibilities. Work you'll do As a Specialist Assistant Manager, Communications on the CoRe Knowledge Services team, you will be responsible for: Coordinate localized campaign execution across Practitioner Engagement, Member Firm Engagement, and Member Firm Knowledge Leaders. Customize centrally developed campaign content for Member Firm audiences based on language, market context, channel, and communication requirements. Manage campaign localization workflows, including intake, stakeholder alignment, review cycles, approvals, and deployment readiness. Maintain outreach guidance, campaign calendars, documentation, templates, and quality assurance checklists to support consistent execution. Track campaign performance, risks, issues, dependencies, and stakeholder feedback to support reporting and process improvement. The team CoRe Knowledge Services supports Deloitte member firms by helping connect professionals to knowledge, insights, and collaboration resources that improve how work is delivered across the organization. This role sits at the intersection of communications, knowledge adoption, and campaign execution, supporting efforts to increase awareness and use of Knowledge Exchange (KX) and related knowledge services across Member Firms. The team works with global and Member Firm stakeholders to localize communications, improve outreach effectiveness, and support scalable adoption practices. Location: Hyderabad/Bengaluru Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM Qualifications Required: Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Business Administration, Journalism, English, Knowledge Management, or a similar field 6-8 years of experience in communications, campaign management, marketing, knowledge management, or content operations Experience coordinating communication campaigns, outreach programs, or engagement initiatives across multiple stakeholder groups Experience localizing content or coordinating translations for different geographies, audiences, or channels Experience developing campaign reporting or performance tracking using quantitative and qualitative metrics Experience using Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams Experience working with SharePoint, intranets, knowledge repositories, or reporting tools Preferred: Master’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Business Administration, Journalism, English, Knowledge Management, or a similar field Certifications in project management, change management, communications, analytics, or digital marketing

DLHP will include focus areas ranging from the humanities – integrating purpose; culture and belonging; well-being; Enduring Human Capabilities (curiosity, informed agility, resilience, connected teaming, divergent thinking, and social and emotional intelligence)—to coaching and leading people and teams, communication skills, growth and sales, industry and market skills, and client leadership.DLHP goals are to:• Integrate purposeful and impactful leadership skills and capabilities to cultivate stronger internal and external relationships, drive business growth, fuel engagement and performance, enhance our value, and feed our social and client impact • Create the next generation of Deloitte professionals and leaders, optimizing the human potential and agility of all our people that will enable them to thrive, change, and lead in the hybrid and technology-focused work environmentWork you'll doAs a Specialist Manager, Talent Development on the Communication Excellence team, you will be responsible for:• Facilitating live virtual and in-person learning programs on language proficiency, advanced business communication, executive presence, and leadership development for professionals across levels • Providing individual and group coaching and adapting learning methods based on business needs, content complexity, and learner profiles • Managing Communication Excellence gym programming, including content creation for live and virtual events and innovation in digital learning experiences using emerging technologies • Supporting scheduling, reporting, assessments, certification processes, curriculum data management, and historical archives in alignment with operational and compliance requirements • Managing stakeholder, project, and vendor coordination, including presentations, reporting, client visit planning, licenses, invoices, contract renewals, and third-party risk management activitiesThe teamCommunication Excellence (CE) is part of DLHP. CE helps businesses take a more strategic view of their communication development with structured and tangible solutions, collaborating and performance consulting.Location: HyderabadShift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PMQualificationsRequired:• 12+ years of experience in learning and development, talent development, communication development, program management, or a corporate learning environment • Experience facilitating instructor-led learning programs in virtual and in-person formats • Experience providing individual and group coaching in business communication, language proficiency, executive presence, or leadership development • Experience managing program operations, including scheduling, reporting, assessments, certification processes, and curriculum data management • Experience using Microsoft Office, learning technologies, and generative artificial intelligence tools in a business environment • Experience managing stakeholder relationships and vendor coordination, including licenses, invoices, contract renewals, and third-party risk management activities • Ability to travel 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.Preferred: • Master’s degree in English Language • Experience working in a learning and development organization
