title: USI-EH27-Consulting-AI&E-IS-Senior Consultant,Technical Transformation-Guidewire BillingCentre
description: Artificial Intelligence & EngineeringAI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.  Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.As a Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation, you will design and deliver enterprise-scale Guidewire solutions that support complex business and technology priorities. You will work with cross-functional teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions, drive delivery quality, and contribute across the full project lifecycle from planning through execution. This role also includes mentoring junior practitioners and supporting consistent, high-quality delivery across engagements.Work you'll do:As a Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation on the Artificial Intelligence & Engineering team, you will be responsible for:• Leading technical discussions with business and functional stakeholders to understand requirements and assess integration impacts across the solution landscape• Designing and developing Guidewire configuration and integration solutions aligned with architecture standards, technical designs, and quality expectations• Creating technical design documents, development standards, templates, and reusable assets to support consistent delivery• Managing day-to-day Agile delivery activities, including sprint ceremonies, deliverable tracking, estimation, and status reporting• Reviewing deliverables, resolving technical issues, and providing guidance to team members throughout development and deploymentThe team:You will play a key role in developing verticalized solutions tailored to the unique needs of each client’s sector, transforming how organizations sell products, deliver services, drive growth, and sustain mission-critical operations. By leveraging your business expertise and advanced technology, you will help ensure every solution is seamlessly integrated with Industry Advantage and aligned with sector-specific requirements. With your focus on innovation and measurable value, you will empower clients to achieve strategic objectives, enhance operational efficiency, and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving marketplace by addressing core business challenges and opportunities across industries.Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/ChennaiQualifications:Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: • 6-10 years of experience in Guidewire configuration and integration• Experience with functional and technical systems analysis, system architecture design, interface design, process flow design, and impact analysis• Experience designing and developing Guidewire integration components and configuring PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, or ClaimCenter• Experience writing Gosu code and working with web services and XML• Experience with test-driven development and unit testing• Experience working in Agile delivery teams using Scrum or Kanban• Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Science in Computer Science, or equivalent; Guidewire ACE or Cloud certificationGood to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: • Experience with platform upgrades in Guidewire environments• Experience with CodeNarc or similar code quality tools• Experience with recent Guidewire Cloud versions#FY27ReferralCampaign#2027_AI&E_Dscreen

title: USI-EH27-Consulting Services-AI&E-EaaS- Lead Architect-Application Architect-Java
description: Artificial Intelligence & EngineeringJoin our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients’ achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to business. Your contributions help Deloitte client service teams improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation. Position SummaryLevel: Specialist Master or equivalentAs a Specialist Master(App Architecture) at Deloitte Consulting, you will oversee the technical delivery of enterprise-scale software solutions, lead cross-functional and global teams and mentor junior members. You will collaborate to understand functional requirements, support sales and proposal efforts, and drive end-to-end project delivery, including estimation and planning, to ensure successful outcomes.Work you’ll do: Collaborate with the functional team and client to thoroughly understand business requirements. Serve as the Architecture lead, overseeing technical delivery by providing architectural direction and implementation recommendations. Lead documentation efforts, ensuring all deliverables adhere to architectural standards and best practices. Direct the design and development of solutions, ensuring alignment with the overall architecture and timely delivery according to project plans. Work closely with project leadership to identify and escalate potential risks, prepare status reports, and ensure architectural considerations are addressed. Mentor junior team members, facilitate communication between various teams within the engagement, and champion architectural integrity throughout the project. Responding to proposals by providing accurate estimations and technical input, supporting the overall success and alignment of project objectives with client needsTechnical ProficienciesExpertise in J2EE and Spring Boot: Strong proficiency in Java/J2EE frameworks, with a focus on Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Cloud Extensive experience in developing scalable, high-performance enterprise applications using J2EE Cloud Computing (AWS/Azure/GCP): Hands-on experience designing and deploying solutions on one or more hyperscalers: AWS: EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFormation Azure: App Service, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Blob Storage, Azure Functions, API Management, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure Resource Manager (ARM) GCP: Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Firestore, Deployment Manager/Terraform Proficiency in designing and deploying microservices architectures on cloud platforms Microservices Architecture: Strong expertise in building and managing microservices using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud Netflix (Eureka, Hystrix, Zuul, Ribbon), and REST/GraphQL APIs Experience with inter-service communication using Eventgrid,gRPC or Kafka Performance Optimization: Proven experience in profiling, monitoring, and optimizing applications for performance using tools like JMeter, Java Flight Recorder Expertise in JVM tuning, memory management, and SQL query optimization DevOps Practices and CI/CD: Hands-on experience with DevOps tools and methodologies, including: CI/CD tools: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure Pipelines, AWS CodePipeline, GCP Cloud Build Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, AKS). Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible Monitoring tools: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk Database and Data Storage: Strong experience with relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server). Experience with NoSQL and caching technologies and/or hyperscaler-native options Code Reviews and Best Practices: Expertise in conducting thorough code reviews to ensure adherence to SOLID principles, design patterns, and industry-standard best practices Proficiency in writing clean, modular, and maintainable code using tools like SonarQube or PMD for static code analysis API Management and Security: Experience in designing and managing APIs using Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, or API Gateway Knowledge of authentication/authorization protocols like OAuth2, JWT, and SAML System Architecture and Design: Experience producing architecture/design artifacts (diagrams, decision logs) using tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, or ArchiMate Strong experience in architecting scalable, distributed systems using microservices, event-driven architectures, and domain-driven design (DDD) Leadership and Communication Provide proof of concepts, analysis of alternatives, and brief their results to client stakeholders Responsible for cloud native architecture design, implementation of distributed, fault-tolerant enterprise applications for cloud Build meaningful relationship with clients Publish whitepapers / point of views and act as an evangelist to the Deloitte brand Work both independently or in a team-oriented, collaborative environment based on the project requirements Contributes significantly towards leading initiatives for development and maintenance of tools, methods, and offerings in the area of specialization Identifies and builds productivity and efficiency drivers which substantially influence during sales pitch and become key criteria for winning new projects in the specialty area The team: Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.QualificationsMust Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: of industry experience, with at least 8+ years in a technical architect role designing applications and hosting solutions on cloud platforms At least 10+ years of hands-on experience in cloud native architecture design, implementation of distributed, fault-tolerant enterprise applications for cloud Should have knowledge to understand and create the Target State Solutions Should be able to create Low level designs for Engineering teams For Ex: Flow charts, Sequence diagrams, class diagrams Should have knowledge of reusable components- Filters, JPA, Logging and Monitoring Should have Hands-On experience on Spring web-Java API development along with certification process Maven build Tools Spring JPA, connection pool configuration Event Driven Implementation: Kafka connector library Integration with Java Should have good knowledge of SOLID principles and Java Design Patterns Should define Interfaces and re-usable components to avoid duplicate effort - For Ex: Circuit breaker, Retry, Error Handling Experience in application migration and modernization of legacy applications to cloud platforms including hybrid connectivity and phased cutovers Familiarity with principles summarized in the major Cloud Adoption Frameworks and Well-Architected/Architecture frameworks (e.g., AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) + Well-Architected; Azure CAF + Well-Architected Framework; Google Cloud CAF + Architecture Framework) Deep expertise in architecting and designing end-to-end cloud solutions, recommending architecture patterns aligned to business needs Experience designing approach and leading migrations from on‑premises to cloud, leveraging database migration services and application migration/assessment tooling (e.g., discovery, wave planning, cutover, validation) Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, and managed/container platforms (e.g., cloud-managed Kubernetes services and/or OpenShift) Working knowledge of cloud-native CI/CD and developer platforms (source control, build, artifact repositories, pipeline orchestration), distributed tracing/observability, and security services Strong understanding of microservices architecture, with experience in designing and implementing cloud-based solutions Strong understanding of the cloud native development practices and architectural patterns Experience in leading and managing teams within specialist areas from project planning to execution AI-related awareness: demonstrated AI-first delivery mindset, including familiarity with Generative AI (GenAI) concepts, agentic workflows/automation, and practical considerations (data privacy, security, model risk) when incorporating AI capabilities into enterprise applications Education:   BE./B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university   Location:   Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai#EaaS_26thNov#2027_AI&E_Dscreen#FY27ReferralCampaign

description: Job title:  Consultant, Technology Controls Advisory, Audit and AssuranceAboutAt Deloitte, we do not offer you just a job, but a career in the highly sought-after risk Management field. We are one of the business leaders in the risk market. We work with a vision to make the world more prosperous, trustworthy, and safe. Deloitte’s clients, primarily based outside of India, are large, complex organizations that constantly evolve and innovate to build better products and services. In the process, they encounter various risks and the work we do to help them address these risks is increasingly important to their success—and to the strength of the economy and public security.By joining us, you will get to work with diverse teams of professionals who design, manage, and implement risk-centric solutions across a variety of domains. description: Senior Engineering Leader (US Deloitte Technology – Product Engineering)Role Overview: As the Senior Engineering Leader for Deloitte's DT-US Product Engineering, you will be the visionary and driving force behind our technology strategy. You will lead by example, actively engaging in high-visibility projects while mentoring and guiding teams. Your role will encompass research, fit-gap analysis, roadmap creation, and the identification of strategic priorities. You will be a pivotal member of the leadership team, responsible for both strategic and tactical decisions, and accountable for delivering enterprise initiatives.Responsibilities:§  Strategic Planning: Transform business goals into actionable strategies and roadmaps to evolve our overall technology blueprint and architecture that delivers incremental business value daily with fully automated, resilient products and platforms.§  Technical Leadership: Design long-term, resilient/secure technology architectures and steer the technology vision with a focus on AI at core.§  Team Leadership: Being hands-on and Master of Engineering craft, lead and mentor teams as well as create POVs and whitepapers on emerging technologies. Lead by example and model the way of a true engineer.§  Research and Innovation: Identify and recommend new technology trends and their impact on Product Engineering. Lead innovation activities and support/evolve enterprise platform capabilities.§  Thought Leadership: Spearhead engineering strategy initiatives and continuous improvement.§  Executive Engagement: Collaborate with executives to define/implement transformation strategies.§  Stakeholder Management: Engage with stakeholders to manage complex projects, drive priorities, and manage expectations in the spirit of co-creation with customers and engineering teams.§  Vision Advocacy: Advocate and communicate a shared technology vision across the enterprise.The Team:US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.Qualifications and Required Skills:Educational BackgroundA bachelor’s degree in computer science, or a related discipline. An advanced degree (e.g., MS) is preferred but not required. Experience is the most relevant factor.Experience§  15+ years of hands-on software engineering experience at the enterprise level, including start-ups, architecting, designing, coding, deploying and operating products & platforms.§  2+ years of experience with driving technology vision, strategy, research and roadmap.§  10+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering, using FaaS/PaaS on multiple cloud hyper-scalers like Azure, AWS, and GCP.§  5+ years in data engineering and AI/ML with strong exposure to creating GenAI production-grade applications.Technical Expertise§  Strong experience in Angular, React, NodeJS. Integration experience with SAP, ServiceNow, Salesforce.§  Deep experience with Big-data technologies, SQL/NoSQL, Python/R, MS Stack, Mobile, RPA, D&A.§  Strong experience in DevSecOps driving multiple daily product deployments using full automation from code check-in to production deployment with all quality checks through SDLC lifecycle§  Strong SRE experience to fully automate operations with smart monitoring, proactive issue detection and seamless recovery§  In-depth understanding of Agile methodologies, XP, Lean, SAFe, ITSM, GRC, GDPR, SOC2.Communication and Influencing SkillsExcellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, multiple initiatives, complex projects, and changing priorities, driving the vision with passion, empathy, and care.How You will Grow: At Deloitte, our professional development plans focus on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day and excel in everything they do.

title: USI-EH27-Consulting Services-EP-SCNO-Omniverse-Software Engineer III
description: Omniverse – Software Engineer IIIJoin Deloitte’s Enterprise Performance practice as a Software Engineer III, Omniverse, where you will support the design, development, and deployment of digital twin solutions for manufacturing and industrial environments. In this role, you will contribute to platform architecture, simulation enablement, 3D and computer-aided design data integration, and scalable cloud-based solution delivery using Omniverse and adjacent technologies. You will work across cross-functional teams to help translate industrial and manufacturing requirements into practical technical solutions that improve visualization, simulation, and operational decision-making.Work you'll doAs a Software Engineer III, Omniverse on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for supporting and delivering digital twin platform initiatives across industrial and manufacturing use cases. Lead the design, development, and deployment of Omniverse-based digital twin solutions for manufacturing and industrial environments. Build and enhance workflows using Universal Scene Description, RTX rendering pipelines, Isaac Sim, and ROS 2 for simulation, visualization, and industrial use cases. Develop Python- and C++-based solution components to support platform integration, simulation workflows, performance optimization, and scalable system design. Integrate 3D content pipelines, computer-aided design assets, and tools such as Blender, Maya, or Unity into digital twin environments to support end-to-end solution delivery. Support cloud-based and distributed platform deployment across Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform environments, including GPU-enabled workloads, platform scalability, and operational reliability. The teamEnterprise PerformanceOur Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions.The Enterprise Performance team leverages deep industry knowledge, strong analytical skills, and practical approaches to address clients’ toughest business challenges. Our professionals as part of the Supply Chain Network Operations (SCNO) service line within Enterprise Performance focus on helping organizations achieve sustainable competitive advantage throughout their operations, spanning product development, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution. We excel at translating strategic objectives into tangible, measurable outcomes at the operational level. By aligning high-level goals with frontline execution, we ensure our clients realize real value and improved performance across every stage of their supply chain and operations.Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / ChennaiShift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST, as per business requirementsQualificationsRequired: Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Technology, or equivalent degree from an accredited university 7-10 years of experience with Omniverse, Universal Scene Description, RTX rendering pipelines, Isaac Sim, or ROS 2 Experience delivering digital twin, simulation, or industrial platform implementations in manufacturing or industrial environments Experience developing applications or platform components using Python or C++ Experience with manufacturing systems, robotics, or industrial control architectures Experience integrating 3D content pipelines or computer-aided design assets using tools such as Blender, Maya, or Unity Experience supporting distributed systems or cloud environments on Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including GPU-enabled workloads Preferred: Experience with Modulus, Generative Artificial Intelligence, or Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning use cases Experience supporting cloud-native architectures, platform scalability, or distributed solution design Experience supporting technical architecture decisions for digital twin platforms in industrial environments Experience integrating simulation, visualization, and industrial data workflows for manufacturing use cases Experience with DevOps tools, deployment pipelines, or environment management for scalable platforms Experience documenting technical designs, solution components, or implementation workflows#SCNOFY27LinkedInbanner

title: USI-EH27-DTLL-CoRe DDAI - Application Development Analyst
description: Analyst- Application Development - CoRe DDAI - Deloitte Support Services India Pvt Ltd.Are you a quick learner with a willingness to work with new technologies? CoRe Business Solutions team offers you an opportunity to be an integral part of the Digital Customer Solutions Group. The principal focus of this group is to customize technical solutions for global Deloitte Member Firms to address a variety of business needs including marketing and communication, knowledge management, learning and development, and overall process automation. The team uses primarily Microsoft SharePoint (on-prem and cloud) as a platform. We use various web development and automation tools/technologies (i.e. HTML, jQuery, Java Script, React Js, BootStrap,REST API, JSON, Nintex, KwizCom, Kendo, Azure, Power Apps/Flows, and many more) within a structured delivery process to develop products that deliver significant value to our internal customers across Deloitte’s global network.Work you'll doAs a Software Engineer I on the CoRe Business Solutions, Digital Customer Solutions team, you will be responsible for: Develop and customize SharePoint solutions using SharePoint 2013, 2016, 2019, and SharePoint Online to support business needs across Deloitte member firms Configure and enhance SharePoint sites using tools such as SharePoint Designer, Visual Studio, and web development technologies including HTML, JavaScript, React, Bootstrap, and CSS Test, deploy, troubleshoot, and maintain SharePoint solutions to support reliability, compatibility, and minimal disruption to existing services Collaborate with lead developers, solution architects, and team members to clarify requirements, resolve technical issues, and deliver project updates Create and maintain technical documentation, user guides, and training materials to support ongoing maintenance, upgrades, and end-user adoption The teamThe CoRe Business Solutions, Digital Customer Solutions team builds and supports internal digital solutions for Deloitte member firms. The team focuses on SharePoint-based applications, workflow automation, and web technologies that help improve communication, knowledge sharing, learning, and business processes. Team members work closely with developers, architects, and stakeholders across Deloitte’s network to deliver scalable solutions for internal users.Location: HyderabadShift Timings: 11:00 AM to 8:00 PMQualificationsRequired: B.E./B.Tech. or M.Tech. with 60% or 6.5 GPA and above throughout with no current backlogs 2+ years of experience developing solutions in SharePoint 2013, SharePoint 2016, SharePoint 2019, or SharePoint Online 2+ years of experience using HTML, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Bootstrap, CSS3, or XSLT Experience performing create, read, update, and delete operations using SharePoint Representational State Transfer (REST) APIs Experience building applications or extensions using SharePoint Framework (SPFx) Experience using SharePoint Designer, Visual Studio, or similar tools to customize SharePoint sites Preferred: Experience with Nintex, KwizCom, KWIZ Apps, or KWIZ Workflows Experience with Power Apps or Power Automate Experience with ShareGate or SharePoint Migration Tool (SPMT) Experience with Azure DevOps, including user story management Experience with unit testing and deployment packaging across development and production environments Experience creating site columns, content types, libraries, permissions, and search navigation in SharePoint

title: USI-EH27-Firm Tax-L50-Tax Manager
description: Manager, Internal Federal & State Direct TaxAre you an experienced tax professionals with strong working knowledge in Indian Corporate tax, Transfer Pricing and International Tax law matters. If yes, here we have an exciting opportunity in our US India Firms Tax team.Work you'll doAs a Tax Manager, you will be responsible for analyzing and computing book-tax differences, calculating taxable income, reviewing federal partnership returns, analyzing state apportionment, state law adjustments, and reviewing state partnership, composite, and withholding tax returns, and producing and distributing the annual K-1 packages. This requires involvement in various processes including federal and state return and K-1 preparation. You will also onboard, manage and retain our staff, and assist with transforming our people, processes, and technology.• Review schedules and working papers for the US Firms’ partnership federal, state, and local income tax returns, including certain partner-related information. • Produce and distribute annual partner K-1 packages, including allocations of income, deductions, and separately stated items to US Firms partners. • Assist in the preparation of the US Firms’ federal, state, and local income tax returns, including composite nonresident income tax returns and certain partner-related information. • Perform tax research as necessary regarding federal and state tax issues affecting the US Firms. • Coordinate on federal withholding information returns. • Assist in analysis and calculation of required estimated state tax payments. • Assist with federal, state, and local tax audits and correspond with authorities regarding audit issues and/or tax notices. • Review selected general ledger accounts monthly for appropriateness of state tax accruals. • Assisting with engagement workflow management and supervising tax consultants on assigned engagements. • Manage the annual partner state tax elections process and the collection of nonresident non-joiner affidavits, review per partner withholding, PET, and composite tax calculations. • Assist with partner questions regarding federal or state or local tax matters related to their K-1 information and withholdings. • Manage implementation of any federal or state or local tax related legislation. • Make recommendations on business and process improvements related to US Firms tax matters.The teamFirm Tax team: This position is a part of the US India Firms Tax team. The Firms Tax team is responsible for ensuring entity level compliances for all the US companies, besides catering to the tax essentials and advise to US companies’ business and enabling functions ecosystems. The team consists of tax professionals with adequate expertise in handling tax matters. This team works in close coordination with the US finance, legal and enabling besides business teams to ensure optimum tax health of the US companies named above.Location: HyderabadShift Timings: 2 PM to 11 PM ISTQualificationsRequired:• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting/Taxation. • CPA, Enrolled Agent or other relevant certification. • Five (5) + years’ experience of federal and state partnership tax compliance, tax research, and tax planning in a professional services firm. • Excellent communication skills. • Strong knowledge of federal and state partnership tax compliance, tax research, and tax planning. • Prior experience supervising tax professionals on a project or engagement basis. • Ability to train and develop staff. • Tax forecasting / planning experience. • Partner level income allocations. • Proficient in Excel. • Limited immigration sponsorship may be availablePreferred:• Advanced degree.How you’ll grow At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities— including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in exactly the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team-based learning, and eLearning. title: USI - EH27 - Product Engineering - Engineering Leader - AVP
description: Engineering LeaderRole Overview: As a Engineering Leader, you will help shape and communicate a strategic vision for modern software engineering. You will provide hands-on leadership across multiple high-impact products, ensuring our solutions are innovative, effective, and aligned with business goals.  You will contribute to and execute a forward-looking technology roadmap, driving simplification, scalability, and efficiency. Leveraging your deep expertise in software engineering—including application and data integration, modern frameworks, and diverse technologies—you will guide teams in delivering robust, high-quality solutions.  As a role model and mentor, you will foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and collaboration. Your ability to inspire and develop engineering talent, while partnering with cross-functional teams, will be essential to our ongoing success and the value we deliver to Deloitte’s business.Key Responsibilities:Strategic Vision and Alignment: Contribute to defining, communicating, and continuously refining a compelling engineering vision that translates business objectives into actionable strategies. Ensure engineering teams are aligned and engaged, collaborating closely with product, experience, delivery, infrastructure, and security teams. Leverage technical artifacts and feedback loops to illustrate and evolve the vision.Advocacy and Technology Roadmap: Champion the integrated engineering strategy and technology roadmap, ensuring organizational awareness of objectives, KPIs, maturity, and compliance. Promote a culture of reuse, quality, and speed to maximize outcomes. Actively engage and energize teams around the engineering vision and its alignment with business and technology goals.Craft Mastery and Objectives Realization: Drive achievement of engineering KPIs, including system performance, scalability, security, and maintainability. Maintain and evolve engineering dashboards (planning, code quality, CI/CD, performance, security, operations). Contribute hands-on to design and code, mentor engineers, and resolve technical challenges. Inspire teams to adopt new technologies and best practices, fostering a passion for engineering excellence.Capability Evolution and Development: Being an engineering expert, mentor and develop full-stack engineering talent in modern practices such as frontend, microservices, cloud-native design, AI/ML/GenAI, data engineering, DevSecOps, and advanced deployment techniques like, Blue-Green, Canary to minimize down-time, enabling A/B testing approaches. Lead by example through thought leadership—speaking at conferences, publishing, R&D, or collaborating with academia. Cultivate a growth mindset and modern engineering behaviors across the team.Iterative Value Delivery: Embrace an iterative and incremental product development, favoring action, prioritizing rapid learning, and adaptation over extensive upfront planning. Apply leaning-forward approach and empirical methods to navigate complexity, ensuring each iteration delivers value and aligns with customer and business needs.Customer-Centric Problem Solving: Maintain a relentless focus on solving the most critical customer challenges. Align technical solutions with business outcomes, minimize unnecessary complexity, and drive teams toward high performance through continuous learning and collaborative execution.Tech/Quality Risk Management: Establish and evolve engineering standards, coding practices, and quality benchmarks to ensure robust, secure, and scalable solutions. Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks, ensuring operational excellence and resilience.Influential Communication: Influence, persuade, and drive decision-making processes. Communicate effectively in both written and verbal forms. Craft clear, structured arguments and technical trade-offs, supported by evidence.Organizational Engagement and Collaboration: Engage stakeholders at all levels of the organization, from team members to middle management to executives. Build collaborative and constructive relationships, co-creating and driving momentum and value across multiple organizational levels.The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.Key Qualifications:A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline. An advanced degree (e.g., MS) is preferred but not required. Enterprise experience is the most relevant factor.Excellent software engineering and product architecture/design foundation with deep understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/ER/DFD diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, code instrumentation, and messaging patterns (e.g., routing, transformation, construction, channel, endpoint, adapter, sequencing).15+ years of proven experience with programming languages, technologies, and frameworks such as Python, C#, Java, Node.js, Golang, .NET Core, XML/JSON, REST/SOAP/GraphQL, SQL/NoSQL, SSO/MFA, and unit testing frameworks.8+ years of hands-on experience with cloud-native integration services on one or more hyper-scalers like Azure, AWS, GCP (e.g., API Gateways, Message Brokers, Queuing Services, Workflow Automation & Orchestration, ETL/ELT, Event Streaming, Real-Time Data Processing, Service Mesh).5+ years of experience with defining and driving engineering KPIs, implementing engineering maturity models, and driving continuous improvement.3+ years of experience with AI/ML; experience with the latest GenAI models is preferred.Deep understanding of methodologies and tools such as XP, Lean, SAFe, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, CAST, etc., to deliver high-quality products rapidly.Proven ability to drive adoption of modern engineering practices at scale, including cross-functional collaboration.Proven track record of leading, mentoring, and developing diverse engineering teams, fostering a culture of innovation, inclusion, and continuous learning.Strong understanding of security, privacy, and compliance requirements in enterprise software engineering.Demonstrated experience aligning engineering initiatives with business and customer value, delivering measurable outcomes in agile environments.Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.How You will Grow: At Deloitte, our professional development plans focus on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day and excel in everything they do.

Lead by example through thought leadership—speaking at conferences, publishing, R&D, or collaborating with academia. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. description: Senior Analyst-Quantitative Strategic Insights- Global Strategic Insights CenterAre you seeking exciting business insights, market intelligence, and strategy development opportunities? title: USI-EH-27 - Tax-TTC-CLM-L35 - Consultant - DocuSign - Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Gurugram/Pune/Mumbai
description: Consultant Tax Technology Consulting - DocuSign - CLMThe role of technology in tax and legal functions has grown exponentially in importance as resource needs change and tax regulations and legal management become more rigorous.   If you are someone who thrives in navigating the growing tax and legal landscape through a technology lens and partnering with passionate professionals to help companies achieve their objectives; then we would like to get to know you.  Apply now! What you’ll doAs a professional in Deloitte’s Tax Technology Consulting (TTC) team, you will be a part of a team that provides an integrated approach to technology implementations, automation, data wrangling, managed legal services and analytics that help tax and legal departments maximize the strategic value to the organization.  You will deliver technical services for companies that streamline their process and increase efficiency; leveraging, integrating with numerous applications, and creating custom solutions.Key responsibilities will be to:       Ø  Configure contract management technologies based on requirements documented by the TMC client facing team.       Ø  Conduct user acceptance testing to compile comprehensive test scenarios and identify flaws as well as improvements to newly built systems and processes       Ø  Gather and document contract management requirements for business and performing system fit and gap analysis.Experience Required –       Ø  3 +years of total experience.       Ø  3+ years of implementation experience in DocuSign CLM application.       Ø  Expert in configuring and troubleshooting DocuSign workflows.       Ø  Experience with DocuSign and API integrations is an added advantage.       Ø  DocuSign CLM Consultant certified (proctored exam).       Ø  Strong documentation skills       Ø  Lead and manage POC of latest DocuSign functionalities.       Ø  Expert in CLM configuration with template rationalization and harmonization, guide or playbook creation and the design of the contracting processes and related functionality.       Ø  Multiple successful project implementation experience in DocuSign.       Ø  Strong in project management, leadership abilities, and has tendency to independently execute project cycles and deliverables.      Relentless focus on quality of work products while adhering to completing deliverables on time       Ø  Effective communications and strong presentation and team building skills.       Ø  Proactive, participates in firm-based activities, and owns his/her career.       Ø  Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparation.       Ø  Team Management experience (For Senior Professionals). Preferred Skills:  Ø  Certifications with any of the tools mentioned, as well as PMP or PMI-ACP, and/or Scrum Master  Ø  Experience with DocuSign CLM implementation  Ø  Experience in DocuSign AI, would be added advantage.Education/Background:·       Engineering with overall experience in functional consulting and coding.The teamAt Deloitte Tax LLP, our Tax Technology Consulting (TTC) practice helps tax departments pursue a streamlined, transparent, and efficient tax function that enhances the core responsibilities of compliance, reporting and planning, while also positioning tax as a strategic business advisor for the digital era. We specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. As technology specialists, we help clients make appropriate technology choices for both direct and indirect taxes across all business cycles that have a tax impact tax. Our team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients with a successful ERP implementation.Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to support our clients’ objectives and address their challenges. Our team’s multi-disciplinary approach combines tax technical and technology skillsets, enabling greater impact and efficiency within our client’s organization. TTC’s business services help clients with operating model evaluation, roadmap development for a desired future state, data management solutions, automation opportunities, tax portal, cloud for enterprise systems, agile resourcing models, risk, provision, and compliance.  Learn more about Deloitte Tax Management Consulting.Our purpose Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our clients, our people, and in our communities. We are creating trust and confidence in a more equitable society. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. We are focusing our collective efforts to advance sustainability, equity, and trust that come to life through our core commitments. Learn more about Deloitte’s purpose, commitments, and impact.  Our inclusive culture At Deloitte, we value our people and work to build an inclusive culture, where our people are encouraged to bring their authentic selves to work. Our commitment has led to outstanding results in terms of attracting, retaining, and advancing a diverse workforce. We drive multiple efforts focused on intentional hiring, increasing awareness and sensitization, and ensuring a safe work environment for all professionals. We are regularly recognized as an employer of choice across a range of aspects, including inclusion, well-being, innovation, leadership, and a place to start your career. To learn more, check out our latest accolades.  Professional development At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state-of-the-art, world-class learning center in the Hyderabad office, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.  Benefits to help you thrive At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.  Recruiting tips From developing a standout resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.  #CA-PA#CA-HNP#CA-DS1 #TechnologyFY26

description: Senior Consultant – Tax Technology Consulting (TTC) - SAP MM/FICO/SD integration with Direct Or Indirect Tax experienceDo you have a passion to work for US based clients of Deloitte Tax and transform their current state of tax to the next generation of tax functions? Are you ready to fulfill your potential and want to have a significant impact to global initiatives? If the answer to all the above is “Yes,” come join Tax Management Consulting group in Deloitte India (Offices of the U.S), a service line of Deloitte Tax LLP!Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in June 2004. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.How you’ll growAt Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. title: USI-EH27-Product Engineering - Experience Leadership - Design Thinking specialist - M/EM
description: As a Lead UX Product Designer for the Deloitte DT-US Product Engineering team, you will be tasked with solving complex challenges through elegant, user-centered design solutions. Our ideal candidate is a versatile design generalist with deep expertise in interaction design. You should feel equally at home shaping big-picture workflow and strategy as you are prototyping details visual and interaction elements. This role requires a proven track-record of experience-driven innovation. Join us in shaping the future of design!You are a user-centered design expert and will lead the creation of design strategy and vision, shaping big-picture workflow and product direction while also delivering high-quality visual and interaction design elements.You have a deep understanding of lean UX approaches and working in small, empowered product teams to design & deliver impactful experiences. You will apply behavioral metrics, user research findings, and other data-driven insights to design innovative product solutions that delight our users and meet their needs. Join us in shaping the future of design!Work you'll doAs a Lead Software Engineer I- Experience Designer- Manager on the Deloitte DT-US Product Engineering team, you will be responsible for: Leading UX strategy and design for a product or product area, connecting individual solutions to the broader product experience vision Collaborating with product, engineering, business, and delivery stakeholders to define user-centered solutions aligned to business goals and key performance indicators Creating workflows, user journeys, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and other UX deliverables that support intuitive and consistent user experiences Applying user research, usability findings, and behavioral data to identify experience opportunities, solve interface challenges, and improve product outcomes Contributing to design standards, reusable assets, and experience practices while guiding teams through workshops, reviews, and hands-on design execution The teamDeloitte DT-US Product Engineering brings together product, engineering, and experience capabilities to build digital products that support business priorities and user needs. The team works in cross-functional product squads to define, design, and deliver scalable experiences through iterative development and continuous improvement. description: As a Senior Consultant - FTH in Deloitte’s Cyber Identity practice, you will support the delivery of Identity and Access Management solutions for enterprise clients, with a focus on Saviynt implementations and support. title: USI EH | FY27 | Cyber | Digital Trust & Privacy | DP/DLP - Consultant
description: As a Consultant in Deloitte’s Cyber practice, you will help clients strengthen data protection capabilities across strategy, design, and implementation efforts. You will support the delivery of data protection solutions that address security, privacy, and regulatory requirements while helping organizations operate with greater confidence in a changing risk landscape. This role offers the opportunity to work across assessments, solution design, deployment, integration, and client enablement in complex enterprise environments.Work you'll doAs a Consultant - Data Protection on the Data and Digital Trust team, you will be responsible for: Assess client data protection environments, perform gap analyses, and support the development of remediation recommendations aligned to business and security requirements. Contribute to the design of data protection solutions, including technical requirements, high-level design, low-level design, and evaluation of technologies through proof-of-concept activities. Deploy, configure, and support data protection technologies across enterprise environments, including migrations, upgrades, high-availability configurations, and platform integrations. Develop detection use cases, workflows, and supporting documentation to help clients operationalize and sustain data protection capabilities. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, client stakeholders, and third-party vendors to deliver implementation activities, knowledge transfer, and project documentation. The teamData and Digital Trust practice is primarily focused on helping our clients to do effective utilization of data while safeguarding privacy and security. D&DT solutions prioritize transparency, privacy, and the ethical use of data, assisting organizations in driving sustainable digital transformation. Our solutions assist organizations in meeting the shifting expectations of consumers and create unprecedented business opportunities. We help our clients to define their overall Data protection and Privacy strategy, design global, pan-enterprise programs that focus on mitigating threats, evaluate their objectives, priorities, strengths and weaknesses and roll out large scale organizational changes to achieve goals. Our services capture work across advice, implement, and operate solutions. The Data and Digital Trust team delivers services to clients through following key areas: Privacy Governance & Compliance Data Protection & Compliance Digital Trust & Online Protection Risk & Controls Enablement Technology & Implementation Our Data and Digital Trust solutions are designed to allow organizations to address requirements stemming from the ever-changing regulatory landscape, consumer expectations, and technological transformations and advancements.Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / ChennaiShift Timings: IST 11 AM to 8 PMQualificationsRequired: 3-6 years of experience assessing, designing, and implementing data protection strategies and solutions Experience performing current-state assessments, gap analyses, and solution architecture for data protection programs Experience developing technical requirements, high-level designs, and low-level designs for enterprise data protection implementations Experience deploying, configuring, or migrating security or data protection solutions in enterprise environments Experience integrating data protection technologies with other security platforms and enterprise systems Experience creating architectural, technical, or operational documentation and supporting client knowledge transfer Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, or Master of Science in Computer Science, or equivalent Preferred: Experience developing detection techniques and customizing workflows within data protection solutions Experience working with cloud or hybrid security architectures One or more certifications such as Certified Information Systems Auditor, Certified Cloud Security Professional, Certified Information Security Manager, cloud security certifications, or vendor certifications in platforms such as Varonis, Netskope, BigID, Imperva, Securiti.ai, Zscaler, Symantec, or Forcepoint#Cyber_Digital Trust & Privacy#CA-TD

title: USI - EH27 - Product Engineering Talent - Full Stack Software Engineer - Assistant Manager
description: L40 - Software Specialist Engineer IIRole Overview: As a Full-stack Software Engineer, you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to multiple high-visibility projects. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering solutions that delight customers and users, while also driving tangible value for Deloitte's business investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftmanship across multiple programming languages and modern frameworks, consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy advanced software solutions.Key Responsibilities:Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations.Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring code integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals. Lead requirement analysis, component design, development, unit testing, integrations, and support.Engineering Craftsmanship: Maintain accountability for the integrity of code design, implementation, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Be hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code ensuring all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.Customer-Centric Engineering: Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time.Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions.Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.Advanced Technical Proficiency: Possess deep expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including Agile methodologies and DevSecOps to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from code check-in to production with all quality checks through SDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Demonstrate understanding of the full lifecycle product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.Domain Expertise: Quickly acquire domain-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs, architectures, and UX/UI designs into technical specifications and code. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.Effective Communication and Influence: Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.Key Qualifications:§  A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline. An advanced degree (e.g., MS) is preferred but not required. Experience is the most relevant factor.§  Strong software engineering foundation with the understanding of OOPs, data-structure, algorithms, code instrumentations, beautiful coding practices, etc. §  5+ years proven experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python, C#, .NET Core, Java, Golang, SQL/NoSQL.§  5+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering, using FaaS/PaaS/micro-services on cloud hyper-scalers like Azure, AWS, and GCP.§  Strong understanding of methodologies & tools like, XP, Lean, SAFe, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, etc. to deliver high quality products rapidly.§  Strong preference will be given to candidates with experience in AI/ML and GenAI.§  Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.How You will Grow: At Deloitte, our professional development plans focus on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day and excel in everything they do.#ProductEngineeringFY26

title: USI-EH27-Tax-LBS - Legal Management Services (LMS) -L35 - Tax Consultant 2-Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Gurugram/Pune
description: Legal Business Associate Tax Consultant-2, Legal Business ServicesMultinational organizations need personnel who can provide legal business services support in their full lifecycle of process and subject matter challenges and opportunities. Deloitte Legal Business Services (“LBS”) assists clients with all aspects of reporting and process for business as usual, as well as triggering and regulatory events. Bring your expertise and client service skills to Deloitte and click “apply” now!Work you’ll do:As a Consultant in Deloitte’s Legal Business Services function for Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“Deloitte Tax in India”), you will provide corporate business legal services support on engagements for our clients’ large and complex organizations. Services include assisting supervising counsel with their business-as-usual contracting and negotiations; and review, and remediation services in response to regulatory and corporate triggering events; assisting in calendaring, statutory filings, workflow coordination, information and records management. You will interact mainly with US and global team members, as applicable and will contribute directly to delivering first class service to our clients. You will be working with Deloitte Senior Managers, Managers and Seniors of Legal Business Services (“LBS”) projects and engagements. Your primary responsibility will be ensuring the high-quality delivery of the work to the leads. As a part of the services, you will pursue and execute continuous service improvements through technology and process improvements. You need to consistently strive for excellence, taking pride in carrying out responsibilities efficiently and with impeccable execution. You should be a self- starter who works well within a team, is energized by a continuous learning environment, and possesses an ability to work well with deadlines.Responsibilities will include:· Deliver legal business engagements for Deloitte clients – Assisting in drafting and negotiating playbooks-based buy side and sales side commercial contracts such as MSA, NDAs, SoWs, Work Orders, Change Notes· Identify process and operational efficiencies within corporate business legal services clients’ contracting function· Report against KPIs and metrics· Assist in executing engagement administration: document collection, data entry, tracking, records organization, contract review, and coordinating client logistics· Review and project manage the entire contracting process i.e., coordinating with various stakeholders such as finance, legal, commercial, business, delivery and incorporating their feedback in the contract and assisting in closing the contract· Review in researching technical and industry-specific issues· Communicate effectively to all levels of engagement management and clients· Ability to balance multiple projects and responsibilitiesDisclaimer: Deloitte Tax in India and its affiliates in the United States and India do not practice law or provide legal advice.The Team:Legal Business Services is a service line within Deloitte Tax in India that collaborates and works closely with other Deloitte business units, including Deloitte Advisory and Deloitte Consulting. title: USI- EH-FY27- L45 - NSE TAX ERP- SD + Excise + ABAP + CDS View- Senior, Tax Technology Services
description: Senior, Tax Technology ServicesDo you have a passion to work for large multinational clients of Deloitte Tax and transform their current state of tax to the next generation of tax functions? Are you ready to take the next step in your career to find new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations? Are you ready to fulfill your potential and want to have a significant impact to global initiatives? If the answer to all of the above is "Yes," come join Tax Technology Consulting group in Deloitte India. Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP ("Deloitte Tax") U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a much sought-after career option. At Deloitte, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment. Position Summary Deloitte is seeking a Tax Technology Services Consultant II to support the delivery of technology-enabled solutions that help improve tax operations, reporting, and compliance processes. This role involves working with tax, data, and technology stakeholders to support implementation, enhancement, and ongoing administration of tax technology solutions. The position requires strong execution skills, attention to process detail, and the ability to contribute across multiple workstreams in a dynamic environment.Work you'll doAs a Tax Technology Services Consultant II on the Tax Technology Services team, you will be responsible for… Supporting the implementation, configuration, and maintenance of tax technology solutions Assisting with data validation, testing, issue tracking, and resolution across tax technology workstreams Preparing functional documentation, process flows, test scripts, and status updates for project activities Coordinating with tax, technology, and business stakeholders to support solution delivery and process improvement efforts Analyzing existing tax processes and identifying opportunities to improve accuracy, efficiency, and standardization The teamThe Tax Technology Services team helps organizations improve the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of their tax processes through technology-enabled solutions. The team works across tax operations, data, and systems to support implementation, enhancement, and ongoing delivery of technology solutions aligned to client and business needs. Professionals in this group collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to solve process challenges, support transformation initiatives, and deliver measurable business outcomes.Location: Hyderabad / Gurgaon / BangaloreShift Timings: 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM ITSQualifications Required: Bachelor’s degree SAP SD Certified with Excise Tax/GTS experienced consultant with over 3 + years of SAP SD Functional Experience emphasizes in configuration, implementation, and support of S4/HANA SD Module experience. Min 3 Full Lifecycle Implementation experience with successful teamwork. Experience in Global Template Preparation and Rollouts. Hands on experience on customer master, delivery processing, Shipping & Transportation. Configuration of the Billing Procedures - Individual Billing, Collective Billing, Invoice Split Processing and Inter-company billing and credit management. Configured Pricing, Pricing procedure, Condition types, Condition tables, and Access sequences, Condition Records, Condition Exclusions and Condition Supplements. Thorough understanding of various pricing techniques. Hands on experience on Collecting requirements, Business Analysis, Gap Analysis, Configuration, customizing interface objects, Testing, User training, Conducting workshops, Performance, Pre, and Post Implementation Support. Strong understanding of the SD module's integration with MM / PP and FI/CO modules. Preferred: Managing Major and Minor changes and enhancements efficiently as per the business requirement Good experience in the configuration, defect management, testing, documentation, and end-user support phase of the project cycle Proficient with enhancements and modifications of the existing functions Experience with or having had exposure to (Indirect) Tax Reporting in SAP is a plus

description: The BCM Specialist role sits within the Business Continuity & Resilience team in the USI Office of Security. title: USI EH | FY27 | Cyber | Digital Trust & Privacy | DP-MS Purview - Senior Consultant
description: As a Senior Consultant in Deloitte’s Cyber practice, you will help clients strengthen data protection capabilities across strategy, design, and implementation efforts. You will support the delivery of data protection solutions that address security, privacy, and regulatory requirements while helping organizations operate with greater confidence in a changing risk landscape. This role offers the opportunity to work across assessments, solution design, deployment, integration, and client enablement in complex enterprise environments.Work you'll doAs a Senior Consultant - Data Protection on the Data and Digital Trust team, you will be responsible for: Assess client data protection environments, perform gap analyses, and support the development of remediation recommendations aligned to business and security requirements. Contribute to the design of data protection solutions, including technical requirements, high-level design, low-level design, and evaluation of technologies through proof-of-concept activities. Deploy, configure, and support data protection technologies across enterprise environments, including migrations, upgrades, high-availability configurations, and platform integrations. Develop detection use cases, workflows, and supporting documentation to help clients operationalize and sustain data protection capabilities. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, client stakeholders, and third-party vendors to deliver implementation activities, knowledge transfer, and project documentation. The teamData and Digital Trust practice is primarily focused on helping our clients to do effective utilization of data while safeguarding privacy and security. D&DT solutions prioritize transparency, privacy, and the ethical use of data, assisting organizations in driving sustainable digital transformation. Our solutions assist organizations in meeting the shifting expectations of consumers and create unprecedented business opportunities. We help our clients to define their overall Data protection and Privacy strategy, design global, pan-enterprise programs that focus on mitigating threats, evaluate their objectives, priorities, strengths and weaknesses and roll out large scale organizational changes to achieve goals. Our services capture work across advice, implement, and operate solutions. The Data and Digital Trust team delivers services to clients through following key areas: Privacy Governance & Compliance Data Protection & Compliance Digital Trust & Online Protection Risk & Controls Enablement Technology & Implementation Our Data and Digital Trust solutions are designed to allow organizations to address requirements stemming from the ever-changing regulatory landscape, consumer expectations, and technological transformations and advancements.Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / ChennaiShift Timings: IST 11 AM to 8 PMQualificationsRequired: 5-7 years of experience assessing, designing, and implementing data protection strategies and solutions Experience performing current-state assessments, gap analyses, and solution architecture for data protection programs Experience developing technical requirements, high-level designs, and low-level designs for enterprise data protection implementations Experience deploying, configuring, or migrating security or data protection solutions in enterprise environments Experience integrating data protection technologies with other security platforms and enterprise systems Experience creating architectural, technical, or operational documentation and supporting client knowledge transfer Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, or Master of Science in Computer Science, or equivalent Preferred: Experience developing detection techniques and customizing workflows within data protection solutions Experience working with cloud or hybrid security architectures One or more certifications such as Certified Information Systems Auditor, Certified Cloud Security Professional, Certified Information Security Manager, cloud security certifications, or vendor certifications in platforms such as Varonis, Netskope, BigID, Imperva, Securiti.ai, Zscaler, Symantec, or Forcepoint#Cyber_Digital Trust & Privacy#CA-TD

title: USI EH | FY27 | Cyber | Digital Trust & Privacy | Data Privacy-Tech - Senior Consultant
description: As a Senior Consultant in Deloitte’s Data and Digital Trust practice, you will support the design and implementation of privacy technology solutions that help organizations address regulatory requirements, strengthen data governance, and enable trusted business outcomes. You will contribute across configuration, integration, testing, and deployment activities while working with client, vendor, and cross-functional teams. This role offers the opportunity to take on increased ownership in privacy-by-design initiatives, AI governance efforts, and large-scale technology implementations.Work you'll doAs a Data Privacy-Tech - Senior Consultant on the Data and Digital Trust team, you will be responsible for: Configure, test, and deploy privacy platform modules, including data subject access requests, consent and preference management, records of processing activities, privacy impact assessments, incident response, and third-party risk workflows. title: USI-EH27-DTTL-Assistant Manager – Insights Specialist – Global Strategic Insights Center
description: Insights Specialist – Assistant Manager – Global Strategic Insights Center – Deloitte Support Services India Private Limited Are you seeking an exciting opportunity in strategic business insights and market intelligence? Do you find the interplay of business economics/financials, industry dynamics, and macroeconomic environment thrilling? If yes, then Global Strategic Insights Center is the team for you. The team is a dynamic group of curious, analytical, and creative problem solvers. The team supports Deloitte’s leaders with strategic insights, empowering them with their go-to-market strategies, eminence agenda, and impact on our clients. Work you'll do As an Assistant Manager, Standardized Strategic Support Services on the Global Strategic Insights Center team, you will be responsible for: Developing account relationships and designing market-facing strategic insights solutions for senior leadership to support business development, client engagement, practice development, and eminence priorities Leading consultative discussions with stakeholders across the Deloitte network to assess business needs and tailor research and insights solutions Managing existing customer relationships, increasing engagement, and identifying opportunities to expand demand for the team’s services Synthesizing qualitative and quantitative research, financial analysis, and strategic frameworks into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for senior leadership Managing project execution, quality, timelines, and stakeholder expectations while coordinating with Deloitte colleagues across geographies Leading operational workstreams and mentoring team members The team Global Strategic Insights Center provides secondary research and analysis services to global Deloitte Member Firms supporting pursuit, business development, practice development, and client engagements. The team uses exclusive sources, specialized research skills, and industry expertise to develop insightful research reports, delivering significant value to customers across Deloitte’s global network. Learn more about Deloitte. Location: Bengaluru/Gurugram/Hyderabad Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM Qualifications Required: Postgraduate degree 6-8 years of experience, including 2+ years in research and insight generation Experience in stakeholder management and account management Experience in qualitative and quantitative analysis, including financial statement analysis and use of strategic or forecasting frameworks Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint Experience using research tools such as Capital IQ, Refinitiv, and Factiva Preferred: Experience supporting business development, pursuit, practice development, or eminence initiatives Experience creating presentations or reports for senior leadership Experience mentoring or coaching team members Experience identifying cross-sell or up-sell opportunities Experience in one or more industries with knowledge of industry trends, benchmarks, and operating dynamics Ability to travel 0%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.#ESG-CORE27#CAL-AS2
