description: Regulatory, Risk & ForensicOur Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team supports client leaders to translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform organizations. Leverage advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with deep domain and industry insights to help bring clarity from complexity and accelerate the path to value creation.Position SummaryLevel: Senior Consultant or equivalentAs a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.Work you’ll do:As part of the team, you will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to collect, analyze, and interpret critical market data for investment banking, trading, and risk management initiatives. You will leverage advanced analytical tools and programming techniques to develop data-driven insights that inform business decisions, optimize trading strategies, and support regulatory compliance. Your work will involve sourcing and validating market, reference, and transactional data from a variety of internal and external platforms, ensuring data quality and integrity, and creating dashboards and reports that translate complex datasets into actionable intelligence for our clients and teams. You will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development and enhancement of data architectures and processes, staying up to date on industry trends, and helping Deloitte’s clients navigate evolving capital markets environments.The team: Our Enterprise Operations & Risk professionals help organizations effectively navigate business risks and opportunities—from strategic, reputation, and financial risks to operational and regulatory risks—to gain competitive advantage. We apply our experience in ongoing business operations and corporate lifecycle events to help clients become stronger and more resilient. Our market-leading teams help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries. We help organizations in their efforts to achieve regulatory and legal compliance and transform their departments to add greater value to the business. We combine highly specialized skills focused on process, risk and controls to produce transformative insights. Our team:Enable profitable growth and competitive advantage by optimizing “heart of the business” operations.Leverage deep domain expertise to extend enterprise resilience, agility, and remediation.Drive enterprise- wide impact across strategy, operations, performance, and reputation.QualificationsMust Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: Minimum 7 years of relevant industry experience with a financial services consulting organization or a large bank or a broker-dealer or investment management firm or GCC (Global Capability Centres) of these financial services firms.CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) or FRM (Financial Risk Manager) certification.Experience of working on Request for Proposals (RFPs).Prior external or internal consulting experience.Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Management or similar fields.Master’s degree in finance, Business Analytics, IT, or Master of Business Administration (MBA) is preferred.Experience of Capital Markets data sets (e.g., Market Data, Pricing Data, Reference Data, Trade/Transaction Data) across the trade life cycle and broker-dealer processes.Hands-on knowledge of Capital Markets data processes across asset classes, exchanges and market data sources, including understanding of data feeds, mapping, and regulatory fields.Experience of executing data management strategies (Data Architecture, Data Lakes/Warehouses, Data Integration, Data Quality, and Stewardship) specific to Capital Markets operations.Experience of working or a good knowledge of regulations, pertaining to the U.S. or requirement gathering, data analysis, and gap analysis including analyzing requirements and breaking them down into actionable functional specifications, converting business requirements into test cases and coordinating testing.Hands-on experience of SQL and Python for manipulation, analysis, and automation of Capital Markets data and related business processes.Experience of collaborating effectively with business, technology, and operations teams, fostering alignment across projects, while efficiently documenting findings and project outcomes.Strong problem-solving, analytical, stakeholder management and presentation skills to navigate through complex business scenarios and recommend effective mitigation strategies and action plans.Good communication skills with the ability to articulate complex financial information and proficiency in documenting findings and effectively communicating risk and control issues to stakeholders.Flexible and dynamic in nature and able to visualizations, and reports using industry-leading tools (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik) or GenAI/Agentic AI is desirable.Exposure to major market data vendors (Bloomberg, Refinitiv, ICE) or in-house data platforms is desirable.Education:Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Management or similar fields.Master’s degree in finance, Business Analytics, IT, or Master of Business Administration (MBA) is preferred.Location:·       Bengaluru/Hyderabad#CA-AEN

description: MES Apriso –Consultant, Technical TransformationJoin Deloitte’s Enterprise Performance practice as a Consultant, MES Apriso, where you will support the delivery of manufacturing execution system solutions that help clients improve operational performance, compliance, and digital manufacturing capabilities. In this role, you will contribute to MES design, configuration, implementation, integration, and deployment activities across complex manufacturing environments. You will work with cross-functional teams to deliver quality work products, support client requirements, and help enable scalable technology solutions aligned to business objectives.Work you'll doAs a Consultant, MES Apriso on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for supporting MES transformation and implementation initiatives across client environments. Support requirements gathering, process analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment activities for MES implementations. Configure and customize MES capabilities across production, quality management, dispatching, scheduling, work-in-process tracking, resource tracking, and maintenance management processes. Support MES integration activities across enterprise resource planning, Level 2 automation, supervisory control and data acquisition, product lifecycle management, advanced planning systems, laboratory information management systems, and other connected platforms. Contribute to workshops, solution documentation, data model validation, configuration validation, testing, and training support for business and technology stakeholders. Support issue analysis, defect resolution, and continuous improvement activities across MES implementations and enhancement releases. The teamEnterprise PerformanceOur Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions.The Enterprise Performance team leverages deep industry knowledge, strong analytical skills, and practical approaches to address clients’ toughest business challenges. Our professionals as part of the Supply Chain Network Operations (SCNO) service line within Enterprise Performance focus on helping organizations achieve sustainable competitive advantage throughout their operations, spanning product development, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution. description: Job Description - Strategy & Transactions – Strategy (Consultant) Join Deloitte Strategy & Transactions – Where Strategy Meets Impact At Deloitte Strategy & Transactions (S&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth. We work with C-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most — from navigating complex M&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. We are trusted advisors during our clients' most critical, high-stakes moments. But we don’t stop at client impact — we are equally passionate about investing in our people. At S&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive. Our capabilities span the full lifecycle of transformation — from Enterprise and Growth Strategy to Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy, end-to-end M&A, valuation and modeling, and performance improvement & restructuring, to infrastructure & real estate advisory and sustainability-driven innovation. If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real-world impact — and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ — Strategy & Transactions is your next move. The Team Our Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate & Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy & Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation. Strategy professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data-driven choices about where to play and how to win, in order to drive growth and enterprise value.

description: As a Services Associate, Firm Risk, Compliance, and Governance Services on the Risk & Brand Protection team, you will be responsible for: Reviewing, creating, and monitoring contract summaries and tracking obligations to validate that deliverables are met in line with contractual terms and conditions Managing trackers for work-in-progress contracts and work-at-risk items, capturing action items, and updating status Assisting with reviews related to statements of work and change requests as required Collaborating with stakeholders and Canadian Contract & Risk Managers on risk and contract management activities Supporting other ad hoc tasks and responsibilities as assigned The teamThe Risk team’s mission is to protect the earnings, assets, and reputation of the firm, facilitate consistency of delivery, and reduce the cost of quality. title: USI-EH27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Consultant-BS-Generalist
description: Job Description - Strategy & Transactions – Strategy (Consultant)Join Deloitte Strategy & Transactions – Where Strategy Meets ImpactAt Deloitte Strategy & Transactions (S&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth.We work with C-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most — from navigating complex M&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. We are trusted advisors during our clients' most critical, high-stakes moments.But we don’t stop at client impact — we are equally passionate about investing in our people. At S&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.Our capabilities span the full lifecycle of transformation — from Enterprise and Growth Strategy to Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy, end-to-end M&A, valuation and modeling, and performance improvement & restructuring, to infrastructure & real estate advisory and sustainability-driven innovation.If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real-world impact — and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ — Strategy & Transactions is your next move.The teamOur Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate & Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy & Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation.Strategy professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data-driven choices about where to play and how to win, in order to drive growth and enterprise value.Work you will doDeloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go-to-market strategies, channel strategies, and pricing strategies.·       Identify strategies for growth and value creation·       Develop the appropriate business models, technology operating models, and capabilities to support their strategic vision·       Providing service excellence by identifying key client business issues, determining client needs by supplementing the standard assessment techniques and tools with innovative approaches, evaluating, and validating analysis and developing recommendations for the client in the context of the overall engagement·       Contribute to multiple work-threads of large, complex engagements, with the high-quality deliverables·       Participate in the development and presentation of proposals for business development activities·       Maximize the ROI on technology investments and leverage technology trends to architect future technology strategiesRequired Experience and SkillsStrategy-specific experience:Enterprise and Growth Strategy - Generalist·       Experience working on: Corporate Strategy, Go-to-market (GTM) Strategy, Market Research / Assessment, Business Planning, Roadmap Development, Business Model, Operating Model Assessment, Business Unit Growth Strategy, Cost-Reduction, Future of Mobility, Vendor Assessment in anyone of the industries mentioned – Banking and Capital Markets, Asset Management, Insurance, Consumer, TMT (Technology, Media, and Telecommunications), Life Sciences and Healthcare, ER&I (Energy, Resources, and Industrials)·       Hands-on experience (min 1+ year of experience) of working in corporate strategy teams and/or cross functional stakeholder interactions / visibility with leading companies in above mentioned industries·       Exposure to working in non-India geographies (preferably US) and / or interacting with global stakeholders·       Interest and knowledge about the current trends in one of the focus industries·       Demonstrate ability to understand and analyze business issues and leverage technology to solve themCore Consulting Skills·       Clear and concise communication - conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations·       Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members·       Analytical thinking - ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.·       Logical structuring - structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems·       Deadline-oriented and quality focused - develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources·       Collaboration - Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate·       Network - ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organizationQualifications Required:·       MBA or MS from a premier (Tier-1) school in India or abroad ·       1 to 3 years of relevant experience (post MS / MBA)·       1 to 2 years industry experience (Consumer, TMT, Retail, Automobile, Hospitality, Life Sciences, Healthcare, B&CM, IMRE, Insurance, ER&I, etc.)

These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations. Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll translate business needs into system solutions, contribute as an individual or team lead, oversee daily reporting and delivery, and play a key role in all project phases from requirements through Hypercare. This Offering advises, implements, and delivers solution as-a-service relating to digital finance strategies, financial planning and analysis, enterprise performance strategies and technologies solutions. By taking a holistic view of these key business areas from strategy development through process design and technology enablement, we help our clients navigate their challenges while continuing to succeed in their business. title: USI-EH27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-TS-AI Strategy
description: Job Description - Strategy & Transactions – Strategy (Consultant) Join Deloitte Strategy & Transactions – Where Strategy Meets Impact At Deloitte Strategy & Transactions (S&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth. We work with C-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most — from navigating complex M&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. We are trusted advisors during our clients' most critical, high-stakes moments. But we don’t stop at client impact — we are equally passionate about investing in our people. At S&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive. Our capabilities span the full lifecycle of transformation — from Enterprise and Growth Strategy to Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy, end-to-end M&A, valuation and modeling, and performance improvement & restructuring, to infrastructure & real estate advisory and sustainability-driven innovation. If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real-world impact — and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ — Strategy & Transactions is your next move. The Team Our Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate & Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy & Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation. Strategy professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data-driven choices about where to play and how to win, in order to drive growth and enterprise value.

description: Artificial Intelligence & EngineeringAI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. You will work across business and technology-led initiatives, helping translate complex requirements into structured analyses and actionable recommendations. In this role, you may also coordinate with junior team members and collaborate with onsite and offshore stakeholders to support project delivery.Work you'll doAs a Consultant, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation on the AI & Engineering team, you will be responsible for:• Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements aligned to client, sector, and project objectives.• Support solution delivery across the software development lifecycle, including analysis, design, testing, deployment, and defect resolution.• Participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, retrospectives, and estimation to help drive timely delivery.• Conduct reviews of work products and contribute to quality assurance across project deliverables.• Develop business process knowledge, support knowledge management, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, automation, and project outcomes.The teamYou will play a key role in developing verticalized solutions tailored to the unique needs of each client’s sector, transforming how organizations sell products, deliver services, drive growth, and sustain mission-critical operations. By leveraging your business expertise and advanced technology, you will help ensure every solution is seamlessly integrated with Industry Advantage and aligned with sector-specific requirements. With your focus on innovation and measurable value, you will empower clients to achieve strategic objectives, enhance operational efficiency, and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving marketplace by addressing core business challenges and opportunities across industries.Location: Bengaluru/HyderabadQualificationsRequired:• 3-6 years of experience in consulting, corporate strategy, or business functions within Health Plans, Provider, Revenue Cycle, or Life Sciences.• Experience in business analysis, including gathering requirements from multiple stakeholders and documenting user journeys and functional processes.• Experience analyzing market landscape, including industry trends, regulatory topics, risk, and competitive intelligence, using primary and secondary research sources.• Experience analyzing financial and non-financial data sets to generate business insights and support decision-making.• Experience independently managing workstreams and owning end-to-end deliverables.• Knowledge of the US Health Plans landscape, including regulatory considerations, market dynamics, and current industry trends.• Experience working with stakeholders across global teams or in non-India geographies.Preferred:• Experience with emerging technologies and their application to business problems, such as digital transformation, robotic process automation, or blockchain.• Experience with data analysis or visualization tools such as Minitab, Power BI, or Tableau.• Master of Business Administration or equivalent degree from a recognized institution, or postgraduate specialization in healthcare or hospital management.#FY27ReferralCampaign#2027_AI&E_Dscreen

title: USI - EH27 - Product Engineering CSG - Full Stack Software Engineer (AWS) - Assistant Manager
description: L40 - Software Specialist Engineer IIRole Overview: As a Full-stack Software Engineer, you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to multiple high-visibility projects. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering solutions that delight customers and users, while also driving tangible value for Deloitte's business investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftmanship across multiple programming languages and modern frameworks, consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy advanced software solutions.Key Responsibilities:Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations.Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring code integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals. Lead requirement analysis, component design, development, unit testing, integrations, and support.Engineering Craftsmanship: Maintain accountability for the integrity of code design, implementation, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Be hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code ensuring all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.Customer-Centric Engineering: Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time.Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions.Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.Advanced Technical Proficiency: Possess deep expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including Agile methodologies and DevSecOps to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from code check-in to production with all quality checks through SDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Demonstrate understanding of the full lifecycle product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.Domain Expertise: Quickly acquire domain-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs, architectures, and UX/UI designs into technical specifications and code. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.Effective Communication and Influence: Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.Key Qualifications:§  A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline. An advanced degree (e.g., MS) is preferred but not required. Experience is the most relevant factor.§  Strong software engineering foundation with the understanding of OOPs, data-structure, algorithms, code instrumentations, beautiful coding practices, etc. §  5+ years proven experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python, C#, .NET Core, Java, Golang, SQL/NoSQL.§  5+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering, using FaaS/PaaS/micro-services on cloud hyper-scalers like Azure, AWS, and GCP.§  Strong understanding of methodologies & tools like, XP, Lean, SAFe, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, etc. to deliver high quality products rapidly.§  Strong preference will be given to candidates with experience in AI/ML and GenAI.§  Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.How You will Grow: At Deloitte, our professional development plans focus on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day and excel in everything they do.#ProductEngineeringFY26

title: USI - EH27 - Product Engineering - Full Stack Software Engineer - Assistant Manager
description: As a Full-stack Software Engineer, you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to multiple high-visibility projects. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering solutions that delight customers and users, while also driving tangible value for Deloitte's business investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftmanship across multiple programming languages and modern frameworks, consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy advanced software solutions. Work you'll do As a Software Specialist Engineer II on the Product Engineering team, you will be responsible for: Designing, developing, testing, and supporting full-stack software solutions across modern engineering frameworks and languages Translating business, architecture, and user experience requirements into technical specifications and scalable code Leading component design, unit testing, integrations, and deployment activities to support high-quality product delivery Applying Agile, DevSecOps, and engineering best practices to improve automation, maintainability, and release quality Collaborating with product, experience, and delivery teams to deliver iterative solutions that address customer and business needs The team US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. Location: Hyderabad, Gurugram, Bengaluru Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM Qualifications Required: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline 5+ years of experience in software engineering using most of the following: Angular, React, Node.js, Python, C#, .NET Core, Java, Go, and SQL/NoSQL databases 5+ years of experience in cloud-native engineering using function as a service (FaaS), platform as a service (PaaS), or microservices on Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Experience with object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentation Experience using one or more of the following methodologies and tools: Extreme Programming (XP), Lean, Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), DevSecOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Azure DevOps, GitHub, and SonarQube Preferred: Advanced degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline Experience in artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), or generative AI

title: USI-EH27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Consultant-TS-Enterprise Architecture
description: Job Description - Strategy & Transactions – Strategy (Consultant)At Deloitte Strategy & Transactions (S&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth.We work with C-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most — from navigating complex M&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. We are trusted advisors during our clients' most critical, high-stakes moments.But we don’t stop at client impact — we are equally passionate about investing in our people. At S&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.Our capabilities span the full lifecycle of transformation — from Enterprise and Growth Strategy to Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy, end-to-end M&A, valuation and modeling, and performance improvement & restructuring, to infrastructure & real estate advisory and sustainability-driven innovation.If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real-world impact — and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ — Strategy & Transactions is your next move.The teamOur Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate & Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy & Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation.Strategy professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data-driven choices about where to play and how to win, in order to drive growth and enterprise value.Work you will do: Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go-to-market strategies, channel strategies, and pricing strategies. As a Technology Strategy Consultant, you will:·       Provide strategic direction, understand business goals, and define how architecture can be leveraged to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and business growth for client organizations·       Work closely with clients to solve strategic issues pertaining to Enterprise Architecture and ensure technology architecture aligns with the broader technology and business strategiesRequired Experience and SkillsEnterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (Technology Architecture and Platforms - Enterprise Architecture) ·       Assessment, setting up and operationalizing of the Enterprise Architecture capability o    EA maturity assessment o    EA operating model and roadmapo    Blueprinting of the Architecture landscape across business, application, data, technology domains·       Selecting and implementing one or more EA tools such as Orbus, LeanIX, Planview·       Setting up and operationalizing EA governance bodies such as the Architecture review board (ARB) and the technology standards board (TSB)·       Application and platform managemento    Application/platform landscape assessmento    Application/platform selectiono    Portfolio application rationalization·       Strong technology strategy athlete with the ability to build line of sight from business to technology and drive strategic conversations with senior business and IT leaders.·       Ability to develop reference architectures for modern digital technologies like GenAI, IoT etc.·       Good understanding of data architecture, data governance, and data related technology concepts like ETL, data lake·       Exposure to technology infrastructure services (on-prem and cloud) and the ability to develop relevant conceptual and logical architecturesCore Consulting ·       Clear and concise communication - conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations.·       Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members·       Analytical thinking - ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.·       Logical structuring - structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems·       Deadline-oriented and quality focused - develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources·       Collaboration - Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate·       Network - ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.#FY27ReferralCampaignQualificationsRequired:·       MBA, MS, M. Tech. from a premier school in India or abroad, with a background in Information Technology·       Certifications like TOGAF, COBIT, ITIL are nice to have but not mandatory·       1-4 years of relevant experience required (post MBA / MS / MTech)

title: USI | RRF |EH| FY 27 | IM/CM - Operations | Consultant
description: Regulatory, Risk & ForensicOur Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team supports client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that help strengthen, protect, and transform organizations. Join our team and use advanced data, AI and emerging technologies with industry insights to help client service teams bring clarity from complexity and accelerate their path to value creation.Position SummaryLevel: Consultant or equivalentAs an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.Work you’ll do: As part of the team, you will engage closely with investment management and capital markets clients, gaining insights into their unique challenges, business contexts, and processes to devise solutions tailored to their needs. Also, an integral part of your responsibilities will encompass directing and overseeing Proof-of-Concept endeavors and consulting projects with our Process Intelligence prospects and clients. This includes defining business requirements, analyzing processes, preparing data, and deploying solutions. You will be responsible for transforming the operations of large, complex financial services organizations by analyzing the current state, identifying the gaps, building the suitable target state, and operating them further (as applicable). title: USI-EH27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Consultant-TS-AI Strategy
description: Job Description - Strategy & Transactions – Strategy (Consultant) Join Deloitte Strategy & Transactions – Where Strategy Meets Impact At Deloitte Strategy & Transactions (S&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth. We work with C-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most — from navigating complex M&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. We are trusted advisors during our clients' most critical, high-stakes moments. But we don’t stop at client impact — we are equally passionate about investing in our people. At S&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive. Our capabilities span the full lifecycle of transformation — from Enterprise and Growth Strategy to Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy, end-to-end M&A, valuation and modeling, and performance improvement & restructuring, to infrastructure & real estate advisory and sustainability-driven innovation. If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real-world impact — and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ — Strategy & Transactions is your next move. The Team Our Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate & Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy & Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation. Strategy professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data-driven choices about where to play and how to win, in order to drive growth and enterprise value.

description: IValua – Consultant, Technical TransformationJoin Deloitte’s Enterprise Performance practice as a Consultant, Ivalua, where you will support digital procurement transformation initiatives across source-to-pay environments. In this role, you will contribute to business process discovery, solution design, configuration, integration, testing, and deployment activities for Ivalua implementations. Map current-state processes, identify business gaps, and support future-state solution design aligned to Ivalua capabilities and client requirements. Support integrations between Ivalua and enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, or other enterprise resource planning systems, including web service and file-based interfaces. Support testing, defect triage, deployment, training, cutover, hypercare, and post-go-live stabilization activities across implementation and support engagements. Our professionals as part of the Supply Chain Network Operations (SCNO) service line within Enterprise Performance focus on helping organizations achieve sustainable competitive advantage throughout their operations, spanning product development, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution. By aligning high-level goals with frontline execution, we ensure our clients realize real value and improved performance across every stage of their supply chain and operations.Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / ChennaiShift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST, as per business requirementsQualificationsRequired: 3-6 years of experience implementing or supporting source-to-pay solutions, including Ivalua Experience supporting catalog content management, strategic sourcing, contract management, purchasing, and invoice-to-payment processes Experience conducting kick-off sessions and requirement-gathering workshops with business and project stakeholders Experience mapping business processes into solution workflows within Ivalua, Coupa, or SAP Ariba Experience supporting at least 3 implementation projects on current or recent versions of a source-to-pay platform Experience configuring or supporting digital procurement solutions across business and technical workstreams Bachelor of Engineering (BE), Bachelor of Technology (BTech), Master of Computer Applications (MCA), Master of Technology (MTech), or equivalent from an accredited university Preferred: Experience authoring functional specification documents and technical design documents Experience configuring Ivalua modules for sourcing, supplier management, contract lifecycle management, procurement, invoicing, or spend analysis Experience supporting low-code or workflow-based configuration within the Ivalua platform Experience building or supporting integrations using REST, SOAP, or file-based interfaces with enterprise resource planning systems Experience supporting system integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover, hypercare, or release planning activities Experience supporting direct spend, taxonomy management, approval workflows, or buying channel design #SCNOFY27LinkedInbanner

title: USI - EH27 - Product Engineering - GenAI Engineer - Software Specialist Engineer II
description: GenAI - Software Specialist Engineer IIRole Overview: As a GenAI Engineer, you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to multiple high-visibility projects. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering solutions that delight customers and users, while also driving tangible value for Deloitte's business investments. You will leverage your extensive GenAI & engineering craftmanship across multiple programming languages and modern frameworks, consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy advanced software solutions.Key Responsibilities:Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations. Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring code integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals. Lead requirement analysis, component design, development, unit testing, integrations, and support. Engineering Craftsmanship: Maintain accountability for the integrity of code design, implementation, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks with significant focus on infusing AI/ML/GenAI where possible/appropriate. Create technical specifications, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code ensuring all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.Customer-Centric Engineering: Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time.Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a learning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions. Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.Advanced Technical Proficiency: Possess deep expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including AI/ML/GenAI, Agile methodologies and DevSecOps to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from code check-in to production with all quality checks through SDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Demonstrate understanding of the full lifecycle product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.Domain Expertise: Quickly acquire domain-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs, architectures, and UX/UI designs into technical specifications and code. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.Effective Communication and Influence: Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.Key Qualifications:§  A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline. An advanced degree (e.g., MS) is preferred but not required. Experience is the most relevant factor.§  Strong software engineering foundation with deep understanding of OOPs, data-structure, algorithms, code instrumentations, beautiful coding practices etc.§  5+ years of experience with AI/ML, with last 2 years focused on GenAI as well as technologies like OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, LangChain, Agents, Vector databases, and approaches like Prompt Engineering, fine-tuning, etc. §  Proven experience in: Python, R, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, Julia, ML libraries, NLP, etc.§  Proven experience with big data technologies, Angular, React, NodeJS, Python, C#, .NET Core, Java, Golang, SQL/NoSQL.§  Proven experience with cloud-native engineering, using FaaS/PaaS/micro-services on cloud hyper-scalers like Azure, AWS, and GCP.§  Strong understanding of methodologies & tools like, XP, Lean, SAFe, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, etc.§  Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.How You will Grow: At Deloitte, our professional development plans focus on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day and excel in everything they do.#ProductEngineeringFY26 #CAP-DS#CAP-NJ#CAP-AJ

title: USI | RRF |EH| FY 27 | IM/CM - Operations | Analyst
description: Regulatory, Risk & ForensicOur Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team supports client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that help strengthen, protect, and transform organizations. Join our team and use advanced data, AI and emerging technologies with industry insights to help client service teams bring clarity from complexity and accelerate their path to value creation.Position SummaryLevel: Analyst or equivalentAs an experienced Analyst at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Work you’ll do: As part of the team, you will engage closely with investment management and capital markets clients, gaining insights into their unique challenges, business contexts, and processes to devise solutions tailored to their needs. Also, an integral part of your responsibilities will encompass directing and overseeing Proof-of-Concept endeavors and consulting projects with our Process Intelligence prospects and clients. This includes defining business requirements, analyzing processes, preparing data, and deploying solutions. You will be responsible for transforming the operations of large, complex financial services organizations by analyzing the current state, identifying the gaps, building the suitable target state, and operating them further (as applicable). Additionally, you will be involved in the process of identifying, evaluating, and mitigating potential risks that could hinder the organization’s objectives. You will also be expected to work in large teams, driving client conversations and providing regular updates to client as well as Deloitte leadership.The team: Our Enterprise & Operations Risk professionals help organizations effectively navigate business risks and opportunities—from strategic, reputation, and financial risks to operational and regulatory risks—to gain competitive advantage. We apply our experience in ongoing business operations and corporate lifecycle events to help clients become stronger and more resilient. Our market-leading teams help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries. We help organizations in their efforts to achieve regulatory and legal compliance and transform their departments to add greater value to the business. We combine highly specialized skills focused on process, risk and controls to produce transformative insights. Our teamEnable profitable growth and competitive advantage by optimizing “heart of the business” operations.Leverage deep domain expertise to extend enterprise resilience, agility, and remediation.Drive enterprise- wide impact across strategy, operations, performance, and reputation.QualificationsMust Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: Minimum of 3 years of relevant industry experience is required. Relevant experience should be with a financial services consulting organization or a large bank or a broker-dealer or an investment management firm, or the Global Capability Centres (GCCs) of these financial services firms.Experience and understanding of the U.S. or International Banking and Securities and Wealth Management industry. Understanding of derivatives—including Swaps, Options, Forwards, and Futures—across asset classes (Equities, Fixed Income, Foreign Exchange, Commodities).Experience in Trade Life Cycle (Onboarding/Trade Confirmation/Reconciliation/Corporate Actions/ Settlement/Transfers/Reporting) of Securities (Equities, Fixed Income, Foreign Exchange, Derivatives), Order/Execution Management Systems, and Front Office Support.Experience of end-to-end onboarding of institutional clients for derivatives products, including KYC/AML Due Diligence, Account Setup, Legal/Agreement Negotiation (e.g., ISDA/CSA documentation), Operational Go-Live.Exposure in one or more of the key areas in Capital Markets and Investment Management domains, such as Compliance Testing, Investment Compliance, Conduct Risk, Security Operations, Wealth Management Operations.Experience of working or a good knowledge of regulations pertaining to the U.S. or International Banking or Capital Markets or Investment Management Regulators (e.g. SEC, FINRA, DOL, FCA, and CFTC).Experience in driving large transformation/implementation and expertise in all aspects of requirement gathering, data analysis, and gap analysis including analyzing requirements and breaking them down into actionable functional specifications, converting business requirements into test cases and coordinating testing.Hands-on experience of industry OMS/tools like Aladdin, CRD, Chronograph, Yardi, Simcorp, Arcesium, efront, PAM etc.Strong problem-solving, analytical, stakeholder management and presentation skills to navigate through complex business scenarios and recommend effective mitigation strategies and action plans.Good communication skills with the ability to articulate complex financial information and proficiency in documenting findings and effectively communicating risk and control issues to stakeholders.Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: ·       Prior external or internal consulting experience is highly valued. ·       Experience of working on Request for Proposals (RFPs) is desirable.·       Flexible and dynamic in nature and able to turn around work quickly. Expertise on systems (such as Calypso, Murex, MarkitWire, or similar platforms) for booking, affirmation, and reconciliation of derivatives trades.Experience of working on accounting platforms for Private Equity and Real Estate sectors, along with exposure to Collateral Management.Experience of working on process transformation and solution design using GenAI/Agentic AI across Middle and Back-office functions.Education: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Management, or another related field from accredited university. Master’s degree in finance, Business Analytics, IT, or Master of Business Administration (MBA) is preferred CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) or FRM (Financial Risk Manager) certification is preferredLocation: Bengaluru/HyderabadShift Timings:   As per business requirements

We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutionsPosition SummaryLevel: SAP TM ConsultantAs an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.  Work you’ll do:As an SAP TM Consultant you will be responsible for successful delivery of SAP TM technology/process deliverables. You will be expected to have hands-on experience and knowledge of transportation planning, execution, and settlement processes as well as technology design, build, integration, test and deployment efforts for various tools/technologies. You will have an opportunity to enhance your full lifecycle of the engagements. You will be responsible for: Gathering the business requirements from the client Performing the Fit-Gap Analysis and identifying the custom developments required to meet the client requirements Designing the system as per client needs including configuring the system and writing functional specifications Involvement in all the testing phases including Unit test, regression test, user acceptance test Regular interaction with the client for day-to-day activities Active participation in the cutover, Go-Live and Hyper-care activities The Team:Offering customer-tailored services and deep industry insights, at Deloitte Consulting LLP we help clients tackle their most complex challenges enabling them to seize new growth opportunities, reduce costs, improve efficiencies, and stay ahead of customer demand. Developing and executing our clients’ strategic vision, we help them dramatically improve their business performance across a broad range of specialties - enterprise model design, global business services, outsourcing, real estate, and location strategy. Learn more about our Business Model Transformation practice. Qualifications:Must have Skills:3-6 Years of hands-on experience with SAP TMFunctional knowledge of the transportation logistics lifecycle including Inbound and Outbound transportation processes and TM Master dataImplementation experience of SAP TM solution Technical knowledge of the SAP TM infrastructure and integration with EWM/GTS Technical knowledge of different SAP TM modules such as Order management, freight planning & execution, and freight settlement Working experience of at least one implementation project using the most recent version of SAP TM Should have experience of running a Blueprint Workshop and should be able to map Business Processes  Good Communication Skills Education: ·       BE/B. title: USI-FY27-Consulting-EP-SAP-CPI- Sr Consultant
description: SAP CPI-PI Consultant SAP CPI Consultant will be responsible for custom interface design/development while adhering to established processes and simultaneously handling critical situations. Candidate will be willing to take up challenges, understand key business areas, propose alternatives and suggestions to make solution sustainable, and develop competency for the team. He/she will have the skills required to become a successful technical architect and be part of complex global implementations. Moreover, features that can transfigure an individual’s potential to upraise an organization to the next level is imperative. Work you’ll doAs a developer you will be expected to design/develop end to end interfaces across different process areas.Being a CMMI certified organization there is a major focus on the quality of the deliverables. The developer will be expected to complete all the required documentation during the build phase and also take care of review activities including self-review and peer review. Primary job functions include:Functional specification reviewsPreparation of technical specificationTranslating technical specification to InterfacesTechnical unit testingDocumentationTracking timesheetsUsing project management tools – as trainedInteracting with functional teams for issue resolutionCapturing MOM during technical review meetings The teamSAP Service Line at Deloitte is one of the largest and most experienced SAP integrators in the world with 8000 global SAP practitioners. Our SAP practice has executed more than 1,700 SAP implementation projects worldwide. More than 50% of our SAP consultants have 10+ years of SAP implementation experience. Deloitte has held the highest level of strategic alliance designated by SAP, Global Partner — Services, since 1989.We have nine solution centers for SAP demos, research, and outsourcing and also have developed a number of proprietary tools and accelerators that contribute significantly to our ability to help our clients compress project timelines and deliver high quality SAP services. Our SAP Practice offers a complete range of implementation services — from business case development and system design to configuration, testing and deployment. Our SAP delivery capabilities are accessed at CMMI level 5 and SAS 70 certification. SAP offerings include – SAP ECC, CRM, SRM, ICH, Portal, Netweaver, BO, SAP Development and BASIS & Infrastructure and covers all functional areas and industry verticals. . Learn more about Deloitte Consulting. Must have:  ·         6-10 years of experience in SAP Cloud Platform Integration.·         Experience with 2-3 full lifecycle implementation and complex integrations with SAP and non SAP systems·         Good exposure in Cloud Integration Suite capabilities like in SAP API Management, Event Mesh, Open Connectors & Integration Advisor.·         Expertise on Cloud to Cloud and Cloud to on premise integrations using SAP CPI.·         Strong hands on experience in developing custom interfaces with SAP CPI using various tools on the Palette.·         Expertise in Java scripts, Groovy scripts, XSLT & graphical mapping.·         Exposure to various business scenarios (A2A and B2B) and expertise in handling integrations using SFSF, ODATA, SFTP, IDOC, SOAP, HTTP, Process Direct, REST Adapters·         Sound knowledge in handling security artifacts, encryption and decryption mechanisms.·         Good understanding of Business Process Knowledge and experience in troubleshooting technical problems   Responsibilities: ·         Gathers specifications from the business and functional departments and deliver the solution that meets the needs presented·         Interprets business and functional requirements and develops technical specifications documentation·         Must be able to work on custom integration as well as standard integration packages·         Must be aware of SAP CPI support activities·         Must be able to perform root cause analysis of any re-occurring or critical issues and proposing solutions for them·         Performs Unit, System and Integration testing at the various phases of the project lifecycle and document the results of the testing process·         Contribute into SAP CPI integration support in complex, business critical situations as area SME  How you’ll growAt Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in exactly the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team-based learning, and eLearning. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state-of-the-art, world-class learning Center in the Hyderabad offices is an extension of the Deloitte University (DU) in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development.Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India BenefitsAt Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you. Deloitte’s cultureOur positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer well-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives.  Learn more about Life at Deloitte. Corporate citizenshipDeloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people and our communities.  We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities.  Learn more about Deloitte’s impact on the world.#FY27SAPOPENROLES

title: USI-EH27-Consulting Services-AI&E-EaaS-ETST-Strategy, Growth, and Transformation II-Enterprise Technology Strategy and Transformation
description: Artificial Intelligence & Engineering AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations. Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses. Position Summary Role: Strategy, Growth, and Transformation IIAs a Strategy, Growth, and Transformation II professional on Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for: Supporting technology modernization engagements, including current-state assessment, application rationalization, workload evaluation, and roadmap development Contributing to product engineering and operating model transformation efforts, including backlog definition, governance design, and Agile delivery support Analyzing client technology environments across cloud, AI, infrastructure, and enterprise platforms to identify improvement opportunities and implementation priorities Developing business cases, financial analyses, and value assessments, including total cost of ownership and return on investment considerations Collaborating with project teams, stakeholders, and offshore/onshore resources to deliver work products, conduct reviews, and support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement The teamEngineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/KolkataShift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST as per business requirementsQualificationsRequired: 3-6 years of experience in technology modernization advisory, including technology strategy, application rationalization, workload assessment, vendor evaluation, and modernization roadmap development Experience in product engineering transformation and product operating model design, including product vision, backlog management, governance, and Agile delivery Experience evaluating and improving technology or product operating models to address governance, collaboration, and operating performance Experience in engineering workforce transformation, including capability assessment, role redesign, upskilling initiatives, and engineering metrics development Experience in cloud migration and modernization strategy, including cloud suitability assessment, migration planning, and modernization approaches Experience performing information technology and cloud financial analysis, including total cost of ownership, return on investment, and FinOps assessments MBA or Master of Science degree Preferred: Experience in artificial intelligence strategy, including GenAI use case assessment and technology adoption planning Experience in data center strategy, resiliency planning, or disaster recovery strategy Experience in enterprise technologies, including cloud, Agile, DevOps, continuous integration and continuous deployment, business intelligence, or mainframe modernization Experience leading client interviews, workshops, research, or structured problem-solving activities in a consulting environment Experience supporting proposals, request for proposal responses, solution design, or stakeholder presentations Entry-level certifications in cloud, Agile, project management, architecture, data, artificial intelligence, GenAI, or FinOps#FY27ReferralCampaign #EAAS #AIE2027

description: SAP CPI-PI Consultant SAP CPI Consultant will be responsible for custom interface design/development while adhering to established processes and simultaneously handling critical situations. Candidate will be willing to take up challenges, understand key business areas, propose alternatives and suggestions to make solution sustainable, and develop competency for the team. He/she will have the skills required to become a successful technical architect and be part of complex global implementations. Moreover, features that can transfigure an individual’s potential to upraise an organization to the next level is imperative. Work you’ll doAs a developer you will be expected to design/develop end to end interfaces across different process areas.Being a CMMI certified organization there is a major focus on the quality of the deliverables. The developer will be expected to complete all the required documentation during the build phase and also take care of review activities including self-review and peer review. Primary job functions include:Functional specification reviewsPreparation of technical specificationTranslating technical specification to InterfacesTechnical unit testingDocumentationTracking timesheetsUsing project management tools – as trainedInteracting with functional teams for issue resolutionCapturing MOM during technical review meetings The teamSAP Service Line at Deloitte is one of the largest and most experienced SAP integrators in the world with 8000 global SAP practitioners. Our SAP practice has executed more than 1,700 SAP implementation projects worldwide. More than 50% of our SAP consultants have 10+ years of SAP implementation experience. Deloitte has held the highest level of strategic alliance designated by SAP, Global Partner — Services, since 1989.We have nine solution centers for SAP demos, research, and outsourcing and also have developed a number of proprietary tools and accelerators that contribute significantly to our ability to help our clients compress project timelines and deliver high quality SAP services. Our SAP Practice offers a complete range of implementation services — from business case development and system design to configuration, testing and deployment. Our SAP delivery capabilities are accessed at CMMI level 5 and SAS 70 certification. SAP offerings include – SAP ECC, CRM, SRM, ICH, Portal, Netweaver, BO, SAP Development and BASIS & Infrastructure and covers all functional areas and industry verticals. . Learn more about Deloitte Consulting. Must have:  ·         2-6 years of experience in SAP Cloud Platform Integration.·         Experience with 2-3 full lifecycle implementation and complex integrations with SAP and non SAP systems·         Good exposure in Cloud Integration Suite capabilities like in SAP API Management, Event Mesh, Open Connectors & Integration Advisor.·         Expertise on Cloud to Cloud and Cloud to on premise integrations using SAP CPI.·         Strong hands on experience in developing custom interfaces with SAP CPI using various tools on the Palette.·         Expertise in Java scripts, Groovy scripts, XSLT & graphical mapping.·         Exposure to various business scenarios (A2A and B2B) and expertise in handling integrations using SFSF, ODATA, SFTP, IDOC, SOAP, HTTP, Process Direct, REST Adapters·         Sound knowledge in handling security artifacts, encryption and decryption mechanisms.·         Good understanding of Business Process Knowledge and experience in troubleshooting technical problems   Responsibilities: ·         Gathers specifications from the business and functional departments and deliver the solution that meets the needs presented·         Interprets business and functional requirements and develops technical specifications documentation·         Must be able to work on custom integration as well as standard integration packages·         Must be aware of SAP CPI support activities·         Must be able to perform root cause analysis of any re-occurring or critical issues and proposing solutions for them·         Performs Unit, System and Integration testing at the various phases of the project lifecycle and document the results of the testing process·         Contribute into SAP CPI integration support in complex, business critical The role is suited for professionals with experience in identity lifecycle management, system integration, and access governance.Work you'll doAs a Senior Consultant - OIM on the Digital Trust & Privacy team, you will be responsible for… Designing, developing, and maintaining One Identity Manager configurations, workflows, and connectors Building Angular-based interfaces for identity self-service and administrative functions Integrating One Identity Manager with Active Directory, Azure, ServiceNow, human resources systems, and databases through Representational State Transfer (REST) application programming interfaces and custom connectors Supporting identity lifecycle activities, including onboarding, provisioning, approvals, recertification, access reviews, and role assignments Implementing and supporting access governance capabilities, including business roles, segregation of duties controls, and application onboarding The teamDigital Trust & PrivacyThe cyber risk services—IAM practice helps organizations in designing, developing, and implementing industry-leading IAM solutions to protect their information and confidential data, as well as help them build their businesses and supporting technologies to be more secure, vigilant, and resilient. The cyber risk services—IAM team delivers service to clients through following key areas of IAM: Application Onboarding Lifecycle Manager Compliance Manager Password Management Automated Provisioning Roles Management ITSM tools Integration Advanced Authentication Methods Strategy and Road Map One Identity Manager Location: Hyd/Blr/Chn/PunShift Timings: General Shift, ISTQualificationsRequired: 5+ years of experience with One Identity Manager, including configuration, customization, and integration Experience developing custom workflows, connectors, or application programming interface integrations in One Identity Manager Experience building web interfaces using Angular Experience integrating identity and access management platforms with Active Directory, Azure, ServiceNow, human resources systems, or databases Experience supporting identity lifecycle processes, including onboarding, provisioning, approvals, recertification, and access reviews Experience with role-based access control, business role modeling, or segregation of duties controls Bachelor of Technology, Master of Technology, Master of Science, or Master of Business Administration Preferred: Experience in cloud or hybrid identity and access management environments Experience with Azure role-based access control, privileged identity management, service principals, or app registrations Experience integrating with ServiceNow or information technology service management tools Experience onboarding applications, shared mailboxes, distribution groups, file shares, local non-personal accounts, or database assets into identity platforms#Cyber_Digital Trust & Privacy#CA-TD
